NVDA.title: US Expands AI Chip Export Restrictions to Chinese Firms' Overseas Subsidiaries
NVDA.content: US DoC issued guidance confirming export license requirements for advanced AI chips (including Nvidia Blackwell) apply to all firms with Chinese parent companies, regardless of where overseas subsidiaries operate — closing a loophole that allowed chip acquisition through third-country affiliates.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA and IREN Announce Strategic Partnership to Deploy up to 5 Gigawatts of AI Infrastructure
NVDA.content: NVIDIA and IREN intend to deploy next-generation AI infrastructure across IREN's global data center pipeline. IREN issued NVIDIA a 5-year right to purchase up to 30M shares at $70/share ($2.1B potential equity investment).

NVDA.title: NVIDIA and Corning Announce Multiyear Partnership to Expand U.S. Optical Manufacturing 10x for AI Infrastructure
NVDA.content: Corning to increase U.S. optical connectivity manufacturing capacity by 10x and U.S. fiber production by 50%+, building 3 new facilities in North Carolina and Texas, creating 3,000+ jobs.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 Earnings Preview: Analysts Expect $78.8B Revenue on May 20
NVDA.content: Wall Street expects $78.8B revenue and $1.77 EPS for Q1 FY2027 (ends April 2026). Stock up ~15% YTD but underperforming Intel and AMD. Earnings scheduled May 20.

NVDA.title: Congress Advances AI OVERWATCH Act to Restrict Blackwell Chip Sales to China, Iran, Russia for 2 Years
NVDA.content: House Foreign Affairs Committee advanced the AI OVERWATCH Act, treating NVDA Blackwell chip exports like weapons sales; would prohibit sales to entities of concern (China, Iran, NK, Russia, Venezuela) for 2 years. Direct regulatory risk for NVDA.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Ships First Vera Rubin Samples; DeepSeek Blackwell Violation Heightens Export Scrutiny Ahead of May 20 Earnings
NVDA.content: NVIDIA shipped first Vera Rubin architecture samples to customers this week — successor to Blackwell delivering up to 10x lower inference token cost and 4x fewer GPUs needed to train MoE models. Separately, Reuters reported DeepSeek trained its latest model on Blackwell chips in apparent export control violation, intensifying Washington regulatory scrutiny ahead of NVDA's May 20 Q1 FY2027 earnings ($78.8B revenue guide).

NVDA.title: Nvidia H200 Chip Shipments Resume to China; ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent Clear 400,000+ Units
NVDA.content: Nvidia is preparing to ship 82,000 H200 AI GPUs to China under revised US export controls allowing H200 sales on a case-by-case basis at 25% tariff. China approved imports for ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent totaling 400,000+ units — a major demand reopening ahead of May 20 earnings.

NVDA.title: Jensen Huang Not Invited on Trump China Delegation — AI Chip Export Easing to China Unlikely Near-Term
NVDA.content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was excluded from Trump's May 13-15 China state visit delegation (Tim Cook and Elon Musk included). Huang said he would join if invited but received no invitation. Analysts: Huang's absence signals AI semiconductor exports to China remain a sensitive category unlikely to recover soon; White House focused on agriculture and commercial aviation, not advanced AI chips. NVDA Q1 FY2027 earnings May 20, $78.8B revenue consensus.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Stock Hits All-Time High $227.84; Market Cap Reaches $5.4 Trillion Ahead of May 20 Earnings
NVDA.content: NVDA hit intraday ATH $227.84 on May 13, pushing market cap to $5.4 trillion. 37 analysts rate Strong Buy with $272 consensus target. Earnings scheduled May 20; consensus calls for $78.8B revenue and $1.77 EPS. China H200 stalled; Jensen Huang excluded from Trump China delegation.

NVDA.title: Trump-Xi Summit May 14-15: H200 AI Chip Sales Cleared to ~10 Chinese Firms; US-China Tariffs Cut 145%→30%
NVDA.content: US-China trade truce (May 12) cut US tariffs 145%→30%, China tariffs 125%→10%. At Trump-Xi summit May 14-15, Washington cleared H200 GPU sales to ~10 Chinese firms (Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance). Blackwell controls NOT lifted. Semiconductor export controls, rare earth restrictions, and antitrust probes vs Nvidia/Qualcomm/Intel remain on negotiating table.

NVDA.title: Nvidia Earnings Preview May 20: Analysts Expect $79.2B Revenue; 97% Beat Probability Priced In
NVDA.content: Q1 FY2027 earnings due after market close May 20; analysts project $79.2B revenue (+86% YoY), $1.78 adjusted EPS. Top hyperscalers raised AI capex guidance to $725B combined. H200 China sales approved for ~10 firms.

NVDA.title: US Government Approves Nvidia H200 Chip Exports to China; ~10 Firms Cleared, 75,000-Unit Cap Per Customer
NVDA.content: Commerce Department cleared ~10 Chinese firms including Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance to purchase H200 chips, capped at 75,000 units each. China shipments must not exceed half of domestic US sales.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 Record Earnings: Revenue $81.6B (+85% YoY), Data Center $75.2B (+92%); Q2 Guidance ~$91B; $80B Buyback Added
NVDA.content: Q1 FY2027 (ended April 2026): Revenue $81.6B beat $78.8B est (+85% YoY); Data Center $75.2B (+92% YoY). GAAP EPS $2.39 beat $1.75 est; GAAP GM 74.9%. Q2 guidance ~$91B ±2%, mid-70% GM, no assumed China DC compute revenue. $80B buyback authorization added; dividend raised to $0.25/share.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Stock Falls 0.9% Day After Record Q1 FY2027 Earnings; Fourth Consecutive Post-Earnings Slide
NVDA.content: Despite record Q1 FY2027 results ($81.6B revenue, $2.39 EPS, Q2 guide $91B), NVDA stock declined 0.9% on May 21 — fourth consecutive post-earnings decline. Analysts called it a "garden variety beat"; market had priced in perfection. Q2 guidance excludes China data center compute revenue.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Names Suzanne Nora Johnson to Board of Directors Effective July 13; Market Cap Reaches $5.22 Trillion
NVDA.content: NVIDIA appointed Suzanne Nora Johnson (former Goldman Sachs vice chairman, RAND Corporation chair) to its board of directors, effective July 13, 2026. As of May 24, NVIDIA's market cap reached $5.22 trillion following Q1 FY2027 blowout ($81.6B revenue, +85% YoY; Q2 guide $91B). Stock up 11%+ month-to-date and ~20% YTD.

NVDA.title: Nvidia's NVLink Fusion Architecture Enters CPU Market — Analysts: NVDA Now Competes with Intel and AMD in Server CPUs
NVDA.content: Nvidia's NVLink Fusion, revealed at Q1 FY2027 earnings, allows third-party Arm-based CPUs to connect to Nvidia GPUs at near-NVLink bandwidth — positioning NVDA to compete directly in CPU markets against Intel and AMD. Analysts estimate Nvidia CPU revenue could reach 0B in 2026, matching Intel and exceeding AMD's CPU segment immediately upon ramp.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Targets $200B CPU Market with Vera Rubin Platform; Jensen Forecasts $20B Standalone CPU Sales in 2026
NVDA.content: CEO Jensen Huang: Vera Rubin platform opens a brand-new $200B CPU TAM for NVIDIA — a market never addressed before. Every major hyperscaler partnering on deployment. NVIDIA predicts $20B in standalone CPU sales in 2026, with Rubin shipments starting Q3. China included in the $200B forecast.

NVDA.title: Nvidia Computex 2026: Vera CPU for AI Agents, RTX Spark Superchip for AI PCs; $0.25 Quarterly Dividend
NVDA.content: Jensen Huang keynote at Computex: Vera CPU (Arm-based, 80% faster agentic tasks than x86, targeting $200B TAM/$20B FY revenue); RTX Spark PC superchip (Blackwell GPU + Arm N1X) shipping in 30+ laptops/10+ desktops fall 2026. Dividend $0.25/share, ex-date June 4.

NVDA.title: Nvidia Computex Day 2: Vera Rubin NVL72 Full Production Confirmed; Spectrum-X Co-Packaged Optics Ships; Cosmos 3 Robotics Launched
NVDA.content: Nvidia confirmed Vera Rubin NVL72 is in full production. Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics (co-packaged optics next-gen switching) also entered full production. NVIDIA Cosmos 3 for robotics unveiled. DLSS 4.5 expanding to 11 new titles including Marvel Rivals and Phantom Blade Zero.

NVDA.title: US BIS Tightens Blackwell Export Controls to Chinese Company Overseas Subsidiaries; Closes Re-Export Loophole
NVDA.source: GuruFocus / Bureau of Industry and Security
NVDA.content: Effective May 31-June 1, US Commerce Dept/BIS issued new rules requiring export licenses for Nvidia Blackwell-class AI chips sold to overseas subsidiaries of Chinese companies — closing a loophole that allowed purchases through non-China entities. AMD chips similarly affected. Expands existing China restrictions to global Chinese corporate subsidiaries, adding material data center revenue uncertainty. NVDA Q2 FY2027 guidance already excludes China DC compute revenue.

NVDA.title: Senator Warren Invites Jensen Huang to Senate Banking Committee Hearing June 11 on China AI Chip Exports
NVDA.content: Sen. Elizabeth Warren invited Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on June 11, citing concerns about AI chip exports to China and export control compliance. Warren's letter referenced DeepSeek training on Blackwell chips and the Super Micro smuggling case. NVDA shares slipped ~1% after-hours on the news.

NVDA.title: NVDA Falls 2-3% on June 5; Director Mark Stevens Sells 500K Shares ($110M); Taiwan Detains 3 in Super Micro AI Server Smuggling Case
NVDA.content: Nvidia shares fell 2-3% on June 5. Headwinds included: director Mark Stevens sold 500,000 shares for ~$109.9M; Taiwan authorities detained 3 individuals for fraudulent declarations while exporting Super Micro AI servers (containing Nvidia chips) to China; Jensen Huang publicly urged Super Micro to improve export compliance. Broader chip equipment sector also sold off (AMAT -7.3%, LRCX -7.5%, KLAC -6.15%).

NVDA.title: NVIDIA and SK Hynix Announce Multiyear Technology Partnership to Advance Memory for AI Factories
NVDA.content: NVIDIA and SK hynix will codevelop next-generation memory for Vera Rubin AI supercomputers, Vera CPUs, RTX Spark PCs and Jetson Thor robotics platforms. Partnership accelerates semiconductor design and manufacturing for global AI factory buildout; SK hynix HBM4 already certified for Vera Rubin.

NVDA.title: Nvidia and LG Group Sign AI Factory Partnership Covering Humanoid Robotics and Data Centers
NVDA.content: Jensen Huang met LG Chairman Koo Kwang-mo in Seoul on June 8, signing a collaboration spanning humanoid robot motor/mechanical systems and data center architecture. The two companies will build an autonomous manufacturing ecosystem via AI and digital twins.

NVDA.title: NAVER Teams Up With Nvidia to Build Gigawatt-Scale AI Factory — Asian CoreWeave
NVDA.content: NAVER and Nvidia agreed to jointly build a gigawatt-class AI factory using NVIDIA DSX, starting from a 55 MW expansion at NAVER's GAK Sejong data center, positioning NAVER as a sovereign AI infrastructure provider across Asia.

NVDA.title: US Commerce Department Closes Loophole Allowing Nvidia Blackwell Chips to Reach Chinese Firms' Overseas Units
NVDA.content: BIS announced enforcement of license requirements for advanced AI chips sold to China-headquartered firms operating outside China, closing a gap that allowed Blackwell chips to flow to Chinese-linked entities in Malaysia and elsewhere.

NVDA.title: Nvidia Announces $80B Share Buyback Windfall for Shareholders Alongside Record Earnings
NVDA.content: Alongside Q1 FY2027 earnings, Nvidia authorized $80B in additional share repurchases—the largest buyback in company history—paired with a landmark 2,400% dividend hike, reflecting surging free cash flow from Blackwell and Vera Rubin AI chip demand.

NVDA.title: Nvidia Launches $25 Billion Bond Offering — Largest Debt Deal in Company History
NVDA.content: Nvidia announced a $25B investment-grade bond issuance, its first since 2021, in 7 tranches (2–30 year maturities). Investor demand exceeded $85B (3x+ oversubscribed). Proceeds primarily for debt refinancing.

NVDA.title: Nvidia Unveils RTX Spark Superchip for Windows AI PCs, Entering Consumer PC Processor Market
NVDA.content: Nvidia debuted the RTX Spark Superchip (Grace CPU + Blackwell GPU) for Windows laptops/desktops. Partners: Dell, Lenovo, ASUS, HP for fall 2026. First Nvidia entry into consumer PC processors, directly competing with Intel and AMD.

NVDA.title: Nvidia RTX Spark PC Chip Entry Triggers Intel and AMD Selloffs on June 16
NVDA.content: AMD and Intel fell 4-6% on June 16 as Nvidia RTX Spark — combining Grace CPU with Blackwell GPU for Windows PCs — raised investor concerns about market share risk for both chipmakers ahead of fall 2026 OEM launches.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA and HPE Expand AI Infrastructure Partnership at HPE Discover; Vultr Selects Joint Platform
NVDA.content: At HPE Discover Las Vegas (June 16-18), NVIDIA and HPE announced expanded AI infrastructure collaboration. Cloud provider Vultr selected HPE-NVIDIA platform for large-scale AI datacenter deployments.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA 2026 Annual Stockholder Meeting Set for June 24; Agenda: Blackwell/Vera Ramp Outlook, Capital Return Plans; Open to Individual Investors Online
NVDA.content: NVIDIA年度股东大会将于北京时间6月25日凌晨举行，议程包括选举十名董事、批准高管薪酬及审视Blackwell/Vera产能爬坡进展与资本回报计划。任何个人均可线上注册参会。

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Unveils 35 Vera Rubin AI Supercomputers Across 23 European Countries at ISC 2026
NVDA.content: At ISC High Performance 2026 in Hamburg, NVIDIA announced 35 Vera Rubin-based AI supercomputers under development across 23 European countries — the continent's largest single-year supercomputing expansion, delivering over 7 exaflops of AI compute per rack and serving more than 3 million researchers.

NVDA.title: CHIPS Act: $150M Award Finalized for xLight EUV Lithography Laser Prototype at Albany Nanotech Complex
NVDA.content: US Department of Commerce finalized a $150M CHIPS and Science Act incentive award to xLight Inc. to build a next-generation free-electron laser (FEL) EUV prototype by 2028 at the Albany Nanotech Complex in New York, funded by the CHIPS Act. xLight was founded in 2021 and is led by former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger.

NVDA.title: Chip Security Act Gains Industry Support — Would Require Tracking Mechanisms in Advanced AI Chips
NVDA.content: A coalition of companies backing international technology shipment tracking sent a letter to Capitol Hill in support of the Chip Security Act (CSA), which would require advanced AI chips to incorporate stronger security mechanisms to close loopholes in US export control regimes and prevent diversion to unauthorized end-users.

NVDA.title: Great American Artificial Intelligence Act of 2026 — Bipartisan 269-Page Discussion Draft Released
NVDA.content: Representatives Jay Obernolte (R-CA) and Lori Trahan (D-MA) released a 269-page bipartisan Great American AI Act of 2026 discussion draft, one of the most comprehensive federal AI regulatory proposals to date. Separately, a June 2 White House executive order established a voluntary framework for frontier AI developers to provide government early access to advanced models for national security assessments.

NVDA.title: ITIF Report: Section 232 Semiconductor Tariffs Would Reduce US GDP by $1.6 Trillion Over 10 Years
NVDA.content: The Information Technology and Innovation Foundation (ITIF) found a 25% semiconductor tariff would reduce cumulative US GDP by $1.6 trillion (3.9%) over 10 years and cut GDP per capita by $170 in year one. A 50% tariff would reduce GDP by $4.4 trillion cumulatively. ITIF recommends removing existing semiconductor tariffs and extending the 35% Investment Tax Credit through 2030 instead.

NVDA.title: Nvidia Denies Kyber NVL144 Delay Rumors; Goldman Reaffirms Buy Calling 21.7x P/E 'Compelling'
NVDA.content: NVIDIA shares gained over 1% after the company denied reports that its Kyber NVL144 rack-scale AI platform (the next-generation successor to Vera Rubin designed to link multiple GPUs) would be delayed until 2028. Goldman Sachs simultaneously reaffirmed its Buy rating, describing the current 21.7x forward P/E as compelling given AI infrastructure demand.

NVDA.title: Nvidia Cuts Approved Asian AI Chip Buyers by 50%+ as U.S. Export Controls Tighten; New Compliance White-List Introduced
NVDA.content: NVIDIA reduced by more than half authorized customers in Asia permitted to buy AI chips, strengthening compliance with tighter US export controls on Blackwell-series chips to China.

NVDA.title: Small Amount of NVIDIA H200 AI Chips Shipped to China With U.S. Government License Approval — Commerce Dept Confirms
NVDA.content: A limited number of H200 chips received US export license approval for Chinese customers; Commerce Under-Secretary Kessler described the shipments as "trivial" in quantity.

NVDA.title: Great News for Nvidia Stock Investors Despite Recent Share Price Pullback
NVDA.content: NVDA核心AI需求基本面持续强劲；近期回调被视为买入机会；7月29日将公布季度业绩，AI算力订单积压创历史新高

NVDA.title: Nvidia Stock NVDA Tests $200 Support as Chinese AI (Kimi K3) Competition Shakes Chip Rally
NVDA.content: 中国Kimi K3模型及AI支出担忧施压；费城半导体指数SOXX本周下跌约10%进入技术熊市；NVDA收于$202.81，盘前回升至$203.54

NVDA.title: One Date Nvidia Investors Should Not Overlook in July: July 29 Quarterly Report
NVDA.content: 7月29日为NVDA关键日期，届时将公布Q2 FY2027季度业绩；尽管短期市场压力，AI算力需求基本面依然坚实

NVDA.title: U.S. Government Issuing Export Licenses for NVIDIA H20 Chips to China
NVDA.content: Washington has begun issuing licenses allowing NVIDIA to resume sales of its H20 AI chips to China, reversing a key export restriction that had been a significant market headwind. The H20, designed to comply with export controls, reopens access to a major revenue opportunity for NVIDIA in the Chinese AI infrastructure market.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Supplier Wistron Opens $700M AI Server Factory in Fort Worth, Texas
NVDA.content: Wistron opened its first U.S. facility — a $700M, 324,000 sq ft plant in Fort Worth, TX — at a ceremony with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang. The plant is the first to mass-produce the NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra and Vera Rubin Superchips domestically, ramping to tens of thousands of computing boards per month. 500+ jobs created, targeting 1,000 by year-end.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Q2 Revenue Target ~$91B; Blackwell Sold Out Through Mid-2026, H200 China Shipments Begin
NVDA.content: NVIDIA guided Q2 FY2027 revenue at ~$91B following a record Q1 of $81.62B (92% Data Center). Blackwell architecture sold out through mid-2026. Goldman Sachs noted NVDA's 21.7x forward P/E is near S&P 500 average and 'compelling'. Company also began limited H200 AI accelerator shipments to China.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Discloses 9.3% Stake in AI Neocloud Company Nebius
NVDA.content: NVIDIA disclosed a 9.3% stake (~22.26 million shares) in Amsterdam-based AI infrastructure provider Nebius, stemming from its previously announced $2B March investment. Nebius shares surged ~19% to nearly $217 on the disclosure.

NVDA.title: At SIGGRAPH, NVIDIA Advances Graphics and Simulation With Agentic and Physical AI
NVDA.content: At SIGGRAPH 2026 (July 19-23), NVIDIA unveiled Cosmos 3 Edge on Jetson Thor, RTX Spark Superchip, DGX Station, MCP integration in Blender/Houdini/Unreal, and an AI Synthetic Video Detector NIM microservice for detecting AI-generated content.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA & SK Group Announce $500B+ AI Infrastructure and Memory Partnership
NVDA.content: 英伟达与SK集团签署逾5000亿美元战略合作备忘录，SK电信将建设2GW Vera Rubin AI工厂（2027年投产），SK海力士与英伟达联合开发下一代HBM内存，以锁定AI算力内存供应瓶颈。

NVDA.title: Jensen Huang Signs Toyota, Fanuc, Kioxia & 4 Other Japanese Industrial Giants Into NVIDIA Physical AI Coalition; Confirms Over $1T Demand Through 2027
NVDA.content: 黄仁勋与丰田、发那科、Kioxia等7家日本工业巨头签约，加入英伟达Cosmos物理AI联盟；英伟达披露2027年前已获超1万亿美元确定性订单需求，物理AI与工业机器人业务加速扩张。

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Invests ~$5B in Ilya Sutskever's Safe Superintelligence (SSI), Grants Priority Access to Next-Gen Vera Rubin Platform
NVDA.content: 英伟达与前OpenAI联创Ilya Sutskever旗下SSI宣布长期战略合作，彭博报道英伟达投资约50亿美元，并为SSI优先提供下一代Vera Rubin平台算力，SSI算力规模将提升数量级。这是SSI结束两年隐身模式后首个重大战略布局。

NVDA.title: SK Group and NVIDIA Announce $500 Billion-Plus Partnership for AI Factories and Next-Generation Memory
NVDA.content: SK Group and NVIDIA announced a $500B+ strategic partnership covering AI factory construction and next-gen memory supply. SK Telecom will build a 2GW AI factory in Korea using NVIDIA's DSX platform and Vera Rubin accelerators powered by SK Hynix HBM4. First facility planned for 2027.

NVDA.title: Nvidia's $750B AI Circular Financing Deals Revive Debt Concerns; NVDA Stock Falls ~5%
NVDA.content: NVIDIA discussed guaranteeing $250B in OpenAI lease payments for SoftBank's 10GW Ohio data center, plus a potential $350B chip financing deal — totaling $750B in 'circular' AI financing. AI skeptics argue such deals artificially inflate industry demand. NVDA credit default swaps hit highest since November. Stock fell ~5%.

NVDA.title: Semiconductor Sector Loses $1T in Market Cap; AI Spending Fears and Chinese DUV Mass-Production Report Drive Selloff
NVDA.content: Broad semiconductor selloff July 28: AMAT -7.82%, MU -8.4%, MRVL -7.4%, AMD -8.85%, NVDA down further. Philadelphia Semiconductor Index posted 4th consecutive decline (longest streak of 2026). Two catalysts: NVDA $750B circular financing controversy and reports of Chinese state-backed firm mass-producing DUV immersion lithography tools.

NVDA.title: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 Earnings Expected August 27 — Analysts Project EPS $0.94, Consensus Strong Buy at $302 Target
NVDA.content: NVDA expected to report Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 27, 2026. Analyst consensus (61 analysts): EPS $0.94 (+44.6% YoY), Strong Buy rating, average price target $302.83. Stock trading near $206.75. Deutsche Bank raised PT to $220. AI chip demand remains strong; Blackwell Data Center revenue is primary growth driver.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Closes $3 Billion Debt Tender Offer Upsized from $2.5 Billion
AVGO.content: Broadcom's cash tender offers expired June 17 with ~$5.5B tendered; upsized buyback from $2.5B to $3.0B, accepting $2.9B of notes. Settlement June 18. Reflects strong cash generation after record Q2 FY2026 AI revenue.

AVGO.title: Wall Street Shifts AI Chip Focus Away from Nvidia and Broadcom Toward Intel, AMD, Micron
AVGO.content: Investors rotating from premium-priced NVDA/AVGO toward cheaper AI chip plays. Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue hit $8.4B last quarter (+106% YoY), guiding $10.7B next quarter; CEO targets $100B AI sales by 2027.

AVGO.title: Bernstein: AI Agent Demand Drives Chip Demand 'Off the Charts'; Broadcom Custom ASIC Among Key Beneficiaries
AVGO.content: Bernstein analyst notes AI agent proliferation driving chip demand 'off the charts.' Broadcom's hyperscaler ASIC business (Google TPU, Meta MTIA) and network switching chips are structural beneficiaries as supply struggles to keep up.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 Preview: $22B Revenue Guidance (+47% YoY), AI Semiconductor Revenue to Reach $10.7B (+140%); Earnings June 3
AVGO.content: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 earnings scheduled June 3, 2026. Q2 revenue guided at $22B (+47% YoY), AI semiconductor revenue expected $10.7B (+140% YoY). CEO Hock Tan targets $100B AI chip revenue by 2027. AI revenue backlog $73B. AVGO shares up 115% YoY and 23% YTD as hyperscaler ASIC (Google TPU, Meta MTIA) and network chip demand accelerates.

AVGO.title: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan Reiterates $100B AI Chip Target for 2027; Custom ASIC Demand 'Unprecedented'
AVGO.content: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan reiterated the $100B AI chip revenue target for 2027, citing 'unprecedented' demand for custom ASIC solutions. Google TPU, Meta MTIA, and a third hyperscaler ASIC program in development. Q2 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue guided $10.7B (+140% YoY); June 3 earnings confirmed. AVGO backlog $73B with 18-month visibility.

AVGO.title: Wells Fargo Raises Broadcom Price Target to $545 from $430; AI Semiconductor Revenue Running 30-40% Above Prior Estimates
AVGO.content: Wells Fargo raised AVGO price target to $545 from $430, citing AI semiconductor revenue tracking 30-40% above prior estimates. Wolfe Research and Citi also raised targets to $500. AVGO rose 4.3% to new 52-week high $438. Year-to-date gain 26.1%.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Discloses Meta Partnership to Co-Develop 2nm Custom AI Chip; Citi Forecasts AI Revenue to Hit 81% of Sales by FY2028
AVGO.content: Broadcom disclosed partnership with Meta Platforms to co-develop a 2nm custom AI ASIC, expanding its hyperscaler ASIC client base beyond Google TPU. Citi forecasts Broadcom AI revenue growing from ~49% of total sales currently to ~81% by fiscal Q4 2028. Adds to existing Google TPU and Meta MTIA relationships.

AVGO.title: Analyst Raises Broadcom Target to $500; AI Revenue Doubled YoY to $8.4B; CEO Projects $100B AI Revenue in 2027
AVGO.content: Major bank raised AVGO target to $500 (from $475), Buy rating. AVGO Q1 FY2026: AI revenue $8.4B (+106% YoY), OpenAI joined named custom-silicon customers. CEO Hock Tan: 'line of sight to $100B AI chip revenue in 2027.' Stock up 30% YTD after -15% early 2026 dip.

AVGO.title: Evercore ISI Raises Broadcom Price Target to $582 from $490; Maintains Outperform — AI Demand Tracking Ahead of Estimates
AVGO.content: Evercore ISI analyst Mark Lipacis raised AVGO target to $582 (from $490), maintaining Outperform. AI semiconductor revenue tracking above consensus ahead of June 3 Q2 FY2026 earnings (guided $22B revenue, $10.7B AI chip). CEO Hock Tan $100B AI chip 2027 target viewed as increasingly achievable.

AVGO.title: London Stock Exchange Group Signs 5-Year Technology Partnership with Broadcom; AVGO Stock at $414
AVGO.content: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) signed a new 5-year technology partnership agreement with Broadcom, expanding their existing relationship. AVGO stock closed at $414.57 on May 21 (-0.76%). Q2 FY2026 earnings June 3 with $22B revenue and $10.7B AI chip revenue guided. Goldman Sachs Buy reiterated May 20.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Custom AI Chips 'About to Hit Full Force' as Multiple Hyperscaler ASICs Enter High-Volume Shipments
AVGO.content: Motley Fool analysis: Broadcom's custom AI silicon 'secret weapon' about to be unleashed as Google TPU, Meta MTIA, and OpenAI ASIC programs simultaneously enter high-volume production in H1/H2 2026. AI semiconductor revenue guided $10.7B (+140% YoY) for Q2 FY2026 (June 3 earnings). CEO Hock Tan's $100B AI chip 2027 target increasingly achievable. Stock at $413-419 range (May 25); $73B backlog provides multi-year visibility.

AVGO.title: Expert Sets Broadcom Price Target $630 (52% Upside); BCM68850 First 50G PON-SoC With Integrated NPU Launched; AVGO +3.46%
AVGO.content: Wall Street analyst issued $630 price target on AVGO (52% upside from ~$415), citing AI infrastructure buildout math and custom ASIC revenue ramp toward $10.7B in Q2 FY2026. Broadcom also launched BCM68850, the industry's first 50G ITU-PON home gateway SoC featuring an integrated NPU and native Wi-Fi 8 support. AVGO rose 3.46% on May 26 ahead of June 3 Q2 FY2026 earnings.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 Earnings Preview: AI Revenue $10.7B Guided; Google Locked to 2031, Meta to 2029, Anthropic Adds 3.5GW
AVGO.content: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 earnings imminent: Q1 AI semiconductor revenue $8.4B (+106% YoY); Q2 AI guidance $10.7B; total Q2 revenue ~$22B (+47% YoY). Major customer commitments: Google locked through 2031, Meta through 2029, Anthropic added 3.5GW. Polymarket traders assign 94.4% probability of Q2 beat. FY2026 revenue target ~$103B.

AVGO.title: Wall Street Expects 140% AI Revenue Growth as Broadcom Q2 FY2026 Reports June 3
AVGO.content: AVGO Q2 FY2026 earnings due June 3, 2026 after market; analyst consensus EPS $2.40, revenue $22.11B (+47% YoY), AI revenue $10.7B (+140% YoY). Broadcom has beaten estimates in 7 straight quarters. Stock up 33% YTD, 57% since March 30 nadir.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 Reports Today After Close: AI Semiconductor Revenue Guided $10.7B (+140% YoY); Total Revenue $22B
AVGO.content: Broadcom reports Q2 FY2026 after close June 3. Guided $22B total revenue (+47% YoY), AI semiconductor revenue $10.7B (+140% YoY), non-GAAP gross margin ~77%. $73B AI backlog across custom accelerators and networking. CEO Hock Tan targets >$100B AI chip revenue in 2027. EPS consensus $2.40 (37 analysts).

AVGO.title: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 Record Results: Revenue $22.2B (+48% YoY), AI Semiconductor $10.8B (+143%); Q3 Guidance $29.4B; Dividend $0.65/Share
AVGO.content: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 (ended May 3, 2026): revenue $22.19B (+48% YoY), GAAP NI $9.31B (+88%), non-GAAP EPS $2.44. AI semiconductor revenue $10.8B (+143% YoY) driven by custom accelerators (Google TPU, Meta MTIA, OpenAI ASIC) and AI networking. Adj. EBITDA margin 69%, FCF $10.26B (46% of revenue). Q3 FY2026 guidance ~$29.4B (+84% YoY); AI revenue to more than triple YoY to ~$16B. Dividend $0.65/share declared. Stock -1.13% on June 4 despite record-breaking results — 'buy the rumor, sell the news' dynamic.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 Earnings Call: Six ASIC Customers (Google/Meta/Anthropic/OpenAI+2); $100B+ AI Revenue Target FY2027; Q3 Guided $29.4B
AVGO.content: On the Q2 FY2026 earnings call, Broadcom confirmed six custom AI chip customers including Google, Meta, Anthropic, and OpenAI; AI bookings exceed 3x quarterly shipments. $100B+ annual AI semiconductor revenue target for FY2027+. Q3 FY2026 revenue guided $29.4B (+84% YoY), beating $28.53B consensus. Infrastructure software $7.18B slightly missed whisper $7.32B, contributing to post-earnings selloff.

AVGO.title: Macquarie Downgrades Broadcom to Neutral, Cuts PT to $437 from $513; Cites Google In-House ASIC Risk
AVGO.content: Macquarie downgraded AVGO from Outperform to Neutral post-Q2 FY2026 earnings, cutting PT to $437 from $513. Core concern: Google's strategic shift toward developing its own custom silicon could erode Broadcom's ASIC revenue. Lower-margin ASIC mix shift threatens structural gross margin compression. 26 of 28 other analysts maintain Buy/Outperform with consensus PT ~$490.

AVGO.title: AVGO Crashes 13.65% Post-Earnings Despite Record Results; Bernstein: Selloff on AI Annual Forecast Not Raised, Not Guidance Cut
AVGO.content: Broadcom shares fell 13.65% on June 4 despite Q2 FY2026 beat ($22.2B revenue, $10.8B AI semi +143%, EPS $2.44, Q3 guided $29.4B). Bernstein's Stacy Rasgon cited market disappointment that the AI chip annual revenue forecast was not raised. 26 of 28 analysts remain Buy. Management reaffirmed $100B+ AI chip revenue path for FY2027.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Post-Earnings: Analysts Defend Buy Ratings After 13% Selloff; Q3 AI Revenue $16B (+200% YoY) Guidance Implies FY2026 Will Far Exceed $100B Target
AVGO.content: Following AVGO's 13% post-earnings decline on June 4, multiple analysts defended Buy ratings by noting that Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor guidance of $16B (+200% YoY) implies a full-year AI revenue run rate of ~$56B—potentially far exceeding the $100B by 2027 target. The selloff was attributed to Hock Tan not explicitly raising the $100B FY2026 AI chip target, despite record results ($22.2B Q2 revenue, AI $10.8B +143%).

AVGO.title: Broadcom Q2 FY2026: Record $22.2B Revenue, AI Semiconductor Revenue Up 143% YoY to $10.8B
AVGO.content: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 revenue $22.2B (+48% YoY), AI semiconductor $10.8B (+143%). Q3 guidance $29.4B revenue and AI semiconductor $16B (+200%). Full-year AI revenue guidance raised to $56B.

AVGO.title: JPMorgan Raises Broadcom Price Target Post-Q2; 28 Analysts Now 24 Buy, 4 Hold
AVGO.content: Following Q2 earnings, JPMorgan lifted Broadcom price target maintaining Overweight. Jefferies, DA Davidson, and TD Cowen also reaffirmed Buy. Consensus: 24 Buy, 4 Hold among 28 analysts.

AVGO.title: Broadcom, Apollo, Blackstone Launch $35B AI Infrastructure Platform; AVGO Falls 1.75% on Geopolitical Tensions
AVGO.content: Broadcom joined Apollo and Blackstone to launch a $35B AI infrastructure platform on June 9; AVGO stock fell 1.75% underperforming the market on renewed geopolitical tensions. Q3 AI semiconductor revenue guidance $16B (+200% YoY); FY2027 AI semiconductor revenue target >$100B.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Launches $2.5B Senior Notes Tender Offer; Q3 AI Revenue Guide Tops $16B
AVGO.content: Broadcom launched $2.5B senior notes tender offer for balance sheet management post-VMware integration. Q3 FY2026 guidance: AI semiconductor revenue exceeding $16B (+200% YoY).

AVGO.title: Broadcom CFO Kirsten Spears Retires; Amie Thuener Appointed as Successor
AVGO.content: Broadcom's long-serving CFO Kirsten M. Spears retired effective June 12, 2026. Amie Thuener appointed as new CFO, announced alongside Q2 FY2026 earnings report.

AVGO.title: OpenAI and Broadcom Unveil Jalapeño — OpenAI's First Custom AI Inference Chip; Targeting 50% Lower Cost vs NVIDIA GPUs
AVGO.content: OpenAI and Broadcom announced Jalapeño: a purpose-built LLM inference accelerator co-developed in just 9 months — claimed fastest ASIC development cycle ever. Targets ~50% lower inference cost per token vs NVIDIA. Initial deployment targeted by late 2026; 10GW multi-year supply agreement through 2029. OpenAI becomes Broadcom's 6th major custom silicon customer.

AVGO.title: Wall Street Maintains Buy on Broadcom Despite 26% Pullback from Highs; Analysts See 40% Upside as OpenAI Jalapeno Deal Expands TAM
AVGO.content: AVGO has declined ~26% from its record high after CEO Hock Tan maintained (did not raise) the 00B FY AI revenue target post-Q2. However, 26 analysts maintain Buy consensus as of July 1. The OpenAI Jalapeño deal adds a 6th hyperscaler ASIC customer, with a contractual 1.3 GW compute deployment in 2027 and 10 GW through 2029 extending long-term TAM.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Extends Multi-Year Apple Partnership Through 2031 for Custom Silicon and Networking Components
AVGO.content: Broadcom disclosed new multi-year agreements with Apple extending through 2031 to develop and supply a range of custom silicon chips and networking components for Apple products, securing a critical long-term revenue stream for Broadcom's semiconductor solutions segment.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Shares Fall 3% as Alphabet Signals Custom Chip Diversification Away from AVGO
AVGO.content: Broadcom fell ~3.1% on July 24 after management acknowledged that Alphabet, a key custom ASIC customer, is actively diversifying its sources of custom AI chips, raising investor concerns about long-term customer concentration risk for AVGO's AI semiconductor segment.

AVGO.title: Samsung Wins $200B Chip Supply Deal with Broadcom Through 2030, Covering HBM4, 2nm Foundry & Advanced Packaging
AVGO.content: 三星与博通于旧金山AI峰会签署5年逾2000亿美元芯片供应协议，涵盖HBM4/HBM4E内存、2nm以下制程代工及先进封装，为迄今最大半导体合作协议之一，直接支撑博通AI定制加速器芯片规模化量产。

AVGO.title: Broadcom Rebounds Toward $391 on $200 Billion Samsung AI Partnership
AVGO.content: Broadcom announced a $200B partnership with Samsung focused on advanced AI memory products and semiconductor technologies for AI infrastructure. Q2 FY2026 revenue was $22.19B (+48% YoY); Q3 FY2026 guidance called for $29.4B revenue with AI semiconductor revenue targeting $16B.

AVGO.title: Analysts Broadly Bullish on Broadcom Ahead of Q3 FY2026 Earnings; Samsung $200B AI Chip Deal in Focus
AVGO.content: Wall Street maintains strong buy consensus on AVGO with average price target of ~$525. Broadcom recently announced a $200B AI chip collaboration deal with Samsung. Shares up ~51% YTD. Q2 fiscal 2026 (reported June 4) showed revenue of $22.2B (+48% YoY) with AI semiconductor revenue of $10.8B (+143% YoY). Next earnings expected September 2026.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Preview: AI Revenue $10.8B in Q2, Q3 Earnings Due September; Consensus Strong Buy at $527 Target
AVGO.content: AVGO analyst preview: Q2 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue $10.8B (+143% YoY) driven by 6 custom AI accelerator customers including Google, Meta, OpenAI, and Anthropic. Full-year 2026 AI revenue guidance reiterated above $100B. Stock corrected 21% from June peak. Q3 FY2026 earnings expected early September 2026. Consensus Strong Buy, average target $527.

AMD.title: BofA, Citi and Bernstein Raise AMD Targets Up to $600 on AI GPU and EPYC Server Strength
AMD.content: Bank of America, Citi, and Bernstein raised AMD price targets as high as $600, citing stronger-than-expected AI GPU (Instinct MI355X) and EPYC server CPU demand tied to agentic AI workloads. AMD stock rose ~4% on June 18.

AMD.title: AMD Q1 2026 Earnings: Revenue $10.3B (+38% YoY), Data Center $5.8B (+57%); Q2 Guide $11.2B
AMD.content: AMD Q1 2026: total revenue $10.3B (+38% YoY), Data Center $5.8B (+57% YoY) on Instinct GPU and EPYC CPU momentum. Non-GAAP EPS $1.37. Q2 guidance $11.2B ±$300M (~46% YoY growth). Strong inference deployment ramp across cloud and enterprise.

AMD.title: Meta to Deploy up to 6 Gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs Including Custom MI450-Based Accelerators
AMD.content: Meta announced plans to deploy up to 6GW of AMD Instinct GPUs; first 1GW deployment utilizes a custom MI450-based GPU developed in partnership with AMD. Largest single AMD Instinct customer commitment announced.

AMD.title: Goldman Sachs and Bernstein Upgrade AMD to Buy After Blockbuster Q1 and Strong Q2 Guidance
AMD.content: Goldman Sachs and Bernstein upgraded AMD to Buy citing AI GPU demand acceleration and EPYC server CPU share gains from Intel. AMD shares surged 14%+ post-earnings as Wall Street diversifies AI chip exposure.

AMD.title: AMD Launches Instinct MI350P PCIe: 144GB HBM3E, CDNA4 Architecture for Enterprise On-Prem AI on Existing Servers
AMD.content: AMD launched Instinct MI350P, its first PCIe-based Instinct accelerator in 4 years: dual-slot air-cooled form factor, 144GB HBM3E at 4TB/s, peak 4,600 TFLOPS at MXFP4, 600W TBP. Enables enterprise AI deployment on existing air-cooled servers without major infrastructure upgrades. Dell expanded on-prem AI platform with MI350P support. CDNA4 architecture targets agentic AI inference workloads.

AMD.title: AMD Up 320% Over 12 Months: 33 Analysts Buy Consensus, $383 Median Target; MI450 Demand Exceeding Expectations
AMD.content: Following AMD Q1 2026 blowout results, 33 analysts maintain Buy consensus with median price target $383.45. CEO Lisa Su confirmed MI450 customer demand is exceeding initial expectations; AMD guided Q2 revenue ~$11.2B (+46% YoY).

AMD.title: AMD Approaches $1 Trillion Market Cap ($731B) After Blowout Q1; Data Center Revenue +57% YoY; Q2 Guide $11.2B
AMD.content: AMD Q1 2026 (reported May 5): revenue $10.25B (+38% YoY, beat $9.89B est), data center segment $5.8B (+57% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $1.37 beat $1.29 est. Q2 guide $11.2B (+46% YoY), non-GAAP GM ~56%. Market cap reached $731B on May 14, analysts speculate $1T milestone achievable in 2026.

AMD.title: AMD Commits $10B+ to Taiwan Ecosystem; Helios Rack-Scale Platform with MI450X GPUs Deploys H2 2026
AMD.content: AMD announced $10B+ in Taiwan ecosystem investments to expand advanced packaging partnerships for next-gen AI infrastructure. Helios rack-scale platform (MI450X GPU + 6th Gen EPYC CPU) to deploy H2 2026 with ODM partners Sanmina, Wiwynn, Wistron, and Inventec. AMD Ryzen PRO 9000 lineup also expanded May 20.

AMD.title: AMD EPYC 'Venice' Enters Production on TSMC 2nm — First HPC Product on Industry's Most Advanced Process Node
AMD.content: AMD announced EPYC 6th-gen 'Venice' CPU production ramp on TSMC 2nm — the first HPC product in the industry on 2nm. Venice targets cloud, enterprise, HPC, and AI infrastructure; future production at TSMC Arizona planned. Follow-on 'Verano' integrates LPDDR for agentic AI memory. AMD stock market cap at $731B after Q1 2026 blowout; Q2 guide $11.2B (+46% YoY).

AMD.title: AMD Up 3.17% on May 28 as Data Center Momentum Continues; Rocket One Joins AMD AI Developer Program
AMD.content: AMD stock climbed 3.17% to $501.25 (high $507.90); Q1 2026 Data Center revenue continues strong. Rocket One accepted into AMD AI Developer Program. Key risk: TSMC foundry capacity constraints expected to cap 2026 server GPU upside.

AMD.title: AMD Computex 2026: RX 9070 GRE Goes Global at $549; AM5 Platform Supported Through 2029
AMD.content: AMD at Computex 2026: Radeon RX 9070 GRE expands from China-exclusive to global market at $549; Socket AM5 extended support through 2029; Ryzen 7 5800X3D Anniversary Edition arriving June 25 at $349.

AMD.title: AMD Faces Competitive Pressure as Nvidia Enters PC Chip Market with RTX Spark Arm-Based Superchip
AMD.content: Nvidia's RTX Spark (Blackwell GPU + Arm N1X CPU) directly challenges AMD's GPU and CPU market. AMD stock pulls back on June 1 despite own Computex launches.

AMD.title: AMD Computex 2026 CPUs: Ryzen 7 7700X3D Ships July 16 ($329); 5800X3D 10th Anniversary Edition June 25 ($349)
AMD.content: AMD at Computex launches Ryzen 7 7700X3D (8 cores, 104MB cache, up to 4.5GHz boost, $329, July 16 availability) and Ryzen 7 5800X3D 10th Anniversary Edition ($349, June 25). AMD also confirmed AM5 socket commitment through 2029 for platform longevity.

AMD.title: AMD MI350 Shipping in Volume; 8 of Top 10 AI Companies Now Use AMD Instinct GPUs; Data Center GPU Revenue Forecast +114% YoY to $15B in 2026
AMD.content: AMD's Instinct MI350 (CDNA 4, TSMC 3nm) is shipping in volume, offering 288 GB HBM3E memory and 2x FP64 perf vs. Nvidia B200. Eight of the top 10 AI companies now use AMD Instinct GPUs in production. Data center GPU revenue forecast to surge 114% YoY to $15B in 2026. DA Davidson raised AMD to Buy with $375 target; consensus Wall Street target ~$261-290.

AMD.title: AMD Drops 10.86% in Sector-Wide Chip Sell-Off Triggered by Broadcom Q3 Guidance Below Estimates
AMD.content: AMD shares fell 10.86% to 66.38 on June 5 as Broadcom's Q3 AI revenue guidance of 6B missed the 7.2B analyst estimate, triggering a broad semiconductor sell-off. AMD MI350 GPU momentum and Meta 6GW Instinct deployment commitment remain intact. Q2 2026 guidance of 1.2B +46% YoY unchanged.

AMD.title: AMD Commits £2 Billion to UK AI Innovation at London Tech Week; Imperial College and Cambridge Partnerships
AMD.content: CEO Lisa Su announced at London Tech Week AMD will invest up to £2B in UK over five years for AI research and sovereign AI infrastructure. Partners include Imperial College London, Oriole Networks, and Cambridge's Zenith AI supercomputer.

AMD.title: OQC, JPMorganChase, and AMD Commence Quantum-AI Research Collaboration in London
AMD.content: AMD joined OQC and JPMorganChase to develop a quantum-AI platform in London, combining quantum computing with AMD's AI accelerator hardware for financial and scientific workloads.

AMD.title: AMD and Imperial College London Announce Strategic Collaboration for AI-Enabled Scientific Discovery
AMD.content: AMD and Imperial College London signed a strategic collaboration to advance AI-enabled scientific discovery and support sovereign AI infrastructure development.

AMD.title: AMD and Dell Technologies, University of Cambridge Launch UK Sovereign AI Innovation Lab
AMD.content: AMD partners with Dell Technologies and the University of Cambridge to establish a UK Sovereign AI Innovation Lab, supporting national AI research and sovereign infrastructure. AMD committed up to £2 billion to accelerate UK AI innovation.

AMD.title: Citigroup Upgrades AMD to Buy from Neutral; Raises Price Target on AI GPU Second Source Opportunity
AMD.content: Citigroup upgraded AMD to Buy from Neutral on June 12, raising its price target and highlighting AMD's growing credibility as a legitimate second-source AI GPU supplier. AMD stock surged ~7.59% on June 15 amid positive geopolitical developments.

AMD.title: AMD Acquires MEXT to Advance Memory Optimization for AI Compute Infrastructure
AMD.content: AMD completed the acquisition of MEXT on June 15, 2026, a company specializing in memory optimization for compute infrastructure, advancing AMD's AI and HPC software stack capabilities alongside its MI300/MI350 GPU portfolio.

AMD.title: AMD and Rackspace Sign 30MW AI Compute Deployment Agreement Through 2028
AMD.content: AMD and Rackspace signed a definitive agreement for phased deployment of 30 MW of AMD AI compute across Rackspace global data centers late 2026–2028. Rackspace shares rose 16%; company announced 15% workforce reduction to fund AI transformation.

AMD.title: AMD Instinct GPUs Set Breakthrough MLPerf Training 6.0 Records Across LLM and Multi-Node Workloads
AMD.content: AMD announced breakthrough MLPerf Training 6.0 results, with AMD Instinct GPUs delivering leading performance across LLM and multi-node FLUX.1 scale benchmarks on June 17.

AMD.title: AMD Powers 4 of Top 10 Supercomputers on New TOP500 List at ISC 2026, Advancing HPC Challenge to NVIDIA
AMD.content: At ISC 2026 in Hamburg, the new TOP500 list showed AMD powers 4 of the 10 fastest and 4 of the 10 most energy-efficient supercomputers globally, including El Capitan (No. 2) and Frontier (No. 3), with 191 AMD-powered systems total — an 11% year-over-year increase.

AMD.title: Gartner Names AMD 'The Company to Beat for Enterprise AI Server CPUs' in New Vendor Rating
AMD.content: Gartner published a vendor rating positioning AMD as the current front-runner for enterprise AI server CPUs, citing consistent roadmap execution, broad OEM alignment, and architectural leadership with EPYC and Instinct products.

AMD.title: AMD Advancing AI 2026 Event Set for July 22-23 in San Francisco: MI450 Instinct Accelerators and EPYC Venice Zen 6 CPUs to Debut; Q2 Earnings July 28
AMD.content: AMD's flagship AI event at San Francisco Moscone Center July 22-23, livestreamed globally. CEO Lisa Su to showcase next-gen Instinct MI450 accelerators and EPYC Venice (Zen 6) CPUs. Event marks AMD's largest AI product reveal since the original Advancing AI 2023. AMD Q2 2026 earnings (1.2B revenue guided) expected July 28 after close.

AMD.title: AMD Sets Q2 FY2026 Earnings Date for August 4 After-Market Close; Q2 Revenue Guided ~$11.2B (+46% YoY), Non-GAAP Gross Margin ~56%
AMD.content: AMD will report fiscal Q2 2026 results on August 4, 2026 at 5 PM ET. Company previously guided Q2 revenue to ~$11.2B ±$300M at ~56% non-GAAP gross margin.

AMD.title: AMD and Microsoft Announce Expanded Strategic Partnership: Helios Rackscale, EPYC Venice, and Pensando on Azure
AMD.content: AMD and Microsoft announced a major expansion of their long-term strategic partnership on July 20, 2026. Microsoft will deploy the AMD Helios Rackscale Solution (combining Instinct MI455X GPUs, EPYC Venice CPUs, Pensando DPUs, and ROCm software) for frontier AI inference on Azure. Two new Azure VM series — HDv2 for agentic AI/data pipelines and HXv2 for semiconductor design — will run on 6th Gen AMD EPYC Venice processors. Helios shipments to Microsoft begin H2 2026.

AMD.title: AMD Launches Zen 6 EPYC 'Venice' at Advancing AI 2026 — 256 Cores on TSMC 2nm
AMD.content: AMD officially launched its 6th Gen EPYC 'Venice' server processors at the Advancing AI 2026 event on July 22-23, 2026. The processors use the new Zen 6 microarchitecture manufactured on TSMC's 2nm process, offering up to 256 cores, 1.7x performance vs. prior platform, and 1.6 TB/s of memory bandwidth. AMD claims more than 70% better performance-per-watt versus Zen 5. This is the first Zen 6 product to reach market; consumer Ryzen desktop CPUs are expected later.

AMD.title: AMD and Anthropic Announce Strategic Partnership to Deploy Up to 2 Gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs; AMD to Invest Up to $5 Billion in Anthropic
AMD.content: AMD and Anthropic announced a major AI infrastructure partnership. Anthropic will deploy up to 2 gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs in AMD Helios rackscale solutions starting H1 2027. AMD commits a strategic equity investment of up to $5 billion in Anthropic. The partnership includes joint engineering collaboration using Claude AI to optimize AMD ROCm software and workloads.

AMD.title: AMD Advancing AI 2026 Keynote: Lisa Su Unveils EPYC Venice on TSMC 2nm, Helios Rack with 31TB HBM4, and MI500-Series Roadmap Preview
AMD.content: At AMD's Advancing AI 2026 event in San Francisco (July 22-23), CEO Lisa Su delivered keynote announcing EPYC Venice (first x86 server CPU on TSMC 2nm), Helios rackscale AI system with 31TB HBM4 memory capacity, and a first public preview of the MI500-series GPU roadmap for 2027.

AMD.title: AMD and Anthropic Announce Strategic Partnership to Deploy Up to 2 Gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs
AMD.content: AMD and Anthropic announced a deal for up to 2 gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs in Helios rack-scale solutions, with the first gigawatt deploying in H1 2027. AMD will make a strategic equity investment of up to $5 billion in Anthropic as part of the partnership.

AMD.title: AAI 2026: AMD Delivers Full-Stack Compute for the Agentic AI Era — Unveils MI450 GPU, EPYC Venice, Helios Rack
AMD.content: At Advancing AI 2026 in San Francisco, AMD unveiled the MI450 GPU series (flagship MI455X), EPYC Venice Zen 6 CPUs, and the Helios rack-scale AI system at 2.9 exaflops priced at $5-5.5M per rack. OpenAI and Meta together committed to 12 gigawatts of AMD accelerator capacity; Microsoft Azure and Oracle were named as early Helios customers.

AMD.title: AMD Unveils New Products in Pursuit of $2 Trillion Market
AMD.content: Bloomberg's coverage of AMD's Advancing AI 2026 event highlights the MI450 series launch, the Helios rackscale system, and multi-billion-dollar customer commitments as AMD targets a $2 trillion AI compute addressable market against Nvidia.

AMD.title: UBS Raises AMD Price Target to $730 on Server CPU and AI Outlook, Sees 35% Upside
AMD.content: UBS raised its AMD price target from $700 to $730 (Buy maintained) following AAI 2026, projecting server CPU revenue of ~$35B in 2027 and ~$60B in 2028. The stock fell 3.3% on the day despite multiple analyst target hikes after the AI Day event.

AMD.title: AMD Partners with South Korea on Sovereign AI Initiative
AMD.content: AMD announced a strategic partnership to contribute compute technology, open software, and ecosystem collaborations to support South Korea's sovereign AI ambitions, part of post-Advancing-AI-2026 rollout following the July 23 event where AMD launched MI400 GPUs, Helios AI rack, and EPYC Venice 2nm CPUs.

AMD.title: AMD and Cisco Announce Enterprise AI Collaboration Combining Ryzen AI Halo and Cisco Security Stack
AMD.content: AMD and Cisco announced a collaboration combining AMD Ryzen AI Halo systems with Cisco networking, observability, governance, and security technologies for enterprise AI deployments.

AMD.title: Wedbush Raises AMD Price Target to $600, Maintains Outperform Ahead of August 4 Earnings
AMD.content: Wedbush raised its AMD price target from $450 to $600, maintaining Outperform, citing stronger AI chip demand and expanded enterprise partnerships. AMD reports Q2 2026 earnings August 4; consensus EPS $1.55-$1.61 representing +235% YoY growth.

AMD.title: AMD Falls 8.85% in Broad Semiconductor Sector Selloff; Q2 2026 Earnings Set for August 4
AMD.content: AMD shares fell 8.85% July 28 in a sector-wide chip selloff driven by NVDA circular financing controversy and Chinese CXMT/DUV competitive concerns. Q2 2026 earnings scheduled August 4 after market close; analyst consensus expects $11.2B revenue (+46% YoY).

AMD.title: AMD Partners with South Korea Ministry of Science and ICT on Sovereign AI Ecosystem; Stock Drops 3% in Sector Weakness
AMD.content: AMD and Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT announced a partnership to advance a sovereign AI ecosystem on July 29. Despite the positive deal, AMD stock fell 3.03% as the broader chip sector continued declining. Stock traded $421-$459 during the session.

AMD.title: AMD Launches Instinct MI400 Series GPUs on CDNA5/2nm with 432GB HBM4 at Advancing AI 2026 Event
AMD.content: AMD unveiled the MI400 GPU series at Advancing AI 2026: MI455X (frontier AI/AI factories) and MI430X (sovereign AI/HPC) on CDNA5 architecture with 2nm process and 432GB HBM4 per GPU (50% more than MI350). Helios rack platform combines 72x MI455X with 1.4 PB/s total memory bandwidth. AMD also shipped Helios AI racks with EPYC 9006 CPUs.

AMD.title: AMD Q2 FY2026 Earnings Preview: August 4 Report Expected to Show 47% Revenue Growth to $11.3B
AMD.content: AMD will report Q2 FY2026 earnings August 4 after close. Consensus: revenue $11.30B (+47% YoY), EPS ~$1.55-$1.62 (+396% YoY). AMD own Q2 guidance was ~$11.2B revenue at 56% non-GAAP gross margin. Options pricing implies a 12.28% post-earnings move. 35 of 46 analysts rate Strong Buy. AMD reportedly achieved first-ever data-center revenue lead over Intel in Q2.

INTC.title: Trump Announces Apple-Intel Chip Manufacturing Partnership; Intel Shares Surge ~9%
INTC.content: President Trump announced Apple agreed to work with Intel to design and manufacture chips domestically. Neither company issued formal confirmation but Intel shares surged 9%+ in premarket. A confirmed deal would be Intel's biggest foundry win and a major validation of its 18A manufacturing strategy.

INTC.title: Intel Begins Risk Production of Advanced 18A-P Node at VLSI Symposium
INTC.content: Intel announced at the VLSI Symposium in Honolulu that its 18A-P process node has entered risk production. The node delivers 9% higher CPU performance or 18% less power than 18A and is backwards compatible with existing 18A fabs, strengthening Intel's foundry pitch particularly to Apple.

INTC.title: 美国政府持有 Intel 9.9% 非投票权股权 — CHIPS Act 拨款转股权
INTC.content: 美国政府将 Intel 剩余 CHIPS Act 拨款转为 9.9% 非投票权股权, 433M 股, 标志着政府成为唯一一家美国先进制程公司的实质股东。

INTC.title: Intel 18A (1.8nm) Fab 52 亚利桑那量产 — 美国本土首次先进节点 HVM
INTC.content: Intel Fab 52 (亚利桑那 Ocotillo) 18A 工艺进入 HVM, 首次美国本土实现先进制程量产, 战略意义对冲 TSMC 集中风险。

INTC.title: Intel 收到 $5.7B 加速 CHIPS Act 拨款
INTC.content: 经修订的 CHIPS Act 协议加速 $5.7B 拨款。Intel 仍独立运营 Foundry, 政府不参与运营决策。

INTC.title: NVDA-Intel 战略合作 — 老对手联手
INTC.content: Nvidia 和 Intel 达成战略合作, AI 生态新格局。

INTC.title: Intel Q1 2026 Blowout: Revenue $13.58B vs $12.42B Estimate; DCAI +22% to $5.1B; Stock +20% After-Hours
INTC.content: Intel Q1 2026: revenue $13.58B (vs $12.42B est), adj EPS $0.29 (vs $0.01 est). Data Center & AI (DCAI) +22% to $5.1B. Q2 guide $13.8-14.8B vs $13.07B est. Intel 18A-based Xeon 6 in full volume production — fastest new product ramp in 5 years. Sixth consecutive quarter beating expectations.

INTC.title: Wall Street Sees 'Changing of the Guard in AI' as Intel Doubles YTD While Nvidia Lags
INTC.content: Intel has more than doubled in value in 2026, leading AI chip sector. Xeon 6 CPU demand running ahead of supply. Investors rotating into INTC from NVDA on valuation and execution turnaround narrative.

INTC.title: Apple Confirms Intel 18A Foundry Agreement to Manufacture Entry-Level Mac/iPad Chips in U.S.; INTC Surges 14%
INTC.content: Bloomberg confirmed Apple entered foundry agreement with Intel to manufacture 18A-based chips for entry-level Mac and iPad product lines — a landmark validation of Intel Foundry Services as a competitive alternative to TSMC. INTC surged ~14% on the news. Validates CEO Lip-Bu Tan's pitch: Intel 18A is the most advanced process node manufactured in the U.S., with yields running ahead of internal projections.

INTC.title: Intel Computex 2026 Preview (June 2): Panther Lake Handhelds, 52-Core Nova Lake Desktop, 288-Core Clearwater Forest Server — All on 18A
INTC.content: Intel's Computex 2026 lineup (June 2 keynote, Taipei): Panther Lake Arc G3 gaming handhelds, Nova Lake 52-core desktop preview, and 288-core Clearwater Forest server — all built on Intel 18A. Entire lineup serves as foundry showcase to potential customers Apple, Amazon, and Musk's Terafab. CEO Tan keynote positions 18A as U.S.-made alternative to TSMC for advanced AI chip production.

INTC.title: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan Confirmed as Computex 2026 Keynote on June 2 Taipei; Nova Lake, Panther Lake, Clearwater Forest to Preview
INTC.content: Intel confirmed CEO Lip-Bu Tan will keynote Computex 2026 on June 2 (1:30 PM Taiwan time), previewing Nova Lake (Core Ultra Series 4, up to 52 cores on 18A), Panther Lake Arc G3 handhelds, and AI data center platforms Crescent Island and Jaguar Shores — all built on Intel 18A.

INTC.title: Intel Stock Soars as Apple and Google Foundry Deals Validate 18A; INTC +116% Month-to-Date

INTC.title: INTC Falls 5.21% on May 14: HSBC Downgrades; UBS Warns AMD at 27.4%, ARM at 17.7% Server CPU Share; Foundry Loss $2.3B

Intel Foundry Q1 2026 operating loss $2.3B; 18A and 14A process yields below expectations.

INTC.title: Intel Stock Continues 200% YTD Rally on Apple + Google Foundry Deal Momentum; 18A Node Commercial Production
INTC.content: INTC +200% YTD as Apple 18A agreement and Google foundry discussions validate Intel's manufacturing revival. Elon Musk's Terafab ($119B Austin fab) to use 14A node. CHIPS Act: $8.5B grants + $11B loans secured.

INTC.title: Intel +6.71% on Melius Research Upgrade to $150: "CPU Renaissance" — Inference AI Proving More CPU-Intensive Than Expected
INTC.content: Intel surged 6.71% on May 20 after Melius Research raised target to $150. Thesis: agentic/inference AI workloads are proving far more CPU-intensive than pure GPU compute, triggering a "CPU renaissance." Intel asking PC partners to adopt more 18A CPUs. Server CPU share 54.9% (from 64.4% a year ago) but overall demand growing. Sixth consecutive beat-and-raise quarter.

INTC.title: Intel and Qualcomm Both Eyeing AI Chip Startup Tenstorrent at ~$5B Valuation
INTC.content: Bloomberg reports Intel and Qualcomm separately exploring acquisition of AI chip startup Tenstorrent (founded by Jim Keller), valued at ~$5B+. Tenstorrent develops RISC-V-based AI processors for training and inference. Intel shares rose ~6% on the news. No deal announced; early-stage discussions involve investment banks exploring strategic options.

INTC.title: Intel Falls 3.24% on May 21: Valuation at 100x Forward P/E; SuperClaw Hybrid AI Solution Announced; Server CPU Share 54.9%
INTC.content: Intel fell 3.24% on May 21 as analysts flag unsustainable 100x forward P/E on YTD +200% rally. Company introduced SuperClaw hybrid AI solution combining CPU and accelerator workloads. Server CPU market share 54.9% (down from 64.4% a year ago); AMD at 27.4%, ARM at 17.7%. Intel stock at ~$120, up 530%+ from 52-week low of $18.97.

INTC.title: Biggest Threat to Intel's 200%+ YTD Rally: 100x Forward P/E, Server CPU Share Loss to AMD and ARM
INTC.content: Motley Fool identifies three key risks to Intel's extraordinary 2026 rally: (1) Valuation at ~100x forward P/E — unsustainable historically; (2) Server CPU market share eroding to 54.9% from 64.4% YoY (AMD at 27.4%, ARM at 17.7%); (3) Intel Foundry Q1 2026 operating loss $2.3B — 18A and 14A process yields below expectations. Intel has doubled AMD's 2026 gains at +222% vs +118% YTD as of May 23.

INTC.title: Northland Capital Markets Downgrades Intel to Market Perform, Suspends Price Target After 222% YTD Rally — Valuation Overextended
INTC.content: Northland Capital Markets downgraded Intel from Outperform to Market Perform and suspended its price target, stating the stock's 222% YTD rally has pushed valuation to overvalued territory. INTC fell 3.26% on May 27. Background concern: Mercury Research data shows Intel continues to lose server CPU share to AMD despite the stock's stellar performance.

INTC.title: Intel Arc G-Series GPUs Unveiled for Handheld Gaming; Preliminary Apple Foundry Deal Reported; Intel Up 224% YTD at $119
INTC.content: Intel unveiled Arc G-Series GPUs for next-gen handheld gaming devices; OEM devices ship June 2026. Preliminary agreement to manufacture chips for Apple at Intel 18A foundry reported. Intel stock up 224.77% YTD, trading at $118.95 on May 28. Q1 Data Center & AI revenue +22% to $5.05B; Foundry +16% to $5.42B.

INTC.title: Intel Stock Falls 6.8% on June 1 as Nvidia RTX Spark Arm-Based Superchip Threatens PC Market
INTC.content: INTC dropped 6.8% June 1 after Nvidia unveiled RTX Spark, its first processor for personal computers, challenging Intel's long-standing x86 dominance. Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan in Taiwan for TSMC meetings ahead of Computex June 2 keynote.

INTC.title: Intel Computex 2026: Xeon 6+ on Intel 18A Architecture Announced; 36,864-Core Liquid-Cooled Rack; Xeon 7 Diamond Rapids 2027
INTC.content: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan keynote at Computex: Xeon 6+ on Intel 18A architecture, single liquid-cooled rack housing 36,864 cores at 100kW. SambaNova SN-50 RDU partnership for disaggregated inference. Next-gen Xeon 7 Diamond Rapids confirmed for 2027 on Intel 18A-P process. Also unveiled Arc G3 platform for AI handheld devices.

INTC.title: Intel Stock Up ~250% in 2026 to ~$130; AI Revenue Now ~60% of Sales (vs <25% a Year Ago); Q2 Guidance $13.8-14.8B Confirmed
INTC.content: Intel is up approximately 250% in 2026, trading near $130, with AI-linked revenue now ~60% of quarterly sales. Data center revenue grew 22% to $5.1B in Q1. Q2 2026 guidance confirmed at $13.8-14.8B (mid $14.3B). Microsoft signed multi-year 18A wafer agreement, AWS expanded Xeon footprint for AI inference. Analyst street mean target ~$89 now well below current price.

INTC.title: Intel Drops 11.28% on June 5 in Chip Sector Sell-Off; AI Revenue ~60% of Sales, Apple 18A Agreement Intact
INTC.content: Intel fell 11.28% to 9.17 on June 5 alongside a broad semiconductor sell-off driven by Broadcom's Q3 AI guidance miss. Despite the single-day decline, INTC is up ~250% YTD in 2026. Apple 18A foundry agreement, Google TPU EMIB partnership, and Xeon 6+ ramp on Intel 18A remain intact. Q2 guidance 3.8-14.8B.

INTC.title: Google Orders 3 Million TPUs from Intel for 2028 Production Using 18A Process — INTC Surges 11%+
INTC.content: Google placed an order with Intel to manufacture 3M+ TPUs for 2028 at Arizona Fab 52 using Intel 18A process. Could expand to 6M units for 2027-2028 if yield milestones are met. INTC surged 11%+ on the news.

INTC.title: Wells Fargo Raises Intel Target to $110, Barclays to $100 on Stronger AI Data Center Demand
INTC.content: Wells Fargo raised INTC price target from $85 to $110 and Barclays from $65 to $100, both citing stronger AI data-center and agentic workload demand following the Google TPU order and Computex announcements.

INTC.title: Intel Unveils Rackscale AI Infrastructure with SambaNova and Foxconn at Computex 2026
INTC.content: At Computex 2026, Intel announced rackscale AI infrastructure combining Intel Xeon with SambaNova SN-50 RDUs and NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. New Foxconn and Hitachi collaborations for physical AI. A $3.3B India advanced-packaging plant also announced.

INTC.content: BofA analyst Vivek Arya double-upgraded Intel from Underperform to Buy, raising PT from $96 to $135. Projects $40B+ in server CPU sales by 2030 and sees foundry deals with Apple, MediaTek, and Terafab. Intel shares surged ~5%.

INTC.title: Intel Wins Major Google Order for 3M+ AI Accelerator Chips via Intel Foundry Services for 2028
INTC.content: Intel jumped 12.5% on news of a major Google order for 3M+ AI accelerator chips to be manufactured by Intel Foundry Services (IFS) for 2028, validating Intel 18A process node. Wells Fargo, Barclays, and Mizuho raised price targets.

INTC.title: Intel Shares Drop ~6% as Nvidia RTX Spark AI PC Chip Threatens Core CPU Market
INTC.content: Intel fell 5-6% on June 16 after Wedbush flagged Nvidia RTX Spark as a direct threat to Intel PC CPU franchise. Nvidia Grace+Blackwell Superchip enters Windows laptop market in fall 2026, targeting OEMs already supplied by Intel.

INTC.title: Intel Initiates Risk Production of Next-Generation 18A-P Process Node; Shares Gain ~3%
INTC.content: Intel initiated risk production of its 18A-P chip process, promising improved performance and power efficiency over 18A. Shares gained ~3% on the news, reinforcing Intel's foundry recovery narrative.

INTC.title: Intel to Report Q2 2026 Results on July 23 After Close; Q2 Revenue Guidance $13.8-14.8B

INTC.title: Analyst Preview: Susquehanna Raises INTC Target to $115, KeyBanc to $155 Ahead of Q2 Earnings

INTC.title: Intel Foundry Lands Fortinet as First Named External Cybersecurity Chip Customer

INTC.title: Intel Reports Second-Quarter 2026 Financial Results: Revenue +25% YoY, Fastest Growth in 15 Years
INTC.content: Intel reported Q2 2026 revenue of $16.1 billion, up 25% YoY, with non-GAAP EPS of $0.42 versus $0.22 consensus. INTC.title: Intel Stock Reverses Post-Earnings Rally, Falls ~8% on Foundry Losses and Weak External Demand Concerns

INTC.title: Intel Q2 2026 Earnings Beat: Revenue Surges 25% YoY to $16.1B, Fastest Growth in 15 Years; DCAI Up 59%
INTC.content: Intel reported Q2 revenue of $16.1B (+25% YoY, vs. $14.42B estimate) and adjusted EPS of $0.42 (vs. $0.21 estimate). Data Center and AI revenue surged 59% YoY to $6.3B. Q3 guidance: revenue $15.8-$16.8B, gross margin 42%, EPS $0.38.

INTC.title: Post-Earnings Analysis: Is Intel Stock a Buy After Q2 2026 Beat?

INTC.content: Baird raised its Intel price target to $125 on July 27, citing AI infrastructure growth. Analyst projects Intel EPS could quadruple over 4 years. BofA's Vivek Arya highlighted INTC's 59% data center growth and agentic AI tailwinds as key re-rating catalysts.

INTC.title: Intel Shares Slide 6% as Chip Selloff and $20B Capex Concerns Intensify
INTC.content: Intel fell 6.02% on July 28, now down 28% in July despite 170%+ YTD gains. QCOM.title: Qualcomm Launches AI Data Center Custom Silicon Program with Major Hyperscaler; Stock Jumps 11%
QCOM.content: Qualcomm launched a new AI data center custom silicon program with a major hyperscaler, marking a major expansion beyond smartphones into AI infrastructure. Initial shipments planned for December 2026 quarter. Stock surged ~11% on the news, ahead of June 24 Investor Day.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Unveils Snapdragon Reality Elite XR Platform with 48 TOPS AI Processing at AWE 2026
QCOM.content: Qualcomm announced Snapdragon Reality Elite at Augmented World Expo, a next-gen XR platform featuring 48 TOPS AI processing, 60% higher GPU performance vs prior gen, and 4.4K-per-eye displays at 90fps. Powers upcoming products from XREAL and Play for Dream.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Q2 FY2026 Beats: Revenue $10.6B, EPS $2.65; Automotive First Time Exceeds $5B Annualized Rate
QCOM.content: QCOM Q2 FY2026: revenue $10.6B, EPS $2.65, both clearing consensus. Automotive segment first time exceeding $5B annualized revenue. Initial data center silicon shipments to a leading hyperscaler in December 2025. Stock rose ~15%.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Shares Up 6% on New Snapdragon X2 PC Platform with 85 TOPS NPU; AI PC Race Heats Up
QCOM.content: Qualcomm launched Snapdragon X2 PC platform with 85 TOPS Hexagon NPU, outperforming Intel Pinter Lake by ~30%. Targets always-on agentic AI PC experiences. Data center silicon shipment to hyperscaler adds new growth vector.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Authorizes $20B Share Buyback; Confirms First Data Center Processor Shipments to Hyperscaler in December 2025
QCOM.content: Alongside Q2 FY2026 earnings beat, Qualcomm authorized $20B share buyback program. CEO Cristiano Amon confirmed initial data center processor shipments already completed to a leading hyperscaler in December 2025, establishing data center as a new revenue vector. Automotive segment exceeded $5B annualized revenue for the first time. Stock surged 15% post-earnings.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Hits All-Time High $247.90 (+9% on May 11); 42% 5-Day Rally on Data Center Entry + Tariff Relief; Leads Nasdaq 100
QCOM.content: QCOM surged 9% on May 11 to intraday all-time record $247.90, extending a 42% gain over 5 consecutive trading days. Catalysts: hyperscaler data center silicon shipments confirmed; 90-day US-China tariff suspension boosting smartphone demand; analyst upgrades (Daiwa Outperform $225, Tigress $280, Benchmark $225). UBS trimmed target from $160 to $150 on deteriorating handset fundamentals.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm QCOM Executives Join Trump China Delegation; CEO Amon Highlights Work with Meta, OpenAI on AI Hardware
QCOM.content: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon joined Trump's China delegation. Amon said QCOM is working with 'pretty much all' major AI players including Meta and OpenAI on top-secret hardware. QCOM fell 11% on May 12 amid broader semiconductor rotation on macro/Iran tension concerns.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Surges 11.2% on May 22; 42% 5-Day Rally Driven by Data Center Silicon Deal + Tariff Relief; Leads S&P 500
QCOM.content: QCOM surged 11.2% on May 22, extending a nearly 42% gain over 5 consecutive sessions. Key catalysts: data center silicon shipments to hyperscaler confirmed (Dec 2025), 90-day US-China tariff suspension boosting smartphone demand, and strong Q2 FY2026 results ($10.6B revenue, $20B buyback). AI data center expansion positioned as QCOM's third growth pillar alongside mobile and automotive.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Signs Landmark AI Chip Deal with ByteDance — First Major Data Center Hardware Client
QCOM.content: Qualcomm secured a landmark agreement to supply AI chips to ByteDance (parent of TikTok), marking QCOM's first high-volume client for its newly launched data center hardware product line. Analysts view this as a significant strategic pivot into the AI data center market.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Computex 2026: Launches Dragonfly Data Center AI Brand; Stock Falls 8.77% on Nvidia RTX Spark Competition; ARM May Cancel Key License
QCOM.content: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon at Computex declared 2026 'Year of AI Agents' and unveiled Dragonfly brand for data center AI inference — QCOM's first formal DC entry. Reports: Arm Holdings considering cancellation of Qualcomm architectural license.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Automotive Revenue at $6B Annual Run Rate Post-Computex; Investor Day June 24 to Detail Dragonfly Data Center Pipeline
QCOM.content: Qualcomm automotive revenue reached ~$1.33B in fiscal Q2 2026, pacing toward $6B annual run rate (long-term target $29B). Hyperscaler Dragonfly CPU/AI inference deployments began late 2025.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Falls 9.52% on June 5 as NVIDIA AI PC Competition Intensifies; CEO Defends $22B Non-Handset Revenue Target by FY2029
QCOM.content: QCOM dropped 9.52% on June 5, extending the selloff triggered June 1 (-7.28%) when NVIDIA unveiled its RTX Spark Arm-based AI PC superchip at Computex, threatening Qualcomm's Snapdragon X Elite position. CEO Cristiano Amon reaffirmed Qualcomm can absorb competition and still hit $22B non-handset (automotive/IoT/PC) revenue by fiscal 2029.

QCOM.title: JPMorgan Raises Qualcomm Target to $265, Adds Positive Catalyst Watch Ahead of June 24 Investor Day
QCOM.content: JPMorgan raised Qualcomm target to $265 from $160 (Neutral) and added Positive Catalyst Watch ahead of Qualcomm's June 24 Investor Day. Anticipates announcement of data center revenue targets exceeding $3B in FY2027 and ~$35B by FY2031.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm AI Data Center Strategy, ByteDance Deal, and Record Automotive Revenue Drive 61% Stock Rally
QCOM.content: Drivers behind QCOM's 61.7% rally since March: record automotive revenue $1.3B (+38% YoY), a reported deal to supply AI chips to ByteDance, and ramping custom silicon with a leading hyperscaler. Investor Day June 24.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Secures Major ByteDance ASIC Deal for AI Data Centers; Stock Hits All-Time High $258
QCOM.content: Qualcomm will supply ByteDance with millions of custom ASICs for AI agent inference workloads. ByteDance's 2026 AI infrastructure budget is $29.4B. The deal stays within US export control thresholds. QCOM hit an all-time intraday high of $258.

QCOM.content: Despite the ByteDance win, QCOM fell ~8% on June 9 as markets reassessed whether ASICs displace rather than supplement Nvidia-class GPUs, dragging other custom-silicon names lower including Marvell (-10%).

QCOM.content: Nvidia's RTX Spark superchip unveiled at Computex targets Windows-on-Arm PCs, a direct competitive threat to Qualcomm's Snapdragon X PC processor business. QCOM fell 6.9% on June 5 in response.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Investor Day Scheduled June 24 — Data Center & Physical AI Roadmap to Be Unveiled
QCOM.content: Qualcomm scheduled Investor Day for June 24, 2026 in New York. CEO Cristiano Amon will present long-term financial targets and the full roadmap for its AI data center (Dragonfly brand) and Physical AI initiatives.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm in Talks to Acquire AI Chip Startup Tenstorrent for $8B–$10B
QCOM.content: Qualcomm reportedly in advanced discussions to acquire Tenstorrent, a RISC-V AI chip startup founded by Jim Keller, for $8-10B. Would accelerate Qualcomm push into data-center AI accelerators ahead of June 24 Investor Day.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm +6.2% on June 19 as JPMorgan Raises Target to $265; Hyperscaler Custom Silicon Deal Pre-Confirmed Ahead of Investor Day
QCOM.content: QCOM rose 6.17% on June 19 ahead of its June 24 Investor Day in New York. JPMorgan raised its target to $265 and placed QCOM on Positive Catalyst Watch. QCOM.content: Qualcomm will release Q3 FY2026 financial results on July 29, 2026 after market close, with a live conference call at 1:45 p.m. PT. The company last posted Q2 revenue of $10.6B (down 3% YoY) with non-GAAP EPS of $2.65, which beat expectations and triggered a 15.1% stock surge.

QCOM.content: Qualcomm sent letters to customers announcing double-digit (>10%) price hikes effective for products shipped after September 1, citing exhausted ability to absorb rising supplier costs and failed attempts to source alternative components. QCOM shares fell ~2% on the report.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Heads Into July 29 Q3 Earnings at 15x Forward PE; Options Price 9.3% Swing
QCOM.content: Pre-earnings preview: QCOM reports Q3 FY2026 on July 29 after close. Analysts expect EPS $2.22-$2.23 on revenue ~$9.71B (both down ~6-20% YoY). Stock trades at 15x forward earnings after ~10% monthly decline and is flat YTD. QCOM has beaten EPS estimates in 4 consecutive quarters.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Reports Q3 Fiscal 2026 Financial Results After Market Close
QCOM.content: Qualcomm releases fiscal Q3 2026 earnings today after market close. Consensus: EPS $2.23, revenue $9.71B. Key focus: smartphone demand recovery, automotive segment growth (record $1.326B last quarter, +38% YoY), AI and IoT expansion. Earnings call at 1:45 PM PT.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Q3 FY2026 Results In Line; Q4 Guide Light Due to Memory Supply Crunch; CEO Raises Chip Prices Starting September 1
QCOM.content: QCOM Q3 FY2026 results in line with expectations. Q4 guidance lighter than expected: EPS $2.05-2.25, Revenue $9.7-10.5B — attributed to supply crunch for computer components, especially memory. CEO Cristiano Amon announced broad chip price increases starting September 1 to expand margins. Shares fell in extended trading.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm CEO Announces Broad Chip Price Hikes Starting September 1 to Combat Margin Pressure
QCOM.content: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon announced price increases across the entire chip portfolio effective September 1, primarily targeting smartphone chip customers, to restore margins under pressure from memory supply constraints and a decline in Apple-related revenue.

MRVL.title: Marvell Ships Over 5 Million Coherent Photonic Integrated Circuits in Tower Semiconductor Collaboration
MRVL.content: Marvell announced shipment of over 5 million coherent photonic integrated circuits (PICs) to global customers in collaboration with Tower Semiconductor, highlighting growing AI data center optical interconnect demand. Stock gained 7.52% on June 18.

MRVL.title: Marvell Names Dan Durn (ex-Adobe CFO) as New CFO; S&P 500 Inclusion Effective June 22
MRVL.content: Marvell named former Adobe CFO Dan Durn as its new CFO effective June 15, replacing Willem Meintjes. S&P Global confirmed Marvell will join the S&P 500 before market open on June 22, driving 8%+ premarket surge. B. Riley raised price target to $345 from $240.

MRVL.title: Marvell Crushed April 2026: Custom AI Silicon at $1.5B Run Rate, Projected to $9-11B in 2026; NVIDIA $2B Partnership
MRVL.content: Marvell custom silicon business reached $1.5B annual run rate in FY2026, scaling to $9-11B projected for 2026. $2B NVIDIA strategic investment validates technology. High-volume production commenced for two major hyperscale AI customers in early 2026.

MRVL.title: Marvell Stock Surges on Google AI Chip Deal and 50+ New Custom ASIC Design Engagements
MRVL.content: MRVL up 84%+ YTD driven by custom silicon ramp for Google TPU and other hyperscalers. Over 50 new custom AI chip design engagements across 10+ customers. Data center revenue 73% of total mix at $1.519B last quarter.

MRVL.title: Marvell Acquires Polariton Technologies to Advance AI Data Center Optical Connectivity to 3.2T and Beyond
MRVL.content: Marvell acquired Polariton Technologies, a developer of high-speed low-power plasmonics-based silicon photonics devices. Terms undisclosed. Adds advanced modulation enabling continued scaling from 1.6T toward 3.2T+ optical connectivity, strengthening Marvell's end-to-end portfolio across ASIC, switching, electro-optics, and photonics for next-generation AI data center architectures.

MRVL.title: Marvell Up 67% in April Alone: Alphabet ASIC Co-Development Confirmed, Nvidia $2B Investment, Custom Silicon at $1.5B Run Rate
MRVL.content: MRVL surged 67% in April 2026 on three catalysts: confirmed Alphabet co-development agreement for custom AI ASIC, $2B Nvidia strategic investment validating technology, and custom silicon reaching $1.5B annual run rate (projected $9-11B for calendar 2026). Over 50 new design engagements across 10+ customers; data center now 73% of revenue mix at $1.519B last quarter.

MRVL.title: Marvell FY2026 Full-Year Revenue $8.195B (+42% YoY); Raises FY2027 Outlook to ~$11B; Q4 FY2026 Earnings on May 21
MRVL.content: Marvell Technology reported full fiscal year 2026 revenue of $8.195B (+42% YoY). Data center surpassed $6B for the year (+46% YoY). Q4 FY2026 revenue $2.219B (+22% YoY). Company raised FY2027 revenue outlook to approach $11B (>30% YoY growth) and FY2028 to ~$15B (~40% YoY). Next earnings report: Q1 FY2027 scheduled May 21, 2026.

MRVL.title: Analysts Raise Marvell Price Targets Ahead of May 21 Q1 FY2027 Earnings; TD Cowen Doubles Target to $180
MRVL.content: Multiple analysts raised MRVL targets ahead of May 21 earnings. TD Cowen raised to $180 from $90. Company guided Q1 revenue of $2.4B (vs $2.28B consensus). AI ASIC (AWS Trainium) + optical interconnect business driving growth.

MRVL.title: Marvell Q1 FY2027 Beats Estimates; Citi Raises Target to $215 (+82%), RBC $200, Wolfe $210; Google TPU Memory Chips
MRVL.source: Marvell IR / Citi / RBC / Wolfe Research
MRVL.content: Marvell Q1 FY2027 earnings (May 21) beat consensus estimates. Analysts raised targets: Citi to $215 (from $118), RBC to $200, Wolfe Research to $210. Google collaboration on custom TPU memory chip designs confirmed. Shares had surged +50%+ over prior month. FY2027 revenue outlook ~$11B (>30% YoY), FY2028 ~$15B (~40% YoY). AI ASIC and optical interconnect businesses driving growth.

MRVL.title: Marvell Q1 FY2027 Official 8-K: Revenue $2.418B Record (+28% YoY); Non-GAAP EPS $0.80 Beat; FY2027 Raised to $11.5B; AI Interconnect +70% YoY
MRVL.content: Marvell Q1 FY2027 8-K (official): Net revenue $2.418B record (+28% YoY), beat guidance midpoint by $18M; non-GAAP EPS $0.80 beat $0.75 estimate; GAAP GM 52.1%, non-GAAP 58.9%. Q2 FY2027 guide: +12% QoQ, +35% YoY. FY2027 total revenue outlook raised to $11.5B (+40% YoY). AI interconnect/custom ASIC revenue to grow 70%+ YoY in FY2027, demand exceeding expectations.

MRVL.title: Marvell Mass Analyst Upgrades Post-Q1: Benchmark $275, BofA $240, Goldman $180, Raymond James $235; FY2028 Revenue Guide Lifted 10% to $16.5B
MRVL.content: Following Q1 FY2027 beat ($2.418B revenue, $0.80 non-GAAP EPS), at least 5 major banks raised targets on May 28-29: Benchmark $275 (from $130), BofA $240, Goldman Sachs $180, Raymond James $235, Cantor Fitzgerald $220. Management raised FY2028 revenue guide 10% to $16.5B (from $15B), reflecting sustained AI custom ASIC and high-speed interconnect demand.
