MRVL.title: Marvell Launches Teralynx T100: Industry's First 102.4 Tbps Switch Silicon for AI Infrastructure
MRVL.content: Marvell introduces Teralynx T100, industry's first 102.4 Tbps switch silicon engineered for AI infrastructure, addressing large AI cluster bottlenecks with lower power and reduced latency. CEO Matt Murphy to deliver Computex 2026 keynote June 2. MRVL +9.42% on June 1.

MRVL.title: Jensen Huang Joins Marvell Computex Keynote; NVIDIA $2B Investment Highlighted; CEO Matt Murphy: 'Marvell Could Be Next Trillion-Dollar Company'
MRVL.content: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang made a special appearance alongside Marvell CEO Matt Murphy at Marvell's Computex 2026 keynote 'The Future of AI Scaling Depends on Connectivity.' Huang endorsed Marvell's connectivity strategy and stated that Marvell 'could be the next trillion-dollar company,' spotlighting NVIDIA's $2B strategic investment. The keynote showcased Teralynx T100 (102.4 Tbps switch) and 100T Teralink for AI cluster connectivity beyond a single rack. Jensen Huang also coined 'use optics where you must' — boosting COHR/LITE stocks 16-13%.

MRVL.title: Marvell Launches Teralynx T100: Industry's First 102.4 Tbps AI-Optimized Switch Silicon; 25% Lower Power vs. Prior Generation
MRVL.content: Marvell Technology introduced the Teralynx T100, the industry's first 102.4 Tbps AI-optimized switch silicon. Delivers 25% lower power consumption and ultra-low latency for improved efficiency in large-scale AI data center spine networks. Targets hyperscale AI clusters alongside Arista and Cisco in next-generation AI fabric infrastructure.

MRVL.title: Marvell Technology Added to S&P 500 Index Effective June 22 — Shares Surge 10%+
MRVL.content: Marvell Technology announced as a new S&P 500 member on June 8, 2026, effective June 22, replacing Campbell Soup. Shares surged 10%+ on the news, extending 210% YTD gain.

MRVL.title: Marvell Q1 FY2027: Record $2.418B Revenue (+28% YoY); Q2 Guidance +35%, Reaching $3B/Qtr One Quarter Early
MRVL.content: Marvell reported record Q1 FY2027 revenue $2.418B (+28% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $0.80, record OCF $638.8M. Data center 76% of sales. Q2 guidance ~$2.7B (+35%). Expects $3B/quarter in Q3, one quarter ahead of schedule.

MRVL.title: Marvell Launches Teralynx T100: 102.4 Tbps AI-Optimized Ethernet Switch on 3nm for Hyperscale AI Clusters
MRVL.content: Marvell launched the Teralynx T100, a 102.4 Tbps AI-optimized Ethernet switch chip on 3nm, targeting hyperscale AI cluster deployments to address power and latency bottlenecks.

MRVL.title: Marvell Appoints Dan Durn (Former Adobe CFO) as New CFO Effective June 15
MRVL.content: Marvell named Dan Durn (former Adobe CFO) as its new CFO effective June 15, 2026. Outgoing CFO Willem Meintjes stays in advisory capacity through April 2027. Durn resigned from Marvell's Board to assume the executive role.

MRVL.title: Qualcomm ByteDance ASIC Deal Triggers Custom-Silicon Selloff; Marvell Falls ~10%
MRVL.content: Marvell fell ~10% on June 9 alongside Qualcomm after reports that Qualcomm secured a large ASIC deal with ByteDance, raising competitive concerns in the custom silicon market where Marvell competes.

MRVL.title: Marvell Technology to Join S&P 500 Index Effective June 22, 2026; Stock Surges 7.54%
MRVL.content: Marvell Technology (MRVL) was announced as a new addition to the S&P 500 Index, effective June 22, 2026. The stock surged 7.54% on the news, building on momentum from new CFO Dan Durn's appointment and ongoing strength in AI data center custom silicon (ASIC) and optical interconnect.

MRVL.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Calls Marvell "Next Trillion-Dollar Company"; Stock Spikes 16–30% Intraday
MRVL.content: MRVL shares spiked 16-30% intraday after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang repeatedly referenced Marvell as the next trillion-dollar company amid AI data-center sentiment.

MRVL.title: Marvell Launches Industry's First 102.4 Tbps Switch for AI and Cloud Data Centers
MRVL.content: Marvell announced availability of the industry's first 102.4 Tbps switch purpose-built for AI and cloud data-center infrastructure.

MRVL.title: Marvell Officially Joins S&P 500 on June 22 Replacing Campbell's; MRVL Closes +7.27% at $310.58 as Index Funds Complete Forced Purchases
MRVL.content: Marvell Technology正式于6月22日纳入S&P 500（取代Campbell's公司），与Flex同步加入。所有追踪标普500的指数基金被迫建仓，叠加NVIDIA CEO黄仁勋称其为下一个万亿美元公司及NVIDIA投资20亿美元，MRVL 2026年迄今累计涨幅达265%。

MRVL.title: Marvell Expands NVIDIA AI Connectivity Deal; Analysts Say Company Is Rewriting Its AI Infrastructure Story
MRVL.content: Marvell Technology quietly expanded its AI infrastructure partnership with NVIDIA for custom connectivity silicon, prompting analysts to describe the company as rewriting its long-term AI infrastructure story. Marvell has previously shipped over 5 million coherent photonic integrated circuits and is now seen as a key supplier for hyperscaler AI switching and custom ASIC programs.

MRVL.title: Marvell Technology Shares Surge 6.61% in AI Infrastructure Rebound
MRVL.content: MRVL rallied 6.61% on July 21, trading as high as $210.60 and closing at $207.96, as semiconductor stocks rebounded strongly amid renewed confidence in AI infrastructure spending. The move reversed a recent ~8.71% decline driven by AI capex sustainability fears.

MRVL.title: Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) Shares Up 6.7% – Here's Why
MRVL.content: Chip stocks including Marvell rebounded sharply as investors bought back into AI infrastructure names. Marvell's Q1 FY2027 results (reported May 27) showed revenue of $2.418B with record operating cash flow of $638.8M. Custom ASIC and data-center networking remain key growth drivers; next earnings expected August 27, 2026.

MRVL.title: China Imposes Export Control and Government Procurement Restrictions on Designated US Companies
MRVL.content: China imposed new export control and government procurement restrictions on designated U.S. semiconductor companies as retaliatory measures. The action compounds existing rare earth export controls and could adversely impact Marvell's China revenue. Marvell has previously flagged that BIS licensing policies and 25% tariffs on certain semiconductor products from January 2026 have reduced China sales.

MRVL.title: Marvell Technology Quarterly Dividend of $0.06/Share Payable July 30
MRVL.content: Marvell Technology has a quarterly cash dividend of $0.06 per share payable July 30, 2026 to stockholders of record as of July 10, 2026. Q1 FY2027 results (revenue $2.418B, non-GAAP EPS $0.80, record cash flow of $638.8M) reflect the company's AI data center growth trajectory. Next earnings report estimated for August 27, 2026.

MRVL.title: Wall Street Remains Strongly Bullish on Marvell; Strong Buy Consensus Cites AI Custom ASIC Wins and NVIDIA NVLink Fusion Partnership
MRVL.content: Marvell Technology holds a Strong Buy consensus from 43 analysts with an average price target of ~$252–$271, implying 25-35% upside from ~$200. Analysts cite custom ASIC momentum, the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion partnership (backed by NVIDIA's $2B strategic investment in March 2026), Teralynx T100 AI switch silicon, and a $4B revenue target for 2028 as key drivers.

MRVL.title: Marvell Falls 4% as Analyst Downgrade and Semiconductor Sector Weakness Weigh on Shares
MRVL.content: MRVL declined ~4% on July 27 on lingering pressure from a recent analyst downgrade and broad semiconductor sector pullback tied to AI capex sustainability concerns. No fresh company-specific news. Last quarter: revenue $2.01B (+57.6% YoY), EPS $0.67 in-line with estimates. Next earnings expected August 20-28.

MRVL.title: Marvell Falls 7.4% in Chip Sector Selloff; Hyperscaler Capex Updates Critical for Recovery
MRVL.content: MRVL shares fell 7.4% July 28 in broad semiconductor selloff. Investors watching Microsoft and Meta capex guidance updates as proxy for Marvell's AI networking demand. Hyperscaler customer concentration risk cited as key concern. Stock compounding a prior 3.81% drop on July 27.

MRVL.title: Marvell Technology Announces $250 Million India Investment to Expand Bangalore AI R&D Hub
MRVL.content: Marvell announced a $250M three-year investment in India, expanding its Bangalore facility, adding Hyderabad presence, and doubling its India engineering headcount. The expanded footprint targets advanced AI, cloud, and data infrastructure semiconductor design and development.

APP.title: AppLovin Q1 2026: Revenue $1.84B (+59% YoY), Net Income $1.21B (+109%); Q2 Guidance $1.93B at 84% EBITDA Margin
APP.content: APP Q1 2026: revenue $1.842B (+59%), net income $1.206B (+109%), adj EBITDA $1.557B (+66%), FCF $1.3B. Q2 guidance revenue $1.93B, EBITDA $1.63B (84% margin). Repurchased 2.2M shares for $1B. Morgan Stanley reiterates Overweight at $720.

APP.title: AppLovin Announces June Public Launch of Axon Platform; Consumer Vertical April Revenue at Record Highs
APP.content: AppLovin to publicly launch Axon advertising platform in June 2026, targeting expansion beyond mobile gaming. Consumer vertical March spend +25% vs January; April at record highs. Gaming ad revenue +44% YoY in Q2 guide.

APP.title: Morgan Stanley: AppLovin June Axon Self-Service Launch Is Key Catalyst; E-Commerce Advertiser Spend +50% Weekly
APP.content: Morgan Stanley identified June 2026 Axon self-service platform launch as the next pivotal catalyst for APP. E-commerce advertisers show 50% weekly spend growth on Axon; Axon 2.0 model improvements and durable margin expansion prospects highlighted. Reiterated Overweight rating post-Q1.

APP.title: AppLovin Stock Falls 7.65% on May 13 as Broader AI Software Rotation Continues; Record Q1 Beat Priced In
APP.content: AppLovin shares declined 7.65% on May 13 as broader AI software valuations faced pressure amid rising rates and macro concerns. APP reported record Q1 2026 revenue $1.842B (+59% YoY) and EPS $3.56, with Q2 guided $1.93B at 84% EBITDA margin. June 2026 Axon self-service platform launch remains the next key catalyst per Morgan Stanley (Overweight, $720 target).

APP.title: Amnesty International Supports Dutch Class Action Lawsuit Against AppLovin for Alleged Illegal Tracking of 1.5M Children
APP.content: Amnesty International backed The Privacy Collective's class action against AppLovin on behalf of Dutch internet users (including 1.5M children), alleging AppLovin's SDK unlawfully collected data via apps like Block Blast, Subway Surfers, and CapCut. Company also faces an active SEC probe. Despite strong Q1 ($1.84B revenue, +59% YoY), legal headwinds mount ahead of June Axon self-service platform launch.

APP.title: AppLovin +11.95% May 27: Major Banks Upgrade on Axon Self-Serve Ad Platform June Launch; Q2 Revenue Guide Above Street
APP.content: AppLovin surged 11.95% on May 27 after UBS, Deutsche Bank, Macquarie, Wedbush, Oppenheimer, and Jefferies issued Buy/Outperform upgrades or raised price targets. Q1 2026: revenue .84B beat .78B est; Q2 guided .915-1.945B and adjusted EBITDA .615-1.645B, both above Street. Key catalyst: Axon self-serve advertising platform confirmed for June 2026 public launch, expected to unlock significant new advertiser growth.

APP.title: AppLovin Opens Axon Platform to All Global Advertisers in June; CEO Projects 100,000 New Customers Adding ~$7B Annual Ad Spend
APP.content: AppLovin opened its Axon AI advertising platform to all global advertisers via full self-serve in June 2026, eliminating the referral-based gating in place since October 2025. CEO Adam Foroughi: 'Come June, advertisers across the world will be able to sign up for Axon and start running campaigns — that changes the trajectory of this company in a very meaningful way.' Unit economics: sub-30-day payback, near-zero churn after day 30, $70K+ annualized spend per advertiser. CEO projection: 100,000 new customers in year one = ~$7B incremental ad spend. AI video creative tool concurrently entering GA to reduce onboarding friction.

APP.title: AppLovin Upgraded to Outperform at Edgewater Research; Shareholders Approve Governance Changes at Annual Meeting
APP.content: Edgewater Research upgraded AppLovin (APP) from Neutral to Outperform on June 5, citing Axon platform global rollout to all advertisers in June as a major monetization catalyst. Shareholders also approved board and governance changes at June 5 annual meeting. Q2 2026 revenue guidance .92-1.95B (+53% YoY); EBITDA margin guided 84-85%.

APP.title: AppLovin Axon AI Advertising Platform Opens Globally to All Ecommerce Advertisers via Self-Serve
APP.content: AppLovin's Axon AI-powered advertising platform opened to all ecommerce advertisers worldwide via self-serve in June 2026, ending a referral-only model active since October 2025. CEO called it a major growth milestone.

APP.title: AppLovin Axon AI Ad Platform Opens to All Advertisers Worldwide in June; Targets ~100K New Customers
APP.source: PPC Land / AppLovin Q1 Earnings Call
APP.content: CEO Adam Foroughi confirmed in June 2026 all advertisers worldwide gain self-serve access to Axon, ending 14 years as a closed-referral platform. The move targets ~100,000 new customers potentially generating ~$7B in initial-year ad spend.

APP.title: AppLovin Presents at 54th Nasdaq & Jefferies Investor Conference; Axon Global Launch Momentum Highlighted
APP.content: AppLovin presented at the Nasdaq & Jefferies Investor Conference June 9, highlighting Q1 beat ($1.84B revenue, +59% YoY) and Axon global self-serve launch momentum as the key near-term catalyst.

APP.title: AppLovin Falls 3.3% on Heavy CEO and CAO Insider Selling Ahead of AXON Global Self-Serve Launch
APP.content: APP fell ~3.3% to $479.49. CEO Arash Foroughi sold 74,000+ shares ($14.6M+) and CAO Victoria Valenzuela sold 20,000 shares per SEC Form 4 filings. Investors cautious ahead of AXON AI ad engine global self-serve launch in late June.

APP.title: AppLovin Opens Axon AI Advertising Platform to All Advertisers; Shares Jump 10.5% on Market Expansion
APP.content: AppLovin opened its Axon AI-powered advertising platform to all advertisers (previously available by invitation only), representing a major addressable market expansion. Multiple Wall Street analysts raised price targets citing the platform's demonstrated AI-driven return on ad spend improvements.

APP.title: Why AppLovin Stock Fell 24% in H1 2026: AXON Slowdown and Heavy Insider Selling
APP.content: AppLovin shares declined 24% in H1 2026 due to a BofA report flagging slower e-commerce growth from the AXON AI ad-targeting engine rollout and heavy insider selling by CEO Adam Foroughi. Q2 2026 earnings expected August 5 with EPS forecast of $3.72, up 64.6% YoY.

APP.title: Jefferies Reiterates AppLovin Buy, $700 Target After Survey Shows E-Commerce Budget Share Gains
APP.content: Jefferies maintained a Buy rating and $700 price target on AppLovin after surveying 30 e-commerce advertisers, finding APP's budget share rose 169 bps QoQ to 11.1% in Q2 2026, ranking #3 by ROAS just ahead of TikTok. Half of advertisers are testing AppLovin's AI-generated video ad tools.

APP.title: AppLovin Surges 5.3% on Platform Expansion to All Advertisers and Bullish Q2 Previews
APP.content: APP shares rose 5.33% on July 27 as investors focused on AppLovin's decision to open its AI-driven ad platform to any business, beyond mobile-game advertisers. Analysts expect Q2 EPS $3.72 (+64.6% YoY) for August 5 report. Company carries 77%+ operating margins. Stock had previously fallen 40% from peaks.

APP.title: Analysts Issue Aggressive Price Targets on AppLovin Ahead of Q2 2026 Earnings
APP.content: Multiple analysts raised bullish price targets on APP ahead of August 5 Q2 results. Company guided Q2 revenue $1.815-1.945B, adjusted EBITDA $1.615-1.645B. Q1 2026 revenue was $1.84B (+59% YoY) with net income doubling. Prior July 13 selloff (-12%) on ecommerce ad growth concerns seen as excessive.

APP.title: AppLovin AXON AI Engine Records Largest Ad Network Share Gain of 2026 Per Jefferies E-Commerce Survey
APP.content: Jefferies survey of 30 e-commerce advertisers shows AppLovin recorded the largest share gain among ad networks in 2026, rising 169bps to 11% of total spend. AXON AI platform expanding from mobile gaming into e-commerce. Q2 2026 earnings due August 5; analysts expect EPS $3.72 (+64.6% YoY) on $1.94B revenue (+54% YoY).

APP.title: AppLovin Names Giovanni Ge as CTO Effective July 1; Craig Billings Named Independent Chairperson
APP.content: Giovanni Ge, architect of AXON 2.0 and former Chief Product and Engineering Officer, became AppLovin CTO effective July 1, 2026. Craig Billings named new independent chairperson. Leadership change positions AXON AI engine development under its principal creator.

TSM.title: TSMC and Amkor Sign 10-Year Advanced Semiconductor Packaging Agreement in Arizona
TSM.content: TSMC and Amkor Technology signed a 10-year agreement for advanced packaging and testing services at Amkor's Arizona facility, supporting TSMC's US supply chain buildout and strengthening domestic advanced packaging capacity for AI and HPC chips.

TSM.title: US-Taiwan Trade Deal: TSMC Arizona Investment Expands to $465B; 11 Fabs Planned Under 15% Tariff Framework
TSM.content: US-Taiwan trade deal caps tariffs on Taiwanese goods at 15%. TSMC plans to expand Arizona investment from $165B to $465B, adding 5 more fabs for 11 total. N2 and A16 processes included. Second fab P2 equipment move-in target: October 2026.

TSM.title: TSMC and Applied Materials Partner at $5B EPIC Center to Accelerate AI Chip Co-Innovation
TSM.content: TSMC and Applied Materials will co-innovate at AMAT's $5B EPIC Center in Silicon Valley to advance materials engineering and process integration for energy-efficient AI chips, accelerating lab-to-fab transitions for next-gen nodes.

TSM.title: TSMC Arizona Corporation Board Approves Up to $20B Capital Injection to Fund Fab Construction and Equipment
TSM.content: TSMC disclosed its U.S. subsidiary TSMC Arizona Corporation approved a capital increase plan authorizing up to $20B injection from parent TSMC, subject to regulatory approvals. Funds support large-scale fab construction and equipment spending under the US-Taiwan trade deal framework (15% tariff cap). Total Arizona investment on track toward $165B+; second fab P2 tool move-in target October 2026, targeting N2 and A16 process nodes.

TSM.title: TSMC Technology Symposium 2026: Global Chip Market $1.5T by 2030; AI/HPC to Reach 55% Share; 9 Fab Phases Planned
TSM.content: At annual Hsinchu technology symposium May 14, TSMC forecast global semiconductor market exceeding $1.5T by 2030: AI/HPC 55%, smartphones 20%, automotive 10%. TSMC planning 9 phases of wafer fab and advanced packaging facilities in 2026. Stock hit new ATH $421.97, market cap ~$2.2T. Quarterly dividend increased 17.2%.

TSM.title: TSMC April 2026 Revenue NT$410.7B +17.5% YoY; Board Approves NT$7/Share Q1 Dividend; Plans VIS Stake Sale
TSM.content: TSMC April 2026 revenue NT$410.73B (-1.1% MoM, +17.5% YoY). Board approved NT$7.0/share Q1 2026 cash dividend. Plans to sell 152M shares (~8.1%) of Vanguard International Semiconductor. Q2 2026 guidance: $39-40.2B revenue, 65.5-67.5% GM.

TSM.title: Bernstein: TSMC Poised for AI Growth Despite Lagging Semiconductor Index; 61% of Q1 Revenue from AI/HPC; N2 Arizona P2 Fab Tool Move-In October 2026
TSM.content: Bernstein analysts flag TSMC has lagged the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index despite fundamentally strong positioning: 61% of Q1 2026 revenue from AI and HPC; N2 Arizona fab (P2) on track for October 2026 equipment move-in as part of $465B US investment; consecutive annual price hikes (5-10% for AI/HPC nodes) already underway through 2029. Bernstein argues stock underperformance is sector-rotation noise — TSMC's structural monopoly on advanced AI chip manufacturing is intact. Q2 2026 guidance: $39-40.2B revenue, GM 65.5-67.5%.

TSM.title: TSMC Arizona Fab Q1 2026 Profit $514M — Exceeds Full-Year 2025; AI Demand "Significantly Outpaces Supply"
TSM.content: TSMC's first Arizona fab earned $514M profit in Q1 2026 alone, exceeding its entire 2025 earnings. Board approved additional $20B capital injection for TSMC Arizona on top of ~$31.3B in broader appropriations. "Demand still significantly outpaces supply," per Counterpoint Research analyst. Stock rose 2.3% May 20 and 1.36% May 21.

TSM.title: TSMC N2 Process in Commercial Production: AMD EPYC Venice First HPC Customer; TSM Stock +1.36% to $407
TSM.content: TSMC's N2 (2nm) process node confirmed in commercial production ramp with AMD EPYC 'Venice' as the first HPC product to ship. AMD also plans to ramp production at TSMC Arizona (N2/A16) fab — P2 equipment move-in October 2026. TSM stock rose 1.36% to $407.15 on May 21. 61% of Q1 2026 revenue from AI/HPC. Stock up to new highs; Bernstein noted TSM lagging the Philly SOX index despite structural monopoly.

TSM.title: TSMC Declares $0.95/Share ADR Dividend; Ex-Date June 11, Payment July 9, 2026; Q2 2026 Revenue Guided $39-40.2B
TSM.content: TSMC declared a $0.95/share ADR cash dividend with ex-date June 11, 2026 and payment date July 9, 2026. Q2 2026 revenue guidance $39-40.2B at gross margin 65.5-67.5%. Arizona Fab P2 (N2 process) tool move-in on track for October 2026. Total Arizona investment trajectory toward $465B under US-Taiwan trade deal (15% tariff cap). Market cap ~$2.2T; 61% of Q1 2026 revenue from AI/HPC customers.

TSM.title: TSMC Raises 3nm Process Pricing Up to 15% for H2 2026 — Second AI-Driven Price Hike This Year; 3nm/5nm Lines Sold Out
TSM.content: TSMC announced a second price increase in 2026: 3nm process quotes raised up to 15% for H2 2026 and another 5-10% in 2027, driven by surging AI server demand from NVIDIA, Google and AWS. All 3nm and 5nm capacity is operating at or near maximum and sold out through year-end. Record gross margin 66.2% in Q1 2026, further expansion expected. TSM ADR rose 2.52% to 12.32.

TSM.title: Bernstein Raises TSMC Target to $430 on 28% EPS CAGR Outlook; Arizona Fab 2 (3nm) Equipment Install Q3 2026; Analyst Consensus $423.50
TSM.content: Bernstein SocGen reiterated Outperform on TSM, raised target to $430 (from $351) projecting 28% EPS CAGR over 2.5 years on AI demand. Analyst consensus $423.50. Arizona Fab 2 (3nm) to begin equipment installation Q3 2026, accelerated from original 2028 timeline. April 2026 consolidated revenue NT$410.7B (+17.5% YoY). Counterpoint: 'demand still significantly outpaces supply, no major sign of slowing.'

TSM.title: TSMC Stock Surges 4.8% to Record $443 as Nvidia Announces Major Taiwan Investment Expansion
TSM.content: TSM hits new 52-week high $443.18 intraday (+4.8%) as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at Computex dramatically expands planned annual Taiwan investment, translating directly into sustained fab utilization for TSMC. Q2 revenue guidance $39B-$40.2B (+30% YoY).

TSM.title: TSMC Plans Up to 15% Price Hike for 3nm Wafers in H2 2026 as Capacity Fully Utilized
TSM.content: TSMC planning 3nm wafer price increases of up to 15% in H2 2026 with potential further hikes in 2027. Capacity fully booked with extended wait times. Positive for TSMC revenue but margin headwind for Nvidia and other fabless customers.

TSM.title: TSMC ADR Hits 52-Week High $449; Adopts NVIDIA cuLitho for 20-50% Manufacturing Efficiency Gain; Intel CEO Visits Taiwan
TSM.content: TSM ADR hit 52-week high $449.39 (Taiwan shares NT$2,380 new high). TSMC implementing NVIDIA cuLitho for computational lithography, achieving 20-50% improvement in cost-effectiveness vs CPU-based systems. Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan visited TSMC management ahead of Computex keynote. TSMC/MediaTek NX1 AI PC chip for Nvidia announced.

TSM.title: TSMC Annual Shareholder Meeting June 4: CEO Confirms >30% Revenue Growth for 2026; AI Chip Supply Constrained; 2025 Revenue NT$3,809B (+40% YoY)
TSM.content: TSMC held its 2026 Annual Shareholders' Meeting on June 4. CEO CC Wei confirmed full-year 2026 revenue will grow more than 30% in USD terms, driven by AI chip demand. Wei noted AI chip supply remains constrained but demand is unconstrained. 2025 annual revenue NT$3,809.05B (+40% YoY), net income NT$1,717.88B, diluted EPS NT$66.25.

TSM.title: TSMC ADR Falls 6.60% to 15.57 in June 5 Chip Sector Sell-Off; Fundamentals Unchanged
TSM.content: TSM ADR fell 6.60% to 15.57 on June 5 as the semiconductor sector sold off post-Broadcom guidance. TSMC fundamentals remain intact: >30% 2026 revenue growth guidance, Q2 2026 guided 9-40.2B (+32% YoY), April 2026 monthly revenue NT10.73B (+17.5% YoY). AI chip demand from NVDA/AMD/AVGO unchanged.

TSM.title: TSMC Delays High-NA EUV Deployment to 2029 — Each Machine Costs €350M+; 2nm Production Unaffected
TSM.content: TSMC will hold off on deploying ASML's most advanced High-NA EUV lithography machines through 2029, citing cost exceeding €350M per unit. TSMC's 2nm/3nm AI chip production for NVDA, AMD, Apple uses existing EUV tools and is unaffected. Delay signals High-NA EUV volume production won't begin at TSMC before 2030, a near-term overhang for ASML High-NA order ramp.

TSM.title: TSMC CEO C.C. Wei: Global Chip Supply Will Fall Short of AI Demand for Years; $165B Arizona Expansion Underway
TSM.content: At TSMC's June 4 Annual Shareholders' Meeting, CEO C.C. Wei said global chip supply will remain insufficient for AI demand for several years. Reaffirmed 30%+ revenue growth guidance for 2026. $165B Arizona program covers 6 fabs, 2 advanced packaging facilities, and an R&D center.

TSM.title: TSMC Reaffirms 30%+ Revenue Growth for 2026; Energy Efficiency Named Top Customer Priority
TSM.content: TSMC reaffirmed 30%+ revenue growth in 2026 driven by AI semiconductor demand. Senior VP noted 'energy efficiency is the area customers most want improvement in.'

TSM.title: TSMC May 2026 Revenue Record NT$416.98B (+30.1% YoY) — AI Chip Demand Drives New Monthly High
TSM.content: TSMC reported May 2026 consolidated net revenue of NT$416.98B (+1.5% MoM, +30.1% YoY), a new monthly record (≈USD $13.25B). Jan-May YTD NT$1,961.80B (+30.0%). Q2 2026 guidance $39-40.2B on track; Q2 earnings scheduled July 16.

TSM.title: TSMC Plans 15% Price Hike for 3nm Process in H2 2026 as AI Chip Demand Tightens Supply
TSM.content: TSMC plans to raise foundry prices moderately in H2 2026, with the 3nm process expected to see a 15% hike due to surging AI chip demand from Nvidia, AMD, and Apple. May 2026 revenue +30.1% YoY to NT$416.98B.

TSM.title: TSMC CoWoS Advanced Packaging Supply Gap Expected to Narrow from 20% to ~10% by Year-End 2026
TSM.content: TSMC and partners are ramping CoWoS advanced packaging capacity for AI accelerators. The supply-demand gap is expected to improve from ~20% to ~10% by end-2026, reducing the bottleneck for Nvidia GB200 and other AI chip customers.

TSM.title: TSMC 3nm Prices Expected to Rise ~15% in H2 2026; Capacity Remains Tight Despite AI Ramp
TSM.content: TSMC plans ~15% price hike on 3nm nodes in H2 2026, with additional 5-10% in 2027. Despite ramping to 160,000-175,000 wafers/month Q2, order backlogs persist from AI demand surge.

TSM.title: TSMC 2026 AGM Approves 2025 Results: Net Revenue NT$3.81T, Net Income NT$1.72T, EPS NT$66.25
TSM.content: TSMC Annual Shareholders Meeting June 4 approved 2025 results: consolidated revenue NT$3,809.05B, net income NT$1,717.88B, diluted EPS NT$66.25. CEO C.C. Wei confirmed openness to selective price hikes to maintain healthy margins.

TSM.title: TSMC and Amkor Technology Sign 10-Year Advanced Packaging Partnership in Arizona
TSM.content: TSMC and Amkor Technology announced a 10-year agreement to expand advanced semiconductor packaging and testing in Arizona. Amkor's large-scale campus in Peoria, AZ targets 2028 operations; deal supports a complete domestic chip supply chain as part of TSMC's U.S. investment strategy.

TSM.title: Republican Lawmakers Urge ITC to Block Imports of TSMC Chips Over UMC Patent Infringement; Ruling Imminent
TSM.content: US Republican lawmakers sent letters urging the ITC to block imports of TSMC-manufactured chips (Apple, Qualcomm, Broadcom named as respondents) found to infringe five patents held by United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC). A preliminary ITC ruling is imminent and could result in an import ban affecting AI-accelerator chips.

TSM.title: S&P Global Revises TSMC Outlook to Positive, Affirms AA- Rating on Dominant ~72% Global Foundry Market Share
TSM.content: S&P Global Ratings revised its outlook on TSMC to Positive from Stable while affirming its AA- long-term issuer credit rating, citing TSMC's ~72% share of global foundry revenue — up from 54.6% in 2021 — and a revenue scale roughly 8.7x larger than its nearest competitor.

TSM.title: TSMC Notifies Customers of 5-10% Advanced Node Wafer Price Hikes Across N7 and Below; Stock Falls 6.6%
TSM.content: TSMC began notifying customers of broad wafer price increases of 5-10% across all advanced nodes (N7, N5, N4, N3, and upcoming N2), covering ~74-75% of TSMC wafer revenue. The hike affects major customers including Nvidia, AMD, Apple, and Qualcomm. TSM ADR fell 6.62% on June 24 following the news.

TSM.title: BofA Raises TSMC Price Target to $590 (Buy); UBS Lifts Target to T$3,400 Citing Pricing Power and 30%+ Revenue Growth
TSM.source: Bank of America / UBS / Yahoo Finance
TSM.content: Bank of America raised its price target on TSMC to $590 from $490 (Buy), and UBS lifted its target to T$3,400 from T$3,000 (Buy), citing TSMC's pricing power, capacity expansion, and 2026 revenue growth guidance raised to over 30%. TSM ADR was up 5.26% on June 29.

TSM.title: TSMC Posts Record Q2 2026 Revenue of $39.62 Billion (+36% YoY); AI Chip Surge Drives Third Consecutive Record Quarter
TSM.content: TSMC Q2 2026 revenue NT$1.27T / US$39.62B, +36% YoY; within guidance of $39.0–40.2B; June revenue alone +68% YoY; full earnings conference call July 16 with margin and H2 guidance details.

TSM.title: TSMC Q2 2026 Earnings Conference Call July 16; Analysts Watch for H2 2026 Guidance and CoWoS Capacity Signals
TSM.content: Q2 full results and management guidance released July 16 at 14:00 Taiwan time / 2:00 AM ET; key watch points: CoWoS advanced packaging capacity, N3/N2 utilization, and full-year revenue visibility above 30% growth in USD.

TSM.title: TSMC to Hike Chip Prices by Up to 10% in 2027, Nikkei Says
TSM.content: TSMC finalized base-price increases of 5–10% on advanced nodes (7nm and below) and mature nodes (12–28nm) effective January 2027. A further 10–15% surcharge may apply to high-performance computing orders beyond pre-agreed volumes. Negotiations with customers began in June and concluded in July. The news sent TSM shares and semiconductor equipment stocks sharply higher.

TSM.title: TSM Stock Jumps Overnight On Reports Of Foundry Price Hike Amid Massive Capacity Expansion
TSM.content: TSM shares jumped in pre-market and morning trading on July 21 following Nikkei Asia's report of the 2027 price hike. The move was accompanied by broad gains across semiconductor equipment peers (AMAT, LRCX, KLAC) as the price hike signals confident demand and healthy pricing power at the world's largest foundry.

TSM.title: TSMC Is Accelerating Arizona Fab Buildout to Capitalize on AI Demand: CFO
TSM.content: TSMC's CFO stated the company is accelerating its Arizona fab buildout to meet AI-driven 'multi-year demand mega trend.' This followed TSMC's July 16 announcement of an additional $100B Arizona investment (four more 2nm-or-better fabs), bringing total Arizona commitment to $265B across 10 fabs, 2 advanced packaging facilities, and an R&D center. Arizona will house ~30% of TSMC's leading-edge capacity upon completion.

TSM.title: TSMC Eyes Price Hikes of Up to 25% on HPC Chip Production in 2027
TSM.content: Detailed breakdown of TSMC's 2027 pricing strategy: base hikes of 5–10% on advanced and mature nodes, with an additional 10–15% surcharge on HPC chip orders above committed volumes, potentially totaling up to 25% for some customers. The move reflects TSMC's capacity constraints and dominant market position amid surging AI chip demand.

TSM.title: TSMC to Raise Chipmaking Prices by Up to 10% in 2027 as AI Demand Surges
TSM.content: TSMC finalized pricing agreements with customers for 5–10% base price hikes across advanced and mature nodes effective January 2027, to offset rising costs for materials, equipment, and overseas fab construction. AI/HPC chip orders exceeding pre-agreed volumes will carry an additional 10–15% surcharge. Bloomberg and MacRumors subsequently confirmed the report.

TSM.title: TSMC Total Arizona Commitment Reaches $265 Billion Covering 10 Planned Fabs
TSM.content: TSMC's cumulative U.S. commitment confirmed at $265 billion, encompassing 10 fab facilities, 2 advanced packaging facilities, and an R&D center in Phoenix. CFO Wendell Huang noted the buildout pace will track customer demand, with all fabs targeting 2nm or more advanced nodes to serve AI workloads.

TSM.title: TSMC Plans to Raise Advanced-Node Wafer Prices 5-10% in 2027; Raises 2026 Capex by $8B to ~$62B
TSM.content: TSMC announced plans to raise advanced-node wafer prices 5-10% in 2027 to offset rising costs, raised its 2026 capex budget by $8 billion to approximately $62 billion, and upgraded its full-year revenue growth target to over 40% in USD terms.

TSM.title: TSMC Announces Additional $100B Investment in Arizona Operations, Bringing US Total to $265B
TSM.content: TSMC announced an additional $100 billion investment in its Arizona operations, bringing cumulative US investment to a record $265 billion. Leading-edge 3nm capacity remains sold out and price increases of 5-10% on advanced nodes begin in 2027.

TSM.title: China Weighs Export Controls Barring TSMC from Making Chips for Huawei, Alibaba, and ByteDance
TSM.content: China's Ministry of Commerce is considering export controls that would prohibit TSMC from manufacturing chips designed by Huawei, Alibaba, and ByteDance. First reported by the Financial Times on July 21, the measure escalates geopolitical risk for TSMC and is weighing on shares near the $390 support level.

TSM.title: TSMC Drops 3.6% as $62B Capex Plan and Rising Chinese Chip Competition Spook Investors
TSM.content: TSM fell 3.61% to $386.99 on July 28, breaking below $390. Despite record Q2 results reported July 16 (revenue $40.2B +33.7% YoY, EPS $4.31 beat vs $3.77), investors weigh $62B 2026 capex commitment and intensifying China semiconductor competition. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance raised above 40% growth.

TSM.title: TSMC Surges 7% on New Advanced Chip-Packaging Tech Report; Raises 2026 Capex Guidance to $60-64B
TSM.content: TSM gained 7% on July 30 after reports that TSMC is developing new advanced chip-packaging technology. TSMC raised 2026 capex guidance to $60-64B (up $4B+ from prior forecast) and announced additional $100B Arizona investment amid surging AI chip demand.

ASML.title: ASML Rises 3.6% on Reports of Faster-Than-Expected EUV Output Expansion Capacity
ASML.content: ASML shares rose 3.6% on June 18 after reports emerged it may expand EUV equipment production more rapidly than projected. Citi also boosted its bull-case price target for WFE makers. ASML stock up ~27% over prior 30 days.

ASML.title: ASML Q1 2026: Net Sales €8.8B; 2026 Guidance Raised to €36-40B; High-NA EUV Enters High-Volume Manufacturing
ASML.content: ASML Q1 2026: net sales €8.8B (+13% YoY), net income €2.8B (+17%). 2026 guidance raised to €36-40B (from €34-39B). EUV revenue €4.1B (+28% YoY). Backlog €38.8B. China fell to 19% of system sales. High-NA EUV entering high-volume manufacturing.

ASML.title: ASML CEO: EUV Supply Cannot Meet Demand Through 2027; Targeting 80 Low-NA Systems in 2027
ASML.content: ASML CEO stated EUV supply will not meet demand in foreseeable future. Plans to ship 80 Low-NA EUV systems in 2027. AI infrastructure build-out represents binding constraint at equipment layer. Stock rose 3.48% on earnings day.

ASML.title: US MATCH Act (April 2, 2026): Bipartisan Bill to Ban DUV Exports and Servicing to China — Major Risk to ASML China Revenue
ASML.content: The MATCH Act proposes banning DUV immersion lithography exports and servicing to Chinese chipmakers (SMIC, Hua Hong, Huawei, CXMT, YMTC). China was 33% of ASML's 2025 revenue. Bill includes 150-day window for allied (Netherlands, Japan) cooperation before U.S. unilateral action. ASML shares fell on the April 7 announcement. Bill still requires Congressional passage; company guided China to ~20% of 2026 revenue.

ASML.title: ASML High-NA EUV Enters High-Volume Manufacturing; Next Q2 2026 Results Expected July 2026; China Now 19% of Sales vs 36% Prior Quarter
ASML.content: Following ASML Q1 2026 results (April 15), High-NA EUV lithography has entered high-volume manufacturing at leading-edge foundries. China fell to 19% of system sales in Q1 from 36% in Q4 2025 due to tightening export controls. 2026 revenue guidance raised to €36-40B. Next earnings Q2 2026 expected mid-July 2026. EUV supply remains demand-constrained through 2027 per CEO.

ASML.title: ASML CEO: High-NA EUV Nearing Commercial Production — First Sub-2nm Chips Expected Within Months; AI Demand Keeps Market Supply-Constrained
ASML.content: ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet: High-NA EUV approaching commercial application, first chips produced via High-NA EUV expected within months. Technology shrinks feature size ~66% vs current Low-NA EUV, enabling sub-2nm processes. Intel leading in High-NA EUV adoption. AI demand from Terafab, Starlink and hyperscalers will keep chip supply constrained for foreseeable future. Each High-NA EUV machine priced ~$400M.

ASML.title: UBS Reinstates ASML as Top Pick in European Semis with Raised PT; Tata Electronics India Partnership Confirmed
ASML.content: ASML gained 3.04% on May 21 and 2.6% on May 22 after UBS reinstated ASML as top pick in European semiconductor sector with raised price target. ASML separately formed semiconductor manufacturing partnership with Tata Electronics to advance chip production in India. Full-year 2026 guidance raised to €36-40B; High-NA EUV (~$400M per unit) nearing commercial production with first sub-2nm chips expected within months.

ASML.title: TSMC Delays High-NA EUV Adoption to 2029, Citing Cost; ASML Stock Falls 4.81% — Low-NA Strategy Intact
ASML.content: TSMC confirmed it will not deploy ASML's High-NA EUV lithography machines for mass production before 2029, citing each unit's ~€350M+ price tag and sufficient capability from existing Low-NA systems. ASML shares fell 4.81% on May 15 before rebounding. Analysts note: Intel and SK Hynix are leading High-NA EUV early adopters, while TSMC will use A12/A13 variants with Low-NA through 2028-2029. ASML 2026 revenue guidance raised to €36-40B; Low-NA target 80 systems in 2027.

ASML.title: ASML Sustains Strong Buy Ratings as EUV Demand Locked In for 2026-2027; TSMC 2nm and Intel 18A Both Require High-NA
ASML.content: ASML maintains strong order book heading into H2 2026 as all major leading-edge fabs (TSMC 2nm, Intel 18A, Samsung) require both EUV and High-NA EUV capacity. Export restrictions to China remain in place but guidance for 2026 revenue of €30-35B maintained. No new major announcements on May 28-29.

ASML.title: US May Expand DUV Export Controls to China — Key Near-Term Risk for ASML
ASML.content: Potential new US law could cut off ASML lower-end DUV machine sales to China (beyond EUV already blocked). Loss of DUV access to China would be a real hit to near-term ASML sales. Stock near 52-week peak, up 53% in 2026; Motley Fool notes ASML could be next $1T tech company.

ASML.title: ASML China Revenue Drops to 19% of Sales (from 36% in Q4 2025); Company Raises FY2026 Guidance to €36-40B as EUV Demand Fills Gap
ASML.content: Despite DUV export controls to China, ASML raised full-year 2026 guidance to €36-40B range. China fell from 36% to 19% of system revenue in Q1 2026, with higher-margin EUV demand from Taiwan, Korea, and US AI customers filling the gap. Finance head confirmed ASML has rare earth material inventory buffer due to long semiconductor equipment lead times.

ASML.title: SK Hynix Places Multi-Year EUV Order >$7B with ASML for HBM Capacity Expansion; ASML Prepares for China Rare-Earth Export Controls
ASML.content: SK Hynix placed a multi-year EUV order exceeding $7B with ASML to support HBM expansion for AI. ASML's finance head confirmed the company has rare-earth material inventory stockpiled (long lead times). China DUV export ban risk persists (MATCH Act April 2026), but China was already 19% of Q1 sales vs 36% in Q4 2025. FY2026 guidance maintained at EUR 36-40B.

ASML.title: ASML Drops 6.49% to ,643.39 in June 5 Semiconductor Equipment Sell-Off
ASML.content: ASML fell 6.49% to ,643.39 on June 5 alongside semiconductor equipment sector sell-off (LRCX -9.85%, KLAC -9.47%, AMAT -7.3%). Sell-off triggered by Broadcom Q3 guidance miss and US orders to halt tool shipments to Hua Hong (China's second-largest chipmaker). ASML Q2 2026 guidance €8.4-9.0B unchanged.

ASML.title: TSMC to Skip ASML High-NA EUV Until 2029 — Creates Near-Term Revenue Mix Uncertainty for ASML
ASML.content: TSMC (ASML's largest customer) will delay High-NA EUV deployment until 2029, as units cost upwards of €350M each. Intel remains the primary High-NA EUV early adopter for 18A/14A. Near-term ASML High-NA unit volume will be limited; existing EUV tools (€150-200M/unit) continue to drive revenue. ASML 2026 full-year guidance €36-40B maintained.

ASML.title: ASML Surges 4%+ on Elon Musk Endorsement and Terafab SpaceX/Tesla $55B Semiconductor Fab JV Announcement
ASML.content: ASML rose 4.18% on June 9 after Elon Musk called ASML 'arguably the greatest company in Europe.' Musk appeared at ASML's Terafab conference discussing a SpaceX/Tesla JV to build a cutting-edge semiconductor fab in Texas valued at $55B+.

ASML.title: JPMorgan Raises ASML Price Target, Retains Overweight Rating; Shares Surged 6.5%
ASML.content: JPMorgan raised its ASML price target early June 2026, maintaining Overweight. Shares surged ~6.5%, supported by Q1 2026 results (€8.8B revenue, 53% gross margin) and full-year guidance of €36-40B in sales.

ASML.title: MATCH Act Could Halt ASML DUV Sales and Servicing to SMIC, Hua Hong, CXMT and Other Chinese Chipmakers
ASML.content: The bipartisan US MATCH Act would stop ASML from selling and servicing DUV equipment to named Chinese chipmakers. China was ~33% of ASML revenue in 2025, projected to fall to 20% in 2026. Estimated EPS impact up to 10% if passed.

ASML.title: ASML to Cut Fewer Jobs Than Planned; Layoffs Delayed Until May 2027
ASML.content: Following negotiations with Dutch trade unions, ASML confirmed it will cut significantly fewer jobs than planned; redundancies will not take effect until May 2027. The final reduction is expected to be 'a lot less' than 1,000 positions, easing investor concerns about demand slowdown.

ASML.title: Bank of America Raises ASML Price Target to EUR 1,921 from EUR 1,710; Maintains Buy
ASML.content: BofA lifted ASML PT to EUR 1,921 from EUR 1,710, maintaining Buy, citing strong Q1 2026 results, raised full-year outlook, and ASML's unassailable position as sole EUV supplier.

ASML.title: ASML Invests €1.3B in Mistral AI, Becomes Largest Shareholder with 11% Stake in French AI Startup
ASML.content: ASML Holding invested €1.3 billion in French AI startup Mistral AI, becoming its largest shareholder with an 11% stake. The investment marks a strategic expansion for the EUV lithography monopolist into the AI software and model infrastructure space.

ASML.title: Morgan Stanley Raises ASML Target to EUR 1,660; JPMorgan to EUR 1,900 on AI EUV Demand Outlook
ASML.content: Morgan Stanley raised ASML price target to EUR 1,660 from EUR 1,400 (Overweight); JPMorgan raised to EUR 1,900 from EUR 1,515 (Overweight). ASML stock up 22.8% over 30 days as AI chip demand drives EUV equipment supercycle.

ASML.title: ASML, TSMC, and imec Achieve First 300mm Integration of 2D-Material Transistors at 50nm Pitch
ASML.content: ASML, TSMC, and imec announced first industrial-scale integration of 2D-material-based nFETs (MoS2) and pFETs on 300mm wafers at 50nm contacted poly pitch, 94% operational transistors. Critical lab-to-fab milestone for post-silicon logic.

ASML.title: JPMorgan Raises ASML Target to EUR 1,900; Morgan Stanley to EUR 1,660 on EUV AI Demand
ASML.content: JPMorgan raised ASML target from EUR 1,515 to EUR 1,900 (Overweight). Morgan Stanley lifted to EUR 1,660. BofA maintained Buy at $2,268. ASML closed at $1,892.66 on June 15, up 27% over one month.

ASML.title: ASML Surges as SpaceX IPO Funds Musk's $55B 'Terafab' AI Chip Fab Plan — ASML Named Key EUV Supplier
ASML.content: ASML surged on June 17 after SpaceX IPO proceeds funded Elon Musk's Terafab semiconductor project — a $55B initial investment by SpaceX, Tesla, and xAI to build a 2nm AI chip fab using ASML's EUV machines, targeting 100-200B AI chips/year. ASML is the sole EUV supplier globally.

ASML.title: US Commerce Secretary Alleges ASML EUV Machine Was Transferred to China in Violation of Export Rules; ASML Denies
ASML.content: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick told ASML senior leaders that one of its top-of-the-line EUV lithography machines may have been transferred to China in violation of export restrictions. Multiple US officials claim to have evidence ASML did not act in good faith. ASML denied the allegations, stating full compliance with all applicable regulations.

ASML.title: ASML Denies EUV Machine in China; US BIS Escalates with Evidence of Components and Transport Equipment; Applied Materials $252.5M Penalty Sets Enforcement Precedent
ASML.content: ASML否认向中国出口EUV整机，但美国商务部BIS称掌握EUV组件及运输设备证据，较整机违规更具可执行性。2026年2月Applied Materials因类似违规被罚$2.525亿，被视为ASML可能面临的先例。荷兰ASML股价承压。

ASML.title: BofA Raises ASML Price Target to $2,345, Wells Fargo to $2,200 on Strong EUV Order Book Ahead of Q2 Results
ASML.content: Bank of America raised its ASML price target to $2,345 (from $2,268) and Wells Fargo raised its target to $2,200 (from $1,750), both maintaining Buy/Overweight ratings. BofA cited increased EUV unit forecasts and expects ASML's 2027 order book to be fully subscribed by the time Q2 results are reported July 15.

ASML.title: Netherlands Joins US-Led 'Pax Silica' Alliance — Risk of Stricter Multilateral Export Controls on ASML EUV
ASML.content: The Dutch government officially joined the US-led Pax Silica semiconductor alliance on June 23, 2026, heightening the risk of stricter multilateral export controls on ASML's EUV and DUV tools. ASML shares fell 7.8% on June 23 amid ongoing concerns sparked by US allegations that an EUV machine may have been transferred to China.

ASML.title: ASML Q2 2026 Earnings Due July 15; Analysts Forecast $10.28B Revenue (+17.8% YoY), EPS $7.98; Options Pricing 8.36% Post-Earnings Swing
ASML.content: ASML reports Q2 2026 before US market open on July 15; guided Q2 net sales €8.4–9.0B at 51–52% gross margin; raised 2026 full-year guidance to €36–40B; stock up 65% YTD.

ASML.title: ASML Raised 2026 Sales Guidance to €36B–40B; EUV and High-NA Demand Strong; Stock Up 65% Year-to-Date
ASML.content: ASML raised 2026 sales guidance to €36B–40B; high-NA EUV system orders the key Q2 signal; both TSMC and ASML earnings this week seen as barometer for entire semiconductor demand cycle.

ASML.title: ASML Q2 2026 Beats Guidance: Net Sales €9.3B, GM 54%; Raises Full-Year 2026 Forecast to €43-45B
ASML.content: Q2净销售额€9.3B，超预期€8.8B；毛利率54%；全年指引从€36-40B大幅上调至€43-45B(毛利率54-56%)；AI需求、DRAM投资加速以及Intel高数值孔径EUV量产进展是主要驱动力

ASML.title: ASML Shares Slide: What Investors Need to Know
ASML.content: ASML stock declined roughly 3% from its July 15 earnings release through July 21 despite beating Q2 expectations. Analysts cite stretched valuations and investor profit-taking after the stock's ~86% first-half 2026 gain. The pullback follows raised full-year guidance of €43–45B (up from €36–40B) and Q2 net sales of €9.3B (+21% YoY).

ASML.title: 1 Massive Reason to Buy ASML Stock Following Its Blowout Earnings Report
ASML.content: Bullish post-earnings take on ASML after Q2 2026 results: €9.3B net sales, €2.9B net income, and raised FY2026 guidance to €43–45B. Analyst coverage updates included Citi raising its price target to EUR 2,200 (from EUR 1,675) and DZ Bank upgrading ASML to Buy from Hold.

ASML.title: Why ASML Stock Jumped 86% in the First Half of 2026
ASML.content: Retrospective on ASML's H1 2026 surge: AI-driven demand for EUV lithography equipment, a record order backlog of €40–45B, and back-to-back guidance raises (April and July). The piece also discusses the risk of valuation compression if AI infrastructure spending growth slows.

ASML.title: Where Will ASML Stock Be in 5 Years?
ASML.content: Long-term outlook piece published July 19, noting ASML is up ~69% YTD and trades at ~40x forward earnings. Discusses ASML's monopoly position in EUV lithography as the key structural advantage, while flagging that any slowdown in AI-driven chip capex would disproportionately impact its premium valuation.

ASML.title: ASML High NA EUV Intel Milestone: First-Ever High-Volume Commercial Logic Shipment on Intel 18A
ASML.content: Analysis highlighted ASML's July 15 press release confirming Intel Foundry achieved the first-ever high-volume commercial logic shipment using High NA EUV — Panther Lake (Core Ultra Series 3) processors on Intel 18A, with select layers on ASML's EXE:5000 scanners. ASML CEO noted Intel reached a 'very important milestone' with the $380M machine. This milestone was expected to feature in Intel's July 23 earnings guidance.

ASML.title: China Begins Mass-Producing Homegrown DUV Immersion Lithography Tools; ASML Shares Plunge ~7%
ASML.content: 据The Information报道，上海一家国有背景企业已开始批量生产沉浸式DUV光刻机（2026年产5台，2027年约20台），预计交付中芯国际、华虹半导体等厂商，突破西方出口管制封锁。ASML股价单日重挫逾7%；ASML中国收入占比已从Q1的19%降至Q2的14%。

ASML.title: ASML Shares Drop ~5% as Reports Emerge of Chinese State-Backed Firms Producing Immersion Lithography Machines
ASML.content: ASML shares fell approximately 5% on July 27 after reports that Chinese state-backed firms had made advances in producing immersion lithography machines, threatening ASML's competitive moat. This came one day before the company's Q2 2026 earnings release.

ASML.title: ASML Reports Q2 2026: EUR9.3B Revenue, EUR2.9B Net Income; Raises Full-Year Guidance to EUR43-45B
ASML.content: ASML Q2 2026 total net sales of EUR9.3B and net income of EUR2.9B both beat guidance, driven by AI-related Logic and Memory demand. Company raised full-year 2026 revenue outlook to EUR43-45B (gross margin 54-56%). Q3 2026 guidance: EUR11-12B revenue, 55-57% gross margin.

ASML.title: ASML Q2 2026 Revenue EUR 9.3B; Raises FY2026 Guidance to EUR 43-45B on AI Chip Demand Surge
ASML.content: ASML reported Q2 2026 total net sales of EUR 9.3B and net income of EUR 2.9B (gross margin 54.0%, operating margin 37.1%, EPS EUR 7.59). Raised FY2026 guidance significantly to EUR 43-45B net sales (up from prior EUR 36-40B guidance), citing accelerating AI chip demand and strong EUV/High-NA EUV order flow. Q3 2026 guided at EUR 11.0-12.0B.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Unveils SENZ Integrated Visual Platform for AI Smart Glasses
AMAT.content: Applied Materials unveiled SENZ, a fully integrated ambient visual platform combining waveguide optics, light engine, sensing, vision correction, and electronic dimming in a single system to accelerate AI-powered next-generation smart glasses manufacturing.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials and EssilorLuxottica Sign Joint Development Agreement for AR Smart Eyewear
AMAT.content: EssilorLuxottica and Applied Materials announced a long-term joint development agreement to co-develop next-generation intelligent optical systems for AI-powered smart eyewear, combining lens expertise with AMAT's waveguide materials engineering.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials and TSMC Partner at $5B EPIC Center to Accelerate AI Chip Technologies
AMAT.content: Applied Materials and TSMC will co-innovate at AMAT's $5B EPIC Center in Silicon Valley to advance materials engineering, equipment innovation, and process integration for next-era AI chips from data center to edge.

AMAT.title: Bernstein: AI Agent Demand Drives Equipment Demand 'Off the Charts'; AMAT, ASML at Maximum Capacity
AMAT.content: Bernstein analyst: binding constraint for AI chip capacity has shifted from chip design to foundry production and semiconductor equipment. TSMC, ASML, and AMAT all running at maximum capacity; supply cannot meet AI demand.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Q2 FY2026 Earnings Tomorrow (May 14): Consensus $7.69B Revenue, EPS $2.66; 20%+ SEM Growth Target Key
AMAT.content: AMAT reports Q2 FY2026 (ends April) results May 14 after close. Consensus: revenue $7.69B (+8.4% YoY), EPS $2.66 (+11.3% YoY); beat streak intact (4 consecutive quarters). Key catalyst: CFO target to deliver >20% semiconductor equipment business growth in calendar 2026. Focus on DRAM/HBM and advanced packaging demand. Morgan Stanley $454 target, Seaport Research Buy $500 target. AMAT-TSMC $5B EPIC Center partnership announced May 11.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Q2 FY2026: Record Revenue $7.91B (+11% YoY); Non-GAAP EPS $2.86 (+20%); Dividend +15%; SEM Business to Grow >30% in 2026
AMAT.content: AMAT Q2 FY2026 (ended April 27): record revenue $7.91B (+11% YoY, beat $7.68B est), non-GAAP EPS $2.86 (+20% YoY, beat $2.68 est), non-GAAP GM 50.0% (record). Q3 guided revenue ~$8.25B. Semiconductor equipment business expected to grow >30% in calendar 2026. Raised quarterly dividend 15% to $0.53/share (9th consecutive annual increase). Announced acquisition of ASMPT's NEXX business (large-area advanced packaging deposition equipment) to strengthen panel-level packaging for AI accelerators.

AMAT.title: Morgan Stanley Cuts Applied Materials to Equal-Weight: China Share Concerns, In-Line 2027 Growth
AMAT.content: Morgan Stanley downgraded AMAT to Equal-weight; 2027 growth expected in-line with market, persistent China share concerns, valuation discount unlikely to narrow despite 2026 share gains. LRCX upgraded simultaneously.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials CEO at Bernstein Conference May 28; In Terafab AI Chip Fab Discussions; Citi Raises Target
AMAT.content: AMAT CEO Gary Dickerson presented at Bernstein Strategic Decisions Conference (May 28, 9am ET). Reports indicate AMAT in preliminary discussions with Elon Musk's Terafab AI chip fab project (2nm, targeting 1 terawatt annual compute capacity). Citi massively raised AMAT price target. Stock at $448.29.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials CFO at BofA 2026 Global Technology Conference: Semiconductor Systems Growth Forecast Raised to 30%+
AMAT.content: Applied Materials CFO Brice Hill presented at BofA Securities Global Technology Conference June 2. Key: AMAT raised full-year semiconductor systems business growth forecast to 30%+ for calendar 2026 on strong new orders. Q2 FY2026 revenue $7.91B record (+11% YoY), GAAP EPS $3.51 record. Advanced packaging expansion continues via EPIC Platform with Broadcom joining, and planned ASMPT NEXX business acquisition for panel-level packaging.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Drops 7.3% on June 5 in Chip Equipment Sector Selloff; China WFE Export Restriction Fears Weigh on Sector
AMAT.content: Applied Materials fell 7.3% on June 5 alongside Lam Research (-7.5%), KLA (-6.15%), and Nova (-7.3%) as investors feared expanded US export restrictions on semiconductor WFE equipment to China. The MATCH Act (April 2026) would ban advanced DUV machinery exports to China. Despite the selloff, the WFE market remains on track for $140B+ in 2026 driven by AI capex.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Declares $0.53 Quarterly Cash Dividend — Ninth Consecutive Year of Increases
AMAT.content: Applied Materials declared quarterly cash dividend of $0.53/share payable September 10, 2026. Ninth consecutive year of increases; rate raised 15% in March 2026 from $0.46.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Expands Singapore Manufacturing Campus for AI Chip Demand
AMAT.content: Applied Materials announced a new facility at its Tampines Campus in Singapore to strengthen global manufacturing and R&D for AI chip equipment. Board simultaneously raised quarterly dividend 15% to $0.53/share—ninth consecutive year of increases.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Agrees to Acquire ASMPT's NEXX Business for Advanced AI Chip Packaging
AMAT.content: Applied Materials entered agreement to acquire ASMPT Limited's NEXX business, a leader in large-area advanced packaging deposition equipment. Broadens AMAT's panel-level advanced packaging portfolio for larger-body AI accelerators.

AMAT.title: Cantor Fitzgerald Raises AMAT Target to $650 on Multi-Year Equipment Upcycle; Barclays Reaffirms $590
AMAT.content: Cantor Fitzgerald raised AMAT target from $575 to $650 (Overweight), citing semiconductor equipment "early innings of a multi-year supply-constrained and durable upcycle" with bookings into 2028. Barclays reaffirmed $590 Overweight; AMAT surged 8.22% on June 11.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Partners with EssilorLuxottica to Co-Develop AR Smart Eyewear Optical Systems
AMAT.content: Applied Materials and EssilorLuxottica announced partnership to co-develop advanced AR and AI-powered smart eyewear optical systems, extending AMAT materials engineering capabilities into consumer optics.

AMAT.title: Citi Raises Applied Materials Price Target to $290 (Post-Split); Singapore AI Infrastructure Buildout Cited
AMAT.content: Citi raised its Applied Materials price target (post-10-for-1 split) to $290, joining Cantor Fitzgerald, Barclays, and UBS in lifting targets. Key catalyst cited: accelerating AI infrastructure buildout in Singapore as a near-term demand driver on top of AI-driven WFE capex cycle.

AMAT.title: Wells Fargo Upgrades Applied Materials to Buy ($715 PT), BofA Raises to $720 on New GAA Transistor Chip Tools
AMAT.content: Wells Fargo upgraded Applied Materials to Buy with a $715 price target (from $520) and Bank of America raised its target to $720 (from $540), citing AMAT's new Centris Spectral SiN ALD and Producer Selectra Mo Etch systems for GAA transistor manufacturing and strong positioning for next-gen AI chips.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Launches Six New AI Chipmaking Systems Targeting DRAM and Advanced Packaging Challenges
AMAT.content: Applied Materials introduced six new chipmaking systems including Centura Prime Epi epitaxy, Opta Quad CMP, and Nokota VMax 2 electrochemical deposition systems, targeting DRAM manufacturing and HBM stacking yield challenges. Shares jumped ~7% on the announcement. Company projects semiconductor industry revenue could reach $1 trillion in 2026.

AMAT.title: KeyBanc Raises Applied Materials Price Target to $750 from $550 (Overweight) Ahead of August Earnings
AMAT.content: KeyBanc Capital Markets raised its Applied Materials price target to $750 from $550, maintaining Overweight, ahead of the August 13 Q3 earnings date. Firm noted expectations are 'higher than ever' and shares need beats on key metrics to hold gains. Q3 estimates: EPS ~$3.38, revenue ~$9B (~36% YoY growth).

AMAT.title: South Korea Unveils $518B Samsung and SK Hynix Semiconductor Investment; Applied Materials Surges ~10% to Record High
AMAT.content: South Korea announced 800 trillion KRW (18B+) national semiconductor plan with Samsung and SK Hynix building four new advanced fabs targeting double DRAM capacity in 5 years. AMAT surged ~10% to record high; Citi upgraded global WFE market forecast to 45B for 2026, 00B for 2027, 50B for 2028 bull case.

AMAT.title: Citi Raises Applied Materials Price Target to $710 from $550; Bull-Case WFE Spending $145B in 2026, $200B in 2027, $250B in 2028
AMAT.content: Citi raised AMAT PT to $710, first-ever 2028 WFE forecast of $250B; AI agentic demand driving HBM and advanced DRAM investment well beyond prior forecasts.

AMAT.title: Stifel Raises Price Targets on AMAT, KLA, Lam Research; Prolonged Semiconductor Equipment Demand Cycle Driven by AI
AMAT.content: Stifel's 5-star analyst Brian Chin raised PTs on all three semi equipment leaders; maintains Buy; notes agentic AI pushing memory demand higher and extending the WFE upcycle.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Inc (AMAT) Moved Up by 6.49% on July 21
AMAT.content: Applied Materials shares surged 6.49% on July 21, outperforming the Technology Equipment sector (+2.36%). The rally was primarily driven by TSMC's announcement of up-to-10% foundry price hikes in 2027, which signaled robust demand for chipmaking equipment, benefiting AMAT as a leading supplier of deposition and etch tools. The stock is up ~110% YTD but still ~21.9% below its 52-week high of $723.

AMAT.title: Why Applied Materials (AMAT) Stock Is Up Today
AMAT.content: AMAT's July 21 rally attributed to: (1) TSMC price hike report signaling healthy foundry demand, (2) broader acceleration in gate-all-around transistor architecture adoption driving equipment spending, and (3) TSMC's raised 2026 capex guidance following record Q2 results. CEO Gary Dickerson has publicly cited demand visibility extending through 2030.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Stock Jumps as TSMC Lifts 2026 Capex and Barclays Upgrades AMAT
AMAT.content: Barclays upgraded Applied Materials alongside the July 21 sector rally tied to TSMC's capex lift and price hike news. B. Riley also raised its price target on AMAT. TSMC's record Q2 with 67.7% gross margin and raised full-year capex underscores sustained demand for Applied Materials' process equipment across advanced nodes.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Joins CuspAI AI Materials Foundry as Founding Member Alongside NVIDIA and Meta FAIR
AMAT.content: CuspAI launched the AI Materials Foundry with 45+ founding members including Applied Materials, NVIDIA, and Meta's FAIR team, aimed at using AI to accelerate semiconductor materials discovery. CuspAI simultaneously announced a $450M Series B at a $2.6B valuation. Applied Materials' participation signals a strategic push into AI-driven materials R&D for next-generation chip process development.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Shares Surge 7.4% After TSMC Announces Plans to Raise Chipmaking Prices Up to 10%
AMAT.content: Applied Materials shares surged 7.4% to $564.55 on July 21 after TSMC announced plans to raise chipmaking prices by up to 10% starting in 2027, signaling robust demand for advanced semiconductor capacity.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Jumps on TSMC Expansion as Fair Value Debate Stays Open
AMAT.content: Applied Materials continued to gain as TSMC's 2027 pricing strategy and $100B Arizona expansion reaffirmed the long-term semiconductor equipment investment cycle; analysts debated whether AMAT, up 110% YTD, still has meaningful upside despite trading 21.9% below its 52-week high.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Drops 4.9% in Broad Chip Equipment Sector Selloff
AMAT.content: AMAT fell 4.89% on July 27 amid sector-wide pressure on semiconductor equipment names. Applied Materials recently joined the AI Materials Foundry (global CuspAI collaboration) as a founding member to apply AI to semiconductor materials discovery. Q3 FY2026 earnings scheduled August 13. Prior Q2 FY2026 revenue was a record $7.91B (+20% YoY).

AMAT.title: Applied Materials Slides 7.5% on Regulatory Probe Concerns and Export Restriction Worries
AMAT.content: AMAT slid 7.54% on July 28 as concerns resurfaced about potential ongoing DOJ/SEC investigations tied to SMIC equipment exports, alongside tightening export regulation signals from the U.S. government. Applied Materials settled with Commerce Dept. BIS for $252.5M in February 2026 for 56 unlicensed ion implanter shipments to SMIC in 2021-22; DOJ/SEC probes were closed at that time.

KLAC.title: KLA Corp Gains 2.9% as AMAT-TSMC EPIC Center Partnership Signals Sustained Equipment Supercycle
KLAC.content: KLAC gained 2.89% following AMAT-TSMC EPIC Center announcement. Measurement and inspection tools are critical for AI chip yield at 3nm/2nm nodes. KLA running at maximum capacity alongside AMAT and ASML.

KLAC.title: TSMC and ASML Post-Earnings Signal Semiconductor Equipment Makers Like KLAC Are Key AI Bottleneck
KLAC.content: Following TSMC and ASML Q1 earnings, analysts note the binding constraint for AI chip capacity has shifted to equipment makers like ASML, Lam Research, and KLA. All running at maximum capacity to meet AI infrastructure buildout demand.

KLAC.title: KLA Corp Announces 10-for-1 Stock Split and 21% Dividend Increase — 17th Consecutive Annual Dividend Raise
KLAC.content: KLA Corp board approved a 10-for-1 forward stock split (record date June 4, trading on split-adjusted basis June 12, 2026 on Nasdaq as KLAC). Quarterly dividend raised 21% to $2.30/share pre-split ($0.23 post-split), the 17th consecutive annual dividend increase. CFO: split intended to improve share accessibility consistent with long-term capital allocation strategy. WFE industry 2026 forecast $140B (per LRCX); KLAC running at maximum capacity.

KLAC.title: KLA Corp: Shares Decline as Morgan Stanley Raises Broader WFE Forecast to $140B for 2026
KLAC.content: KLA shares under pressure amid sector rotation. Industry backdrop strong: WFE market forecast raised to $140B for 2026. KLA Q1 FY2026 revenue $3.4B (+6.6% YoY), GM 61.1%, benefiting from AI-driven advanced node investments by TSMC and Samsung.

KLAC.title: KLA Corporation Poised for Growth as Semiconductor Equipment Demand Surges; Analysts Bullish on Market Share Gains
KLAC.content: Motley Fool coverage highlights KLA's dominant position in wafer metrology/inspection — 'Huge News' (May 27) and 'Great News' (May 28) articles underscore limited competition and strong AI-driven semiconductor capex cycle. KLAC stock at $1,791.44 (+3.26% on May 28). Semiconductor industry boom translating directly to inspection equipment demand.

KLAC.title: KLA Corp Gains 4.56% Post-Nvidia Keynote; Jefferies Upgrades; BofA Forecasts WFE Market $131B in 2026, $150B in 2027
KLAC.content: KLAC jumped 4.56% to $2,028.57 on June 1 post-Computex. Jefferies upgrades KLA. Bank of America forecasts WFE market $131B (+10% YoY) in 2026 and $150B (+14%) in 2027, driven by HBM expansion, leading-edge logic (3nm/2nm), and advanced packaging. KLAC's yield inspection and process control tools are critical for all these nodes.

KLAC.title: KLA Presents at BofA 2026 Global Technology Conference; June 4 Record Date for 10-for-1 Stock Split
KLAC.content: KLA presented at BofA Securities 2026 Global Technology Conference on June 3 at 9:20 AM PT. June 4 is the record date for KLA's 10-for-1 forward stock split (announced May 7). Post-split trading begins June 12. KLA is up ~59.7% YTD 2026, holding ~58% global market share in semiconductor process control. Q4 FY2026 revenue guidance $3.575B ±$200M.

KLAC.title: KLA 10-for-1 Stock Split Record Date — Shareholders Receive 9 Additional Shares June 11; Split-Adjusted Trading June 12
KLAC.content: June 4 is the record date for KLA's Board-approved 10-for-1 forward stock split. Each stockholder of record receives 9 additional shares on June 11; split-adjusted trading starts June 12. Quarterly dividend $2.30/share pre-split (21% increase approved March 12) was paid June 2. The split reflects management confidence in sustained earnings power from the AI-driven WFE cycle.

KLAC.title: KLA Drops 6.15% on June 5 in WFE Sector Selloff; 10-for-1 Stock Split Effective June 11, Split-Adjusted Trading Begins June 12
KLAC.content: KLA Corporation fell 6.15% on June 5 alongside semiconductor equipment peers in a China WFE export restriction-driven selloff (AMAT -7.3%, LRCX -7.5%). Separately, KLA's 10-for-1 stock split becomes effective June 11 after market close, with shares trading split-adjusted from June 12 open. Post-split dividend will be $0.23/share (+21% vs. pre-split $2.30 on a per-share basis).

KLAC.title: KLA +8.73% on June 10 Ahead of 10-for-1 Stock Split Effective June 11; Cantor Raises Price Target
KLAC.content: KLA Corp (KLAC) rose 8.73% on June 10 ahead of the 10-for-1 forward stock split effective after Nasdaq close June 11 (trading on split-adjusted basis begins June 12); Cantor Fitzgerald raised KLAC price target in the session on improved semiconductor capex outlook.

KLAC.title: Export Controls on China to Cost KLA $300M–$350M in Revenue for 2026
KLAC.content: U.S. export controls targeting semiconductor equipment to China are estimated to cost KLA $300–$350M in forfeited FY2026 revenue, ongoing headwind despite strong overall AI-driven equipment demand from non-China customers.

KLAC.title: KLA Corp +8.7% on June 18 Following Citi Sector-Wide WFE Price Target Hikes; Post-Split High of $259.56
KLAC.content: KLAC surged 8.7% on June 18 to $259.56 after Citigroup issued broad price target upgrades across the wafer fab equipment sector, reflecting AI-driven capex demand optimism. Stock extended gains +8.73% on June 19, approaching a new 52-week high.

KLAC.title: Cantor Fitzgerald Raises KLA Corp Target to $2,500 Pre-Split (Overweight); KLAC New 52-Week High $260.62
KLAC.content: Cantor Fitzgerald lifted its KLAC price target to $2,500 pre-split (Overweight), citing multi-year AI equipment upcycle with booking visibility into 2028. Following a 10-for-1 stock split effective June 12, KLAC hit a new 52-week high of $260.62 on June 19.

KLAC.title: BofA Raises KLA Corporation Price Target 51% to $317, Citing $2.7 Trillion Semiconductor TAM Forecast
KLAC.content: Bank of America maintained its Buy rating on KLA and raised its price target to $317 from $210 — a 51% increase — after updating semiconductor industry models to reflect a new 2030 TAM forecast of $2.7 trillion (up from $2.3 trillion), driven by data center and memory demand.

KLAC.title: KLA Corp Surges 7.1% as Cantor Fitzgerald Raises Post-Split Price Target to $325 on AI Chip Spending Momentum
KLAC.content: KLA Corp shares rose 7.11% on June 29, 2026, driven by Cantor Fitzgerald raising its post-split price target to $325 from $250 (Overweight), citing AI-related chip spending momentum. Management also raised its 2026 revenue outlook for advanced packaging process control products to approximately $1 billion.

KLAC.title: Citi Raises KLA Corporation Price Target to $290 from $206; Q2 2026 Earnings Scheduled July 23
KLAC.content: Citi raises KLAC PT to $290; bull-case WFE scenario of $145B in 2026 supports strong process-control demand; KLAC Q2 earnings call July 23.

KLAC.title: Stifel Raises KLA Price Target; AI-Driven HBM and Advanced Logic Demand Supports Prolonged Equipment Upcycle
KLAC.content: Stifel keeps Buy on KLAC; notes KLA's process-control position uniquely benefits from yield management demand as customers push into N2 and DRAM EUV nodes.

KLAC.title: KLA (KLAC) to Release Quarterly Earnings on Tuesday, July 28
KLAC.content: KLA Corporation confirmed it will report Q4 FY2026 results on July 28 at 2pm PT after market close, accompanied by a shareholder letter and earnings slide presentation. Analyst consensus expects adjusted EPS of ~$1.00 (+6.4% YoY). Of 28 analysts covering KLAC, 15 rate it Strong Buy, 3 Moderate Buy, 10 Hold, with an average price target of $224.28.

KLAC.title: KLAC Stock Rallies As Wall Street Hikes AI-Fueled Targets
KLAC.content: Cantor Fitzgerald raised its KLAC price target to $325, citing a durable AI-driven semiconductor equipment upcycle and a chip industry projected to top $3.5T by 2030. Wall Street consensus remains broadly constructive with Moderate Buy ratings and average targets near $277–$280, even after a ~18% pullback from June highs.

KLAC.title: $290,000 of KLA Corporation Lobbying Disclosed — Export Controls on Semiconductor Equipment
KLAC.content: KLA Corporation disclosed $290,000 in Q2 2026 lobbying activity, including lobbying on US-China trade policy and export controls on semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The filing is relevant given ongoing US government scrutiny of advanced chipmaking tool exports to China, where KLA has significant revenue exposure.

KLAC.title: UBS Maintains Neutral on KLA Corporation, Lowers Price Target to $240; Q4 Earnings Set for July 28
KLAC.content: UBS maintained Neutral on KLA Corporation while cutting price target to $240 from $255, citing valuation concerns. Contrasts with BofA (Buy, $317 target) and Wells Fargo (Overweight, $305 target). KLA Q4 FY2026 earnings scheduled for July 28, with consensus expecting adjusted EPS of $9.87 and revenue of $3.58 billion.

KLAC.title: KLA Announces Fourth Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Earnings Date of July 28
KLAC.content: KLA Corporation will release Q4 FY2026 earnings on July 28, 2026. Analysts expect EPS of approximately $1.00 and revenue of $3.60 billion, representing ~13.7% year-over-year revenue growth.

KLAC.title: KLA Corp Shares Surge 4.8% on Broad Semiconductor Equipment Rally Following TSMC Price Hike
KLAC.content: KLAC shares rose 4.8% to $217.56 on July 21, lifted alongside AMAT and LRCX by TSMC's chipmaking price hike announcement confirming sustained demand for advanced semiconductor capacity.

KLAC.title: What to Expect From KLA Corporation's Q4 FY2026 Earnings Report Due July 28
KLAC.content: Analysts preview KLA's Q4 FY2026 earnings (scheduled July 28 after close), expecting revenue of approximately $3.60 billion (+13.7% YoY) and EPS of $9.87, building on Q3's record $3.42 billion quarter driven by leading-edge and advanced packaging demand.

KLAC.title: KLA Corporation Stock Fell 12% in a Day to $236 Ahead of July 28 Q4 FY2026 Earnings
KLAC.content: KLAC dropped 12% in a single session ahead of Q4 FY2026 earnings on July 28. Analysts expect $3.61B revenue (+13.7% YoY) and $1.00 EPS (+6.4% YoY). Key watch: AI foundry/logic spending strength and DRAM inspection volumes.

KLAC.title: Earnings Preview: KLA Corporation Reports Q4 FY2026 Results Tomorrow After Market Close
KLAC.content: KLA scheduled to release fiscal Q4 2026 results July 28 at 2:00 p.m. PT. Consensus: $3.61B revenue, $1.00 EPS. Company guided $3.575B ±$200M. 15 of 28 analysts rate Strong Buy.

KLAC.title: KLA Reports Q4 FY2026 Record Revenue $3.66B, Beats EPS; Shares Tumble ~11% on Margin Mix Concerns
KLAC.content: KLA posted Q4 FY2026 record revenue of $3.66B (vs $3.6B consensus) and EPS beat. FY2027 guidance of $3.8-4.2B revenue broadly in line with consensus. Despite the beat, shares fell ~6% in regular trading and additional ~7.7% after-hours on investor concerns about margin mix and pace of capacity expansion.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Investors Focus on June Dragonfly G5 Shipments for 2.5D AI Advanced Packaging
ONTO.content: Onto Innovation climbed week of June 16 as investors focused on initial Dragonfly G5 shipments expected in June 2026 for 2.5D AI advanced packaging. Company issued $1.30B in convertible notes and acquired 27% stake in Rigaku. Record Q1 revenue of $292M (+~10% QoQ).

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Q1 2026: Revenue $292M (+10% Sequential); Advanced Packaging Revenue to Grow >50% in 2026
ONTO.content: ONTO Q1 2026 revenue $292M exceeded high end of guidance across all metrics. Dragonfly G5 initial commercial shipments and qualification at leading 2.5D logic customer. Advanced packaging (HBM/2.5D) expected to grow >50% in 2026. Full-year revenue growth >30% expected.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Announces $710M Strategic Investment for 27% Stake in Rigaku for AI-Enhanced X-Ray Metrology
ONTO.content: ONTO announced $710M strategic investment in Rigaku, acquiring 27% stake. Partnership integrates AI Diffract software into Rigaku X-ray metrology platforms to address advanced packaging inspection demands at HBM and CoWoS nodes.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Q1 2026 Revenue $300M+; HBM CoWoS Metrology Demand Drives Equipment Cycle
ONTO.content: ONTO Q1 2026 revenue continued growth driven by HBM and CoWoS advanced packaging metrology. TSMC CoWoS capacity expansion (for NVDA Blackwell) drives demand for ONTO's specialty inspection/measurement equipment.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Q1 2026 Earnings Beat; Plans $710M Investment for 27% Stake in Rigaku Holdings
ONTO.content: Onto Innovation announced a $710M investment for 27% stake in Rigaku Holdings to build hybrid X-ray and optical metrology capabilities. Q1 2026 revenue $291.9M (+9.5% YoY), full-year guidance raised to above $1.3B.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Shares Rise 6.2% on Dragonfly G5 Momentum and Rigaku Partnership
ONTO.content: Onto Innovation shares closed at $268.99 (+6.2%) on June 8, driven by Dragonfly G5 inspection platform momentum and growing market recognition of the Rigaku partnership as a strategic differentiator.

ONTO.title: Morgan Stanley Initiates Onto Innovation with Overweight Rating and $371 Price Target
ONTO.content: Morgan Stanley initiated ONTO with Overweight/$371 target citing strong HBM and advanced packaging inspection demand. Adds to Deutsche Bank (Buy/$350) and Oppenheimer (Outperform/$370) bullish calls.

ONTO.title: Oppenheimer Raises Onto Innovation Price Target to $450 from $370, Maintains Outperform on AI/Advanced Packaging Demand
ONTO.content: Oppenheimer maintained an Outperform rating and raised its Onto Innovation price target from $370 to $450, citing continued AI and advanced packaging demand momentum and the company's record Q1 2026 revenue of $292M with projected 30%+ revenue growth for full-year 2026.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation to Report Q2 2026 Financial Results on August 6
ONTO.content: Onto Innovation scheduled its Q2 2026 earnings release for August 6 after market close. Q2 guidance midpoint calls for ~$325M revenue and ~$1.69 EPS, with gross margin 56%-56.5% and operating margin 28%-28.6%. Stock has doubled YTD driven by Dragonfly G5 wins at 2.5D logic and HBM customers and Atlas G6 selection by a second logic customer for gate-all-around metrology.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Sets Q2 2026 Earnings Release for August 6; Q2 Revenue Guide $320-330M — Record Growth Continues
ONTO.content: ONTO announced Q2 2026 financial results scheduled for August 6. Revenue guide $320-330M (midpoint $325M vs $291.9M Q1 2026 record). Dragonfly G5 system qualified at leading 2.5D logic and HBM customers; Atlas G6 selected by second logic customer for gate-all-around metrology. AI semiconductor inspection demand driving strong backlog.

SNPS.title: Synopsys Launches Multiphysics Fusion Platform Combining AI-Powered EDA with Ansys Analysis
SNPS.content: Synopsys announced Multiphysics Fusion solutions combining AI-powered EDA with Ansys golden-signoff analysis for timing, power integrity, thermal, and EM across advanced chips. Delivers up to 3x faster SPICE-accurate timing and 10x faster design closure. Validated by Cisco, MediaTek, NVIDIA, and Samsung Foundry. Stock rose 5.41%.

SNPS.title: Synopsys Q1 FY2026 Earnings: Revenue $2.41B (+66% YoY) on Ansys Integration; Non-GAAP EPS $3.77, Backlog $11.3B
SNPS.content: SNPS Q1 FY2026: revenue $2.409B (+66% YoY), Design Automation $2.0B (+96%), non-GAAP EPS $3.77. Backlog $11.3B. Ansys integration progressing with joint solutions expected H1 2026 and monetization in FY2027.

SNPS.title: Elliott Management Takes Stake in Synopsys; Stock Down 23% From 52-Week High Despite EDA Dominance
SNPS.content: Elliott Management disclosed a stake in Synopsys while SNPS trades 23% below 52-week high. Activist involvement could accelerate strategic changes. Company unveiled AgentEngineer (2-5x EDA productivity) and Electronics Digital Twin Platform at Converge 2026.

SNPS.title: Synopsys Q2 FY2026 Earnings Scheduled May 27; Citi Raises PT to $600; Ansys Integration Ahead of $400M Target
SNPS.content: Synopsys will report Q2 FY2026 results May 27 after market close. Citi raised price target to $600 (from $580) on May 6. Morgan Stanley: Ansys integration ahead of plan targeting $400M cost synergies ahead of original 3-year schedule. Stock +27% in past month. Elliott Management stake disclosed.
