AMZN.title: Amazon Prime Day 2026 Launches June 23-26; Earliest Since 2021; AI-Powered Personalization Deployed; Walmart Intensifies Competition
AMZN.content: Amazon Prime Day 2026于6月23日至26日举行，为2021年以来最早。AMZN利用AI个性化推荐提升转化率，沃尔玛同期推出大额电子产品折扣展开竞争。Prime Day通常是AMZN季度GMV重要驱动因素。

AMZN.title: Amazon Announces $13 Billion Additional Investment in India AI and Cloud Infrastructure Through 2030
AMZN.content: Amazon announced plans to invest an additional $13 billion to expand AI and cloud infrastructure in India, bringing total committed investment to $48 billion between 2026 and 2030. The expansion covers AWS data center capacity in Mumbai and Hyderabad, providing access to custom AI chips, managed AI services, and developer tools for Indian startups, enterprises, and government.

AMZN.title: EU Preliminary Finding: Amazon AWS Should Be Designated a 'Cloud Gatekeeper' Under Digital Markets Act
AMZN.content: The European Commission issued preliminary findings on June 25-26, 2026 that Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure should be designated as 'gatekeepers' under the EU Digital Markets Act. AWS faces potential requirements and fines of up to 10% of worldwide annual turnover for non-compliance. AWS called the designation a risk to European investment and innovation.

AMZN.title: Amazon Prime Day 2026 Delivers Record $26.4 Billion in Online Sales Over June 23-26
AMZN.content: Amazon's Prime Day 2026 (June 23-26) generated a record $26.4 billion in online spending per Adobe Analytics. Amazon captured approximately 60% of total e-commerce activity during the event. The results provided a positive revenue read-through for AWS AI momentum, boosting AMZN stock by 4.4% on June 29.

AMZN.title: Amazon Raises $25 Billion in Bond Sale to Fund AI Infrastructure; No Further 2026 Debt Planned
AMZN.content: Amazon raised at least $25 billion through a US bond sale to fund its massive AI infrastructure investments, including AWS data center expansion. The company told underwriters it does not plan to issue additional debt for the remainder of 2026, making this its largest single capital markets raise specifically designated for AI capex.

AMZN.title: Amazon 30% Upside Predicted Ahead of July 30 Q2 Earnings; AWS Q1 Revenue $37.59B at 37.7% Operating Margin
AMZN.content: 分析师预测Q2营收$196B，EPS $1.82；AWS Q1收入$37.59B(+28% YoY)，利润率37.7%；Bedrock AI服务处理token数超历年总和；$200B资本支出指引显示AI布局决心

AMZN.title: Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) Stock Shows 30% Upside Potential Ahead of July 30 Earnings Report
AMZN.content: Analysts cite 30% upside in AMZN ahead of Q2 2026 earnings (July 30). Wall Street expects EPS $1.82 and revenue $196.02B (guidance: $194-199B). AWS delivered its fastest growth in 15 quarters in Q1 ($37.6B, +28% YoY). Prime Day shift into Q2 is an additional revenue tailwind.

AMZN.title: Amazon (AMZN) Poised for Upside Ahead of Q2 Earnings and AI Expansion
AMZN.content: Amazon Q2 2026 earnings preview: revenue guidance $194-199B, AWS acceleration expected to continue, record advertising business. Amazon's total 2026 debt issuance exceeds $106B (including $25B bond sale in early July) to fund $200B capex plan for AI data centers, chips, and logistics. Company pledged no further 2026 debt after the July issuance.

AMZN.title: What's Going on With Amazon Stock on Tuesday?
AMZN.content: Amazon stock analysis on Tuesday July 21 as investors position ahead of July 30 Q2 2026 earnings report. Focus areas: AWS growth trajectory vs. capex spend rate, advertising business momentum, and execution on $200B AI infrastructure investment commitment made for full-year 2026.

AMZN.title: Amazon Q2 2026 Earnings: What to Expect on July 30, 2026
AMZN.content: Amazon set to report Q2 2026 on July 30 at 2:00 PM PT / 5:00 PM ET. Q2 revenue guidance: $194-199B; analyst consensus EPS $1.82. CEO Andy Jassy has defended $200B 2026 capex, with ~$106B already funded via bond markets. AWS growth, ad revenue, and margin expansion are the three key earnings watchpoints.

AMZN.title: Bank of America Raises AWS Q2 Growth Estimate to 33%, Reiterates Buy on Amazon Ahead of Earnings
AMZN.content: Bank of America raised its AWS Q2 revenue growth estimate to 33% YoY (from 31% prior), citing surging demand from Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock AI services, and broad enterprise AI adoption. BofA forecasts Q2 revenue of $198.8B and operating profit of $24.1B, both above consensus. Amazon reports Q2 results on July 30.

AMZN.title: Amazon Expected to Beat Q2 2026 Earnings; Evercore ISI Sets $315 Price Target
AMZN.content: Pre-earnings analysis ahead of Amazon's July 30 Q2 2026 results. Consensus expects ~$197B revenue and $1.81 EPS. AWS estimated to have grown ~32% YoY, accelerating from 28% in Q1. Evercore ISI rates Amazon Outperform with $315 target. Prime Day (June 23-26) generated $26.4B in sales, up 9.3% YoY, boosting Q2 estimates.

AMZN.title: Amazon Shares Rise as Investors Weigh AWS AI Momentum and Prime Day Read-Through
AMZN.content: Amazon shares gained ahead of Q2 2026 earnings (July 30) as investors weighed strong AWS AI momentum and Prime Day results. Wall Street consensus: Strong Buy from 45 of 46 analysts, average price target $318.98 (+29% upside). Bears flag trailing free cash flow collapse of 95% YoY as quarterly capex reached $43.2B.

AMZN.title: Amazon's AWS May Deliver a July 30 Earnings Beat as Cloud Growth Accelerates to ~32%
AMZN.content: TheStreet analysis ahead of Amazon's Q2 2026 earnings on July 30 highlights AWS as the key beat driver, estimated at ~32% growth in Q2, up from 28% in Q1. Prime Day moving into Q2 adds a further tailwind. Key bear concern: $200B+ total 2026 AI capex guidance and whether returns will materialize. Keybanc maintains Overweight with $335 price target.

AMZN.title: Amazon Q2 2026 Earnings Preview: CEO Jassy Expected to Raise Full-Year 2026 Capex Above $32.9B; AWS Growth Critical
AMZN.content: Amazon Q2 2026 earnings scheduled July 30 after close (2pm PT/5pm ET). Analyst consensus: Revenue $196.97B (+18% YoY), EPS $1.82. Key analyst prediction: CEO Andy Jassy will raise full-year 2026 capex guidance above $32.9B (committed at Q4 2025 earnings, +52% YoY). AWS AI acceleration, Prime Day uplift, and record ad revenue drive bull case. Shares down ~11% in 3 months on capex concerns.

AMZN.title: Amazon Q2 2026 Earnings Release Today After Close — Expected $196.97B Revenue, $1.82 EPS; AWS and Capex Guidance in Focus
AMZN.content: Amazon reports Q2 2026 results today after market close, with earnings call at 2pm PT/5pm ET. Consensus: Revenue $196.97B (+18% YoY), EPS $1.82. Investor focus: AWS cloud growth acceleration, AI custom chip progress, capex raise likelihood, and progress on Q1's collapsed free cash flow ($1.2B, -95% YoY from AI infrastructure spending surge.

AMZN.title: Amazon Q2 2026 Earnings: Revenue $200.6B (+20%), AWS Grows 37% to $42.2B — Fastest Cloud Growth in 18 Quarters
AMZN.content: Amazon reported Q2 2026 with net sales of $200.6B (+20% YoY), beating $196.47B estimate. AWS revenue grew 37% YoY to $42.2B, the fastest rate in 18 quarters, with AI and Chips businesses each exceeding $25B annualized run rates. Net income surged to $62.6B ($5.75 EPS). Operating income rose 43% to $27.5B.

META.title: Meta Threads Reaches 500 Million Monthly Active Users, Launches Community Features
META.content: Meta announced Threads reached 500M monthly active users (~100M added since Aug 2025). Launched community controls, custom icons, and personal feed algorithm control 'Your Algo'. Reinforces Meta's social media dominance and advertising platform breadth.

META.title: Meta Q1 2026: Revenue +33% YoY (Fastest Among Hyperscalers); 2026 Capex Raised to $125-145B
META.content: META Q1 2026: revenue $56.3B (+33%), fastest growth among hyperscaler group driven by AI-powered ad targeting via Llama models. 2026 capex raised to $125-145B. MTIA custom AI chip scaling. Net margin 47.5%. One Big Beautiful Bill Act tax reform impacts being managed.

META.title: Meta Commits to 6GW AMD Instinct GPU Deployment; Confirmed as One of World's Largest AI Compute Buyers
META.content: Meta announced deployment of up to 6GW of AMD Instinct GPUs including custom MI450. Combined with $125-145B capex, Meta is among the world's largest AI compute buyers. Llama open-source models and MTIA chips further deepen AI infrastructure vertical integration.

META.title: Zuckerberg Town Hall: Meta 2026 Layoffs Are Capex Reallocation to AI Infrastructure, Not AI Productivity Concerns
META.content: Mark Zuckerberg told employees that 2026 workforce reductions are budget reallocations toward AI infrastructure capex — not signals of AI replacing workers. Meta committed to $125-145B capex in 2026 (nearly double 2025), with nearly all directed to data centers, GPUs, and Llama model infrastructure. Meta Superintelligence Labs released its first model in Q1 2026. Stock initially fell ~10% on capex increase before recovering.

META.title: Meta Muse Spark: First Paid AI Model Marks Strategic Pivot Away From Open-Source Toward Monetization
META.content: Meta unveiled Muse Spark, its first commercial (paid) AI model — deviating from previous Llama open-source releases. The move mirrors OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google's paid API approach. Wall Street responded skeptically, wanting clearer AI revenue strategy beyond the $125-145B capex commitment. Analysts: AI monetization thesis requires demonstrated revenue from models, not just advertising efficiency gains.

META.title: Five Major Publishers Sue Meta Over Llama AI Training on Pirated Books — Class Action in Manhattan Federal Court
META.content: Elsevier, Cengage, Hachette, Macmillan, and McGraw Hill filed a class-action lawsuit in Manhattan federal court alleging Meta pirated millions of books and journal articles to train its Llama large language models without permission, payment, or license. Author Scott Turow is co-plaintiff. Case adds copyright litigation risk atop Meta's $125-145B capex AI buildout plan for 2026.

META.title: Meta Sued by Santa Clara County Over $Billions in Scam Advertisements; Chinese Regulators Block Manus AI Acquisition
META.content: Santa Clara County, California filed suit against Meta alleging the company knowingly facilitates and profits from billions of scam advertisements across Facebook and Instagram. Separately, Chinese regulators blocked Meta's proposed acquisition of AI startup Manus citing geopolitical and regulatory concerns — a setback for Meta's AI strategy in Asia. META stock up 33% YoY in Q1 but down in May on litigation and capex overspend concerns.

META.title: Meta Q1 2026 Summary: Net Income +61% YoY; 2026 AI Capex Raised to $125-145B; Q2 Revenue Guide $59.5B (+25% YoY)
META.content: Meta Platforms Q1 2026: net income grew 61% YoY despite elevated AI capex. Raised FY2026 capex guidance to $125-145B from $115-135B due to higher component costs and additional data center capacity for future years. Q2 2026 revenue midpoint guide $59.5B (+25% YoY). Daily active users declined slightly in Q1 due to Iran internet disruptions and Russia WhatsApp restrictions.

META.title: Meta Confirms 10% Workforce Cut (~8,000 Jobs) on May 20 to Redirect Billions to AI
META.content: Meta will execute 10% workforce reduction (~8,000 employees) on May 20 as Zuckerberg redirects capital toward AI. 2026 capex guidance raised to $125-145B. Muse Spark new AI model departing from Llama open-source model. Acquired Assured Robot Intelligence for humanoid robots.

META.title: Meta 10% Workforce Reduction Begins May 20: 8,000 Cut + 6,000 Roles Cancelled; 7,000 Redeployed to AI Teams
META.content: Execution of Meta's 10% workforce reduction began May 20: 8,000 employees cut, 6,000 open positions cancelled, 7,000 employees reorganized into new AI-focused roles. Largest workforce overhaul in Meta's history. CEO Zuckerberg told employees no further company-wide layoffs expected in 2026. Reflects AI-first organizational pivot alongside record $72B+ capex guidance.

META.title: Meta Launches Forum App to Compete with Reddit and Facebook Groups; Reddit Shares Plunge
META.content: Meta launched Forum, a standalone community discussion app targeting Reddit's core use case and Facebook Groups. Reddit shares fell sharply on the news. META stock settled near $608 on May 22. Q1 2026 EPS $10.44 beat estimates by ~56%; 10% workforce cut (8,000+ jobs) underway to redirect capital to AI infrastructure ($125-145B 2026 capex). AMD 6GW Instinct GPU deployment confirmed as part of Meta AI training expansion.

META.title: Meta Signs Multi-Year AWS Deal: Hundreds of Thousands of Graviton Chips for Agentic AI Across 3.6B Daily Users
META.content: Meta agreed to deploy hundreds of thousands of AWS Graviton chips over at least 3 years to power next-gen agentic AI across its 3.6 billion daily active user platform and 32 new data centers under construction. The deal combines AWS purpose-built silicon with Meta's AI stack — a strategic win for AWS custom silicon over Nvidia GPU dependency for certain AI inference workloads.

META.title: Meta Launches Global Paid Subscription Plans: Instagram/Facebook Plus $3.99/mo, WhatsApp Plus $2.99/mo; Stock +3.6%
META.content: Meta announced global rollout of paid subscriptions: Instagram Plus and Facebook Plus at $3.99/mo each; WhatsApp Plus $2.99/mo; Meta One Plus $7.99/mo; Meta One Premium $19.99/mo. Designed to diversify revenue beyond advertising. META stock rallied 3.6% to $633-$643 range. AI spending plans had weighed on stock.

META.title: Meta Superintelligence Labs Launches Muse Spark AI Model; Tests Meta One Plus $7.99/mo Subscription in 3 Countries
META.content: Meta's Superintelligence Labs (led by Alexandr Wang) launches Muse Spark, matching Llama 4 mid-size capability at far lower compute. Meta begins testing subscription plans: Meta One Plus $7.99/month and Meta One Premium $19.99/month, launching first in Singapore, Guatemala, Bolivia. Full-year 2026 capex raised to $125-145B.

META.title: Meta Muse Spark Developer API Delayed Again — No Launch Date Set; Behemoth 2T+ Model Shelved; $125-145B Capex ROI Questioned
META.content: Meta delayed the Muse Spark developer API (from Superintelligence Labs) for the third time with no confirmed launch date. Delays attributed to software bugs and insufficient infrastructure. The Behemoth 2T+ parameter model was also shelved after engineers failed to meaningfully improve capabilities. META stock at $617-$623. Investor debate intensifies on ROI for $125-145B capex guidance. Model launch (April) distinct from developer API availability.

META.title: Meta AI Support Chatbot Flaw Exposed 20,225+ Instagram Accounts to Account Takeover, Issue Patched June 5
META.content: Meta confirmed a bug in its AI-powered Instagram support chatbot's password-reset flow allowed attackers to hijack 20,000+ accounts from April 17 to early June 2026. Issue patched June 5; impacted accounts being secured.

META.title: Meta Partners with Reliance Industries to Build First AI Data Center in India
META.content: Meta Platforms announced partnership with Reliance Industries to build its first AI data center in India, adding to global AI infrastructure investment wave. Complements META's custom MTIA AI chip deployments and India consumer market expansion strategy.

META.title: Meta Business Agent Expands to All Businesses Globally on WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram
META.content: Meta's Business Agent — used by 1M+ businesses on WhatsApp and Messenger — is now expanding to all businesses globally and rolling out to Instagram, enabling AI-driven customer interactions at scale.

META.title: Meta Signs Deal with Reliance Industries to Lease First AI-Enabled Data Center in India
META.content: Meta entered agreement with Reliance Industries to lease its first AI-enabled data center in India, marking a major AI infrastructure expansion into one of the world's largest internet markets.

META.title: Report: Violent Threats Against US Congress Members Quadruple After Meta Scales Back Content Enforcement
META.source: Center for Countering Digital Hate / ASIS Online
META.content: Center for Countering Digital Hate found abusive comments against Congress members tripled and violent threats quadrupled after Meta reduced automated enforcement of violent language rules, raising regulatory and reputational risk.

META.title: Meta Platforms Hit by Major Global Outage: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger All Disrupted
META.content: Meta suffered a widespread global outage on June 12, 2026, affecting Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger. Users were abruptly logged out and unable to sign back in. Over 100,000+ outage reports filed; Meta Ads also impacted.

META.title: Meta Begins Unwinding $2B Manus Acquisition After China Orders Buyout Reversed
META.content: Meta completed operational split from Manus AI and halted data sharing after Beijing ordered the $2B acquisition unwound, creating uncertainty about Meta's AI talent and technology strategy in China.

META.title: Meta Launches AI-Powered Features Across Facebook for Improved User Connection and Discovery
META.content: Meta launched AI-powered features on Facebook for user connection, content creation, and discovery, as part of its broader consumer AI rollout strategy.

META.title: Meta WhatsApp Business AI Agent Now Available Globally
META.content: Meta launched its WhatsApp Business AI agent globally, enabling businesses to automate customer support, product recommendations, appointment booking, and sales qualification via WhatsApp.

META.title: Meta Expands AI Business Agents with Shopify and Zendesk Enterprise Integrations for Customer Automation
META.content: Meta expanded AI business agent capabilities with automatic customer responses, lead qualification, and appointment booking. New integrations with Shopify and Zendesk for enterprise customers announced in mid-June.

META.title: US Appeals Court Allows Ohio Parental Consent Law for Under-16 Social Media Users; Affects Meta's Instagram, Facebook
META.content: A US appeals court ruled Ohio can enforce a law requiring parental consent before users under 16 can access social media platforms. The ruling affects Meta's Instagram, Facebook, and Threads and could set precedent for similar laws across other states, creating significant regulatory compliance burden.

META.title: Child Safety Lawsuit Against Meta Allowed to Proceed; AI Data Center Deal Advances Simultaneously
META.content: A court ruled a child safety lawsuit against Meta can proceed, citing alleged harm caused by Meta's platforms to minors. Simultaneously, Meta advanced a major new AI data center infrastructure deal, illustrating the company's dual legal exposure and AI expansion push.

META.title: Meta Secures 1.6 GW AI Computing Capacity from Crusoe Data Centers in Texas and Missouri; Part of $600B AI Infrastructure Plan Through 2028
META.content: Meta与数据中心开发商Crusoe签署协议，获取约1.6吉瓦AI算力（分布于德克萨斯Childress和密苏里Warrenton两处）。Crusoe将提供可再生能源及移动能源方案。Meta承诺2028年前在AI基础设施上总投入高达$6000亿。

META.title: Meta AI for Work Division Chief Emily Dalton Smith Departs; Key Executive Behind Internal Enterprise AI Tooling Exits Amid Reorganization
META.content: Meta AI for Work部门负责人Emily Dalton Smith离职，其团队主导企业内部AI工具及Copilot类产品研发。此次人事变动被部分投资者视为Meta内部AI战略调整信号，叠加Crusoe算力扩张消息，市场关注Meta AI组织架构走向。

META.title: Meta Invests $900 Million in Indian Fintech Cred (~20% Stake), Appoints Cred Founder Kunal Shah as New WhatsApp Global Head
META.content: Meta Platforms announced a $900 million investment in Indian fintech startup Cred, acquiring roughly a 20% stake at a $4.5B valuation. Cred founder Kunal Shah will become the new global head of WhatsApp, succeeding Will Cathcart, tying the investment to a major leadership change for Meta's flagship messaging platform.

META.title: Meta's Threads Reaches 500 Million Monthly Active Users, Launches New Communities Features
META.content: Meta announced Threads reached 500 million monthly active users and launched new communities features to mark the milestone. The company also expanded Instagram to Samsung smart TVs in the US to target longer-form video content consumption.

META.title: Meta Plans to Launch Meta Compute Cloud Service Rivaling AWS and Azure; Stock Jumps 9%+ on July 1
META.content: Meta reportedly plans Meta Compute — a cloud infrastructure service selling GPU compute, hosted Llama models, and AI agent tools — to compete directly with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Meta aims to undercut rivals by 20-30% using proprietary MTIA chips. Stock surged 9%+ on July 1. Meta's 2026 CapEx guidance raised to 25-145B.

META.title: Vistra Signs 20-Year Nuclear Power PPA With Meta for ~2,600MW Across Three PJM-Region Plants
META.content: Vistra signed a 20-year power purchase agreement providing Meta with approximately 2,600 megawatts of nuclear power across three PJM-region plants, securing clean AI data center power long-term.

META.title: Meta Q2 2026 Earnings Scheduled for July 29 After-Market; Analysts Forecast Diluted EPS $7.09 on AI Advertising Strength
META.content: Meta Platforms Q2 2026 earnings on July 29 after market; consensus EPS estimate $7.09, slightly below $7.14 year-ago quarter; Agentforce and AI ad optimization in focus.

META.title: Meta to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results on July 29
META.content: Meta confirmed Q2 2026 financial results release after market close on July 29, 2026, with conference call at 1:30 PM PT. Analyst consensus: revenue $60.18B (guidance: $58-61B), EPS $7.18. Q1 2026 results showed revenue $56.31B (+33% YoY), net income $26.77B (+61% YoY), diluted EPS $10.44 (+62% YoY).

META.title: Meta Targets Enterprise AI with Meta Compute Cloud Service, Launch Set for July 2026
META.content: Meta is launching 'Meta Compute,' a cloud GPU service directly competing with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Service bundles raw GPU compute access and hosted AI model APIs (Llama 3, Llama 4) with pricing expected to undercut rivals by 20-30%. Leverages Meta's MTIA custom silicon and massive data center footprint. Aims to monetize excess GPU capacity.

META.title: Meta Gets Major Boost as Zuckerberg Advances Cloud Computing Business Plan
META.content: Zuckerberg is positioning Meta to become a fourth major cloud provider by selling excess AI compute capacity, with a reported $10B Anthropic deal in discussions. Meta plans $125-145B in capex for 2026. META stock is up 21% in July ahead of Q2 earnings on July 29. 91% of analysts rate it Buy with a median target of $810.

META.title: BofA Expects Meta to Beat Q2 Estimates: Projects $60.6B Revenue and $7.50 EPS Above Consensus
META.content: Bank of America raised Q2 2026 Meta estimates above consensus, forecasting revenue of $60.6B (vs. $60.2B consensus) and EPS of $7.50 (vs. $7.18 consensus). BofA cites healthy advertising demand and AI-driven improvements. For Q3, BofA projects revenue of $60.5-63.5B (18-24% YoY growth). Muse Spark AI advertising improvements and external compute sales are key investment themes.

META.title: Meta in Talks for $10B Anthropic AI Compute Deal, Hiring AWS Veteran to Lead New 'Meta Compute' Unit
META.content: Meta Platforms is in early-stage negotiations with Anthropic for a two-year, $10 billion cloud-computing services agreement backed by $145 billion in 2026 capex. Meta hired 19-year AWS veteran Dave Brown to lead the new 'Meta Compute' unit aimed at competing with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

META.title: Meta Stock Up 21% in July as Anthropic Deal Talks Emerge Ahead of July 29 Q2 Earnings
META.content: Meta's potential Anthropic deal could serve as the headline announcement at its July 29 Q2 earnings call. Meta stock is up 21% in July alone, driven by cloud expansion plans and a Louisiana data center surpassing $250 billion in estimated build cost.

META.title: Meta Reports Q2 2026 Earnings: Revenue Beats on AI-Driven Ad Growth
META.content: Meta reported Q2 2026 results after market close on July 29. Consensus expected ~$60.2B revenue (+27% YoY) and EPS of ~$7.23. Meta has beaten EPS estimates for 6 consecutive quarters. Key investor focus: AI capex guidance of $125B-$145B for 2026, performance of Muse Spark 1.1, and rumored Anthropic cloud partnership. Stock was down ~10% YTD heading into the print.

META.title: Meta Sets Q2 2026 Earnings Release for July 29 After Market Close
META.content: Meta Platforms officially announced Q2 2026 financial results on July 29 after market close, followed by a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET. Official guidance had placed Q2 revenue between $58B and $61B. Prediction markets assigned 87.1% probability of another EPS beat.

META.title: Meta and Microsoft Earnings Showdown: What Investors Are Expecting on July 29
META.content: Wall Street previews the dual earnings releases of Meta and Microsoft on July 29. META carries 57 Buy ratings, 6 Holds, and zero Sells. Analysts note that despite META beating estimates six consecutive quarters, the stock has fallen after each of the last two reports due to elevated AI capex concerns.

META.title: Meta Q2 2026 Results: Revenue $60.80B Beats, EPS $6.18 Misses $7.10 Est; Total Costs +55% YoY on AI Spending; Stock -8% After Hours
META.content: META Q2 2026: Revenue $60.80B (+28% YoY, beat $60.18B est). Adjusted EPS $6.18 — misses $7.10 consensus and $7.61 whisper number. Total costs +55% YoY to $42.03B driven by AI infrastructure spending. Ad impressions +14% YoY, average price per ad +12% YoY. Stock fell to $539.93 AH from $585.61 close (~-8%). Zuckerberg: 'AI is accelerating our core business.'

META.title: Meta Q2 2026: Revenue $60.8B (+28%) but EPS Misses at $6.18 vs $7.18 Est. as Costs Surge 55% on AI and Legal Charges
META.content: Meta reported Q2 2026 revenue of $60.8B (+28% YoY), beating top-line estimates, but EPS of $6.18 missed consensus of $7.18. Total costs surged 55% to $42B, including $2.4B in legal charges and $1.18B in severance from May 2026 layoffs. Net income fell 14% to $15.8B; operating margin contracted to 31% from 43%. Family daily active people reached 3.60B.

META.title: Meta and BlackRock Announce $14 Billion AI Infrastructure Investment Deal
META.content: Meta and BlackRock announced a $14B deal tied to AI infrastructure investment on July 29, 2026. The arrangement reflects Meta aggressive push to build out AI capacity and is part of the company broader strategy to deploy AI capabilities at scale.

AAPL.title: Bloomberg: Apple Plans Camera AirPods, Second Foldable iPhone and 20th Anniversary iPhone for 2027
AAPL.content: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported Apple is developing camera-equipped AirPods for late 2027, alongside a second-generation foldable iPhone and a 20th Anniversary iPhone commemorating 2007 launch, outlining Apple's multi-year hardware roadmap.

AAPL.title: Apple Q2 FY2026: Revenue $111.2B (+17% YoY), iPhone +22%; Apple Intelligence Driving Upgrade Cycle
AAPL.content: AAPL Q2 FY2026: revenue $111.2B (+17% YoY), EPS +22%. iPhone segment $57B (+22% YoY). Apple Intelligence AI features driving hardware upgrade cycle and Services growth. Gross margin 49.3%. Strong performance despite macro headwinds.

AAPL.title: Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft Trading at Best Valuations in Years Amid AI-Driven Earnings Growth
AAPL.content: AAPL, NVDA, MSFT trading at historically attractive valuations relative to earnings growth trajectory. Apple Intelligence hardware cycle, Services monetization, and M-series chip advantage in edge AI create multi-year earnings expansion case.

AAPL.title: Apple Authorizes $100B Buyback, Raises Dividend 4% to $0.27; Seeks Refund of Supreme Court-Struck IEEPA Tariffs; June Q Revenue Guide +14-17%
AAPL.content: Q2 FY2026 earnings: Apple's Board authorized $100B additional share repurchases and raised quarterly dividend 4% to $0.27/share (payable May 14, record date May 11). CEO Cook confirmed Apple pursuing refunds on IEEPA tariffs recently struck down by the Supreme Court, with refunds to be reinvested in U.S. advanced manufacturing above prior $500B commitment. June quarter revenue guided +14-17% YoY despite Mac supply constraints and tariff headwinds.

AAPL.title: Wedbush Sets $400 Apple Price Target — Highest on Street — as AI Hardware Cycle Drives Services Ecosystem Growth
AAPL.content: Wedbush analyst Dan Ives raised Apple price target to $400 — highest on Wall Street — citing Apple Intelligence hardware upgrade cycle and Services monetization. iOS 27 multi-AI-model architecture (supporting Google Gemini and others) expected to drive hundreds of AI-based app monetization opportunities through the App Store. iPhone revenue +22% YoY in Q2 FY2026; Apple Intelligence increasingly a hardware replacement catalyst.

AAPL.title: Apple-Google Gemini Deal: Google AI to Power Next-Gen Siri via iOS 27 Multi-Model AI Framework
AAPL.content: Apple and Google formally announced a multi-year deal where Google's Gemini models power the next generation of Apple Foundation Models, including a rebuilt Siri in iOS 27. iOS 27 will allow users to switch between multiple AI providers — Gemini, OpenAI, and Apple's own models. Wedbush projects this creates an 'AI toll booth' on the App Store as developers integrate Gemini and other AI APIs into iPhone apps.

AAPL.title: Apple CEO Tim Cook Joins Trump China Delegation (May 13-15 Beijing); iPhone Tariff Relief and Supply Chain on Agenda
AAPL.content: Apple CEO Tim Cook joined President Trump's May 13-15 China state visit to Beijing alongside Tesla's Elon Musk and executives from Qualcomm, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Cargill, and Visa. Apple likely seeking tariff relief on iPhone/Mac China manufacturing and supply chain assurances. AAPL Q2 FY2026 revenue $111.2B (+17% YoY); company previously pursuing IEEPA tariff refunds from Supreme Court ruling to reinvest in U.S. manufacturing. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was notably not invited.

AAPL.title: Tim Cook Beijing Trip: CEO Meets Xi Jinping, Signals Apple All-In on China; $500B US Investment Pledge Backdrop
AAPL.content: Tim Cook visited Beijing; Xi Jinping told assembled executives including Cook that China would open wider for their businesses. Apple Q2 2026: revenue $111.2B (+17% YoY), $100B buyback authorized. 80% of production still in China.

AAPL.title: Apple Restructures Hardware Development Team to Accelerate AI-Centric Devices; Stock at $306, Market Cap $4.48T
AAPL.content: Apple restructured its hardware development organization to accelerate AI-focused devices amid growing competitive pressure from AI-enabled rivals. Apple Intelligence driving upgrade cycle. Stock at $306 (+14.6% past 30 days, market cap $4.48T). Apple Vision Pro gains eye-tracking wheelchair control capability. Intel 18A foundry deal and Google-Gemini Siri integration (iOS 27) remain major strategic milestones.

AAPL.title: Apple Hits All-Time Closing High $312.19; $4.59T Market Cap; Apple Maps to Launch Ads Summer 2026
AAPL.content: Apple shares hit all-time intraday high $313.26 on May 27 and all-time closing high $312.19 on May 28; market cap $4.59T. Apple Maps to introduce local search/discovery ads this summer. Risk: management warned rising memory costs will have increasing margin impact beyond current quarter.

AAPL.title: Apple WWDC 2026 Begins June 8: Revamped Siri AI and iOS 27 Expected After 2025 Delay
AAPL.content: Apple WWDC 2026 starts June 8, 2026. The long-delayed Siri AI upgrade (pushed from 2025 after technical challenges) expected to launch alongside iOS 27. Analysts view as pivotal moment for Apple Intelligence rollout and device upgrade cycle.

AAPL.title: WWDC June 8 Make-or-Break for Apple AI Credibility; Google Gemini Integration Depth the Key Analyst Watch Item
AAPL.content: Analysts flagged WWDC June 8 keynote as near-term AAPL catalyst. Key watch: (1) Depth of Google Gemini integration in Apple Intelligence following January 2026 partnership; (2) Redesigned Siri chatbot credibility vs. Claude/ChatGPT; (3) iOS 27 'Snow Leopard'-style performance overhaul. Apple fell behind MSFT/GOOGL in AI 2024-25; WWDC 2026 is the reset moment. Q3 FY2026 earnings upcoming (guided +14-17% YoY). Hardware (Mac) reveals considered secondary.

AAPL.title: Apple WWDC 2026 Begins Monday June 8: Major Siri Overhaul with Google Gemini Integration; iOS 27 / macOS 27 AI Features Preview
AAPL.content: Apple's WWDC 2026 kicks off Monday June 8 at 10 AM PT. Expected highlights: major Siri overhaul integrating Google Gemini for conversational, multi-step task AI; new dedicated Siri app with voice/text and history; iOS 27/macOS 27/watchOS 27 AI features; Apple Intelligence 2.0 across devices. This is Apple's most critical AI credibility event following the underwhelming 2025 launch.

AAPL.title: WWDC 2026: Apple Unveils Gemini-Powered Siri Overhaul, iOS 27, macOS Golden Gate
AAPL.content: Apple's WWDC 2026 keynote revealed Siri overhaul powered by Google Gemini with full on-screen context awareness and cross-app actions. Also announced iOS 27 (30% faster app launches, iPhone 11+), macOS Golden Gate (drops Intel support), expanded Apple Intelligence.

AAPL.title: WWDC 2026: Tim Cook to Step Down as Apple CEO September 1; John Ternus Named Successor
AAPL.content: Apple confirmed at WWDC 2026 that CEO Tim Cook transitions to Executive Chairman on September 1, 2026, with SVP of Hardware Engineering John Ternus named as new CEO.

AAPL.title: Melius, Wedbush, BofA Raise Apple Price Targets Ahead of WWDC 2026 Siri AI Reveal
AAPL.content: Multiple analysts raised AAPL targets ahead of WWDC: Melius to $385, Wedbush to $400 (street-high), BofA to $380 projecting $15-30B in AI revenue by FY2030.

AAPL.title: Apple WWDC 2026: Rebuilt AI Siri with Contextual Understanding, iOS 27, and Deep AI Integration Unveiled
AAPL.content: At WWDC 2026, Apple unveiled a fully rebuilt AI Siri with contextual understanding and cross-app task handling, along with iOS 27 and AI-powered tools for photos, messaging, productivity, and search across all Apple devices.

AAPL.title: Siri AI EU and China Rollout Delayed Due to Regulatory Hurdles; AAPL Falls ~$27 from WWDC High
AAPL.content: Siri AI will not launch in the EU due to Digital Markets Act compliance issues and faces delayed rollout in China, limiting initial addressable market. AAPL fell from ~$317 ATH to ~$290 by June 10. Consensus analyst PT remains $314.59.

AAPL.title: Apple Unveils Rebuilt Siri AI and Next-Generation Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2026
AAPL.content: At WWDC 2026, Apple announced a completely rebuilt Siri with contextual understanding and generative AI capabilities, alongside iOS 27 and macOS Golden Gate. Siri AI beta is US-only initially.

AAPL.title: Apple Partners with Google to Bring Gemini as Underlying Model for New Siri AI
AAPL.content: Apple confirmed a significant partnership with Google, integrating Gemini as a core underlying model powering the new Siri AI, adding to existing OpenAI ChatGPT integration.

AAPL.title: Apple 2027 Roadmap Confirmed: Camera-Equipped AirPods and Second-Generation Foldable iPhone
AAPL.content: Reports in mid-June 2026 confirmed Apple is preparing camera-equipped AirPods and a second-generation foldable iPhone for 2027, one of Apple's largest product pushes. Shares near $295 (vs ~$317 WWDC peak) on Siri exclusion from Europe/China (~35% of shipments).

AAPL.title: Apple and Intel Announce US Chip Manufacturing Collaboration Following Trump Administration Push for Domestic Production
AAPL.content: Apple announced a collaboration with Intel on US-based chip manufacturing, spurred by the Trump administration's domestic semiconductor manufacturing push. The partnership is seen as a milestone for domestic chip supply chain and boosted Intel shares ~9% on the announcement.

AAPL.title: Apple VP Paul Meade, Head of Vision Pro and Smart Glasses Engineering, Departs for OpenAI Hardware Division
AAPL.content: Paul Meade, Apple's VP overseeing Vision Pro and smart glasses engineering for seven years, announced his departure to join OpenAI's AI hardware division. Meade joins former Apple colleagues Jony Ive and executives from the $6.5B 'io' acquisition. His exit adds to Apple's AI talent drain at a critical moment for its spatial computing roadmap.

AAPL.title: Apple Raises MacBook and iPad Prices as AI-Driven Memory Chip Shortage Intensifies; iPhone Exempt
AAPL.content: Apple announced price increases for MacBook and iPad models due to rising high-bandwidth memory chip costs driven by surging AI demand. Apple is simultaneously lobbying the US government for permission to source memory chips from a blacklisted Chinese supplier. iPhones were not included in the price hikes. China iPhone sell-in declined 19% YoY in May 2026.

AAPL.title: Apple Sets Q3 FY2026 Earnings Call for July 30 — Tim Cook's Final Earnings as CEO Before John Ternus Takes Over September 1
AAPL.content: Apple confirmed Q3 FY2026 (fiscal quarter ending Jun 28) earnings release for July 30 after close, followed by conference call at 2pm PT. Analyst consensus: revenue ~11B, EPS ~.89. This will be CEO Tim Cook's final earnings call before John Ternus assumes the CEO role September 1, 2026.

AAPL.title: Tim Cook Signs Largest U.S. Manufacturing Deal in Apple History as Final Move Before Handing CEO Role to John Ternus on Sept 1, 2026
AAPL.content: Tim Cook finalizes a landmark American manufacturing deal before transitioning to Executive Chairman; John Ternus, 25-year Apple veteran, becomes CEO September 1 with foldable iPhone and AI glasses on the roadmap.

AAPL.title: Apple Only Magnificent 7 Stock Near All-Time Highs at $317 as It Avoided AI Arms Race; +15% Since June 25
AAPL.content: AAPL has climbed 15% since June 25, adding $600B in market value to reach $317.18, near its 52-week high of $323.45, outperforming all Magnificent 7 peers on a stability premium.

AAPL.title: Citi Raises Apple Price Target to $365; AAPL Tests Record Highs as AI Strategy Gains Traction; Q3 FY2026 Earnings July 30
AAPL.content: Citi upgraded Apple PT to $365, citing premium brand positioning and ability to raise prices to offset rising costs; Q3 FY2026 earnings call July 30 will be Tim Cook's last as CEO.

AAPL.title: Apple Q3 FY2026 Earnings Preview July 30: Revenue Est $109-110B, EPS $1.89; Tim Cook Final Earnings Call as CEO
AAPL.content: Apple Q3 FY2026财报7月30日发布；分析师共识预测营收$109-110B，EPS $1.89；为Tim Cook CEO任期最后一次财报电话会，John Ternus将接任CEO

AAPL.title: Apple (AAPL) Stock Update — July 20, 2026
AAPL.content: Apple stock at $326.59, above average analyst target of $318.25 and near 52-week high of $334.99. Analyst consensus as of July 21: 37% Strong Buy, 33% Buy, 20% Hold. KeyBanc holds a bearish $250 target. Q3 FY2026 earnings due July 30 represent a binary 5%+ move risk event.

AAPL.title: Apple's Quarterly Earnings Preview: What You Need to Know
AAPL.content: Apple reports fiscal Q3 2026 on July 30 after close. Analysts expect EPS $1.88 (+19.8% YoY) on revenue ~$108.9B. Notably, the July 30 report will be the final earnings call for CEO Tim Cook, who transitions to Executive Chairman on September 1, 2026, handing the CEO role to hardware SVP John Ternus.

AAPL.title: Apple (AAPL) Set to Raise iPhone Prices by $200 — Analysts Bullish on Growth
AAPL.content: Morgan Stanley report indicates Apple plans to raise iPhone 18 prices by approximately $200 in September to partially offset tariff costs. The market has not fully priced this in, potentially boosting EPS by 2-4% for Q3 FY2026 and beyond. Foldable iPhone launch is an additional catalyst. Tariff recoveries expected to improve gross margins in the December quarter.

AAPL.title: Apple Launching 'Apple Upgrade' Device Leasing Program with Klarna on July 28
AAPL.content: Apple is launching 'Apple Upgrade', a lease-to-own program backed by Klarna for iPhones, Macs, iPads, and Apple Watches. Launching July 28 in the US, with 24-month terms for iPhones/Apple Watches and 36-month terms for Macs/iPads. Customers can pay off early, upgrade mid-term, or return devices after the term. Described as one of Apple's biggest-ever changes to how it sells hardware.

AAPL.title: Apple and DOJ in Early Settlement Talks Over iPhone Antitrust Case
AAPL.content: Apple is in early settlement discussions with the DOJ over the 2024 iPhone antitrust case, with Apple making multiple settlement proposals. Two factors accelerated talks: Apple won a discovery procedural ruling, and DOJ leadership prefers negotiated resolutions for inherited Big Tech cases. No trial date set; no guarantee a deal is reached. Case accuses Apple of restricting super apps, cloud gaming, and third-party digital wallets.

AAPL.title: Apple Launches 'Apple Upgrade' Lease-to-Own Program with Klarna for iPhones, Macs, iPads
AAPL.content: Apple is introducing 'Apple Upgrade,' a lease-to-own program backed by Klarna launching July 28, covering most iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Apple Watch models on 24-month or 36-month terms available in U.S. Apple Stores and online.

AAPL.title: Morgan Stanley Raises Apple Price Target to $364, Maintains Overweight Ahead of Q3 Earnings
AAPL.content: Morgan Stanley analyst Erik Woodring raised his Apple price target from $360 to $364, reiterating Overweight, forecasting fiscal Q3 2026 results due July 30 are likely to slightly exceed consensus estimates of $1.88 EPS on approximately $108.9B revenue.

AAPL.title: Apple Reveals Plans for New Mac Lineup Including MacBook Pro with M6 Chip
AAPL.content: Apple announced plans to refresh its entire Mac lineup, including a new MacBook Pro featuring the M6 chip expected later in 2026, alongside updated iMac models slated for 2027, amid rising AI-driven hardware demand.

AAPL.title: Apple Launches 'Apple Upgrade' Device Leasing Program with Klarna
AAPL.content: Apple launched 'Apple Upgrade' on July 28, a new device lease-to-own program backed by Klarna, replacing the legacy iPhone Upgrade Program. Covers iPhones, Macs, iPads, and Apple Watches. Marks a structural change to how Apple sells hardware, aimed at lowering upfront cost.

AAPL.title: Apple Launches 'Apple Upgrade' Device Leasing Program for iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Apple Watch
AAPL.content: Apple officially launched its 'Apple Upgrade' leasing program in the US on July 28, offering monthly device rentals starting at $17.99 for iPhone, $11.99 for Apple Watch, $24.99 for Mac, and $11.99 for iPad. The program, backed financially by Klarna, replaces Apple's previous iPhone Upgrade Program and installment plans. Seen as a strategy to boost hardware sales ahead of iPhone 17.

AAPL.title: Apple Hits $5 Trillion Market Value, Becomes Second Company Ever to Reach Milestone
AAPL.content: Apple became only the second company in history to achieve a $5 trillion market capitalization on July 28, as shares rose 1.8% to $342.89. The milestone followed Apple reclaiming the title of world's most valuable public company on July 27 by overtaking Nvidia. AAPL is up ~20% YTD ahead of its Q3 FY2026 earnings report on July 30.

AAPL.title: HSBC Upgrades Apple to Buy with $366 Price Target, Calls It an 'Operational Turning Point'
AAPL.content: HSBC analyst Nicolas Cote-Colisson upgraded Apple from Hold to Buy, raising the price target from $260 to $366, saying Apple is at an 'operational turning point.' Robert W. Baird also raised its price target from $310 to $330. AAPL shares rose 1.2% on the dual upgrades, hitting a new 1-year high.

AAPL.title: Apple Reclaims World's Most Valuable Company Title, Overtakes Nvidia
AAPL.content: Apple reclaimed its position as the world's most valuable public company on July 27, overtaking Nvidia with shares hitting an all-time high of $337.12 and a market cap of $4.95 trillion. The stock is up approximately 20% in 2026. Q3 FY2026 earnings are scheduled for July 30, with consensus expecting EPS of $1.89 and revenue of $108.9B.

AAPL.title: Apple Q3 FY2026 Earnings July 30: Tim Cook's Final Earnings Call as CEO; Expected $108.9B Revenue, $1.89 EPS; Stock at $5T Market Cap
AAPL.content: Apple Q3 FY2026 earnings after market close July 30 mark Tim Cook's final earnings call as CEO before transitioning to Executive Chairman on September 1; John Ternus becomes new CEO. Consensus expects Revenue $108.9B (+16% YoY), EPS $1.89 (+20% YoY). iPhone 17 family demand and Services growth are key drivers. Apple recently reclaimed world's most valuable company at $5 trillion market cap.

AAPL.title: Apple Fiscal Q3 2026: Revenue $109.4B (+16%), iPhone +22% to $54.3B, EPS $2.02 Beats — Soft Q4 Guidance Issued
AAPL.content: Apple reported fiscal Q3 2026 (ended June 27, 2026) with revenue of $109.4B (+16% YoY), beating $108.65B estimate. iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $54.3B. EPS of $2.02 beat the $1.89 consensus. Gross margin expanded to 50.1% from 46.5%, including ~2pp benefit from tariff refunds. Soft Q4 guidance issued citing supply constraints.

TSLA.title: Tesla Robotaxi Expands to Dallas and Houston; FSD Subscriptions Hit 1.28M (+51% YoY)
TSLA.content: Tesla Robotaxi went live in Dallas and Houston (April 18), expanding beyond Austin and Bay Area. FSD subscriptions reached 1.28M in Q1 2026 (+51% YoY). Management targeting a dozen U.S. states by year end. Large-scale unsupervised ramp remains 2027 per Musk on software architecture improvements.

TSLA.title: Piper Sandler: Tesla Optimus Robot Valued at Zero in Current ~$400 Stock Price; FSD/Robotaxi Key to Bull Case
TSLA.content: Piper Sandler analyst Alex Potter: Optimus humanoid robot effectively valued at zero in current ~$400/share price despite production ramp underway. Bull case anchored on FSD/Robotaxi scaling in 2027 and robot optionality on top.

TSLA.title: Tesla Optimus Factory Preparations Begin Q2: Fremont Line Targets 1M Robots/Year; FSD v14.3 Cuts Inference Latency 20%
TSLA.content: Tesla beginning preparations for first large-scale Optimus factory at Fremont (first-gen line: 1M robots/year) and Gigafactory Texas (second-gen: 10M robots/year long-term target) in Q2 2026. FSD v14.3 launched April with reinforcement learning upgrades, improved neural encoder, AI compiler, and 20% lower inference latency. Unsupervised Robotaxi now operating in Austin, Dallas, and Houston; targeting a dozen U.S. states by year-end.

TSLA.title: Tesla Rallies 54% From November Low to $421; Optimus Factory Q2 Preparations Begin at Fremont and Gigafactory Texas
TSLA.content: TSLA closed May 11 at $420.84 — up 54% from the November 2025 low of $273. Q2 2026: Optimus factory preparations begin at Fremont (first-gen line: 1M robots/year capacity) and Gigafactory Texas (10M robots/year long-term). Robotaxi operational in Austin, Dallas, Houston; FSD v14.3 with 20% lower inference latency in active deployment; FSD subscribers 1.3M (+51% YoY). Piper Sandler: Optimus effectively valued at zero in current share price.

TSLA.title: Elon Musk Joins Trump China Trip as Tesla Seeks EV Market Recovery; 2026 Model Y Passes NHTSA ADAS Tests
TSLA.content: Elon Musk joins Trump's May 13-15 China state visit delegation, with Tesla seeking EV market access recovery and supply chain stability. Separately, NHTSA confirmed Tesla's 2026 Model Y successfully passed ADAS tests for pedestrian emergency braking, lane-keeping, and blind-spot warnings — a regulatory milestone supporting Tesla's FSD and Robotaxi expansion. TSLA stock up 54% from November 2025 low; Optimus factory preparations underway at Fremont and Gigafactory Texas.

TSLA.title: Tesla FSD v14.3 Launches with 20% Lower Inference Latency; Model S/X Fremont Lines Shut to Enable Optimus Robot Factory
TSLA.content: Tesla launched FSD (Supervised) v14.3 with 20% lower inference latency, improved vision perception, and enhanced edge case handling. Model S/X production lines at Fremont permanently closed to make way for Optimus humanoid robot factory targeting 1M robots/year. Tesla also received EU FSD approval in Netherlands. Q1 2026 FSD subscribers: 1.3M (up from ~850K a year ago).

TSLA.title: Wedbush: SpaceX and Tesla to Merge in 2027; SpaceX Confirms New Tesla Collaboration Exploration; India Facility Plans Dropped
TSLA.content: Wedbush analyst Dan Ives reported SpaceX and Tesla "will eventually merge into one company in 2027." SpaceX publicly confirmed plans to explore expanded Tesla collaboration. Tesla ended plans to build India manufacturing facility. Q1 2026: EPS $0.41 beat estimates, energy storage margins hit record 39.5%. Stock at $414 range.

TSLA.title: Tesla Robotaxi Confirmed in Austin; Targeting 12 US States by Year-End 2026; Stock at $441 Despite Q1 Delivery Miss
TSLA.content: Tesla Robotaxi confirmed live in Austin (joining Dallas and Houston); management guiding to ~12 US states by year-end 2026. New lens-cleaning patent supports autonomous fleet operations. Stock at $441.01 on May 28 despite Q1 2026 deliveries of 358,023 missing 365,645 consensus. Kalshi places 52% odds on Tesla-SpaceX merger before May 2027.

TSLA.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Mass Production Preparations Underway at Fremont (1M Robots/Year Target); Robotaxi Expands to Dallas and Houston
TSLA.content: Tesla began preparations for first large-scale Optimus Gen 3 mass-production factory at Fremont, CA, replacing Model S/X lines, designed for capacity of 1 million robots/year. A second Gigafactory Texas Gen 3 line is planned for 10M robots/year long-term. Unsupervised Robotaxi service now operational in Austin and expanded to Dallas and Houston in April 2026. FSD subscription at record net new subscriptions in Q1 2026. Total 2025-2026 CapEx plan: $25B+ across six factories including new Texas chip fab for Dojo. Elon Musk projects Optimus to drive 80% of future Tesla value.

TSLA.title: Tesla FSD v14.3.3 Waves 2-3 Roll Out June 3-4; 20% Reaction Time Improvement; Upgraded Vision Encoder
TSLA.content: Tesla deployed 2nd and 3rd FSD Supervised v14.3.3 (build 2026.14.6.7) waves June 3-4. Key improvements: rewritten AI compiler with 20% better reaction time; upgraded neural network vision encoder for better 3D geometry comprehension and low-visibility performance; improved driver monitoring (DMS) with eye gaze tracking; new live FSD intervention-free distance stat.

TSLA.title: Tesla FSD v14 Lite for HW3 Targets Late-June North America Rollout; EU FSD Supervised Approval Secured in Netherlands
TSLA.content: Tesla confirmed FSD v14 Lite — bringing reversing, gear shifting, and parking automation to older Hardware 3 vehicles — targeting late-June 2026 North America rollout. HW3 owners represent a large installed base awaiting v14. Tesla received EU regulatory approval for FSD (Supervised) in Netherlands in April; full EU-wide recognition targeted summer 2026.

TSLA.title: J.P. Morgan Upgrades Tesla to Neutral: 'TSLA at the Forefront of Physical AI'; Erste Group Upgrades to Hold; OpenAI Launches Robotics Division
TSLA.content: J.P. Morgan upgraded Tesla to Neutral from Underweight on June 5, citing TSLA's leadership in physical AI (FSD autonomous driving, Optimus humanoid robot, Dojo training). Erste Group also upgraded to Hold from Sell. Competitive headwind: OpenAI formally launched a robotics division targeting the same humanoid market as Optimus. Stock remains up ~75% YTD in 2026.

TSLA.title: Tesla Expands Unsupervised Cybercab Robotaxi Service to Entire Austin Metro Area (4,285 sq miles)
TSLA.content: Tesla expanded its unsupervised Cybercab robotaxi service to the entire Austin metro area (~4,285 sq miles). Approximately 28-39 unsupervised vehicles operating commercially in Austin.

TSLA.title: JPMorgan Upgrades Tesla from Underweight to Neutral, Raises Price Target 227% to $475
TSLA.content: JPMorgan upgraded Tesla from Underweight to Neutral with price target $475 (+227% from $145), abandoning a long-held bearish stance. Cites Tesla's 'physical AI' positioning with ~50% annual EPS growth through 2030 and autonomous/robotic platforms as nearly half of incremental growth.

TSLA.title: Tesla Files for Nevada Autonomous Vehicle Network Company Permit — Up to 5,000 Vehicles in Clark County
TSLA.content: Tesla Robotaxi, LLC filed an AVNC permit application in Nevada for Clark County (Las Vegas/Harry Reid Airport), requesting authorization for up to 5,000 vehicles in year one. Public protest window closes July 5, 2026.

TSLA.title: SpaceX Begins Trading on Nasdaq at $135/Share Target, Raising ~$75B; Tesla-SpaceX Merger Speculation Rises
TSLA.content: SpaceX is scheduled to begin public trading on Nasdaq on June 12, 2026 at $135/share target, raising ~$75B. The listing has catalyzed debate about the 'Musk halo effect' on Tesla and whether merger speculation will intensify post-IPO.

TSLA.title: J.P. Morgan Double-Upgrades Tesla to Neutral; Raises Price Target to $475 from $145
TSLA.content: J.P. Morgan issued one of the largest single PT revisions in Tesla history, upgrading to Neutral and raising 12-month target to $475 from $145, reframing valuation around autonomous driving and humanoid robotics. Projects Tesla revenue growing to $203B by 2030.

TSLA.title: Tesla and SpaceX Announce 'Terafab' Partnership — Projected World's Largest AI Chip Manufacturing Plant
TSLA.content: Tesla and SpaceX announced 'Terafab,' an AI chip manufacturing plant partnership projected to become the world's largest, combining Tesla's manufacturing capabilities with SpaceX's AI ambitions ahead of the SpaceX IPO.

TSLA.title: J.P. Morgan Upgrades TSLA to Neutral, Raises Target to $475 on Autonomous + Robotics Thesis
TSLA.content: J.P. Morgan upgraded Tesla from Underweight to Neutral, raising 12-month price target from $145 to $475, reframing valuation around autonomous driving and humanoid robotics, projecting revenue growth to $203B by 2030.

TSLA.title: Tesla Files for Autonomous Vehicle Network Permit in Nevada — Up to 5,000 Robotaxis in Clark County
TSLA.content: Tesla filed for an Autonomous Vehicle Network Company permit in Nevada, seeking approval to operate up to 5,000 robotaxis in Clark County including Las Vegas and Henderson airport zones within 12 months of launch.

TSLA.title: Tesla Robotaxi Fleet Totals Just 59 Vehicles Across Three Texas Cities — Far Below Expectations
TSLA.content: As of mid-June 2026, Tesla's operational robotaxi fleet stands at only 59 vehicles across Austin, Houston, and Dallas, significantly underperforming Musk's earlier promise of widespread US coverage by end of 2026.

TSLA.title: Tesla Raises 2026 CapEx Forecast to $25B, Focused on AI Compute and Robotaxi Infrastructure
TSLA.content: Tesla raised its 2026 capital expenditure guidance to approximately $25 billion (up from $20B), directed toward AI compute infrastructure and robotaxi fleet buildout.

TSLA.title: Tesla FSD Wins Regulatory Approval in Denmark; Faces Potential EU-Wide Block After Swedish Warning on Speed Limits
TSLA.content: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) software received regulatory approval in Denmark. However, EU-wide deployment faces a significant hurdle after Swedish regulators issued a formal warning about FSD's handling of speed limit features, potentially triggering a bloc-wide block that would bar FSD across all 27 EU member states.

TSLA.title: Tesla, Sunrun, and Renew Home Announce 16 GW Virtual Power Plant Deal to Supply Flexible Power to Data Centers
TSLA.content: Tesla, Sunrun, and Renew Home announced a deal to deliver more than 16 GW of flexible energy capacity to hyperscalers and utilities by aggregating home batteries, EVs, and 8 million smart thermostats into a virtual power plant requiring no new hardware, sending Sunrun shares surging over 30%.

TSLA.title: U.S. Federal Regulators Open Formal Investigation into Fatal Tesla Driver-Assistance Crash in Texas
TSLA.content: U.S. federal regulators opened a formal investigation into a fatal crash in Texas involving Tesla's driver-assistance system, adding regulatory scrutiny as the company continues its autonomous driving push. The investigation contributed to downward pressure on Tesla shares.

TSLA.title: NHTSA Opens Special Investigation into Fatal Texas Crash Involving Tesla FSD — Same Software Stack as Austin Robotaxi
TSLA.content: NHTSA opened a special investigation into a fatal Model 3 crash near Houston (Katy, TX) in which the driver claimed Tesla FSD was engaged when the vehicle struck a home, killing a 76-year-old woman. The probe is significant because Tesla uses the same FSD software stack in its Austin robotaxi service launched June 6. NHTSA already covers 3.2M vehicles in a broader FSD probe at Engineering Analysis stage.

TSLA.title: Morgan Stanley Raises Tesla Q2 2026 Delivery Estimate to 413,000 Vehicles Citing Europe and China Recovery
TSLA.content: Morgan Stanley analyst Andrew Percoco raised his Q2 2026 delivery estimate for Tesla to 413,000 vehicles (up from 373,000), citing solid recovery in Europe and China sales. Consensus estimates cluster around 401,000-420,000 vehicles. Tesla is scheduled to report Q2 deliveries imminently and Q2 earnings on July 22, 2026.

TSLA.title: Tesla Q2 2026 Deliveries Jump 25% YoY to Record 480,126 Vehicles — Beat Consensus by 74,000 Units
TSLA.content: Tesla delivered 480,126 vehicles in Q2 2026, a 25% YoY increase and +34% vs Q1. Beat consensus estimate of ~406,000 by 74,000 units — highest Q2 ever. Model 3/Y accounted for 467,762 units; energy storage deployments reached 13.5 GWh (+41% YoY).

TSLA.title: Tesla Launches Robotaxi Service in Miami, Expanding Unsupervised FSD Ride-Hailing to Third City
TSLA.content: Tesla launched its robotaxi ride-hailing service in Miami with unsupervised Full Self-Driving capability, marking a major commercial milestone following earlier deployments in Austin and San Francisco. The Miami expansion extends Tesla's autonomous vehicle monetization strategy to a fourth major metropolitan market and was a key driver of the stock's post-Q2 delivery rally.

TSLA.title: Tesla Q2 2026 Earnings Set for July 22 After-Market; Wall Street Focused on Automotive Gross Margin, Cybercab Timeline, and $25B Capex
TSLA.content: Q2 earnings July 22 after close; 480K deliveries already reported, so focus shifts to Q2 gross margin trajectory, Cybercab commercial launch timeline, and whether $25B capex is compressing free cash flow.

TSLA.title: Tesla Q2 2026 Earnings Preview: 480K Record Deliveries, $0.52 EPS Estimate, Options Price 7.6% Move for July 22
TSLA.content: 创纪录480K交付量，13.5 GWh储能；营收预测$26.07B(+16% YoY)，EPS $0.52(+30% YoY)；期权隐含7.6%波动幅度；市场焦点：汽车毛利率、Robotaxi进展和Optimus机器人更新

TSLA.title: Tesla (TSLA) Q2 2026 Earnings Preview: Strong Deliveries, Murky Profits
TSLA.content: Tesla reports Q2 2026 earnings on July 22 (today). Record 480,126 deliveries (+25% YoY, ~74K above consensus), best Q2 ever and first YoY delivery growth in two years. Energy storage: 13.5 GWh (+53% from Q1). Revenue est. ~$26.4B. EPS range: $0.27-$0.74 (consensus $0.53). Key metric: automotive gross margin ex-regulatory credits — whether the delivery surge translated to profits or was erased by pricing incentives.

TSLA.title: Tesla Hints at FSD v14 Lite (2026.20.6.10) Going Wide Release
TSLA.content: Tesla AI chief Ashok Elluswamy confirmed FSD v14 Lite (build 2026.20.6.10) is heading to wide release for HW3 vehicles. New UI features include self-driving stats, camera previews, and an intervention-free streak counter (animations at 100/250/500/1K/5K miles). FSD v14 is the software base underpinning the Cybercab. Currently in limited early-access rollout.

TSLA.title: How Will Tesla Stock React to Its Upcoming Earnings?
TSLA.content: Analysis ahead of TSLA's July 22 earnings. Record deliveries boost revenue but margin uncertainty is the swing factor. Tesla expanding Robotaxi service to Miami (Cybercab employee rides starting at Gigafactory Texas). $200B+ AI/FSD investment thesis requires improved margins to justify valuation. Straddle prices ~7% move.

TSLA.title: Tesla Scheduled to Report Q2 Earnings — Deliveries Hit Record High, Is Profitability Strong Enough?
TSLA.content: Tesla Q2 2026 preview: 480K deliveries beat consensus by ~74K. Revenue est. $27.35B (+22.2% YoY from $22.4B). Analyst EPS range $0.27-$0.74. Investors watching whether AI/Robotaxi investment pace is sustainable alongside vehicle margin recovery. Energy storage deployment of 13.5 GWh reinforces non-auto revenue growth.

TSLA.title: Tesla Launches Driverless Robotaxi Service in Tampa and Orlando, Florida
TSLA.content: Tesla launched its camera-only driverless Robotaxi service in Tampa and Orlando on July 21-22, just 18 days after the Miami debut. Tesla's Robotaxi fleet now operates in Miami, Tampa, Orlando (FL), Austin, Houston, Dallas (TX), and the San Francisco Bay Area — all using vision-only FSD with no lidar or radar.

TSLA.title: Tesla Q2 2026 Earnings: Revenue $28.2B Beats, EPS $0.33 Misses Badly; Operating Income Falls 57%
TSLA.content: Tesla reported Q2 2026 revenue of $28.24B (+26% YoY) with record deliveries of 480,126 vehicles, but non-GAAP EPS of $0.33 missed the $0.47 consensus. Operating income fell 57% to $398M (1.4% margin), free cash flow turned negative at -$1.1B, and TSLA fell ~7% pre-market July 23.

TSLA.title: Tesla Q2 2026 Earnings Miss: EPS $0.33 vs. $0.51 Estimate; Operating Margin Collapses to 1.4% on AI/Robotics Capex Surge
TSLA.content: Tesla Q2 2026 EPS of $0.33 missed the $0.51 consensus; operating income fell 57% to $398M with free cash flow turning negative -$1.1B as capex surged 142% on AI, robotics, and autonomous systems. Stock plunged 14.52%, erasing $214B in market cap.

TSLA.title: Tesla Releases FSD v14 Lite to Wide Release, Extending to HW3 Hardware Vehicles
TSLA.content: Tesla pushed FSD (Supervised) v14 Lite to wide release via software update 2026.20.6.11, bringing distilled HW4 intelligence to older HW3 hardware and significantly expanding the number of vehicles with access to the latest autonomous driving capabilities.

TSLA.title: Wall Street Analysts Cut Tesla Price Targets and Ratings Following Q2 Earnings Disappointment
TSLA.content: Multiple Wall Street analysts reduced Tesla price targets or ratings following the Q2 miss, citing unsustainable capital allocation toward AI and robotics, compressed 1.4% operating margins, and the quiet removal of Optimus mass-production language from shareholder materials.

TSLA.title: Tesla Crosses $100 Billion Trailing 12-Month Revenue for First Time After Q2 2026 Results
TSLA.content: Tesla hit $100B in trailing 12-month revenue for the first time following Q2 2026 record revenue of $28.2B (+26% YoY). Q2 non-GAAP EPS of $0.33 missed the $0.53 consensus by 38%, GAAP operating income fell 57% to $398M (1.4% margin), and FCF was negative $1.1B. Stock fell ~14.5% on July 23 post-earnings.

TSLA.title: Tesla Q2 2026 Earnings: Revenue $28.24B (+26% YoY) Beats; EPS $0.33 Misses $0.51 Estimate
TSLA.content: Tesla Q2 2026: revenue $28.24B (+26% YoY, beat) on record 480,000 deliveries; adjusted EPS $0.33 missed $0.51 estimate (-18% YoY). Trailing 12-month revenue crossed $100B for the first time. Auto margins fell to 16.3%; energy margins fell to 20.4%. Company expects 2026 capex to exceed $25B with up to $30B in debt facilities for Robotaxi, Optimus, and AI chip manufacturing.

TSLA.title: Tesla Stock Falls Below $300 — Worst Week Since 2022 — on Negative Free Cash Flow, Rising Capex and Margin Compression
TSLA.content: TSLA fell below $300 July 29, marking its worst week since 2022 despite Q2 revenue crossing $100B trailing 12 months. Key negatives: Q2 free cash flow turned negative, margins declined, $30B borrowing plan announced, Optimus robot production line targets end of 2026. Multiple banks including JPMorgan cut price targets. Cybercab under $30K expected before 2027.

TSLA.title: Tesla Q2 2026 10-Q Filed: Q2 Revenue $28.24B (+26% YoY), EPS $0.33 Misses $0.51 Est; Optimus Production Line Starts End-2026
TSLA.content: Tesla Q2 2026 10-Q (period ended June 30) filed. Revenue $28.24B (+26% YoY) beats; EPS $0.33 misses $0.51 estimate. Free cash flow negative. Optimus humanoid robot production line at Fremont starts end of 2026; mass production targeting same year. Cybercab production commenced, expected under $30K before 2027.

TSLA.title: Tesla Expands Unsupervised Robotaxi Operations to Miami, Orlando, and Tampa; Stock Rebounds 3%
TSLA.content: Tesla confirmed launch of unsupervised Robotaxi rides in Miami, Orlando, and Tampa in July 2026, expanding beyond the original Austin pilot, bringing total to seven major metro areas. Stock rebounded 3.09% on July 30. Tesla is investing $25B+ in 2026 to target 1 million Optimus robot units annually.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Secures $2.2B Chicago Hyperscale Data Center Deal and Joins Nasdaq-100 Effective June 22
CRWV.content: CoreWeave confirmed Nasdaq-100 inclusion (effective June 22) while also announcing a 15-year lease on a new Chicago-area hyperscale data center adding ~$2.2B in contracted revenue. CRWV shares jumped 10-12% on June 16.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Q1 2026: Revenue $2.1B (+112% YoY), Backlog $99.4B Approaching $100B; 2026 Guide $12-13B
CRWV.content: CRWV Q1 2026: revenue $2.1B (+112% YoY, +32% sequential). Backlog $99.4B (+50% QoQ). Active power surpassed 1GW; targeting 1.7GW by end 2026. 2026 capex guidance $31-35B. Full-year revenue guidance $12-13B maintained. Adj operating income $900M-$1.1B.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Stock Falls ~10% on Wider-Than-Expected Loss Despite Record Backlog Near $100B
CRWV.content: CRWV stock fell ~10% post-earnings as Q1 EPS of -$1.11 missed -$0.87 estimate. Despite backlog approaching $100B and revenues tripling YoY, heavy capex ($31-35B in 2026) and persistent net losses concerned investors. Revenue guidance $12-13B for 2026 maintained.

CRWV.title: Magnetar Capital Sells $164.4M of CoreWeave Shares; Post-Earnings EPS Miss Raises Profitability Concerns
CRWV.content: Magnetar Capital funds disclosed $164.4M sale of CRWV shares following post-earnings ~10% decline. Q1 EPS of -$1.40 significantly missed -$0.87 estimate despite $2.1B revenue (+112% YoY) and $99.4B backlog. 2026 capex guidance $31-35B with persistent net losses raises investor concerns about path to profitability. Revenue guidance $12-13B for full 2026 maintained.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Q2 2026 Revenue Guide $2.45-2.6B Misses $2.69B Consensus; $95B Backlog Includes Jane Street $6B Deal
CRWV.content: CoreWeave Q2 2026 guided $2.45-2.6B, with the midpoint trailing analyst consensus of $2.69B. Despite strong Q1 (revenue $2.1B +112% YoY, backlog $99.4B), cautious Q2 guide added to post-earnings investor concerns. Committed pipeline exceeds $95B including $21B Meta agreement and a new $6B deal with Jane Street signed April 2026. CRWV targeting $12-13B full-year 2026 revenue and 1.7GW active power by year-end.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Secures $3.1B GPU-Backed HPC Infrastructure Loan; Jane Street $6B Deal + Nvidia $2B Equity Investment
CRWV.content: CRWV secured $3.1B DDTL 5.0 GPU-backed loan (oversubscribed). Separately, Jane Street will pay ~$6B for AI cloud access + $1B equity at $109/share; Nvidia bought additional $2B CRWV shares in Q1. Backlog: $99.4B.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Q1 2026 Revenue $2.08B (Doubled YoY); EPS Miss Triggers 13% Drop; Rebounds +5% on NVDA Q2 Guide
CRWV.content: CoreWeave Q1 2026: revenue ~$2.08B (doubled YoY, beat), but EPS missed, triggering ~13% post-earnings decline. Stock recovered +5% on May 21 following NVDA's strong Q2 guidance ($91B), confirming AI data center GPU demand. Short interest at 14%. Capital-intensive GPU cloud model faces debt scrutiny despite strong revenue growth.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Launches Unified Agentic AI Capabilities; $99.4B Contracted Backlog; 2027 Revenue 75% Already Contracted
CRWV.content: CoreWeave announced unified agentic AI platform capabilities on May 27. Analysts assign Strong Buy: $99.4B contracted backlog with $36B expected within 24 months. Over 75% of 2027 revenue already contracted. Stock at $104.30 on May 27.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave First to Deploy Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72; Joins Russell 3000 Index June 26
CRWV.content: CoreWeave becomes first AI cloud to deploy and validate Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 system (10x better inference/watt vs Blackwell; 1/10 cost per million tokens). Added to Russell 3000 effective June 26, 2026. Contracted backlog nears $100B. Stock +6.5% in pre-market on three simultaneous catalysts.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Signs $2.2B 15-Year Hyperscale Data Center Lease in Chicago as Sole Tenant; Stock Surges 12%
CRWV.content: CoreWeave signed 15-year build-to-suit hyperscale data center lease in Chicago area (~$2.2B contracted revenue). CRWV stock surged 12%+. Q1 2026 revenue ~$2.08B (+100% YoY), above Street expectations; net loss ~$740M ongoing. Previously deployed first Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 system among hyperscalers.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Invests in Tensormesh AI Startup; $21B Meta Contract Through 2032; Russell 3000 Index Inclusion Effective June 27
CRWV.content: CoreWeave invested in AI networking startup Tensormesh, expanding its infrastructure stack. Reiterated full-year 2026 revenue outlook of $12-13B. Meta contract (~$21B through December 2032) and Anthropic multi-year deal provide strong revenue visibility. CEO Mike Intrator confirmed CoreWeave has reached 'hyperscale' with 3.5+ GW of contracted power. Russell 3000 Index inclusion begins June 27, 2026.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave First AI Cloud to Deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72; Completes Industry-First Rack-Scale Bring-Up
CRWV.content: CoreWeave became the first AI cloud provider to complete bring-up and validation of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 rack-scale AI architecture on CoreWeave Cloud. Milestone positions CRWV to offer next-gen Vera Rubin compute commercially ahead of rivals. CRWV Q1 2026 revenue .1B (+112% YoY), backlog 9.4B, 0B+ new customer commitments in Q1.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Explores Euro-Denominated High-Yield Bond Market, Appoints JPMorgan to Lead Investor Calls
CRWV.content: CoreWeave engaging European high-yield investors for potential USD- and EUR-denominated bonds. First euro-denominated high-yield bond attempt. Holds Ba3/B+/BB- ratings; secured $20B+ in 2026 funding including $8.5B non-recourse term loan.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Expands into Agentic AI Application Stack to Deepen Enterprise Stickiness Beyond GPU Rental
CRWV.content: CoreWeave is expanding beyond pure GPU cloud infrastructure into the agentic AI application stack to increase enterprise customer lock-in across ~50 data centers in North America and Europe.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave First to Deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72; Stock Surges 14%
CRWV.content: CoreWeave became world's first AI cloud provider to bring up and validate NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 (most powerful AI system), completing full rack-scale validation and unveiling two patent-pending innovations. Shares rose ~14%.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Q1 Earnings Miss: Wider Loss Than Expected; Q2 Revenue Guidance Below Consensus
CRWV.content: CoreWeave reported Q1 net loss wider than Wall Street expected and issued Q2 revenue guidance below consensus, triggering a ~12% single-day drop on elevated volume.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Co-Founders Sell $2.3B in Stock Following IPO Lockup Expiration
CRWV.content: After the IPO lockup period expired, co-founders Michael Intrator, Brannin McBee, and Brian Venturo collectively sold over $2.3B in CRWV shares, creating significant near-term selling pressure.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave to Join Nasdaq-100 Index Before Market Open June 22; Vanguard Boosts Stake 275% to 28M Shares
CRWV.content: CoreWeave announced Nasdaq-100 inclusion effective before market open on June 22, 2026. Vanguard boosted its stake by 275.6% to ~28M shares worth ~$2B. Q1 revenue of $2.08B (+111.6% YoY) and $35.1B debt load noted.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Secures 15-Year Chicago Hyperscale Data Center Lease Worth ~$2.2B in Contracted AI Revenue
CRWV.content: CoreWeave signed a 15-year Chicago hyperscale data center lease, locking in approximately $2.2B in contracted AI infrastructure revenue and sending shares up 12% on the headline. Also announced new agentic AI capabilities linking training and inference.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave CSO Sells $7.45M in Shares Ahead of Nasdaq-100 Index Entry on June 22
CRWV.content: CoreWeave's Chief Strategy Officer sold $7.45M in company shares ahead of the Nasdaq-100 inclusion. The insider sale coincided with CRWV stock trading up 8.86% amid strong AI infrastructure demand sentiment.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Contracted Backlog Expected to Reach $131B by End of Q2 2026
CRWV.content: CoreWeave management guided contracted backlog to grow from ~$100B (March 2026) to $131B by end of Q2 2026, reflecting surging demand for AI compute infrastructure.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Contracted Backlog Tops $99.4B with $32B in Recent Additions; 2026 Revenue Guidance $12-13B; Joins Nasdaq-100 June 22
CRWV.content: CoreWeave enters Nasdaq-100 (effective June 22) with $99.4B contracted revenue backlog, including $32B in new commitments added recently and $40B+ signed in Q1 alone. FY2026 management guidance: $12-13B revenue with an exit run rate of $18-19B; 2027 run rate targeted above $30B (75%+ already contracted). Major commitments: $21B Meta, $6B Jane Street, $2.2B Chicago hyperscale data center.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Launches ARIA — Agentic AI Research and Iteration Platform Connecting Training and Inference in a Continuous Loop
CRWV.content: CoreWeave launched ARIA (AI Research and Iteration Agent) on June 27, 2026, connecting model training and inference in a continuous feedback loop for agentic AI workloads, representing CoreWeave's expansion from pure GPU cloud infrastructure into AI platform software capabilities.

CRWV.title: Shareholder Lawsuit Filed Against CoreWeave Over Alleged Securities Violations Around IPO Period
CRWV.content: The Shareholders Foundation announced that a lawsuit against CoreWeave alleging securities law violations is advancing, with a notice issued June 29, 2026 for investors who purchased CRWV shares prior to March 28, 2025. The case relates to disclosures made around CoreWeave's IPO period.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Slides on Meta Compute Cloud Threat Then Rebounds; Analysts Highlight AI Training Differentiation
CRWV.content: CoreWeave shares initially dropped after Meta Platforms announced its internal 'Meta Compute' cloud service targeting AI compute customers. The stock partially recovered as analysts noted CoreWeave's differentiated positioning in GPU-optimized cloud for demanding AI training workloads, where it holds capacity commitments from OpenAI and other major AI labs.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Shares Rise as Analyst Raises Spending Estimate and Dismisses Meta Cloud Competition Threat
CRWV.content: 分析师反驳Meta自建云竞争威胁论，指出客户面临的核心问题是"能否获得所需AI算力容量"而非"选哪家提供商"；CRWV上涨1.80%至$74.53

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Stock Surges 6.27% on Major AI Infrastructure Expansion Deal
CRWV.content: CRWV shares rallied 6.27% on July 20 on news of a major AI infrastructure expansion. CoreWeave's Conapto colocation partnership adds capacity across two renewable-powered Stockholm data center campuses featuring NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture and Vera Rubin Platforms connected via Quantum-X800 InfiniBand.

CRWV.title: Price Prediction: CoreWeave Has 124% Upside Despite Capex Concerns
CRWV.content: Bullish price target implying 124% upside from current levels. CoreWeave reported ~$2.08B quarterly revenue at 69.4% gross margin but carries ~$740M quarterly net loss. New commitment pipeline reached $40B+; Helios data center power capacity secured from Galaxy Digital.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave and Meta Announce $21 Billion Expanded AI Infrastructure Agreement
CRWV.content: CoreWeave and Meta announced a $21B expanded AI infrastructure agreement, significantly extending CoreWeave's role as Meta's AI cloud compute provider. Despite the positive deal size, some investors were also concerned by separate reports that Meta was exploring selling its own excess GPU compute capacity.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Stock Jumps as Truist Upgrades to Buy, Baird Initiates at Outperform
CRWV.content: CoreWeave shares rebounded as Truist upgraded to Buy (target $126) and Baird initiated at Outperform (target $100), citing AI demand momentum and expanded power capacity commitments. The company also launched a $2.6B GPU term loan to fund AI infrastructure buildout.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave CFO Sold $5.5M in Company Shares During July Selloff
CRWV.content: CoreWeave CFO Nitin Agrawal sold 65,055 shares at $82.80–$88.79 per share totaling ~$5.5 million via SEC Form 4. The insider sale during a 19% six-day stock decline drew scrutiny as the company pursues a $34B capex buildout.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Stock Price Sinks Despite $35 Billion Meta Deal as Hyperscaler Competition Intensifies
CRWV.content: CRWV continued sliding even though Meta holds a locked-in $35B compute contract through 2032. Meta's new 'Meta Compute' cloud service — selling spare AI computing capacity to third parties — triggered a 35% single-session crash on July 17 and sustained pressure. Stock is down ~40% YoY, near $71 vs. $99.4B revenue backlog.

CRWV.title: Rosenblatt Reiterates Street-High Buy on CoreWeave with $250 Target, 248% Implied Upside
CRWV.content: Rosenblatt maintained Buy and street-high $250 target on CRWV (trading ~$71), citing $99.4B revenue backlog and ~108% projected Q2 YoY revenue growth. Called hyperscaler competition fears overblown given Meta's contractual commitment.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Announces Q2 2026 Earnings Call Scheduled for August 11, 2026
CRWV.content: CoreWeave announced it will host its Q2 2026 financial results conference call on August 11, 2026 at 5:00 PM ET. Stock traded in a $64.63-$70.32 range around the announcement date, down ~43% from year-ago levels.

CRWV.title: Rosenblatt Reiterates Buy / $250 Price Target on CoreWeave as Stock Sits 43% Below Year-Ago Levels
CRWV.content: Rosenblatt reiterated its Buy rating and $250 price target on CRWV while shares traded near $71. Analyst channel checks showed no change in hyperscale GPU compute demand, with GPU shortages remaining the norm. Rosenblatt characterized recent weakness as a buying opportunity.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Down 30%+ This Month; Meta's Own AI Cloud Plans Raise Competition Concerns; Investors Demand GAAP Profits
CRWV.content: CRWV fell 5.75% July 28, down 30%+ over the prior month. Key concerns: reports Meta is building own AI compute capacity (competitive threat) and investors shifting toward demanding GAAP profitability over revenue growth. Q1 2026 revenue $2.1B (doubled YoY) and ~$100B contract backlog show enterprise demand intact.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Surges 11% as Truist Upgrades to Buy After 42% Pullback; Roth Capital and Jefferies Also Bullish
CRWV.content: CRWV jumped 11.08% on coordinated analyst upgrades: Truist upgraded to Buy citing strong AI compute demand and discount to neocloud peers; Roth Capital called the Meta-driven selloff overdone; Jefferies labeled CRWV one of the strongest AI compute hosting plays. Q2 2026 earnings due August 11.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Secures $8.5B Loan Facility to Scale AI Cloud Infrastructure
CRWV.content: CoreWeave secured an $8.5B loan facility to fund aggressive AI cloud expansion. Latest quarter showed ~$2.08B revenue with 69.4% gross margin but -$740M net income as infrastructure buildout accelerates. New York hyperscale data center moratorium may redirect growth to other regions.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy Deepens AI Data Center Nuclear Power Strategy with 5,650 MW PPA Pipeline
CEG.content: Constellation highlighted its nuclear AI data center strategy: over 5,650 MW of long-term clean energy agreements, ~1 GW of nuclear uprates ($3.9B capex), including 20-year 1.1 GW PPA with Meta and nuclear restart agreement with Microsoft at Crane Clean Energy Center.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy Q1 2026: EPS $2.74 Beats $2.59 Estimate; Revenue $11.12B; Calpine Drives Near-Doubling of Revenue
