CEG.content: CEG Q1 2026: GAAP net income $1.59B (vs $118M a year ago), adj EPS $2.74 (vs $2.59 est). Revenue $11.12B (beat $9B estimate) thanks to Calpine acquisition consolidation in January 2026. Nuclear capacity factor 92.3%. Full-year adj EPS guidance $11.00-$12.00 affirmed.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy Freestone Site Approved for Large Data Center Co-Location; Pin Oak Creek 460MW Online
CEG.content: CEG Q1 update: Freestone site secured regulatory approval to co-locate a large data center, expanding nuclear power AI supply capacity. Pin Oak Creek 460MW natural gas facility reached commercial operation. 105MW Pastoria Solar commissioned.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy CEO Affirms 20% Long-Term EPS Growth Target; Ranked #1 on Barron's Most Sustainable U.S. Companies
CEG.content: Constellation Energy Q1 2026 earnings call: CEO affirmed 20% long-term earnings growth target. Ranked #1 on Barron's 2026 Most Sustainable U.S. Companies list. Nuclear PTC portfolio and AI data center power agreements provide multi-year revenue visibility.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy Q1 2026: Revenue +64% to $11.12B; Crane Nuclear Plant Awaiting Regulator Restart Decision
CEG.content: CEG Q1 2026: Adjusted EPS $2.74, revenue $11.12B (+64% YoY, includes Calpine). Crane Clean Energy Center (Three Mile Island) restart awaiting NRC decision; may not supply grid until 2031. FY 2026 adj. EPS guidance $11-12 reaffirmed. $4B growth capex planned.

CEG.title: DOE Emergency Order 202-26-17: Eddystone Generating Station Must Stay Online May 25–Aug 22 for PJM Grid Reliability
CEG.content: U.S. Department of Energy issued Emergency Order No. 202-26-17 on May 25, 2026, requiring Constellation Energy's Eddystone Generating Station Units 3 & 4 to remain in commercial operation through August 22, 2026, to ensure PJM Interconnection grid reliability during summer peak demand. CEG stock rose 3.38-4.86% on the news, underscoring the essential role of Constellation's dispatchable generation fleet.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy Quarterly Dividend $0.4265/Share Payable June 5; Pursuing 1GW Nuclear Uprates Over Next Decade
CEG.content: Constellation declared quarterly dividend of $0.4265/share payable June 5 (record May 15). Pursuing 1GW+ of nuclear uprates over the next decade including 135MW at Braidwood and Byron plants (Illinois). Prioritizing long-term hyperscaler PPAs for AI data center power. Q1 2026 earnings beat; reaffirmed full-year guidance.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy: Existing Shareholders Launch 11M-Share Secondary Offering; CEG Falls 7%; Nuclear Uprates 1GW and $3.9B Capex Plan Ongoing
CEG.content: Institutional shareholders launched underwritten secondary offering of 11M CEG shares (company itself not selling). Stock fell 7% on June 1-2. CEG's own nuclear expansion plan: ~1GW uprates and $3.9B capital spending to support 5,650+ MW long-term clean energy agreements with AI data center customers. Q1 2026 revenue $11.12B beat consensus $8.71B.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy-Calpine Merger Creates Largest Private Power Producer; Nuclear + Gas Targets AI Data Center; EPS Visibility Through 2029
CEG.content: Constellation Energy's Calpine acquisition integrates its zero-emission nuclear fleet with Calpine's natural gas and geothermal assets, creating the largest private power producer in the US. Long-term agreements include Microsoft (20-year) and Meta (1.1 GW, 20-year). Multi-decade contracted nuclear cash flows provide EPS visibility through 2029+. Nuclear fleet uprates targeting higher output to meet AI data center demand.

CEG.title: FERC Waiver Accelerates Three Mile Island Restart to 2027 to Serve Microsoft AI Data Centers
CEG.content: FERC granted Constellation a waiver allowing expedited grid integration of Three Mile Island, moving target restart from 2031 to 2027. Plant will primarily serve Microsoft AI data centers.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy Completes $3.1B Secondary Offering and $558M Share Repurchase
CEG.content: Constellation priced an 11M-share secondary offering at $281/share and simultaneously repurchased 2M shares for $558M. Offering closed June 2, 2026.

CEG.title: Wells Fargo Initiates Constellation Energy with Buy Rating; AI Nuclear Power Demand as Secular Tailwind
CEG.content: Wells Fargo initiated coverage of Constellation Energy (CEG) with a Buy rating on June 8, citing AI data center nuclear power demand as a multi-year secular tailwind. CEG has locked in 20-year, 1.1 GW clean energy deal with Meta and 5,650+ MW total AI clean power contracts.

CEG.title: Calpine (Constellation Business Unit) Completes 25 MW Expansion at The Geysers Geothermal Complex
CEG.content: Calpine, a Constellation Energy business unit, completed a 25 MW capacity expansion at The Geysers geothermal complex in California, adding clean baseload power capacity aligned with Constellation's strategy to serve AI data center and grid clean energy demand.

CEG.title: Bernstein Initiates Constellation Energy at Outperform; 19 Buy Ratings, Zero Sells
CEG.content: Bernstein initiated coverage of Constellation Energy with an Outperform rating, citing the company's role as a key provider of clean, reliable electricity for AI data centers. Analyst consensus stands at 19 Buy ratings and zero Sells.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy and Walmart Sign First-Ever Corporate Nuclear Power Purchase Agreement (176 MW, Dresden Nuclear Plant, Illinois)
CEG.content: Constellation Energy (CEG) and Walmart signed a landmark long-term nuclear PPA on June 23, covering approximately 176 MW of emissions-free output from Constellation's Dresden Clean Energy Center in Illinois — Walmart's first-ever nuclear deal, with two 15-year supply terms beginning 2029 and 2030.

CEG.title: Constellation Seeks 20-Year License Renewals for Ginna and Nine Mile Point Unit 1 Nuclear Plants Through 2049
CEG.content: Constellation Energy filed subsequent license renewal applications with the NRC to extend operating licenses for R.E. Ginna and Nine Mile Point Unit 1 nuclear plants in upstate New York through 2049 (20-year extension). The Federal Register published formal notice of the Ginna application on June 29, 2026, initiating the regulatory review process.

GEV.content: GEV fell 3.33% on May 28 amid broader market headwinds and bearish analyst report questioning current valuation. CEO highlighted state-level permitting resistance causing delays for hyperscaler customers in advancing data center power projects — potential slowdown in near-term order flow.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Q2 2026: $0.50 Quarterly Dividend; Backlog Grows $13B+ QoQ; Targets 110GW Gas Turbine Agreements by Year-End
GEV.content: GEV board declares $0.50/share quarterly dividend (payable July 14, record June 16). CEO Scott Strazik: Power and Electrification demand accelerating; backlog grew $13B+ QoQ; expects at least 110GW combined gas turbine backlog and slot reservations by year-end 2026. Hosting Orchestrate 2026 in Atlanta, June 9-12.

GEV.title: GEV Data Center Electrification Orders Pacing $24.8B in 2026 (+29% YoY); Total Backlog Approaching $200B; Orchestrate June 9-12
GEV.content: Analyst notes highlight GEV data center electrification orders tracking toward $24.8B for full-year 2026 (+29% YoY), with Electrification segment book-to-bill ~2.5x in Q1 2026. Total backlog approaching $200B; Q1 Electrification backlog $45.3B estimate. Revenue guidance raised to $44.5-$45.5B. Orchestrate 2026 customer conference (June 9-12, Atlanta) is next expected catalyst with additional order announcements.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Raises 2026 Revenue Guidance to $44.5-45.5B; Targets $200B Backlog by 2027 (One Year Earlier); Gas Turbine Slots Sold Out Through Late 2020s
GEV.content: GE Vernova raised 2026 revenue guidance to $44.5-45.5B and expects total backlog to reach $200B by 2027, one year earlier than previously forecast. Gas turbine delivery slots are sold out through the late 2020s. The Electrification segment captured $2.4B in data center equipment orders in Q1 2026 alone, exceeding all of 2025 combined. Gas turbine backlog + slot reservations approaching 110 GW by year-end 2026.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Launches GridOS for Transmission and Releases AI Whitepapers at Orchestrate 2026 Conference
GEV.content: At Orchestrate 2026, GE Vernova introduced GridOS for Transmission — a unified grid intelligence solution for transmission networks — and released AI whitepapers on grid planning and autonomous grid-edge operations.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Wins 100 MW India Wind Order; Launches 3.8 MW Onshore Wind Turbine
GEV.content: GE Vernova launched its 3.8 MW-154m onshore wind turbine and secured a 100 MW order (28 turbines) from Powerica Limited for the Botad Wind Farm in Gujarat, India. Initial deliveries expected Q4 2026.

GEV.title: Court Orders GE Vernova to Continue Vineyard Wind Turbine Work Despite $360M Payment Dispute
GEV.content: Massachusetts Superior Court denied GEV's appeal of injunction requiring it to remain on the Vineyard Wind 1 offshore project. GEV sought to exit after Vineyard Wind failed to pay $360M stemming from a blade failure.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Launches 3.8MW Onshore Wind Turbine in India; Wins 100MW Order from Powerica
GEV.content: GEV launched its 3.8MW–154m onshore wind turbine and won a 100MW order from Powerica for the Botad Wind Farm in Gujarat, India. Initial deliveries expected Q4 2026.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Declares $0.50/Share Quarterly Dividend; Ex-Date June 16, Payable July 14
GEV.content: GE Vernova declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.50 per share with ex-date and record date of June 16, 2026, payable July 14. The company raised 2026 revenue guidance to $44.5-45.5B and holds a record $163B backlog driven by AI data center and hyperscaler demand.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Stock Up 3.76% June 15; Record $163B Backlog and Raised 2026 Guidance Attract Investor Attention
GEV.content: GE Vernova rose 3.76% on June 15, trading at $907-944. Management's record $163B backlog and raised 2026 guidance ($44.5-45.5B revenue, 12-14% EBITDA margin, $6.5-7.5B FCF) continue to attract investors in the AI power trade.

GEV.title: Bernstein Initiates GE Vernova at Outperform with $1,206 Price Target; Stock Surges 6.8%
GEV.content: GEV surged 6.77% to $1,048.86 on June 17 after Bernstein initiated at Outperform with a $1,206 target, highlighting GEV's position in global electricity infrastructure, grid upgrades, industrial electrification, and AI datacenter power demand.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Secures Order for Two 9HA.02 H-Class Gas Turbines for Vietnam's Quang Trach II LNG Power Plant (1.6 GW+)
GEV.content: GE Vernova secured an order for two 9HA.02 gas turbines and two H78 generators for Vietnam Electricity's (EVN) Quang Trach II LNG Power Plant, a combined-cycle facility expected to generate over 1.6 GW of electricity by 2030, expanding GEV's Southeast Asia LNG-to-power footprint.

GEV.title: Microsoft Orders Seven GE Vernova Gas Turbines for 2.67 GW Project Kilby West Texas AI Data Center
GEV.content: Microsoft purchased seven large GE Vernova gas turbines for the 2.67 GW Project Kilby off-grid AI data center power plant in West Texas, co-developed with Chevron under a 20-year power agreement. The ~$7 billion project is expected to deliver first power in 2028. GEV shares rose 4.26% on June 29, boosted by the AI data center power narrative.

GEV.title: GE Vernova to Report Q2 2026 Financial Results on July 22, 2026 Before Market Open
GEV.content: GE Vernova scheduled Q2 2026 financial results release for July 22, 2026 before market open, with CEO Scott Strazik and CFO Ken Parks hosting a webcast at 7:30 AM ET. Analysts expect strong results driven by gas turbine orders and grid electrification backlog growth.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Q2 2026 Earnings on July 22; Q1 Orders $18.3B, Backlog $163B; FY2026 Revenue Guidance Raised to $44.5–45.5B
GEV.content: GEV Q2 2026 earnings before market open July 22; Q1 backlog climbed to $163B; management raised FY2026 guidance to $44.5–45.5B revenue and $6.5–7.5B FCF; 2028 target $56B revenue at 20% EBITDA margin.

GEV.title: GE Vernova and Vertiv Among Top AI Power Plays; Goldman Sachs Projects Data Center Power Demand to Rise 165% by 2030
GEV.content: Goldman Sachs projects global data center power demand +165% from 2023 levels by 2030; GEV uniquely positioned selling into every layer of AI power stack simultaneously — generation, transmission, and data center equipment.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Q2 2026 Earnings Preview July 22: Polymarket 85.5% Odds Orders >$18B, EPS Est $3.17
GEV.content: Q2财报7月22日开盘前发布；EPS预测$3.17，营收$10.77B；Polymarket预测市场65.5%概率订单超$200亿；全年收入指引$44.5-45.5B，自由现金流$6.5-7.5B

GEV.title: GE Vernova Q2 2026 Earnings Released Before Market Open
GEV.content: GE Vernova released Q2 2026 results before the open on July 22. Consensus expected EPS of $3.17 (vs $1.86 YoY, +70%) on revenue of $10.77B (+18.2% YoY). The company raised full-year 2026 guidance: revenue $44.5–$45.5B, adjusted EBITDA margin 12–14%, FCF $6.5–$7.5B. CEO Scott Strazik and CFO Ken Parks hosted a webcast at 7:30 AM ET. GEV is up ~62% YTD.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Gas Turbines Sold Out to 2030 — $163B Backlog Ahead of Q2 Earnings
GEV.content: GE Vernova's gas turbine production slots are fully booked out to 2030 as AI data center power demand surges. Q1 2026 orders hit $18.3B with total backlog at $163B. Q1 revenue reached $9.34B (+16.3% YoY). The company is sitting at the intersection of AI power, grid modernization, and electrification megatrends. Q2 2026 earnings due July 22 before market open.

GEV.title: Wall Street Picks GE Vernova as Top Earnings Catalyst Over CSX on July 22
GEV.content: Analysts broadly favor GEV's July 22 Q2 print as the more powerful catalyst among major reporters. Consensus EPS of $3.17 (+70% YoY) and revenue of $10.77B (+18%) reflect AI-driven power demand supercycle. GEV has delivered four consecutive revenue beats and trades up 62% YTD.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Q2 Earnings Could Send Stock Soaring — What to Watch on July 22
GEV.content: Motley Fool pre-earnings analysis highlights GEV's potential for outsized move on July 22 Q2 report. Key metrics: gas turbine orders, total backlog ($163B+), wind segment profitability improvement, and updated guidance. Stock is up 62% YTD; the prior year it doubled. AI power demand and sold-out turbine production are central thesis drivers.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Forecasts Higher 2026 Profits As Backlog and Valuation Draw Focus
GEV.content: Post-earnings: GEV's total backlog on track for $200B by 2027 (vs. prior 2028 target). Gas turbine slot reservations now targeting 110+ GW by year-end. Q1 2026 orders had surged 71% organically to $18.3B with $2.4B in data center orders. Analysts targeting up to $1,216/share.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Wins Order for Six LM6000VELOX Aeroderivative Turbines for Hawaiian Electric Grid Reliability
GEV.content: GE Vernova signed a contract with Hawaiian Electric to supply six LM6000VELOX aeroderivative turbine packages to repower aging oil-fired steam turbines at the Waiau Power Plant in Pearl City, O'ahu. The multi-phase project adds over 250 MW of dispatchable capacity to Hawaii's grid, with first two units targeting commercial operation in 2029.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Q2 2026 Earnings Beat: Orders +88% to $24.2B, Revenue +22%, Full-Year Guidance Raised
GEV.content: GE Vernova reported Q2 2026 revenue of $11.1B (+22% YoY), net income of $649M ($2.47 diluted EPS), and record orders of $24.2B (+88% YoY). Backlog grew $13B to $176B, on track for $200B in 2027. Q2 FCF was $5.1B. FY 2026 guidance raised to revenue $45.5–$46.5B and FCF $11.5–$12.5B. Company signed 20 GW of new gas equipment contracts in Q2, now expects at least 125 GW under contract by year-end 2026, 'mostly sold out' through 2030.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Rebounds 4.3% as Investors Digest Record $176B Backlog and Raised 2026 Guidance
GEV.content: GE Vernova shares rose 4.29% on July 23 after an initial post-earnings selloff, as investors recognized the strength of Q2 results: orders up 88% YoY to $24.2B, backlog at a record $176B, and full-year 2026 revenue guidance raised by $1B to $45.5-46.5B with free cash flow guidance raised to $11.5-12.5B.

GEV.title: Morgan Stanley Raises GE Vernova Price Target to $1,350, Calls Post-Earnings Drop a 'Knee-Jerk Overreaction'
GEV.content: Morgan Stanley raised GEV price target from $1,250 to $1,350, maintaining Overweight. Called the ~9% post-Q2 drop a significant overreaction. Q2: revenue $11.1B (+22% YoY), orders up 88% to $24.2B, record backlog of $176B, full-year guidance raised to $45.5–$46.5B.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Modernizes Veresegyház Gas Power Hub With On-Site Solar and Lean Production Lines
GEV.content: GE Vernova modernized its Veresegyház, Hungary plant — its largest Gas Power manufacturing base outside the US. Upgrades include on-site solar park, new lean production lines, and plans to add 80+ professionals. Company targets a 20 GW/year run rate in Q3 2026.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Slides 4.7% as Markets Continue to Digest Q2 2026 EPS Miss Despite Record $176B Backlog
GEV.content: GE Vernova stock fell 4.72% on July 27 following Q2 2026 results (reported July 22): adjusted EPS of $2.47 missed the $3.04 consensus despite revenue of $11.1B beating estimates. Orders surged 88% to $24.2B; backlog hit a record $176B. Full-year revenue guidance raised to $45.5-46.5B. Wind segment remains a headwind with $275M EBITDA loss.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Continues Post-Earnings Slide, Down Another 4.7% on July 28
GEV.content: GE Vernova fell an additional 4.69% on July 28 as selling pressure from the Q2 EPS miss continued. Stock has declined roughly 9-10% cumulatively over July 27-28. Despite record backlog and strong order growth, cautious FCF guidance revisions and wind segment underperformance weighed on sentiment.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Q2 2026: Revenue +12% to $11.1B, Orders +88% to $24.2B, Record $176B Backlog; Full-Year Guidance Raised
GEV.content: GE Vernova Q2 2026 revenue rose 12% to $11.1B (beating $10.73B est). Orders surged 88% YoY to $24.2B; backlog hit a record $176B (+$13B sequentially). Free cash flow $5.1B in Q2 alone (~$10B in H1). Management raised 2026 revenue guidance by $1B and free cash flow guidance by $5B. Wind revenue declined 11% as onshore orders fell 40% in North America.

CCJ.title: Cameco Restores McArthur River/Key Lake to Full Production After Flooding Disruption
CCJ.content: Cameco announced McArthur River and Key Lake operations back at full production after flood-related transportation disruptions, using a secondary roadway for deliveries. Reaffirmed 2026 uranium output guidance of 19.5M-21.5M pounds U3O8.

CCJ.title: Cameco Q1 2026: EPS $0.34 Beats $0.29 Estimate; EBITDA $509M; Annual Guidance Maintained Despite Flooding
CCJ.content: CCJ Q1 2026: net earnings $131M, adj EBITDA $509M, EPS $0.34 (beats $0.29 est). Revenue $607.5M beats forecast. Multi-year uranium delivery contracts average 28M lbs/year through 2030. Annual production and financial guidance maintained despite Saskatchewan flooding.

CCJ.title: Cameco Temporarily Halts Key Lake Production After Saskatchewan Flooding Collapses Bridge to McArthur River
CCJ.content: Flooding in northern Saskatchewan collapsed Smoothstone River Bridge, cutting supply access to McArthur River mine and Key Lake mill. Cameco temporarily halted Key Lake milling and reduced McArthur River mining activity. Long-term guidance unchanged; near-term production impact being assessed.

CCJ.title: White House NSTM-3 Mandates Space Nuclear by 2028; Uranium Spot Price $86.55/lb (+24% TTM); Nuclear Demand Momentum Builds
CCJ.content: White House National Science and Technology Memorandum 3 (April 14) mandates space-based nuclear deployment by 2028 and lunar reactor by 2030 — a new demand driver for uranium. Uranium spot price: $86.55/lb (+24% trailing 12 months). Cameco board chair cited building momentum in government, industry, and public support for nuclear energy at annual meeting.

CCJ.title: Cameco Operational Update: Flooding Collapses Smoothstone River Bridge on Route to McArthur River/Key Lake Sites
CCJ.content: Flooding in northern Saskatchewan caused collapse of Smoothstone River Bridge—primary supply route to McArthur River and Key Lake sites. Cameco Q1 2026: adjusted net earnings $203M, operations consistent with annual expectations.

CCJ.title: Uranium Above $86.5/lb Near 2-Month High; Meta 7.8GW and Microsoft Nuclear SMR Deals Drive Long-Term Demand; CCJ Consensus Target $130
CCJ.content: Uranium futures rose above $86.5/lb near 2-month high on May 28 on recovering risk sentiment and structural nuclear demand from AI data centers. Catalysts: Meta signed agreements for up to 7.8GW nuclear capacity; Microsoft pursuing nuclear reactor restarts. US govt backed Westinghouse reactor development with Cameco support. CCJ at $107.53, analyst consensus Buy with 12-month target $130.04 (+17.5% upside).

CCJ.title: Cameco and Orano Acquire TEPCO's 5% Cigar Lake Stake; Cameco Ownership Rises to 57.4%; Uranium Supply Consolidates Among Western Producers
CCJ.content: Cameco and Orano Canada reached an agreement to acquire TEPCO's 5% participating interest in the Cigar Lake Joint Venture, increasing Cameco's ownership stake to 57.418%. Cigar Lake is one of the world's highest-grade uranium mines. The deal consolidates supply ownership among Western producers as AI data center nuclear demand drives a long-term uranium demand upcycle.

CCJ.title: Urenco USA Plans Multi-Billion-Dollar Enrichment Expansion (+2.1M SWU by 2032); Uranium Stocks Rally
CCJ.content: Cameco (CCJ) and Energy Fuels surged on June 3 after Urenco USA announced a multi-billion-dollar expansion adding 2.1 million SWU of enrichment capacity at its New Mexico facility, expected online 2032. Strengthens global nuclear fuel supply chain for reactor builds driven by AI data center electricity demand. Cameco also signed .6B India uranium supply deal in 2026 H1.

CCJ.title: Cameco Raises Cigar Lake Stake via $115.75M TEPCO Resources Acquisition
CCJ.content: Cameco and Orano Canada agreed to acquire TEPCO Resources Inc.'s 5% participating interest in Cigar Lake Joint Venture for ~$115.75M. Cameco's ownership rises by 2.871pp to 57.418% upon closing (expected Q3 2026).

CCJ.title: Cameco Increases Cigar Lake Ownership to 57.4% via TEPCO Resources Stake Acquisition
CCJ.content: Cameco and Orano Canada agreed to acquire TEPCO Resources' 5% interest in the Cigar Lake Joint Venture. Cameco's stake rises to 57.418%, strengthening control of one of the world's highest-grade uranium mines.

CCJ.title: Cameco Raises Cigar Lake Mine Stake for $115.75M to Extend Long-Term Uranium Production Capacity
CCJ.content: Cameco increased its ownership stake in the Cigar Lake uranium mine in a $115.75M deal, extending the company's long-term production capacity. Nuclear power demand for AI data centers and energy transition continues to drive uranium prices higher.

CCJ.title: Nuclear Capital Flows Accelerate: Cameco Leads on AI Hyperscaler Nuclear Offtake Agreements; Uranium at $91.50/lb
CCJ.content: Cameco and uranium peers attracting institutional capital flows driven by AI hyperscaler nuclear offtake agreements (Meta up to 6.6 GWe), 38-country pledge to triple nuclear capacity by 2050, and uranium spot at $91.50/lb. Cameco maintains 2026 guidance $3.13-3.37B revenue, 29-32M lbs at $85-89/lb.

CCJ.title: Canada Launches First-Ever National Nuclear Energy Strategy, Targets 10 New Reactors and Doubled Uranium Exports by 2035
CCJ.content: Canada's Energy Minister unveiled the country's first national Nuclear Energy Strategy on June 22, targeting up to 10 new reactors built by 2040, two large-scale reactors under construction by 2035, and a doubling of uranium exports by 2035 — a direct demand catalyst for Cameco (CCJ) as Canada's dominant uranium miner supplying ~24% of global output.

CCJ.title: DOE Announces $17.5B in Conditional Loans for 10 AP1000 Nuclear Reactors; Cameco-Backed Westinghouse is Sole Qualified Supplier
CCJ.content: The U.S. DOE announced $17.5B in conditional loans for five projects (two AP1000 reactors each), directly benefiting Cameco which owns 49% of Westinghouse — the sole licensed AP1000 supplier. CEO Tim Gitzel highlighted significant growth opportunities for Westinghouse's energy systems segment during procurement and construction phases.

CCJ.title: Cameco Files 6-K with SEC Formally Welcoming DOE $17.5B AP1000 Nuclear Supply Chain Loan Package
CCJ.content: Cameco filed a Form 6-K formally welcoming the DOE's $17.5B conditional loan announcement for the American Nuclear Supply Chain, with CEO Tim Gitzel outlining expected growth in Westinghouse's energy systems segment and positioning the company as the primary uranium and fuel services beneficiary.

CCJ.title: NRC Proposes Sweeping Modernization of Nuclear Fuel Cycle Licensing Under ADVANCE Act; Comments Due August 10
CCJ.content: The NRC announced proposed rulemaking to modernize fuel cycle and materials licensing requirements, accelerating construction timelines for uranium fuel cycle facilities and streamlining licensing of plutonium processing and fuel fabrication plants in response to the ADVANCE Act of 2024.

CCJ.title: RBC Capital Raises Cameco Price Target to Cdn$175 Citing Uranium Strength, DOE Support, and AP1000 Rollout
CCJ.content: RBC Capital Markets analyst Andrew Wong raised Cameco's price target from Cdn$160 to Cdn$175, maintaining Outperform, citing strengthening uranium prices, strong sovereign buyer interest, and the DOE's $17.5B AP1000 loan commitment as positive catalysts for Cameco's Westinghouse partnership.

CCJ.title: Cameco Completes Acquisition of TEPCO's 5% Cigar Lake Stake; Ownership Rises to 57.4%
CCJ.content: Cameco completed its acquisition of TEPCO Resources' 5% participating interest in the Cigar Lake Joint Venture, increasing Cameco's total ownership stake to 57.418% in one of the world's highest-grade uranium mines, strengthening the company's long-term uranium production control.

CCJ.title: Cameco Temporarily Suspends Cigar Lake Mining Due to Orano McClean Lake Sulfuric Acid Plant Issues
CCJ.content: Cameco temporarily suspended mining operations at its Cigar Lake uranium mine following operational challenges at Orano Canada's McClean Lake mill sulfuric acid plant. Milling operations are expected to resume within approximately two weeks, with no material impact to full-year uranium production guidance.

CCJ.title: Cameco Valuation Analysis After Mine Disruption: Buy, Hold or Sell?
CCJ.content: Post-disruption valuation review of Cameco (CCJ). The uranium major trades at a premium multiple that reflects long-term nuclear power demand tailwinds, a 9-year India supply agreement (~22M lbs U3O8, ~$2.6B, deliveries 2027–2035), and the now-higher 57.418% Cigar Lake ownership stake. Question is whether premium valuation is justified given near-term production risk.

CCJ.title: Cameco Q2 2026 Preview: Cigar Lake Suspension Impact, India $2.6B Uranium Deal, Spot Near $85/lb
CCJ.content: Seeking Alpha Q2 2026 earnings preview for Cameco (CCJ) ahead of July 31 results. Key focus: Cigar Lake mine suspended July 1 (McClean Lake acid plant failure), resumed July 14; 2026 guidance of 17.5–18.0M lbs U3O8 maintained. Cigar Lake ownership now 57.418% after TEPCO Resources JV acquisition. $2.6B India uranium supply deal (22M lbs over 9 years, 2027–2035). Uranium spot near $85/lb.

CCJ.title: Uranium Stocks Rally on US-Saudi Nuclear Deal; Cameco Flagged as Top Buy Ahead of July 31 Q2 Earnings
CCJ.content: Cameco was highlighted as a top uranium buy following the US-Saudi 30-year nuclear cooperation agreement and with a potential Section 232 uranium import decision imminent. CCJ Q2 earnings are due July 31.

CCJ.title: UBS Upgrades Cameco to Buy from Neutral, Sets C$166 Target on Strengthening Uranium Bull Case
CCJ.content: UBS upgraded Cameco (CCJ) from Neutral to Buy with C$166 price target, citing record long-term uranium contract prices, accelerating utility contracting, nuclear demand growth above 3.5% annually, and undervalued Westinghouse stake. Follows 18% stock decline. Q2 earnings due July 31.

CCJ.title: Cameco Q2 2026 Earnings Preview: EPS Expected -49% YoY; UBS Upgrades to Buy Ahead of July 31 Report
CCJ.content: Cameco expected to report Q2 2026 EPS of $0.26 (-49% YoY) and lower revenues on July 31, reflecting softer uranium delivery volumes. UBS upgraded CCJ to Buy citing favorable long-term uranium market outlook. Full-year 2026 guidance remains 29-32M lbs at $85-89/lb realized price.

CCJ.title: Cameco Q2 2026 Earnings Released July 31; Uranium Demand Tailwinds Despite Expected YoY Earnings Decline
CCJ.content: Cameco released Q2 2026 results before markets open July 31. Consensus: revenue $534-584M, EPS ~$0.26-0.27 (down YoY due to lower deliveries vs strong Q2 2025 base). McArthur River mine briefly suspended May 2026 due to Saskatchewan flooding but restored quickly; 2026 production guidance 19.5-21.5M lbs maintained. Cameco raised its Cigar Lake JV stake to 57.418% in July. Nuclear demand from AI data centers is key long-term tailwind.

SMH.title: Semiconductor Sector Buoyed by AMD-Rackspace Deal, COHR CHIPS Act Funding, and AWS Summit AI Announcements
SMH.content: During June 17-18 semiconductor sector sustained momentum from concurrent catalysts: AMD's 30MW Rackspace deal, Coherent's $50M CHIPS Act grant, AWS Summit AI infrastructure announcements, and Astera Labs' Nasdaq-100 inclusion ahead of June 22 rebalancing. SMH AUM now $72B, up 72% YTD.

SMH.title: AMAT-TSMC $5B EPIC Center Partnership Signals Sustained Semiconductor Equipment Capex Supercycle
SMH.content: AMAT-TSMC EPIC Center partnership confirms sustained equipment capex. SMH portfolio companies — NVDA, TSM, AVGO, AMD, AMAT, KLAC, ASML — all benefit from AI infrastructure buildout. KLAC +2.89%, AMAT higher on announcement.

SMH.title: Semiconductor Sector Rotation: Intel (+200% YTD), AMD (+14% Post-Earnings) Lead; SMH Broadens AI Exposure
SMH.content: Semiconductor sector broadening AI rally beyond NVDA. Intel >200% YTD, AMD +14% post-Q1, Micron +700% TTM. Wall Street diversifying AI chip exposure across SMH's holdings — INTC, AMD, MU now among top performers in 2026.

SMH.title: Semiconductor ETFs SMH and SOXX Log Best Month Ever in April 2026; SMH +45% YTD as AI Chip Earnings Accelerate
SMH.content: VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) and iShares SOXX logged their best monthly performance on record in April 2026, driven by AMD Q1 blowout (+14%), Intel 18A Apple deal (+13%), and continued Micron HBM supercycle narrative. SMH +45% YTD; SOXX +60% YTD. Broadband AI chipmaker earnings driving sector-wide multiple expansion across SMH's top holdings.

SMH.title: US-China Trade Truce: Tariffs Cut Sharply; H200 AI Chip Sales Cleared to Chinese Firms; Semiconductor Sector Broadly Rallies
SMH.content: US-China trade truce (May 12) cut US tariffs from 145% to 30% and Chinese tariffs from 125% to 10%. At Trump-Xi Beijing summit May 14-15, Washington cleared H200 AI GPU sales to ~10 major Chinese tech firms (Alibaba, Tencent). Blackwell controls not lifted. Semiconductor sector rallied broadly: NVDA +4.5%, TSM +5%, ANET +4.5%. Chip export controls and rare earth restrictions remain under negotiation.

SMH.title: SMH Semiconductor ETF: AI Capex Cycle Drives Record Holdings — NVDA Q1 FY2027 Earnings Catalyst May 20
SMH.content: SMH top holding NVDA (25%+ weight) reports Q1 FY2027 earnings May 20 ($79.2B revenue expected). AI hyperscaler capex raised to $725B combined. SMH tracks NVDA, TSM, AVGO, AMD, ASML — all reporting strong AI demand. AMD +38% Q1 YoY, TSM +35% Q1 YoY.

SMH.title: SMH Hits $618 High as AI-Driven Semiconductor ETF Inflows Surge; +120% Over Past Year
SMH.content: VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) reached $618.24 intraday high on May 27; strong AI-driven inflows into semiconductor equities. SMH returned over 120% in the past year driven by NVDA, TSM, AVGO and AMD. Consensus 2026 EPS growth forecast >100% for underlying holdings.

SMH.title: VanEck Semiconductor ETF Declines on Broad Chip Selloff: AVGO -13%, QCOM -9.5%, LRCX -7.5%, AMAT -7.3%, KLAC -6.15%, NVDA -2-3%
SMH.content: SMH fell on June 5 as major AI semiconductor holdings sold off: AVGO down 13-15% post-earnings (Hock Tan didn't raise $100B AI target), QCOM -9.52% (NVIDIA PC chip threat), LRCX -7.5% and AMAT -7.3% (China WFE export fears), KLAC -6.15%, NVDA -2-3% (Senate hearing + insider selling). Underlying AI demand remains robust: hyperscaler combined CapEx $725B in 2026, up 77% YoY.

SMH.title: Semiconductor Shorts Pile On as Winning Trade Reverses — SMH Off >10% From Record High; YTD Still +64%
SMH.content: VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) fell >10% from its recent record high by June 9 as short interest built; YTD return +64.11%. Semiconductor short sellers emerged as sector-wide selling driven by geopolitical and valuation concerns; SOXX YTD +86.78%.

SMH.title: South Korea KOSPI Semiconductor Selloff Triggers Circuit Breaker; KOSPI Had Surged 90%+ YTD on AI Demand
SMH.content: KOSPI plunged ~8.8% triggering a 20-minute trading halt — third such halt in 2026. SK Hynix (+263% YTD) and Samsung (+191% YTD) led the selloff. Drivers: stronger-than-expected US jobs report and sector-wide semiconductor profit-taking. Weighs on SMH constituents.

SMH.title: Semiconductor Sector Rebounds: PHLX Up 6.7% MTD Through June 12 Led by MU +9%, INTC +8.5% on AI Catalysts
SMH.content: The PHLX Semiconductor Index recovered sharply after the June 5 selloff (-10%, worst since March 2020, wiping $1.3T). Month-to-date through June 12 the index is up 6.7%, led by Micron (+9% on HBM4 Vera Rubin news), Intel (+8.5% on Google 3M chip deal), AMD, NVDA, and AVGO.

SMH.title: VanEck Semiconductor ETF SMH Up 72% YTD Near $644; Global Semiconductor Sales Projected at $975B in 2026
SMH.content: SMH surged near $644 on June 15, up 72% YTD. Deloitte projects global semiconductor industry reaching $975B in 2026. AI infrastructure buildout driving broad demand across memory, processors, and networking.

SMH.title: Global Semiconductor Rout: SOXX ETF Falls 7.88%, ARM Drops 10% as South Korea KOSPI Crash Spreads to Chip Sector
SMH.content: The SOXX semiconductor ETF fell 7.88% on June 23, erasing an estimated $1.4 trillion in AI chip market cap, as South Korea's KOSPI meltdown (circuit breaker triggered) spread through global chip names. ARM Holdings dropped 10.1%, Nasdaq fell 2.21%, S&P 500 shed 1.44%.

SMH.title: Samsung Foundry Wins Nvidia, Tesla, and Qualcomm Orders as TSMC Advanced-Node Capacity Below 3nm Fills Up
SMH.content: Samsung Foundry secured or is negotiating chip manufacturing orders from Nvidia, Tesla, Qualcomm, Google, AMD, and BYD on sub-5nm nodes as TSMC's 2nm-and-below capacity has been pre-booked by Apple and Nvidia, with Samsung co-CEO meeting Jensen Huang in Seoul to reinforce foundry cooperation.

SMH.title: SMH Attracts Near-Record $6.9B in Single-Day Net Flows on AI Chip Fervor
SMH.content: VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) nearly broke $7B in single-day net inflows driven by broad semiconductor demand. 1-month net flows stand at +$2.03B and 6-month net flows at +$6.36B. SMH was trading at $558.25 on July 20, up 55% YTD and total net assets of $67.52B.

SMH.title: NVIDIA Export Curbs Hit ~$8B in Q2 Sales; Trade War Overhang Persists for SMH
SMH.content: US government export controls blocking NVIDIA's H20 AI chip shipments to China are estimated to cost NVIDIA ~$8B in Q2 revenues. With NVIDIA as SMH's largest holding, ongoing trade policy uncertainty around advanced chip exports remains a key risk factor. Washington is also weighing semiconductor-specific tariffs to incentivize US-based fabrication.

SMH.title: SMH Holds Near $558 After TSMC Q2 Record: Revenue $39.6B, Net Income Up 77%, 30%+ FY Guidance
SMH.content: TSMC reported record Q2 2026 earnings on July 16 with revenue of ~$39.6B and net income surging 77% YoY, guiding for 30%+ full-year USD revenue growth underpinned by AI infrastructure investment. SMH, which holds TSMC as a top position, bounced back from early-July volatility as the results validated AI chip demand. SMH was at $558.25 on July 20, up 55% YTD.

SMH.title: Intel Rises 3% on Q2 Beat and Upbeat Q3 Guidance; Chip Sector ETF SMH Holds Flat
SMH.content: Intel gained 3% on July 24 after its earnings beat and Q3 revenue guidance of $16.3B, but the broader SMH semiconductor ETF stayed flat as traders viewed Intel's results as a single-name event rather than a broader sector catalyst ahead of more chip earnings the following week.

SMH.title: Jim Cramer Warns the Semiconductor Selloff Has 'Monstrous' Sellers Behind It; SMH Falls 4.06%
SMH.content: SMH fell 4.06% on July 27, extending its one-month decline to 9.33%. Jim Cramer flagged an intraday reversal driven by 'monstrous, motivated and often margined' sellers ahead of major chip earnings (LRCX and ARM both due July 29). NVIDIA -4.92%, AMD -8.31%, Intel -3.54% on the same session.

SMH.title: Semiconductor ETF SMH Falls 4%+ in 4th Consecutive Declining Session; Sector Posts Longest Losing Streak of 2026
SMH.content: Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) fell for 4th straight session July 28 — the longest losing streak of 2026 — with SMH ETF declining 4%+. Two key catalysts: NVDA's $750B circular AI financing controversy and a report that a Chinese state-backed firm began mass-producing DUV immersion lithography tools. Semiconductor sector lost over $1 trillion in market cap.

SMH.title: Chip ETF SMH Attempts Recovery to $512-$544 After Microsoft Azure Catalyst; Down ~18% in July
SMH.content: SMH traded $512.80-$544.61 on July 30, recovering from ~$504 close on July 29. ETF down ~18% in July and ~25% from 52-week high despite +39.87% YTD return. Top holdings: Nvidia 21.7%, TSMC 9.51%, Broadcom 6.74%. AI capex sustainability concerns and China AI competition cited as headwinds for the July correction.

XLU.title: AI Data Center Electrification Requires $1.4 Trillion by 2030; Nuclear and Gas Utilities Re-Rating Continues
XLU.content: Industry analysis projects $1.4T in AI data center electrification capex by 2030. XLU holdings Constellation Energy (CEG), NextEra Energy (NEE) and Duke Energy are key beneficiaries. CEG Q1 EPS beat, GE Vernova $2.4B Q1 data center orders reinforce structural power demand shift.

XLU.title: White House Defense Production Act: U.S. Power Grid as National Security — XLU Holdings CEG and NEE to Benefit from Federal Procurement
XLU.content: White House Defense Production Act invocation (April 20) adds federal backing to U.S. power grid expansion. XLU's top holdings — Constellation Energy (CEG, nuclear) and NextEra Energy (NEE, renewables/gas) — benefit from streamlined regulatory approvals and accelerated grid procurement. Combined with $1.4T projected AI data center electrification by 2030, structural tailwind for utilities sector is strengthening beyond historical rate-base growth.

XLU.title: US Utilities ETF XLU: AI Power Demand Thesis Strengthening as CEG, VST Reaffirm Guidance
XLU.content: XLU utilities ETF benefits as major holdings CEG and VST reaffirm strong guidance. Nuclear power + natural gas generation combination most attractive for AI data center PPAs. Constellation Energy Crane restart awaiting NRC approval; Vistra upgraded to investment grade.

XLU.title: US Utilities Plan $1.4T in AI Data Center Power Investment — 27% Capex Surge
XLU.content: Updated 2026 analysis shows US utilities plan $1.4T in spending through 2030 to meet AI data center power demand, a 27% jump from $1.1T projected in 2025. AI data centers consume 4% of US electricity today and are projected to hit 9% by 2030. Duke Energy leads with a $102.2B commitment; Southern Company pledged $81.2B. Both are top XLU holdings, underpinning the sector's growth re-rating.

XLU.title: NextEra Energy's $66.8B Dominion Acquisition Reshaping XLU Sector Composition
XLU.content: NextEra Energy's pending $66.8B acquisition of Dominion Energy (announced May 2026) is the largest utility deal in years, driven by AI data center cluster power demand concentrated in Virginia. Both companies are significant XLU holdings; the pending merger is actively reshaping the ETF's exposure profile and pushing the sector's valuation higher as AI-linked power demand transforms utilities from defensive to growth holdings.

XLU.title: XLU Holds Above All Key Moving Averages at $45.41 as Defensive-Growth Rotation Continues
XLU.content: XLU is trading at $45.41, above its 20-day EMA, 50-day SMA, and 200-day SMA with a neutral RSI of 55.8 — signaling stable upward momentum. A 2.63% dividend yield continues to attract defensive allocations, while AI-driven power demand growth is drawing fresh growth capital into the sector.

XLU.title: NextEra Energy Q2 2026 Adjusted EPS Beats at $1.15; Renewable Backlog Hits Record 35.1 GW
XLU.content: NextEra Energy (NEE), XLU's largest holding at ~13%, beat Q2 adjusted EPS ($1.15 vs $1.09 est, +9.5% YoY) and reaffirmed 2026 EPS guidance of $3.92-$4.02. Record renewables and storage origination added 3.6 GW to backlog in the quarter, with AI data center electricity demand cited as the primary growth driver.

XLU.title: XLU Trades Near $45 as AI Data Center Power Demand Drives Utility Sector Thesis; GuruFocus Flags 8.6% Overvaluation
XLU.content: XLU traded $44.74-$45.80 on July 29, up 7.53% YTD. GuruFocus flags XLU at 8.6% above GF Value. AI data centers projected to add ~125 GW of U.S. electric load by 2030. Key holdings Constellation Energy and Vistra have signed multi-year hyperscaler supply agreements; NextEra Energy is largest holding at 13.59%.

COPX.title: COPX Near 52-Week High as US Copper Tariff Decision Looms; ETF Returned 93% in 2025
COPX.content: COPX traded at ~$89.79 on June 16, near its 52-week high, amid focus on the pending US copper tariff decision. Tariff implementation could sustain US price premiums and benefit domestically-exposed miners. ETF returned 93% in 2025 and drew $2B in inflows in January 2026 alone.

COPX.title: Copper Supercycle Accelerates: AI Data Centers, EV, and Grid Upgrade Drive Demand; COPX Up ~154% TTM
COPX.content: S&P Global projects copper demand to roughly double through 2040 (+2.9% CAGR). Data center electrification is a major new demand driver per Freeport-McMoRan CEO. Supply side constrained by scarce discoveries and decade-long permitting. Tariff uncertainty peaked in 2025 with declining risk in 2026.

COPX.title: COPX Copper Miners ETF: Data Center + Grid Upgrade + EV Triple Demand Underpins Copper Super-Cycle
COPX.content: COPX copper miners ETF benefits from AI data center copper wiring demand (each 1MW GPU cluster requires ~30 tons copper), US grid modernization, and global EV adoption. WFE expansion and AI buildout driving multi-year copper demand tailwind.

COPX.title: Trump Signs Section 232 Tariff Update on Copper; Commerce Secretary to Recommend Refined Copper Tariff by June 30
COPX.content: Trump signed updated Section 232 proclamation on June 1 (effective June 8). Commerce Secretary has until June 30 to recommend refined copper tariff (expected ≥25%). Goldman raised year-end 2026 copper price forecast to $13,735/tonne.

COPX.title: China Adds MP Materials and USA Rare Earth to Export Control List in Retaliation for US Military Companies Designation
COPX.content: China's Ministry of Commerce added 10 US companies to its export control list including MP Materials and USA Rare Earth, barring Chinese exporters from supplying dual-use items to these firms — targeting the very companies the US government has funded to reduce reliance on Chinese critical minerals.

COPX.title: Vedanta's CopperTech Metals Launches NYSE IPO Targeting $3.6B Valuation, Highlighting AI Infrastructure Copper Demand
COPX.content: CopperTech Metals (Vedanta subsidiary operating Konkola Copper Mines in Zambia) launched a US IPO targeting a $3.57B valuation and up to $423.5M raise at $16–$18/share on NYSE (ticker: CUX), highlighting surging investor demand for copper exposure driven by AI infrastructure, grid modernization, and electrification.

COPX.title: US Copper Tariff Section 232 Report Due June 30 — COMEX Inventories Hit Record 650,000 Tons Ahead of Decision
COPX.content: The Commerce Secretary was required to deliver a Section 232 copper tariff report to the White House by June 30, 2026. The report will inform potential phased import duties of 15% (starting Jan 1, 2027) and 30% (starting Jan 1, 2028). COMEX copper inventories hit a record ~650,000 tons as importers front-ran tariffs, while LME copper closed at $13,371/tonne on June 24.

COPX.title: Copper Surges to $6.50/lb (+3.25%) on July 21 as China Demand Premium Hits 12-Month High
COPX.content: Copper jumped to $6.50/lb on July 21 (+3.25% in a single session). China's premium for imported copper rose to $100/tonne — the highest since May 2025 — as Beijing's crackdown on VAT fraud restricted scrap availability and boosted refined copper import demand. COPX traded at $73.86 (52-week range: $41.94–$99.99); 1-month return remains -14.19% reflecting prior tariff shock.

COPX.title: US Tariff Framework Exempts Refined Copper Through 2026; Phased Tariffs Deferred to 2027
COPX.content: The US tariff framework finalized June 30, 2026 temporarily exempted refined copper imports, with phased tariffs on copper now deferred to 2027. This reduced near-term cost pressure on copper miners held in COPX, though the initial tariff scare caused COPX to drop sharply (1-month return -14.19%). Supply is structurally tight; major research houses expect the copper market to remain constrained into year-end.

COPX.title: Mining Stocks Recovering After Trump's 50% Copper Tariff Threat Softened by June 30 Framework
COPX.content: Following President Trump's July 8 suggestion of a 50% tariff on copper, COPX holdings sold off sharply. However, the final June 30 executive framework deferred copper-specific tariffs to 2027, triggering a partial recovery. Electrification, EV, and grid investment remain the long-term structural demand thesis for copper miners.

COPX.title: Copper Wavers Near $14,000/Tonne as Traders Await Overdue Trump Section 232 Tariff Decision
COPX.content: Copper pulled back from near $14,000/tonne as traders awaited a White House decision on Section 232 copper import tariffs — already overdue from a June 30 DoC recommendation deadline. A potential phased universal duty (15% in 2027, rising to 30% in 2028) on copper could trigger further stockpiling. Goldman Sachs projects copper could breach $14,000/t once tariffs are finalized.

COPX.title: Shanghai Copper Hits 7-Week High on Supply Worries and Strong China Demand
COPX.content: Shanghai copper prices climbed to a 7-week high amid mounting supply concerns and robust Chinese demand, with LME import premiums reaching $115/t — their highest since 2023. Tight global copper supply and pre-tariff US stockpiling continue to support copper miner valuations across COPX holdings.

COPX.title: Copper Wrap: China, Chile and the Miners — Monday July 27, 2026
COPX.content: Copper market wrap covering Chinese demand signals, Chilean supply updates, and major miner stock moves. COPX was trading around $77.72. Freeport-McMoRan had reported strong Q2 2026 results (July 23) with net income up 65% H1 YoY; Grasberg mine doubled daily output to 69,000 tons.

COPX.title: Copper Surges 2.9% to $6.49/lb Near Record Highs on Tightening LME Supply; COPX Attracts $1.7B 2026 Inflows
COPX.content: Copper jumped 2.9% to $6.4930/lb on LME inventory drawdowns and China import premiums at highest since 2022. COPX traded at $76.14. Fund attracted ~$1.7B net inflows in 2026, pushing AUM to ~$7.5B. AI data center electrification and EV demand driving structural copper demand.

XME.title: Metals & Mining 2026: Tariff Relief Supports Outlook; AI Infrastructure Driving Copper, Steel, Aluminum Demand
XME.content: BMI Research: tariff uncertainty peaked in 2025 and declining in 2026 improves metals investment climate. XME trading $120.95 as of May 8. AI infrastructure buildout driving structural copper, aluminum, and steel demand; less cross-border trade risk encourages mining capex.

XME.title: XME Metals & Mining ETF: AI Infrastructure Steel/Copper/Aluminum Demand Supports Diversified Commodity Basket
XME.content: XME metals/mining ETF: AI data center buildout drives demand for steel (structure), copper (wiring/cooling), and aluminum (heat sinks). Grid upgrade cycle adds transmission-grade metal demand. Tariffs add complexity but domestic production benefits.

XME.title: Trump Section 232 Tariff Update Covers Steel, Aluminum, and Copper Products Effective June 8
XME.content: New proclamation effective June 8 adjusts Section 232 metals tariff thresholds: products with ≤15% steel/aluminum/copper content now exempt. Impacts XME holdings across steel and metals mining sector.

XME.title: Trump Updates Section 232 Tariffs on Steel, Aluminum, and Copper Through 2027 — Domestic Steel Prices Remain Near $1,109/Ton
XME.content: President Trump's June 2026 Section 232 proclamation adjusted tariff rates for derivative steel and aluminum products, reducing rates for agricultural equipment combines to 15% and extending lower rates to equipment from trade-deal partners. Domestic hot-rolled coil steel prices remain near $1,109/ton, supporting XME holdings such as Nucor and Steel Dynamics.

XME.title: Trump Declines to Extend USMCA in Current Form, Creating Uncertainty for North American Metals Trade
XME.content: During the scheduled July 2026 USMCA review, the Trump Administration declined to extend the agreement in its current form, introducing uncertainty for cross-border steel and aluminum trade flows from Canada and Mexico. XME holdings with North American supply chains face potential renegotiation risk, while domestic US producers may benefit from further import restrictions.

XME.title: Alcoa Acquires South32 Bauxite and Aluminum Assets in $5.6B Deal, Reshaping XME Composition
XME.content: Alcoa agreed to acquire South32's bauxite, alumina, and aluminum assets in a deal valued up to $5.6B, citing improved scale and cost reduction. Alcoa is a significant XME holding; the consolidation move comes as the 50% Section 232 aluminum tariffs create a favorable domestic pricing environment. XME fell from $103.20 to $98.99 (-4.08%) on July 16 before stabilizing.

XME.title: US Section 232 Copper Smelt/Cast Reporting Requirement Takes Effect July 30
XME.content: New mandatory copper smelt and cast country-of-origin reporting under Section 232 takes effect July 30, 2026. Existing 50% tariff on semi-finished copper and June 8 modifications remain in force. Goldman Sachs projects copper could breach $14,000/tonne post-tariff implementation.

EWY.title: South Korea ETF EWY Up 112% YTD Through June 16, Best Single-Country ETF on AI Memory Boom
EWY.content: iShares MSCI South Korea ETF (EWY) up 112% YTD through June 16, best of any single-country ETF — 11x the S&P 500. SK Hynix (+267% YTD) and Samsung (+187% YTD) together make up ~46% of EWY, driven by surging demand for HBM used in Nvidia AI accelerators. NAV $204.81.

EWY.title: Foreign Capital Flows to Korean Chipmakers; EWY Up 87% YTD as SK Hynix and Samsung Dominate HBM Market
EWY.content: EWY up 87% YTD driven by SK Hynix (25.4% weight, primary HBM supplier to NVIDIA) and Samsung (24% weight). Foreign capital exiting broad KOSPI ETFs into targeted memory chip names. HBM now >30% of total DRAM revenue globally.

EWY.title: Samsung Electronics Unveils Next-Gen HBM4 Memory Targeting AI Accelerators; EWY Becomes AI Memory Proxy
EWY.content: Samsung unveiled HBM4 memory targeting AI accelerators to compete with SK Hynix's dominance. SK Hynix remains primary HBM3E supplier to NVIDIA. EWY has become a direct proxy for AI memory supercycle, with HBM and server DRAM driving earnings for both top holdings.

EWY.title: Samsung Worker Strike Threat Tightens HBM Supply Outlook; EWY Top Holdings Face Dual AI Memory Risk
EWY.content: A threatened Samsung Electronics worker strike raised HBM supply disruption fears, adding risk to EWY top holdings (SK Hynix 25.4%, Samsung 24%). Micron gained 7.2% on May 12 on alternative supply narrative. EWY is up 87% YTD on AI memory supercycle; Samsung HBM4 competes with SK Hynix HBM3E for NVIDIA orders. Labor action risk is a key variable for HBM supply chain stability heading into H2 2026 ramp.

EWY.title: EWY Korea ETF: SK Hynix HBM AI Memory Dominance Drives Korean Tech Outperformance in 2026
EWY.content: EWY's top holding SK Hynix remains dominant in HBM3E supply to NVDA Blackwell systems. Samsung Electronics also shipping HBM4 prototype samples. Korean semiconductor sector benefits from AI memory super-cycle; EWY up sharply alongside US semiconductor peers.

EWY.title: EWY +109% YTD as SK Hynix-Samsung Market Cap Gap Narrows to 6.8%; South Korea Launches 2x Leveraged Samsung/Hynix ETFs; Korea Up ~96% in 2026
EWY.content: EWY +109% YTD through May 28 (top holdings: SK Hynix 28%, Samsung 24%). SK Hynix market cap now within 6.8% of Samsung—driven by HBM3E AI memory dominance—vs less than half Samsung's a year ago. South Korea launched first 2x leveraged single-stock ETFs for Samsung and SK Hynix on May 29, drawing 2 trillion won in 45 minutes. Korean equity market up ~96% in 2026, dominated by HBM/AI chip rally.

EWY.title: Korea ETF (EWY) Benefits from SK Hynix HBM Leadership; SK Hynix Places >$7B Multi-Year EUV Order with ASML for HBM Expansion
EWY.content: iShares MSCI Korea ETF (EWY) is underpinned by SK Hynix's dominant global HBM position. SK Hynix placed a multi-year EUV order exceeding $7B with ASML to expand HBM memory capacity for AI customers. Combined with Samsung's memory and foundry operations, Korean chipmakers are critical AI supply chain nodes driving EWY performance. SK Hynix is the primary HBM3E and HBM4 supplier for NVIDIA.

EWY.title: iShares MSCI South Korea ETF Falls 14% — Worst Session Since March 2020 — After Broadcom AI Revenue Miss
EWY.content: EWY fell 14% on June 6, its worst session since March 2020, after Broadcom guided Q3 AI chip sales at $16B vs. $17.2B whisper. Samsung Electronics fell 6.4% and SK Hynix dropped 9.9% in Seoul; foreign investors pulled ~$1.21B from Korean equities.

EWY.title: KOSPI Circuit Breaker Triggered as South Korean AI/Semiconductor Rally Reverses; EWY NAV Down ~5.1% in One Day
EWY.content: KOSPI, which had surged >90% YTD driven by SK Hynix and Samsung on HBM/AI chip demand, fell ~8.8% on June 10, triggering a 20-minute circuit breaker. EWY NAV fell ~$9.57 (-5.11%) on the day.

EWY.title: SK Hynix Overtakes Samsung to Become South Korea's Most Valuable Company for First Time in 25 Years on HBM Dominance
EWY.content: SK Hynix surged past Samsung Electronics on June 22 to claim the top KOSPI spot by market cap for the first time in 25 years, reaching 2,080.4 trillion won ($1.35 trillion) on a 340%+ year-to-date rally driven by HBM chip dominance for AI customers including Nvidia and Google.

EWY.title: MSCI Denies South Korea Developed Market Status for 12th Time; KOSPI Crashes ~10% with Circuit Breaker Triggered
EWY.content: MSCI's 2026 Annual Market Classification Review again excluded South Korea from Developed Markets, triggering a ~10% KOSPI crash with a circuit-breaker halt as Samsung and SK Hynix each plunged 12%+, driven by inadequate Korean won offshore trading access and short-selling oversight gaps cited by MSCI.

EWY.title: South Korea Government in Active Talks with Samsung and SK Hynix on Second Semiconductor Cluster, Accelerated Fab Timeline
EWY.content: South Korea's presidential policy adviser confirmed discussions with Samsung and SK Hynix about a new chip cluster with AI-driven fab construction timelines potentially accelerated to 2034–2035. KOSPI rebounded 3.26% with Samsung surging 9.11% and SK Hynix gaining 2.74%.

EWY.title: South Korea Unveils $576 Billion National Semiconductor and AI Investment Drive Led by Samsung and SK Hynix
EWY.content: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung announced a $576 billion (800 trillion won) national semiconductor and AI investment strategy on June 29. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix will each build two new fabs in South Korea. An additional 81 trillion won is earmarked for a chip packaging cluster. Despite the announcement, Samsung fell ~4.8% and SK Hynix fell ~1.6% on fears of potential supply glut.

EWY.title: SK Hynix Set to Debut on Nasdaq via American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) on July 10, 2026
EWY.content: SK Hynix, which holds ~58% global HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) market share, is set to debut on Nasdaq via American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) on July 10, 2026. The move is designed to capitalize on surging AI-driven HBM demand and broaden SK Hynix's US investor base. EWY holds SK Hynix as its top position at approximately 23-30% of assets.

EWY.title: SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR Debuts +14% on July 10; EWY South Korea ETF Gains as Samsung and SK Hynix Drive Korea AI Semiconductor Wave
EWY.content: SK Hynix listed on Nasdaq as ADR on July 10, +14% on first day; GraniteShares and ProShares launched 2x leveraged ETFs July 14; Korea ETF EWY up 122.9% YTD as Samsung/Hynix dominate HBM supply.

EWY.title: Samsung and SK Hynix Enter 'Super Week': Record Earnings Expected + SK Hynix ADR Listing Tests Kospi Rally
EWY.content: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are entering a critical week (July 21+) with Samsung expected to post record operating profit of 86–90 trillion won and SK Hynix's new US ADR listing generating proxy-buying in EWY. Market consensus calls for Samsung revenue of ~170 trillion won ($111B). SK Hynix reports July 29. EWY (trading at $162.86 on July 21) allocates ~25% to SK Hynix shares.

EWY.title: Samsung and SK Hynix Slump 27% and 33% in July Despite Record Earnings Forecasts; US Hyperscaler Results Eyed as Catalyst
EWY.content: Despite Samsung signaling record chip profits potentially surpassing Nvidia's on a quarterly basis, Samsung shares are down 26.95% and SK Hynix down 33.43% in July — creating a deep disconnect from fundamentals. Brokerages cite upcoming US hyperscaler earnings (Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta, Amazon) due later in July as the key catalyst to rerate Korean chip stocks and EWY.

EWY.title: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix Trade Flat Ahead of US Big Tech Earnings as EWY Proxy Demand Stabilizes
EWY.content: Korean chip equities traded flat on July 21 as investors awaited US big tech earnings expected later in the week. Following consecutive record daily inflows into EWY ($814M then $1.1B on July 15–16 as investors used EWY as a SK Hynix proxy), inflow pace has moderated. EWY's 52-week range spans $70.36 to $220.89, with tech at 48.79% of the portfolio.

EWY.title: SK Hynix Rockets 14% Ahead of July 29 Earnings, Lifting EWY as Korea Equities Up ~96% YTD
EWY.content: SK Hynix, EWY's top holding at ~23% weight, surged 14% on July 21 ahead of its July 29 earnings as the semiconductor sector broadly rebounded. South Korea equities are up ~96% YTD in 2026 driven by AI memory demand.

EWY.title: Section 122 Tariff Expires July 24; Permanent 12.5% Section 301 Replacement Proposed for South Korea
EWY.content: The temporary 10% Section 122 tariff surcharge expired by statute at 12:01 a.m. ET on July 24 after its 150-day statutory limit. A proposed 12.5% Section 301 replacement covering South Korea among 46 countries carries no expiration date or rate cap, representing a potentially permanent and higher levy on Korean semiconductor and electronics exports central to EWY.

EWY.title: South Korea's Semiconductor Boom Risks Flatlining Under US-China Pressure
EWY.content: Analysis warns Korea's chipmakers (Samsung, SK Hynix — top EWY holdings) face structural risk: they need US permits to serve Chinese customers but depend on China for revenue. South Korea's H1 2026 chip exports surged 162% to a record $192.4B, yet US-China decoupling pressure and new Section 301 tariff dynamics (15% cap reaffirmed July 24) threaten that trajectory.

EWY.title: KOSPI Falls Over 1% as US Tech Selloff Spills Into Korean Markets
EWY.content: KOSPI dropped to ~6,620 (-1%+) on July 27 as US technology weakness weighed on sentiment. SK Hynix fell 1.4%, Samsung Electronics -0.7%, Hanwha Aerospace -7.7%, SK Square -4.9%. EWY NAV declined -$1.97 (-1.20%) to $161.96.

EWY.title: Record $3.03B Flows Into EWY as Investors Use ETF to Bypass SK Hynix ADR Premium
EWY.content: Investors directed a record $3.03B into EWY to gain SK Hynix exposure while US ADRs (SKHY) traded at a ~27% premium. EWY YTD total return reached 66.90%; trading at $152.36 vs. NAV of $161.96.

EWY.title: KOSPI Rebounds 0.97% on ~$950B South Korea-AI Partnership Deals Including SK-Nvidia $750B Deal
EWY.content: KOSPI closed at 6,756 (+0.97%) on July 28 as South Korean firms announced AI cooperation deals totaling ~$950B, led by a $750B SK Group-Nvidia long-term semiconductor supply agreement and Nvidia's $1B investment in Naver. SK Hynix +3.24%, Samsung +1.80%, Naver +8.43%.

EWY.title: iShares MSCI South Korea ETF Falls 4.8% to $144 as Global Semiconductor Selloff Hits Samsung and SK Hynix
EWY.content: EWY fell 4.81% on July 29 tracking the global semiconductor selloff. Major holdings Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix led declines. South Korean chipmakers had been buoyed by a government-backed $520B chip plant investment plan and SK Hynix emergence as top HBM supplier to Nvidia. EWY was up ~87% YTD before the correction.

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Set to Join Nasdaq-100 Index Effective June 22, 2026
RKLB.content: Rocket Lab Corporation (RKLB) confirmed inclusion in the Nasdaq-100 index effective before market open on June 22, 2026, alongside CoreWeave and Teradyne in the same rebalancing cycle.

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Launches Cassowary Vex Hypersonic Mission for US Department of Defense
RKLB.content: Rocket Lab executed the Cassowary Vex hypersonic test mission using its HASTE vehicle for the US DoD, advancing the company's growing defense hypersonics program.

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Q1 2026 Record: Revenue $200.4M (+63.5% YoY), Net Loss Narrows; Backlog $2.2B; Q2 Guide $225-240M
RKLB.content: RKLB Q1 2026: record revenue $200.35M (+63.5% YoY), net loss narrowed to -$45M. Backlog more than doubled YoY to $2.2B. Q2 guidance $225-240M (vs $207.5M estimate). Space Systems $136.7M, Launch $63.7M. 31 new contracts signed in Q1 alone, more than all of 2025.

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Wins Expanded Anduril Hypersonic, Raytheon Space Force, and Motiv Space Systems Acquisition
RKLB.content: RKLB announced: largest launch contract to date, expanded hypersonic testing with Anduril, Space Force missile defense program with Raytheon, and acquisition of Motiv Space Systems for space robotics. 5 dedicated Neutron and 3 Electron launches contracted through 2029.

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Shares Surge 8%+ Premarket on Record Revenue; Neutron Medium-Lift Rocket Program on Track
RKLB.content: RKLB stock surged 8%+ premarket after record Q1 2026 results. Neutron medium-lift rocket program advancing with 5 dedicated launch contracts through 2029. Defense sector expansion with Anduril and Raytheon diversifying revenue from commercial launches.

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Neutron Timeline Risk: Tank Rupture Test Failure Pushes Launch to Q4 2026 / Early 2027; Archimedes Engine Tests Ongoing

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Acquires Motiv Space Systems (May 26); Stock at $146 on May 28; Q1 Revenue $200.3M (+63% YoY)

RKLB.content: Stifel Nicolaus analyst Erik Rasmussen raised Rocket Lab (RKLB) price target to 32 from 10, maintaining Buy. RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Launches U.S. Space Force VICTUS HAZE Mission in Record 16 Hours 42 Minutes, Shattering Responsive-Space Record

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Completes 10th Consecutive Successful Launch — 'Ten Owl of Ten' Mission Delivers Synspective's 10th SAR Satellite

This marks Rocket Lab's 10th consecutive successful launch, completing the current Synspective constellation phase. 17 more Synspective satellites remain on Rocket Lab's launch manifest through 2030.

Iridium operates a 66-satellite L-band constellation serving 2.55 million subscribers with $871M in 2025 revenue. The deal merges Rocket Lab's satellite manufacturing and launch capabilities with Iridium's global network and 500+ partner ecosystem, creating a fully vertically integrated space company. Closing expected mid-2027 pending regulatory approvals.

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Delivers Mission Success for U.S. Space Force VICTUS HAZE II — Satellite Tracking in Record Time
