ORCL.title: Oracle Stock Suffers Worst Weekly Decline Since 2001 Dot-Com Bust, Falls ~19% on $40B Capital Raise Plan
ORCL.content: Oracle's stock fell approximately 19% in the week ending June 27, 2026 — its steepest weekly decline in 25 years — following investor concerns over a planned $40 billion capital raise (including a $20 billion share sale) to fund AI infrastructure buildout. FY2026 capex surged ~162% to nearly $56 billion. Despite record Q4 results (revenue $19.2B, +21% YoY; RPO of $638B, +363% YoY reported June 10), markets punished the dilution risk and debt load.

ORCL.title: New Mexico Rejects Oracle Gas Pipeline Permit for 2.5GW Project Jupiter Data Center — Second Rejection
ORCL.content: 新墨西哥州再度否决Green Chile天然气管线申请(17英里，为Bloom燃料电池供气400M cu ft/天)；8月15日投产时间节点恐无法实现，将大幅增加成本；Oracle声称项目Jupiter仍按计划推进；ORCL、BE股价双双下跌

ORCL.title: Mizuho Reiterates Outperform on Oracle, $320 PT — Sees 164% Upside After 50%+ Stock Crash
ORCL.content: Mizuho's Siti Panigrahi maintained Outperform and $320 PT on ORCL (~$122), calling it 'one of the most attractive risk/reward profiles in our coverage.' ORCL is down ~38% YTD and ~50% since June FY2026 earnings. OCI's AI cloud cost advantages vs. AWS/Azure cited as underappreciated. Stock rose ~3-4.7% on July 21.

ORCL.title: Oracle Stock Hits 52-Week Low (~$122) as New Mexico Blocks Project Jupiter Gas Pipeline (Second Rejection)
ORCL.content: Oracle fell to 52-week lows (~$122) after New Mexico's land commissioner blocked the Green Chile pipeline (17-mile, 400 MMcf/day gas supply) needed for Oracle's 2.5 GW Project Jupiter data center. This was the second rejection (March 2026 was first). Cited: water use, CO2 emissions, lack of state revenue. Oracle's August 15 in-service target now appears unachievable; Oracle disputes delay.

ORCL.title: Oracle Oversold: ORCL Selling Exhaustion Meets OCI's LLM Cost Advantage
ORCL.content: Technical/fundamental analysis on ORCL's decline from late-2025 high of $345.72 to ~$122-126 (~64% drop). OCI's cost leadership in LLM inference workloads vs. AWS/Azure highlighted as re-rating catalyst. Stock testing critical support zone with potential selling exhaustion signals.

ORCL.title: Oracle Leads Race to Build Japan's Secure Air-Gapped Government Cloud vs. Chinese Cyber Threats
ORCL.content: Oracle reportedly leading negotiations to build a highly secure, air-gapped sovereign government cloud in Japan as a counter to Chinese cyber threats, with US Ambassador George Glass coordinating with Tokyo. If won, this would be a major new OCI contract, competing against AWS, Microsoft, and Google.

ORCL.title: Oracle Faces Pressure: Massive Data Center Cost Overruns and OpenAI Exposure Weigh on Stock
ORCL.content: Oracle under scrutiny amid reports of massive data center cost overruns and heavy OpenAI exposure. Oracle plans ~$70B in capex for next fiscal year, raising ~$40B in debt and equity. The aggressive AI infrastructure spending pushed Oracle's credit rating to just one step above junk. Stock is down ~37% YTD despite a $638B backlog. Investor concerns center on execution risk and balance sheet leverage.

ORCL.title: Mizuho Reiterates Oracle Outperform With $320 Target, Sees 164% Upside After 38% YTD Decline
ORCL.content: Mizuho reiterated its Outperform rating on Oracle with a $320 price target (implying ~164% upside) after shares hit a 52-week low following a New Mexico pipeline rejection for the Project Jupiter data center and S&P credit cut to BBB-. Oracle's $638B AI cloud backlog was cited as the key bull thesis.

ORCL.title: Oracle Wins 10-Year $7 Billion Pentagon Software Contract Covering Entire US Military
ORCL.content: The DoD awarded Oracle a 10-year IDIQ contract worth up to $7B ($3.31B base over 5 years, with a $3.6B 5-year option) for on-premises software licenses, maintenance, and consulting across military branches, intelligence community, and the Coast Guard, consolidating fragmented purchases and saving taxpayers at least $441M.

ORCL.title: Oracle Surges ~5% as Reports Emerge Nvidia Will Provide ~$250B Backstop for Massive OpenAI Data Center Build on Oracle Cloud
ORCL.content: WSJ reported Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250B in financial guarantees for a 10-gigawatt OpenAI data center project hosted on Oracle cloud infrastructure. The backstop would allow the SoftBank-affiliated entity to raise investment-grade debt at favorable terms. Oracle shares recovered ~5% on July 27 after prior-month weakness linked to a disclosed 13% workforce reduction (~21,000 jobs) in its FY2026 annual report.

ORCL.title: Oracle Rallies 5% as Market Weighs $7B Pentagon Deal Against Data Center Debt Risks
ORCL.content: ORCL surged 5.05% on July 27 on the $6.99B Dept. of War software contract (announced July 23). The 10-year IDIQ (base $3.31B + $3.68B options) consolidates Oracle licenses across the military, saving an estimated $441M. Offsetting the news: Wisconsin regulators may require $7B+ in collateral for Oracle's planned AI data center.

ORCL.title: Oracle Gains 4.27% as Analysts Weigh $40B Financing Plan Against Government Contract Pipeline
ORCL.content: ORCL gained another 4.27% on July 28. Analysts flagged Oracle's plan to raise $40B through debt and equity financing (including a $20B share sale) for AI data center expansion as a key risk, even as the Pentagon contract win strengthened the government cloud pipeline.

ORCL.title: Oracle Expands Google Cloud Partnership to Embed Gemini AI in Oracle Fusion Applications and NetSuite; Shares +8%
ORCL.content: Oracle announced an expanded partnership with Google Cloud on July 30 to integrate Gemini AI models across Oracle Fusion Applications and Oracle NetSuite via Oracle AI Agent Studio. Shares surged more than 8% on the news.

ORCL.title: Oracle Secures $6.9B U.S. Department of Defense Software Contract (IDIQ, 10-Year)
ORCL.content: Oracle finalized a $6.9B indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity enterprise software agreement with the U.S. Department of Defense. The contract spans 10 years with a base value of $3.31B for the first five years, covering software procurement across military branches and intelligence agencies.

PLTR.title: Wolfe Research Upgrades Palantir to Peer Perform as Q1 Revenue +84.7% YoY Drives Debate
PLTR.content: Wolfe Research upgraded Palantir to Peer Perform from Underperform. Q1 2026 revenue of $1.63B (+84.7% YoY) with 133% US commercial revenue growth. Stock down 26% YTD with P/E ~190x; NHS contract review adding political headwind.

PLTR.title: UK Government Launches Formal Review of Palantir's £330M NHS Contract
PLTR.content: The UK government launched a comprehensive review of Palantir's £330M ($441M) NHS contract amid political scrutiny over data privacy and public sector AI procurement. A separate £50M UK Metropolitan Police contract was also blocked, weighing on PLTR shares.

PLTR.title: Palantir Q1 2026: Revenue +85% YoY to $1.63B (Fastest Since IPO); US Revenue +104%; Raises FY2026 Guide to 71% Growth
PLTR.content: Palantir Q1 2026: revenue $1.63B (+85% YoY), adj EPS $0.33 beat $0.28 estimate, 60% adj operating margin. US revenue +104% (government +84%, commercial +133%). Raised FY2026 guidance to $7.65-7.66B (+71% YoY) and US commercial to +120% YoY — crushing consensus. AIP platform driving both government and enterprise AI monetization.

PLTR.title: Palantir Creates Stock Market History: 85% Revenue Growth + 57% FCF Margin — Rare Hyper-Growth Profitability Pairing
PLTR.content: Following record Q1 2026 results, Palantir achieved historic stock market milestones as one of very few large-cap companies combining hyper-growth (85% revenue) with high profitability (57% FCF margin). AIP platform adoption in DoD and enterprise sectors driving both growth vectors simultaneously.

PLTR.title: DoD FY2027 Budget Proposes $2.3B for Palantir Maven Smart System — Highest Ever Single-Program Allocation
PLTR.content: Palantir disclosed on Q1 2026 earnings call that the DoD FY2027 budget proposal includes $2.3B specifically allocated for Maven Smart System — providing multi-year revenue visibility significantly above current annual run rate for the program. Maven usage doubled over 4 months and is 4x higher over 12 months across combatant commands and intelligence applications. US government revenue +84% YoY to $687M in Q1 2026. Average contract size ~4x what it was 4 quarters ago.

PLTR.title: Palantir Rises 2.9% in Sympathy with Cisco Blowout; FY2026 Revenue Guide $7.65-7.66B (+71% YoY Above Consensus)
PLTR.content: PLTR rose 2.9% on May 14, lifted by Cisco's blowout Q3 results boosting software/AI infrastructure sector sentiment. Palantir FY2026 guide: $7.65-7.66B (+71% YoY) well above $7.27B consensus. Q1 2026 (May 4): revenue $1.63B vs $1.54B est, EPS $0.33 vs $0.27 est.

PLTR.title: Palantir Raises FY2026 Guidance to 71% Revenue Growth After Q1 +85% YoY Record; DoD AI Deployments Surge
PLTR.content: PLTR Q1 2026: Revenue $1.63B (+85% YoY, fastest since IPO), US Revenue +104%, non-GAAP EPS $0.33 vs $0.28 est. FY2026 guidance raised to $7.65-7.66B (71% growth, 10 points above prior guidance). Net income quadrupled to $870.5M.

PLTR.title: Deutsche Bank Raises Palantir PT to $200 (from $160), Maintains Hold — Clearest AI Winner But Expensive Valuation
PLTR.content: Deutsche Bank raised PLTR target to $200 from $160, keeping Hold due to premium valuation. BofA views Palantir as the clearest enterprise AI winner with strong government DoD and commercial AIP momentum. Strong revenue growth and margin expansion priced in. Stock expensive on traditional metrics but AI monetization visibility highest in software sector.

PLTR.title: Palantir +7.83% on May 28; Q1 Revenue $1.633B (+85%), US Commercial +133%; FY2026 Guidance Raised to $7.65B; Maven AI = DoD Program of Record
PLTR.content: Palantir surged 7.83% to ~$143. Q1 2026: revenue $1.633B (+85% YoY, highest-ever growth rate); US commercial +133% to $595M. 206 government deals closed in Q1, many >$10M. Maven AI military system designated DoD 'program of record' (March 2026) — durable defense budget embeddedness. Full-year 2026 guidance raised to ~$7.65B.

PLTR.title: Palantir Wins $300M USDA Contract for Farmland Data Management; PLTR Hits $156 (+13.7% in 5 Days)
PLTR.content: PLTR secures $300M Department of Agriculture contract for farmland data management. Stock reaches $156.54 (+13.68% in 5 days) driven by strong AI platform demand. Q1 FY2026 record revenue $1.633B (+85% YoY), US Commercial +133% YoY.

PLTR.title: Palantir Falls 5.74% as Trump Signs AI Executive Order Targeting High-Performance Defense AI Software Providers
PLTR.content: PLTR fell 5.74% (down up to 6.8% intraday) on June 2 amid broader AI stock pullback. President Trump signed executive order focused on ultra-high-performance AI software from defense contractors including Palantir and Anthropic, raising regulatory uncertainty. This follows June 1 +3.17% gain on strong Q1 results.

PLTR.title: Palantir AIPCon 2026: Google Cloud Partnership Announced; Kirkland & Ellis Private Equity Deal Signed; PLTR +2.1%
PLTR.content: At AIPCon 2026 (June 4), Palantir announced: (1) New Google Cloud collaboration making AIP platform available across Google Cloud infrastructure and Google Cloud Marketplace; (2) Multiyear partnership with Kirkland & Ellis to build AIP-powered enterprise platform for private equity fundraising. PLTR +2.11% on day. Annual meeting was June 3 (routine governance).

PLTR.title: Palantir Defense Infrastructure: AIP/Gotham in Multi-Year Program-of-Record Roles Across US DoD, NSA, CIA, NATO; DIA Next
PLTR.content: Palantir AIP and Gotham have secured multi-year program-of-record contracts across DoD, NSA, CIA, NATO, plus Ukraine battlefield deployments and Project Maven expansion. DIA (Defense Intelligence Agency) identified as next large potential contract target. Multibillion-dollar defense backlog creates infrastructure-like revenue visibility, distinct from commercial AIP growth.

PLTR.title: Palantir Files Challenge to DIA's In-House Analytics Modernization Plan, Targets Major Federal Contract
PLTR.content: Palantir filed a challenge to the DIA's internal data-analytics modernization plan, urging the agency to adopt AIP/Gotham commercial platforms instead. Targets a potentially major federal contract.

PLTR.title: Palantir CEO Karp Warns Corporate Clients Dissatisfied with AI Labs Focused on 'Token Consumption'
PLTR.content: CEO Alex Karp warned on June 11 that corporate clients are growing dissatisfied with AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic, which prioritize 'token consumption' over solving specific business needs — positioning Palantir's AIP as the enterprise-grade alternative.

PLTR.title: Palantir Shares Jump 5.2% as Strait of Hormuz Peace Deal Reduces Geopolitical Risk; Defense AI Intact
PLTR.content: Palantir Technologies shares jumped 5.2% on June 15 after the Trump administration announced a peace deal leading to reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Reduced geopolitical risk sentiment benefited PLTR; defense AI contracts remain intact. Stock at $134.82, down 34.9% from Nov 2025 high.

PLTR.title: UK Parliament Urges End to Palantir's £330M NHS Contract; Government Formal Review Underway
PLTR.content: UK House of Commons Science Committee labeled Palantir an "unacceptable risk" and urged termination of its £330M ($441M) NHS data platform contract. UK PM confirmed formal review; break clause available in 2027. Material contract risk.

PLTR.title: Palantir's £330M NHS Deal Under Fire From UK Lawmakers — Bloomberg
PLTR.content: Bloomberg reported growing bipartisan UK parliamentary pressure on Palantir's £330M NHS contract, citing concerns over patient data privacy, US government ties, and over-reliance on a single American AI vendor.

PLTR.title: Wolfe Research Upgrades Palantir to Peer Perform from Underperform Upon Resuming Coverage
PLTR.content: Wolfe Research upgraded Palantir to Peer Perform from Underperform upon resuming coverage, citing improving fundamentals. PLTR traded between $129.62-$135.00 on June 17.

PLTR.title: Palantir Shares Hit 52-Week Low as European Contract Losses Accelerate; NHS FDP Under UK Parliamentary Scrutiny
PLTR.content: Palantir shares fell to a 52-week low on June 22 following significant contract losses, with renewed UK parliamentary pressure to cancel Palantir's £330 million NHS Federated Data Platform contract weighing on sentiment. PLTR did win a foundational role in the US Army's NGC2 Data Layer program.

PLTR.title: Palantir Announces Strategic Partnership with Zeta Global to Expand Commercial AI Platform Reach
PLTR.content: Palantir Technologies announced a strategic partnership with Zeta Global on June 23, combining Palantir's AI platform with Zeta's data-driven marketing capabilities to expand Palantir's commercial sector reach beyond its core government business.

PLTR.title: Palantir and NVIDIA Launch Sovereign AI Platform for U.S. Government, Integrating Nemotron Open Models in Classified Environments
PLTR.content: Palantir announced a strategic partnership with NVIDIA to deploy NVIDIA Nemotron open-source AI models inside U.S. government sovereign and classified computing environments. The joint offering combines NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPU systems with Palantir's AIP, Ontology, Foundry, and Apollo platforms, enabling government agencies to train and fine-tune AI on their own data in air-gapped environments. PLTR stock rose ~4.6% on the news.

PLTR.title: DA Davidson Upgrades Palantir to Buy as Stock Adds $22B in Market Cap After NVIDIA Sovereign AI Deal
PLTR.content: DA Davidson upgraded PLTR to Buy on July 2 following the June 29 NVIDIA sovereign AI OS partnership and a new Army data-layer contract win. Palantir stock added ~2B in market cap on July 1 alone. Stock +3% on July 2 on the dual catalyst of upgrade and sovereign AI deal momentum.

PLTR.title: Palantir AI Partnerships Fuel Bullish Analyst Calls; PLTR-NVIDIA Sovereign AI Platform for Government Gains Traction
PLTR.content: DA Davidson Buy升级后PLTR股价持续走强；PLTR+NVIDIA主权AI平台支持政府机构在本地安全训练AI；AI编排层的差异化竞争优势获分析师认可

PLTR.title: Prediction: Palantir Defies Doubters — Analyst Issues New Price Target of $163.30
PLTR.content: Updated price target of $163.30 (~23% upside from $132.38) citing eight consecutive earnings beats, a 10-point full-year guidance raise, expanded NVIDIA partnership for sovereign AI models for U.S. government agencies, and U.S. Army NGC2 contract. Q2 earnings set for Aug. 3; Street expects $1.8B revenue (+80% YoY) and EPS $0.35.

PLTR.title: Palantir Stock in Focus After Busy Stretch of Partnerships and Analyst Activity
PLTR.content: Round-up of recent PLTR momentum: NVIDIA partnership for sovereign AI models for U.S. agencies, Army NGC2 modernization program selection, DA Davidson Buy upgrade with $175 target, Zeta Global strategic partnership valued at over $100M annually. Stock up 25.7% from June 25 lows but still 35% below 52-week peak.

PLTR.title: Should You Buy Palantir Stock Before the Huge Investor Update?
PLTR.content: Pre-Q2 earnings positioning analysis: PLTR advanced 4.4% last week, up 25.7% from June 25 lows. Q1 2026 revenue $1.633B (+84.7% YoY), U.S. commercial revenue +133%, adjusted EPS $0.33 beat by 18%. Consensus Q2 (Aug. 3): $1.8B revenue, EPS $0.35.

PLTR.title: Palantir Q2 2026 Earnings Preview: EPS Expected at $0.35, Revenue ~$1.8B; Earnings Call August 3
PLTR.content: Palantir set August 3, 2026 for Q2 results. Analysts expect adjusted EPS of $0.35 (up from $0.16 in Q2 2025) and consensus revenue near $1.7B vs. company guidance of $1.797-1.801B. Q1 2026 revenue grew 85% YoY (U.S. revenue +104%). Full-year 2026 guidance implies ~71% YoY growth at $7.65-7.66B. Options market prices in a 15.3% move post-earnings.

PLTR.title: Palantir Stock Braces for 15% Swing as Q2 Earnings Approach on August 3
PLTR.content: Options market implies a 15.32% post-earnings move for PLTR ahead of August 3 Q2 earnings. Recent tailwinds include U.S. Army NGC2 contract win, NVIDIA/Nemotron partnership for sovereign AI environments, and Zeta Global deal worth $100M+ annually. D.A. Davidson upgraded to Buy; Wedbush reaffirmed $230 target.

PLTR.title: Why Is Palantir Stock Falling on Wednesday? NHS Regulatory Scrutiny and Valuation Concerns
PLTR.content: Palantir shares fell ~5% as UK NHS Federated Data Platform regulatory scrutiny surfaced alongside concerns about insider selling and open-source competition. The drop occurred ahead of the August 3 Q2 earnings report while shares traded at ~42x FY26 sales valuation.

PLTR.title: PLTR Stock Drops 6% as Valuation Fears, NHS Scrutiny Build Before Palantir Earnings
PLTR.content: Palantir fell 6.1% to $124.57 as the UK Office for Statistics Regulation formally addressed public concerns over NHS England's Federated Data Platform performance metrics. Shares slipped toward $120 as pre-earnings selling pressure compounded valuation anxiety ahead of the August 3 Q2 report.

PLTR.title: Palantir Wins Interim Victory as DIA Withdraws MARS Military Intelligence Contract Solicitation
PLTR.content: The Defense Intelligence Agency withdrew the MARS (Machine-assisted Analytic Rapid-repository System) contract solicitation following a formal Palantir protest arguing DoD should use commercially available products rather than build a new system from scratch; shares gained approximately 1% on the news.

PLTR.title: Oppenheimer Reiterates Outperform, $200 Price Target on Palantir Ahead of August 3 Q2 Earnings; Expects Beat-and-Raise
PLTR.content: Oppenheimer reiterated Outperform and $200 price target on PLTR, projecting at least 84-85% year-over-year Q2 revenue growth versus management's 79% guide, and expecting another full-year guidance raise when results are reported August 3. Options market pricing a ~15% earnings move.

PLTR.title: Palantir Jumps 7%; Oppenheimer Reiterates $200 Target on 85% Q2 Revenue Growth Forecast
PLTR.content: PLTR surged 7% to ~$131.53 on July 27. Oppenheimer reiterated Outperform/$200 PT, projecting 85% YoY Q2 revenue growth vs the 80% consensus. Options are pricing a 15.32% post-earnings swing for the August 3 report. Q2 revenue consensus: ~$1.81B (+80% YoY).

PLTR.title: Palantir Drops 6% After Cleveland Research Flags Weak Commercial Partner Spending
PLTR.content: PLTR fell 5.26-6.1% on July 28 after boutique firm Cleveland Research suggested commercial partner data came in 'inline or below plan' in Q2 due to increased competition. Oppenheimer and Baird disputed the note, arguing commercial revenue will grow 135%+ YoY. Q2 earnings report due August 3.

PLTR.title: Palantir Down 26% YTD, Q2 Earnings August 3; Michael Burry Maintains Short on 148x Trailing P/E Valuation
PLTR.content: PLTR at $124.16 July 29, down 26% YTD and 35%+ from all-time high. Q2 2026 earnings scheduled August 3; analyst expectations: EPS $0.16, Revenue $1.08B. Despite 84.7% revenue growth and raised FY2026 guidance to 71%, the stock trades at 148x trailing P/E — prompting Michael Burry to maintain an active short position.

PLTR.title: Palantir Stock Slides to $122, Down ~35% from All-Time High Ahead of August 3 Q2 Earnings
PLTR.content: PLTR fell to ~$122, down ~35% from its all-time high, amid broad enterprise SaaS selling pressure. Q2 2026 earnings due August 3 after close. Analysts expect EPS $0.28 (+115% YoY); full-year 2026 revenue guidance $7.18-7.20B. Company has beaten EPS estimates in each of its last 8 quarters.

IREN.title: IREN Completes Acquisition of Spain's Nostrum Group Adding 490MW of European AI Data Center Capacity
IREN.content: IREN Limited completed its acquisition of Ingenostrum S.L. (Nostrum Group), expanding into Europe with ~490MW of secured grid-connected power in Spain. First European foothold as IREN scales AI Cloud platform backed by $3.65B GPU financing and $9.7B Microsoft contract.

IREN.title: IREN Acquires Mirantis for ~$625M All-Stock to Strengthen AI Cloud Delivery; 1,500+ Enterprise Kubernetes Customers
IREN.content: IREN signed a definitive agreement to acquire Mirantis — a Kubernetes orchestration provider serving 1,500+ enterprise customers — for ~$625M in all-stock. Mirantis is a founding ISV partner of the NVIDIA AI Cloud Ready Initiative, strengthening IREN's managed AI cloud capabilities and enterprise software layer.

IREN.title: IREN Secures $3.4B Five-Year NVIDIA AI Cloud Contract; NVIDIA Receives Warrants for 30M Shares at $70 (~$2.1B)
IREN.content: IREN signed a five-year ~$3.4B managed GPU cloud services contract with NVIDIA, granting NVIDIA the right to purchase up to 30M IREN shares at $70/share (~$2.1B warrants). Underpins IREN's plan to deploy up to 5GW of NVIDIA-designed AI infrastructure; stock surged 13% on May 8.

IREN.title: IREN Acquires Nostrum Group: Enters Europe with 490MW Secured Power in Spain; Global Portfolio Reaches 5GW
IREN.content: IREN agreed to acquire Ingenostrum S.L. (Nostrum Group), a Spanish data center developer with ~490MW grid-connected power in Spain plus an additional development pipeline — expanding IREN's total secured global power portfolio to 5GW.

IREN.title: IREN Q3 FY2026 Revenue $144.8M Misses $219.9M Estimate as Bitcoin-to-AI Infrastructure Pivot Continues
IREN.content: IREN Q3 FY2026 revenue $144.8M significantly missed analyst consensus of ~$219.9M as the company continues pivot from Bitcoin mining to AI infrastructure. Revenue miss was overshadowed by the simultaneous NVIDIA $3.4B contract, Mirantis, and Nostrum announcements the same week.

IREN.title: IREN Launches $2B Convertible Notes Offering to Fund AI Infrastructure Expansion; Shares Fall ~10%
IREN.content: IREN announced a $2B convertible notes offering to fund AI infrastructure expansion, sending shares down ~9.9% to $55.15 as investors digested dilution risk following the prior week's 13% surge on the NVIDIA deal announcement.

IREN.title: IREN Rallies on NVDA Blowout Q2 Guidance; $5.6B NVDA Cloud/Equity Deal; Short Interest 16%
IREN.content: IREN shares rose May 21 following NVDA's $91B Q2 guidance. IREN holds a $5.6B combined cloud services and potential equity deal with Nvidia (5-year right to purchase 30M shares at $70). Short interest 16% as traders bet against AI infrastructure debt load. Company transitioning from Bitcoin mining to dedicated AI GPU data center infrastructure.

IREN.title: Iris Energy (IREN) to Join Russell 3000 Index Effective June 26, 2026
IREN.content: FTSE Russell preliminary list includes IREN Limited in Russell 3000 Index changes effective after US market close June 26, 2026. Inclusion expected to drive passive fund inflows and improve market visibility for the Bitcoin mining-to-AI data center operator.

IREN.title: IREN Closes $3.65B Investment-Grade GPU Financing for $9.7B Microsoft AI Cloud Contract
IREN.content: IREN closed a $3.65B investment-grade GPU financing facility (rated A by Fitch/DBRS) — structured as $2.10B U.S. private placement and $1.55B delayed draw term loan — to fund its $9.7B Microsoft AI cloud contract.

IREN.title: IREN Announces First Australian Data Center Campus — 800MW in South Australia
IREN.content: IREN signed a transmission connection agreement for a planned 800MW data center campus in Bundey, South Australia. One of the largest APAC data center projects announced; expected to create 200+ skilled jobs.

IREN.title: IREN Closes $3.65B Investment-Grade GPU Financing Facility for Microsoft AI Cloud Contract
IREN.content: Closed a $3.65B investment-grade GPU financing facility covering ~96% of the $5.81B GPU spend tied to its Microsoft AI cloud contract, de-risking the financing of its major AI data center expansion.

IREN.title: IREN Signs 800MW Data Center Transmission Connection Agreement in Bundey, South Australia
IREN.content: IREN signed a transmission connection agreement supporting a planned 800MW data center campus in Bundey, South Australia, adding major capacity to its global AI infrastructure pipeline alongside U.S. and European operations.

IREN.title: IREN Closes $3.65B Investment-Grade GPU Financing Facility to Support Microsoft AI Cloud Contract
IREN.content: IREN closed a $3.65B investment-grade GPU financing facility to support delivery of its large-scale AI Cloud contract with Microsoft, one of the largest GPU infrastructure financing deals for an AI cloud compute provider.

IREN.title: IREN Acquires Nostrum Group (Ingenostrum), Entering European AI Data Center Market via Spain
IREN.content: IREN completed the acquisition of Ingenostrum S.L. (Nostrum Group), a developer of grid-connected AI data centers in Spain, marking IREN's first entry into the European AI infrastructure market. Street targets on IREN now reach $99 after Buy/Overweight wave.

IREN.title: IREN Closes $3.65B Investment-Grade GPU Financing Facility Tied to Microsoft AI Cloud Contract
IREN.content: IREN closed a $3.65B investment-grade GPU financing facility to fund large-scale Blackwell GPU deployments tied to its AI cloud contract with Microsoft, covering IREN's expanding global data center portfolio.

IREN.title: IREN Added to Russell 1000 Index Effective June 26, 2026 Following FTSE Russell Annual Reconstitution
IREN.content: IREN Limited was added to the Russell 1000 Index effective after market close on June 26, 2026, following the FTSE Russell annual reconstitution. The inclusion validates IREN's transition from Bitcoin mining to AI infrastructure (GPU cloud and data center services). IREN shares gained 3.6% in premarket trading.

IREN.title: IREN Appoints Kambiz Aghili as Chief Product Officer and Michael Nudelman as Chief Development Officer for AI Compute Expansion
IREN.content: Iris Energy strengthened executive team with CPO and CDO appointments on July 2 to lead AI Cloud product strategy and infrastructure development as company scales to 480MW by end of 2026.

IREN.title: IREN Signs $2.8 Billion in New AI Developer Contracts, Raises 2026 ARR Target Above $4 Billion
IREN.content: IREN announced $2.8B in new multi-year AI cloud services contracts, raising its 2026 ARR target from $3.7B to >$4B (85% now under contract). Customers include Microsoft, Nvidia, Perplexity, Figure AI, Together AI, Fluidstack, Fireworks AI, Fal AI, and Hume AI. Weighted average contract duration ~4 years. Customer prepayments cover 45% of GPU capex. IREN plans 480 MW of AI cloud capacity in 2026, scaling to 1.2 GW in 2027.

IREN.title: IREN Files 6-K with SEC Disclosing $2.8B AI Cloud Contract Details
IREN.content: IREN Limited filed a Form 6-K current report disclosing the $2.8B customer contract signings and revised 2026 AI Cloud ARR target of over $4B. The company is transitioning from Bitcoin mining to a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider with owned data centers and a GPU cloud strategy targeting major AI developers.

IREN.title: IREN Stock Surges 17% on $2.8B AI Cloud Contract Announcement
IREN.content: IREN shares jumped 17–20% on July 20 following the $2.8B AI developer contract announcement. Bitcoin mining stocks broadly rose as AI infrastructure demand accelerates. The surge follows a ~44% 30-day pullback linked to controversy over ~$700M co-CEO stock awards. Jefferies had earlier initiated IREN with a Buy rating and $79 target.

IREN.title: IREN Gains 20% on $2.8B AI Contract Haul; Bulls Set $48 Target
IREN.content: IREN extended gains to ~20% on July 21 following the prior day's $2.8B AI contract announcement. Bullish price targets reach $48. The deal covers ~85% of the revised >$4B ARR goal. IREN's Nostrum Group acquisition in Spain added ~490 MW of secured power capacity and a 50+ person AI data center team, further supporting expansion plans.

IREN.title: IREN Signs $2.8B in New Multi-Year AI Cloud Contracts with Microsoft, NVIDIA, Perplexity, Figure AI; Raises ARR Target to $4B+
IREN.content: IREN Limited announced $2.8B in new multi-year AI cloud contracts with Microsoft, Nvidia, Perplexity, Figure AI, Together AI, Fireworks AI, Fal AI, and Hume AI. IREN raised its year-end AI Cloud ARR target from $3.7B to $4B+, with ~85% now under contract. Weighted average contract duration is ~4 years; customer prepayments cover 45% of GPU capex. IREN stock surged ~19.5% on the announcement.

IREN.title: IREN Signs $2.8B in New Multi-Year AI Cloud Contracts with Microsoft, NVIDIA, Perplexity; Raises 2026 ARR Target to $4B+; Stock +20%
IREN.content: IREN Limited announced $2.8 billion in new multi-year AI cloud service contracts with Microsoft, NVIDIA, Perplexity, Figure AI, Together AI, and others, raising its year-end ARR target to over $4B; shares surged ~20% on the news.

IREN.title: IREN Secures $2.8 Billion in New Multi-Year AI Cloud Contracts, Raises 2026 ARR Target to Over $4B
IREN.content: IREN signed $2.8B in multi-year AI cloud services contracts (avg ~4-year duration) with customers including Microsoft, NVIDIA, Perplexity, and Figure AI, raising its 2026 annualized run-rate revenue target from $3.7B to over $4B; shares jumped approximately 20% on the announcement.

IREN.title: IREN 5GW AI Data Center Roadmap Analysis: $3.1B ARR Contracted with Microsoft and NVIDIA; Stock Surged 26%
IREN.content: IREN 5GW roadmap pivoting from Bitcoin mining to AI/HPC data centers gained significant analyst attention in late July 2026, driving a 26% stock surge. The company has $3.1B ARR under contract: Microsoft ($1.9B), NVIDIA ($0.7B for Blackwell GPUs ramping early 2027). 2026 target: 480MW capacity with 150,000 GPUs. Total secured power over 4.5GW. Jefferies initiated with Buy/$79 target. Full-year FY2026 results expected September 16.

VST.title: Vistra Named Preferred Power Provider for KKR's $10B+ Helix Digital AI Infrastructure Venture
VST.content: Vistra designated as preferred power provider for Helix Digital Infrastructure, a KKR-backed AI data center venture with $10B+ committed capital, also backed by NVIDIA (AI design) and Kuwait Investment Authority, led by ex-AWS CEO Adam Selipsky. Vistra is an anchor investor supplying power from its ~50,000 MW portfolio.

VST.title: Vistra Q1 2026: Net Income $1.03B; EPS $2.87 Beats by 30%; 2026 Adjusted EBITDA Guidance $6.8-7.6B Reaffirmed
VST.content: Vistra Q1 2026: GAAP net income $1.029B (vs -$268M a year ago), EPS $2.87 beat $2.21 consensus by 30%. Revenue $5.64B (from $3.93B). Reaffirmed 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance $6.8-7.6B. Retail and generation expansion supports AI data center direct power supply strategy.

VST.title: Vistra Achieves Investment-Grade at Both S&P and Fitch; Dual Rating Triggers Lien Release, Lowers Capital Cost
VST.content: Fitch upgraded Vistra to BBB- (investment grade), joining S&P's December 2025 upgrade. Dual investment-grade status triggered lien release provisions, expanding Vistra's access to lower-cost capital markets debt and improving financial flexibility for AI data center long-term power agreements.

VST.title: Vistra Signs Long-Term PPA with Meta for 2,600MW Nuclear Power at PJM Sites; Stock Pulls Back 25% From February Peak
VST.content: Vistra signed a long-term power purchase agreement with Meta for ~2,600MW of nuclear generation capacity at Vistra's PJM nuclear plants — one of the largest AI data center clean power deals announced. Despite Q1 2026 earnings beat (EPS $2.87 +30%), 2026 EBITDA guided $6.8-7.6B, and dual investment-grade rating from S&P+Fitch, VST stock pulled back ~25% from its February 2026 high amid broader utility sector rotation.

VST.title: Vistra Upgraded to Investment Grade at Second Major Rating Agency; Q1 2026 EBITDA $1.49B, Guidance Reaffirmed
VST.content: Vistra upgraded to investment grade at second major credit rating agency. Q1 2026: GAAP net income $1,029M, Adjusted EBITDA $1,494M. Reaffirmed 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance $6.8-7.6B, Adjusted FCF $3.925-4.725B.

VST.title: Power Sector Rally: DOE PJM Emergency Order Highlights Irreplaceable Role of Dispatchable Generators; VST +5-6%
VST.content: Vistra Corp surged 5.32-6.32% on May 26 alongside Constellation Energy (+3.38-4.86%) and GE Vernova (+5.31%) after the U.S. Department of Energy issued Emergency Order No. 202-26-17 mandating specific PJM power plants remain online through summer 2026. The order reinforced the policy premium being placed on dispatchable power assets supporting grid reliability during AI-driven demand growth, directly supporting Vistra's long-term contracted generation strategy.

VST.title: Vistra Declares Quarterly Dividend $0.229/Share, Ex-Date June 22, 2026; 2026 Revenue Projected $23B (+20%)
VST.content: Vistra declared quarterly cash dividend of $0.229/share with ex-date June 22, 2026. Q1 2026 revenue $5.64B (+43% YoY), reaffirmed Adj EBITDA guidance $6.8-7.6B and Adj FCF $3.9-4.7B for 2026; projects $10B+ cumulative cash generation through 2027. Analysts forecast $23B 2026 revenue on Meta 2,600MW nuclear PPA and AI data center power demand.

VST.title: Vistra vs. Constellation Analysis: Vistra's Meta 20-Year Nuclear PPAs (2,600 MW); Both Fall ~5-7% in Broader June 5 Selloff
VST.content: New analysis compares Vistra (VST) and Constellation Energy (CEG) as top AI power plays. Vistra signed 20-year PPAs with Meta in January 2026 for ~2,600 MW of nuclear power across three PJM plants. Constellation has 20-year agreements with Microsoft and Meta (1.1 GW). Both fell ~5-7% on June 5 in the broader market selloff; no company-specific negative catalysts identified.

VST.title: Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan Raise Vistra Price Targets, Keep Overweight After Record Q1 2026 Results
VST.content: Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan raised price targets on Vistra following record Q1 2026 profitability and strong cash generation. Both maintained Overweight ratings.

VST.title: KKR, Nvidia, and Vistra Launch Helix Digital Infrastructure — $10B+ AI Infrastructure Company
VST.content: KKR, Nvidia, and Vistra launched Helix Digital Infrastructure to deliver integrated data center, power, and connectivity infrastructure for hyperscalers at AI scale. $10B+ committed. Vistra is preferred power partner. Led by former AWS CEO Adam Selipsky.

VST.title: KKR, NVIDIA, and Vistra Launch Helix Digital Infrastructure with $10B+ to Power Hyperscale AI Data Centers
VST.content: KKR (with Kuwait Investment Authority), NVIDIA, and Vistra launched Helix Digital Infrastructure — $10B+ committed capital led by ex-AWS CEO Adam Selipsky. Vistra is preferred power partner to Helix, serving hyperscaler data center power and connectivity needs.

VST.title: Seaport Research Raises Vistra Price Target to $230 on AI Data Center Power Demand
VST.content: Seaport Research raised its price target on Vistra Corp (VST) to $230 from $227, maintaining a bullish outlook amid rising AI infrastructure electricity demand.

VST.title: Vistra Reports Record PJM Grid Demand During July Heat Dome; Nuclear Fleet Runs at Full Capacity
VST.content: Vistra experienced record electricity demand in its PJM grid footprint during a July 2026 heat dome event, with its nuclear fleet running at full capacity and power prices spiking. The demand surge significantly boosts Vistra's Q2/Q3 2026 earnings outlook and highlights the value of its baseload nuclear generation in extreme weather events.

VST.title: Vistra Signs 20-Year Nuclear Power Purchase Agreement With Meta for ~2,600MW Across Three PJM-Region Plants
VST.content: Vistra secured a landmark 20-year PPA with Meta Platforms for approximately 2,600MW of nuclear power capacity across three PJM-region plants, a cornerstone long-term AI data center power deal.

VST.title: Vistra Secures PJM Capacity Win and AWS Nuclear PPA; Wells Fargo, BofA, Scotiabank All Reiterate Buy
VST.content: PJM容量竞价成功(7月12日)；与AWS签署约1,200MW核电长期购电协议(补充早前Meta 2,600MW PPA)；Wells Fargo(7月17日)、Scotiabank(PT上调至$298，7月16日)、BofA(7月15日)均维持买入；Q2财报8月7日

VST.title: Vistra Prices $4 Billion Private Offering of Senior Notes to Repay Existing Debt
VST.content: Vistra priced a $4 billion senior notes offering across four tranches to repay existing debt and extend its maturity profile. This is a capital market transaction separate from the January 2026 $2.25B secured notes offering, part of ongoing balance sheet management as VST expands nuclear and gas generation capacity.

VST.title: Vistra Receives Approval to Extend Operation of Perry Nuclear Plant Through 2046
VST.content: Vistra received regulatory approval to extend the operating license of its Perry Nuclear Power Plant in Ohio through 2046. Perry is one of three plants included in VST's 20-year, 2,609 MW nuclear PPA with Meta Platforms. License extension provides critical long-run revenue and capacity visibility.

VST.title: Wells Fargo Issues Buy Rating on Vistra Energy; 13 Analysts at Buy With Mean Target $232
VST.content: Wells Fargo issued a Buy rating on Vistra Corp (VST) on July 21. VST shares rose 2.75% to $162.33. The bullish thesis centers on Vistra's nuclear PPA with Meta (2,609 MW, 20-year contract), PJM capacity auction clearing ~10.9 GW at $325/MW-day for 2028/29, and expanding capital program in nuclear, solar, and battery storage. Q2 2026 results scheduled for August 7.

VST.title: TD Cowen Cuts Vistra Price Target to $222 From $230, Maintains Buy; Stock Falls 3.8%
VST.content: TD Cowen trimmed its Vistra (VST) price target to $222 from $230 (Buy), contributing to a 3.8% stock decline on July 27. Morgan Stanley had also cut its target to $208 from $210 on July 22. VST is scheduled to report Q2 earnings August 7 with consensus EPS at $2.43 (+140% YoY).

VST.title: Morgan Stanley Raises Vistra Price Target to $212 (Overweight); Unusual Call Options Volume Surges 30% Above Typical
VST.content: Morgan Stanley raised Vistra (VST) price target to $212 from $208, maintaining Overweight on July 28. Same day, investors acquired 39,705 call options — 30% above typical volume of 30,452 — suggesting bullish positioning. Goldman Sachs also has Buy on VST. Vistra Q2 2026 earnings expected in early August.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Q1 2026: Record Revenue $804M (+26% YoY); Raises Capacity Target to $6B; Q2 Guided ~$900M; AI Server Growth 85% YoY
MPWR.content: MPWR Q1 2026: record revenue $804M (+26% YoY, +7% QoQ), adj EPS $5.10 beat $4.90 estimate. Raised manufacturing capacity target to $6B (from $4B). Q2 guided ~$900M. Enterprise data (AI servers DrMOS/VRM for NVIDIA H100/B200) growth raised to 85% YoY from prior 50% floor.

MPWR.title: Multiple Analysts Raise MPWR Price Targets After Q1 Beat and 85% AI Server Growth Guidance
MPWR.content: Multiple analysts raised MPWR price targets following Q1 2026 beat and enterprise data growth upgrade to 85% YoY. Communications segment grew 33% sequentially. Structural position in AI server power delivery (DrMOS/VRM) cited as a durable multi-year growth driver for MPWR.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Records +18% One-Month Return; $6B Capacity Target Set; Raymond James Raises to $1,800
MPWR.content: Monolithic Power Systems shares have returned +18% in the past month following Q1 2026 record results. The company raised its manufacturing capacity target from $4B to $6B to meet AI server power management demand. Raymond James raised price target to $1,800 (from $1,350, Outperform), Needham to $1,750, TD Cowen to $1,850. Enterprise data AI server growth guidance raised to 85% YoY.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Systems Q1 2026 Record Revenue +26% YoY; AI Server DrMOS/VRM Demand Leads; Stock at $1,534
MPWR.content: MPWR Q1 2026: record revenue, up 26% YoY, led by enterprise data and AI communications segment. DrMOS and VRM power management chips for NVDA H100/B200 servers driving growth. Stock at $1,534 on May 21. Structural bull case intact; Seeking Alpha notes potential margin pressure risk at 61x forward P/E if competition intensifies.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power AI Server Power Market Expanding; MPWR a Key NVDA H100/B200 Supply Chain Beneficiary
MPWR.content: MPWR's DrMOS/VRM power management chips are critical components in NVIDIA H100/B200 AI server builds. As hyperscalers scale AI training clusters, power delivery efficiency demands grow. Analysts continue to highlight MPWR as a direct AI infrastructure spending beneficiary, with data center exposure now representing the majority of revenue.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Falls 3.4% June 4 on Restatement/Insider-Selling Disclosures; Stock Still Up 86.5% YTD; Q1 Record Revenue +26% YoY
MPWR.content: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) fell 3.4% on June 4 as investors digested financial restatement/non-reliance disclosures and insider-selling filings. Despite the pullback, MPWR remains up 86.5% year-to-date. Q1 2026 delivered record revenue (+26% YoY), led by AI server power management demand. MPWR is a key NVIDIA H100/B200 DrMOS/VRM supply chain partner.

MPWR.title: Schall Law Firm Investigates Monolithic Power Systems Over Fiduciary Duty Breaches Tied to Restatement
MPWR.content: The Schall Law Firm announced on June 3, 2026 investigation of Monolithic Power Systems for potential breaches of fiduciary duty tied to a financial restatement disclosed in a February 2026 Form 8-K.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Systems Discloses $195M Deferred Tax Restatement for FY2024; Audit Committee Review Ongoing
MPWR.content: MPWR disclosed incorrectly accounted deferred income taxes from a foreign tax incentive, requiring $195M restatement to FY2024 financials. Audit committee determined prior statements cannot be relied upon. Insiders sold $220.2M in shares over 3 months.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Declares Q2 2026 Dividend $2.00/Share; Signals 30–40% Enterprise Data Growth on AI Demand
MPWR.content: MPWR declared Q2 2026 dividend of $2.00/share (payable July 15) and signaled 30-40% growth in enterprise data segment for 2026 driven by AI server power management demand. Stock surged 7.91% on June 12 to $1,589.55.

MPWR.title: Analyst Consensus Raises Monolithic Power Systems Price Target 27% to ~,797 After Earnings Beat
MPWR.content: Multiple analysts lifted consensus target ~27% to ~,797. Wells Fargo issued Buy on June 9. Stock surged 7.91% on June 12 to ,589.55, up 135%+ from 52-week low. AI power management demand driving momentum.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Systems Upgrades to Russell Large-Cap Indexes; AI Data Center Power Demand Thesis Recognized
MPWR.content: Monolithic Power Systems was upgraded to Russell Large-Cap Indexes in the annual FTSE Russell reconstitution, reflecting institutional recognition of its substantial market cap growth driven by AI data center power management IC demand. The stock also gained 4.5% on July 6 as chip stocks rebounded on AI power demand themes.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Systems Shares Fall 4.5% to $1,291; Q2 2026 Dividend of $2.00/Share Paid July 15; Q2 Results Expected July 30
MPWR.content: MPWR fell 4.5% in broader tech selloff to $1,291.38; second quarter dividend of $2.00/share paid July 15 to shareholders of record June 30; Q2 earnings call July 30.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Systems to Report Q2 2026 Results on July 30 After Market Close
MPWR.content: MPWR Q2 2026财报7月30日盘后发布，随后举办网络Q&A；AI数据中心电源管理需求持续强劲，但公司近月股价承压下跌约12.9%

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Systems Stock Gets AI Boost From IBM Spending Signals
MPWR.content: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna revealed enterprise clients sharply shifted budgets toward AI servers, storage, and memory to secure supply-constrained AI infrastructure. This boosted MPWR, a key power management IC supplier for AI data centers. MPWR and Amkor surged ~6% on the AI demand validation ahead of MPWR's July 30 Q2 2026 earnings report.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Systems Jumps 4.2% as Bullish Analyst Tone and AI Data-Center Demand Sustain Momentum Into Earnings
MPWR.content: MPWR gained 4.2% as 22 analysts maintain consensus Buy with median price target of $1,300. Analysts expect Q2 EPS of $5.65 and revenue of ~$902M when the company reports July 30. MPWR has beaten EPS estimates for 8 consecutive quarters; FY2026 full-year EPS consensus is $20.13 (up 57% YoY). Current price ~$1,305 is ~27% below consensus target.

MPWR.title: AI's Dual Catalyst: Monolithic Power Systems and Amkor Technology Surge on AI Infrastructure Demand
MPWR.content: Monolithic Power Systems and Amkor Technology surged over 6% driven by dual catalysts: a cooler-than-expected June 2026 inflation print and IBM's AI infrastructure spending validation. Analysts note MPWR's dominance in high-efficiency power ICs for AI GPU and accelerator platforms, with 12-month price targets clustered between $1,500 and $2,000.

MPWR.title: Wells Fargo Trims Monolithic Power Systems Price Target to $1,700 from $1,860, Keeps Overweight
MPWR.content: Wells Fargo analyst Joe Quatrochi cut the MPWR price target to $1,700 from $1,860 while maintaining an Overweight rating after the stock fell roughly 22% from its 52-week high of $1,714; Monolithic Power is scheduled to report Q2 2026 results on July 30, with consensus expecting EPS of $5.88 on revenue of ~$904M.

MPWR.title: Monolithic Power Systems Q2 2026: Record Revenue $980.6M (+48% YoY), Non-GAAP EPS $6.50 Beats by 10.5%
MPWR.content: MPWR reported record Q2 2026 revenue of $980.6M, up 47.6% YoY, beating consensus by 8.6%. Non-GAAP EPS of $6.50 beat by 10.5%. Q3 2026 guidance midpoint of $1.15B was 16.5% above Street estimates. Board increased share repurchase authorization by $500M. Stock rallied ~10.5%.

GLW.title: Corning Rallies on Amazon Multibillion-Dollar Optical Fiber Deal and Meta-Funded NC Manufacturing Expansion
GLW.content: Corning rose ~6% week of June 16 on momentum from the Amazon multiyear multibillion-dollar optical fiber and connectivity deal (announced June 8) plus ~1,000 new NC manufacturing jobs. Also broke ground on Meta-funded optical cable manufacturing expansion in Hickory, NC.

GLW.title: NVIDIA and Corning: 10x US Optical Manufacturing Expansion; NVIDIA Warrants for Up to $3.2B Corning Investment
GLW.content: NVIDIA and Corning announced a multiyear partnership: Corning to expand US optical connectivity manufacturing 10x and US fiber production 50%+, building 3 new factories in North Carolina and Texas (3,000+ jobs). NVIDIA received warrants to invest up to $3.2B in Corning shares. GLW stock surged 12%.

GLW.title: Corning +12% on NVIDIA Deal; $500M Pre-Funded Warrant Executed; Positioned as Critical AI Data Center Optical Supplier
GLW.content: GLW jumped 12% on NVIDIA partnership. Deal includes $500M pre-funded warrant for NVIDIA to purchase ~3M Corning shares immediately plus additional warrants for up to 15M shares at $180/share — establishing Corning as a cornerstone US-based optical interconnect supplier for AI data centers.

GLW.title: Corning and Meta Sign Up to $6B Multiyear Fiber-Optic Agreement to Accelerate U.S. AI Data Center Buildout Through 2030
GLW.content: Corning and Meta announced a multiyear agreement worth up to $6B through 2030 for optical fiber, cable, and connectivity solutions for Meta's AI data centers. Meta serves as anchor customer for Corning's expanded North Carolina optical cable facility (15-20% employment increase). Deal followed by May 6 NVIDIA-Corning $3.2B partnership — cementing Corning as the primary U.S. optical fiber supplier for AI infrastructure. Corning targeting $20B annualized sales run rate by end of 2026.

GLW.title: Bank of America Adds Corning to US 1 List; GLW Surges 10%+ on AI Infrastructure Optical Supply Role
GLW.content: Bank of America added Corning to its 'US 1 List' of top investment ideas, citing the NVIDIA multiyear partnership (10x US optical manufacturing expansion) and revised 2026/2030 targets ($20B and $40B respectively). GLW surged 10%+ in a high-volume session before pulling back 5.73% on May 12 on broader market pressure, then rebounded 5.33% on May 13.

GLW.title: Corning +324% Over Past Year Driven by AI Optical Demand; NVIDIA Partnership for 10x US Optical Production
GLW.content: GLW stock up 324% over past year, +123% YTD. Key catalyst: NVIDIA multiyear partnership to 10x US optical manufacturing capacity in North Carolina. Q1 2026 revenue $4.14B (+7.3% YoY). Optical telecom segment driven by AI data center fiber demand.

GLW.title: Corning Declares $0.28 Quarterly Dividend; $3.2B NVIDIA Optical Deal; Stock Down 3.21% on May 28 Amid Insider Selling
GLW.content: Corning declared quarterly cash dividend of $0.28/share (May 29). Stock fell 3.21% on May 28 (range $182-$195). Senior SVP and CTO among insiders who sold $33M+ in shares in the past 90 days. Company benefits from $3.2B NVIDIA deal to expand optical connectivity for AI data centers; Q1 solar revenues up 80% YoY.

GLW.title: Corning Stock Up 305% Past Year; $6B Fiber Supply Deal with Meta + NVIDIA 10x Optical Capacity Expansion Drive AI Demand
GLW.content: Corning's stock has risen over 305% in the past year, driven by multi-year AI optical connectivity agreements: $6B fiber supply deal with Meta, and the NVIDIA strategic partnership to expand US optical manufacturing 10x and fiber production by 50%+ (three new facilities in NC and TX). Corning also launched Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3 for foldable phones. AI-driven fiber demand remains the primary growth catalyst.

GLW.title: Corning Signs Multibillion-Dollar Multiyear Fiber Supply Deal with Amazon for US Data Centers; Creates 1,000 Jobs
GLW.content: Amazon and Corning announced a multiyear, multibillion-dollar agreement for Corning to supply optical fiber, cable, and connectivity for Amazon's U.S. data center buildout. ~1,000 new manufacturing jobs at North Carolina facilities. GLW rose ~7%.

GLW.title: UBS Raises Corning Price Target to $228, Mizuho to $220 Following Amazon Fiber Deal Announcement
GLW.content: UBS raised Corning target to $228 (Buy) and Mizuho to $220 following the Amazon fiber deal. Management targets $20B annualized sales run rate by end of 2026, scaling to $40B by 2030.

GLW.title: Amazon Signs Multibillion-Dollar Fiber Optics Supply Deal with Corning; Creates 1,000+ US Jobs in North Carolina
GLW.content: Amazon and Corning signed a multiyear, multibillion-dollar supply agreement for optical fiber, cable, and connectivity for Amazon's US data centers. Creates 1,000+ manufacturing jobs in North Carolina and includes a fiber optic technician training program.

GLW.title: Corning Shares Surge 9% on Amazon Deal; Long-Term Sales Targets Raised to $40B by 2030
GLW.content: Corning shares surged 9% to ~$194 following the Amazon deal announcement, coming months after a similar ~$6B deal with Meta. Corning raised long-term targets: $20B annualized run rate by end-2026, $30B by 2028, $40B by 2030.

GLW.title: TrendForce: Amazon-Corning Multibillion Fiber Deal Signals AI Data Center Buildout Acceleration
GLW.content: TrendForce reported on the Amazon-Corning deal in the context of hyperscaler AI data center buildout, noting Corning has now secured multiple comparable large-scale fiber supply deals with Meta and Amazon.

GLW.title: Corning Jumps 4.8% on Amazon Multiyear Multibillion-Dollar AI Optical Fiber Supply Agreement
GLW.content: Corning reached $187.88 (+4.8%) on June 15 following Amazon multiyear, multibillion-dollar optical fiber, cable, and connectivity supply agreement for expanding US data centers, adding ~1,000 manufacturing jobs in North Carolina. Deepens Corning's AI infrastructure role alongside Meta and Nvidia fiber deals.

GLW.title: Corning Falls 4.31% on Analyst Downgrades; Solar Division Delays Add $30M Quarterly Expense
GLW.content: GLW dropped 4.31% on June 16 on analyst downgrades to Hold citing P/E near 90x (double 5-year median). Solar division production delays added ~$30M in quarterly expenses. CEO recently sold 100,000 shares ($18.6M).

GLW.title: Corning Surges +8% June 18, +11.2% June 19 on Amazon Fiber Deal Momentum; Insiders Sell $30.7M of Stock
GLW.content: Corning shares continued their post-Amazon deal surge, rising 8% on June 18 and 11.2% on June 19, extending the rally from the multi-billion dollar Amazon optical fiber supply agreement. Concurrently, SEC filings disclosed that corporate insiders sold 160,655 shares valued at $30.7M+ in mid-June, a notable insider activity signal.

GLW.title: Corning Surges 14% on FTSE Russell Annual Reconstitution — Reclassified from Value to Growth Indexes Including Russell 1000 Growth
GLW.content: On June 29, 2026, Corning (GLW) rose 14.03% as the FTSE Russell annual index reconstitution reclassified Corning from value to growth benchmarks (Russell 3000 Growth, Russell 1000 Growth, Russell Top 200 Growth), triggering substantial institutional rebalancing flows. Combined with the earlier Amazon multi-billion dollar fiber optics supply deal, the stock reached new highs.

GLW.title: Corning Shares Plunge 13% Intraday as Profit-Taking Hits Overextended AI-Driven Rally
GLW.content: Corning Inc shares plunged 13.3% intraday on July 1 following a rapid AI-driven parabolic run that had pushed the trailing P/E ratio to levels considered significantly stretched. The sharp decline followed the FTSE Russell annual reconstitution boost (Corning +14% the prior week) and reflected broad institutional profit-taking.

GLW.title: Corning Shares Rise 6%, Snapping Six-Session Losing Streak That Erased ~28%; Amazon and NVIDIA Optical Fiber Deals Cited
GLW.content: Corning recovered +6% on July 9 after six consecutive down sessions erased ~28% of market value; multi-billion dollar optical fiber agreements with Amazon and NVIDIA support long-term AI demand thesis.

GLW.title: Corning Q2 2026 Earnings Preview: EPS Expected $0.76 (+26.7%), Revenue ~$4.62B; Reports July 28
GLW.content: Analysts expect Corning Q2 2026 diluted EPS of $0.76 (+26.7% YoY) on revenue of ~$4.62B. Corning reports July 28 before market open. 8 of 14 analysts rate Strong Buy, 6 Hold. Average 12-month PT of $217.43 offers ~15.7% upside. Full-year 2026 EPS consensus is $3.19 (+26.6%), 2027 $4.22 (+32%).

GLW.title: Mizuho Raises Corning Price Target to $270 from $220, Maintains Outperform
GLW.content: Mizuho raised its Corning price target from $220 to $270, maintaining an Outperform rating ahead of Q2 results. The raise reflects accelerating AI-driven fiber demand tied to megadeals with Meta ($6B), Amazon, and Nvidia ($3.2B investment / US manufacturing expansion).

GLW.title: Corning (GLW) Consensus 'Moderate Buy' Ahead of Q2 Earnings July 28; Citi Raises PT to $240
GLW.content: Analysts maintain consensus 'Moderate Buy' on Corning ahead of Q2 2026 earnings due July 28. Citi raised PT to $240 from $225 (Buy); Truist raised PT to $205 from $149 (Hold); Morgan Stanley maintains Equal Weight at $180. Consensus 12-month PT of $214 implies ~38% upside. Q2 EPS expected at $0.76, up 26.7% YoY.

GLW.title: Corning Surges 6% as Analysts Raise Price Targets: Mizuho to $270, Citi to $240 Ahead of Q2 Earnings
GLW.content: Corning surged 6.06% on July 21 as Mizuho raised to $270 (Outperform), Citi to $240 (Buy), and Oppenheimer to $230 (Outperform), all citing accelerating AI-driven optical fiber and data center infrastructure demand ahead of July 28 Q2 earnings.

GLW.title: Morgan Stanley: Corning Q2 Earnings Not Expected to Be a 'Large Catalyst'; Maintains Equal Weight
GLW.content: Morgan Stanley maintained its Equal Weight rating with a $180 price target on Corning ahead of July 28 Q2 earnings, cautioning results are unlikely to be a major stock catalyst; the firm sees modest optical revenue upside but notes sold-out optical capacity constrains near-term growth, with H2 optical ramp-up discussions more relevant than Q2 itself.

GLW.title: Corning Q2 2026 Earnings Pre-Market; Raises Springboard Plan to $11B Incremental Revenue Target by 2028
GLW.content: Corning reported Q2 2026 results before market open on July 28 (consensus: EPS $0.76, revenue ~$4.6B). The company raised its Springboard Plan annualized revenue target to $11B in incremental sales by end-2028, up from the prior $8B goal, and lifted its 2026 internal growth target to $6.5B.

GLW.title: Corning Q2 Earnings Preview: Options Imply Up to 10% Move; AI Fiber Optic Demand in Focus
