Prior Q2 FY2026: Revenue $1.57B (+40% YoY), EPS $1.64 (+290% YoY), FY2026 guide $5.9-6.3B. Q3 FY2026 earnings expected; analyst consensus projects EPS $1.45 (+253.7% YoY) on continued AI networking demand.

CIEN.title: Needham Reiterates Buy on Ciena at $600; Verizon-Google Dark Fiber Project Seen Adding $100M+ Revenue
CIEN.content: Needham reiterated Buy on CIEN with $600 price target, citing $100M+ revenue opportunity from Verizon winning a Google dark fiber project. CIEN shares fell 7.1% on July 29 in sympathy with the broader optical sector selloff. Q3 FY2026 earnings due September 3; guidance: $1.625B (+/-$50M).

CSCO.title: Cisco Unveils Cloud Control Agentic AI Platform for Critical IT Infrastructure at Cisco Live US
CSCO.content: Cisco launched Cisco Cloud Control at Cisco Live US — a unified management platform for humans and AI agents to manage critical IT infrastructure. Supports AgenticOps model with centralized networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. Also announced Live Protect runtime security and Quantum Ready Assessments.

CSCO.title: Cisco Q2 FY2026: $2.1B AI Infrastructure Orders in One Quarter (= All of FY2025); Full-Year AI Outlook Raised to >$5B
CSCO.content: Cisco Q2 FY2026: $2.1B in AI infrastructure orders in a single quarter — equal to all of FY2025 combined — raising full-year AI infrastructure order outlook to >$5B. Silicon One ASIC adoption and data center networking demand driving acceleration. Splunk added 500 new logos in H1 FY26. Q3 FY2026 results scheduled May 13.

CSCO.title: Cisco Q3 FY2026 Earnings Today (May 13): Revenue Guide $15.4-15.6B; AI Orders Trajectory Toward >$5B Full-Year Key
CSCO.content: Cisco reports Q3 FY2026 (ended April 25) after close May 13. Mgmt guided $15.4-15.6B revenue and adj EPS $1.02-1.04 — above prior Street consensus. Key watch: AI infrastructure orders vs Q2's $2.1B pace (toward >$5B full-year target); ~$3B of that order book converting to hyperscaler revenue in FY26. Options pricing ~10% implied move. Silicon One AI ASIC adoption, Splunk security integration, and gross margin management in focus.

CSCO.title: Cisco Q3 FY2026: Revenue $15.84B (+12% YoY) Beats; Stock +15%; Hyperscaler AI Orders >2x YoY; Q4 Guide $16.7-16.9B
CSCO.content: Cisco Q3 FY2026 (ended April 25): revenue $15.84B beat $15.56B est (+12% YoY), adj EPS $1.06 beat $1.04 est. Product orders +35% YoY; hyperscaler AI orders more than doubled. CSCO jumped 15-17% on May 14 — largest single-day gain in 14 years. Q4 guide: revenue $16.7-16.9B, adj EPS $1.16-$1.18. Restructuring: <4,000 job cuts (<5% workforce).

CSCO.title: Cisco Q3 FY2026 Earnings Presentation: Record $15.8B Revenue +12% YoY; Shares Surged 13.4% Post-Earnings
CSCO.content: Cisco Q3 FY2026 (ended Apr 25): revenue $15.8B (+12% YoY, record), Product revenue +17%, AI infrastructure and campus networking led growth. GAAP EPS $0.85, non-GAAP $1.06 vs $1.00 est. Q4 guidance $16.7-16.9B. Cutting <4,000 jobs (<5%).

CSCO.title: Bank of America Raises Cisco Target to $135 from $114; $1B+ Acacia AI Optics Orders; Cisco Leads 800G with 50% Market Share
CSCO.content: BofA raised Cisco target to $135 (from $114), maintaining Buy. Cisco reported $1B+ in Acacia orders; AI-related optics surged ~4x to ~$950M. Cisco leads the 800G AI optics segment with >50% market share. 800G technology expected to account for 35.5% of optical market in 2026, up from 4.6% in 2025.

CSCO.title: Cisco Hits Record High $127 (+5%) at Cisco Live U.S.; AI Cloud Control Platform Launched; FY2026 AI Orders Target Raised to $9B (4x YoY)
CSCO.content: Cisco shares surged 5% to record high ~$127 on June 2 at Cisco Live U.S. Major launches: Cisco Cloud Control (AI + human unified management platform), Live Protect (automated security patches), and quantum-safe portfolio upgrades. Cisco raised its FY2026 AI infrastructure orders target to $9B (4x prior year), with $5.3B already accumulated YTD. CSCO is up ~65% year-to-date.

CSCO.title: Cisco Unveils Cloud Control Agentic AI Platform and Quantum-Safe Security at Cisco Live 2026 in Las Vegas
CSCO.content: At Cisco Live 2026, Cisco launched Cloud Control, a unified agentic AI platform for joint human-AI management of IT infrastructure, alongside quantum-safe security upgrades and Managed Secure Service Edge solution. GA July 2026.

CSCO.title: Bank of America Raises Cisco Price Target to $150, Maintains Buy on AI Networking Momentum
CSCO.content: BofA raised Cisco price target to $150 while maintaining Buy, citing AI networking momentum and strong FY2026 revenue of $15.8B (+12% YoY) with $9B AI infrastructure order target.

CSCO.title: Cisco Launches Cloud Control Agentic Platform at Cisco Live 2026 — Unified AgenticOps with 50+ Integrations
CSCO.content: Cisco Cloud Control, entering Controlled Availability on June 2, is a unified AgenticOps platform where human operators and AI agents co-manage IT infrastructure. Includes Cisco IQ, Agentic Actions for Meraki, and Cloud Control Studio with 50+ third-party integrations via MCP.

CSCO.title: Cisco at BofA 2026 Global Technology Conference: Record Revenue $15.84B Quarter; AI Networking Opportunity
CSCO.content: Cisco management presented at the BofA Global Technology Conference June 4, highlighting AI networking opportunities and a record revenue quarter of $15.84B with adjusted EPS of $1.06.

CSCO.title: Morgan Stanley Raises Cisco Target to $130, Cites AI Front-End Networking Refresh Cycle
CSCO.content: Morgan Stanley maintained Overweight and raised Cisco target from $120 to $130, arguing growing inference workloads are driving an underappreciated front-end infrastructure upgrade cycle.

CSCO.title: U.S. Supreme Court Dismisses Falun Gong Surveillance Lawsuit Against Cisco in 6-3 Ruling, Eliminating Major Legal Liability
CSCO.content: The U.S. Supreme Court voted 6-3 to dismiss a long-running lawsuit alleging Cisco helped China's government surveil and persecute Falun Gong members via its 'Golden Shield' internet surveillance system, ruling the Alien Tort Statute does not allow aiding-and-abetting claims against corporations for overseas human rights abuses.

CSCO.title: Cisco Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.42/Share; Ex-Dividend Date July 6, Payment Date July 22, 2026
CSCO.content: Cisco Systems declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.42 per share, ex-dividend date July 6, 2026, payable July 22 to shareholders of record as of July 8. Dividend yield approximately 1.1% annualized at current price.

CSCO.title: Cisco Eyes SentinelOne Acquisition to Strengthen AI-Focused Cybersecurity Portfolio; SentinelOne Holds FedRAMP High Authorization
CSCO.content: Cisco reported as a leading acquisition candidate for SentinelOne; deal would bolster Cisco's security revenue, which was flat in recent quarters, with AI-native cybersecurity capabilities.

CSCO.title: Cisco Pays $0.42/Share Quarterly Dividend on July 22
CSCO.content: Cisco paid its quarterly dividend of $0.42 per common share on July 22, 2026, to stockholders of record as of July 6. The dividend rate is unchanged. 100 shares earns $42/quarter. CSCO has surged ~61% YTD 2026 while continuing to grow the payout, making it a key AI-era dividend stock.

CSCO.title: Price Prediction: Analysts See Cisco Stock Doubling as AI Order Book Fills
CSCO.content: 24/7 Wall St. analysis dated July 20 outlines the bull case for CSCO doubling, anchored by the FY2026 AI infrastructure order target raised to $9B (from $5B initially), with $5.3B already booked YTD, and Q4 FY26 guidance of $16.7–16.9B revenue and $1.16–1.18 non-GAAP EPS. Q4 FY2026 earnings set for August 19.

CSCO.title: JPMorgan Raises Cisco Price Target to $145; Wall Street Broadly Bullish on AI Networking Story
CSCO.content: JPMorgan raised its CSCO price target to $145. HSBC, Morgan Stanley, and BofA also raised targets. Consensus from 28 analysts leans strongly Buy, citing Cisco's AI networking leadership, 25% networking revenue growth to $8.82B in Q3, and total product orders up 35% YoY.

CSCO.title: Cisco Stock Surges 61% YTD 2026: AI Infrastructure Order Book Now 4.5x FY2025 Level
CSCO.content: As of mid-July 2026, Cisco is up 61% YTD, driven by a $9B AI hyperscaler order target (4.5x FY2025), $5.3B already booked. Q4 FY2026 earnings August 19 with EPS forecast $1.17 on revenue of $16.82B. Analysts view Cisco as a rare large-cap AI infrastructure play combining growth with a sustainable dividend.

CSCO.title: Cisco's AI Momentum Faces August Earnings Test — FY26 Hyperscaler AI Orders Guidance Raised to $9B
CSCO.content: Cisco raised its FY26 AI infrastructure order forecast to $9B (from $5B). Q3 FY2026 delivered record revenue of $15.8B (+12% YoY) with $1.3B in quarterly AI orders. Analysts expect Q4 EPS of $1.17 and revenue of $16.82B for earnings due around August 19. CSCO up ~57% YTD.

CSCO.title: Cisco Systems Downgraded to Hold from Buy by Wall Street Zen
CSCO.content: Wall Street Zen downgraded Cisco (CSCO) from Buy to Hold on July 28. CSCO last reported Q3 FY2026 in May with record quarterly revenue of $15.8B, raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $62.8B-$63.0B, and boosted AI infrastructure order outlook from $5B to $9B. Broader analyst consensus remains Buy (26 analysts; avg target ~$127). Next earnings expected August 19, 2026.

PWR.title: Quanta Services Maintains AI Infrastructure Momentum with Record ~$48.5B Backlog
PWR.content: Quanta Services reported Q1 2026 backlog of $48.5B driven by AI data center electrical infrastructure, grid modernization, and electrification projects. A $1B share buyback program and Oppenheimer's $800 Outperform target support positive sentiment.

PWR.title: Quanta Services Q1 2026: Record Revenue $7.87B (+26% YoY); Backlog $48.5B; Raises Full-Year Guide to $34.7-35.2B
PWR.content: Quanta Services Q1 2026: record revenue $7.87B (+26% YoY), adj EPS $2.68 vs $1.78 a year ago, record backlog $48.5B. Raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $34.7-35.2B and adj EPS to $13.55-14.25. Data center grid connection and power transmission line construction driving strong demand.

PWR.title: Quanta Services Stock Gains 4.63% YTD; Data Center Grid Connection Now Majority of Electric Power Revenue at 80%+
PWR.content: Quanta Services Q1 2026 record revenue $7.87B (+26% YoY) with electric power infrastructure accounting for 80%+ of revenue — including data center grid connection, transmission lines, substations, and renewable energy facilities. Raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $34.7-35.2B with adj EPS $13.55-14.25. Analysts expect Quanta revenue and adj EBITDA to grow at 17% and 19% CAGRs from 2025-2028.

PWR.title: Quanta Services Named Top Electrical Infrastructure Play Alongside EMCOR and MasTec for AI Grid Buildout
PWR.content: PWR highlighted as top AI grid/data center EPC play: data center transmission and power interconnect work accelerating. Q1 2026 revenue $7.88B. Backlog visibility strong as hyperscalers commit to multi-year power infrastructure buildouts.

PWR.title: Quanta Services CEO/CFO at Bernstein Strategic Decisions Conference; Data Center Power Grid Buildout Accelerating
PWR.content: Quanta Services CEO Duke Austin and CFO Jayshree Desai participated in Bernstein Strategic Decisions Conference on May 28 (1:30pm ET). Focus on accelerating data center power interconnection work and transmission line construction; power infrastructure backlog for AI data centers remains robust.

PWR.title: Quanta Services Shares Surge ~5% on Strong Q1 2026 Results; Backlog Near $50B, New $1B Buyback Authorized
PWR.content: Q1 2026 results beat expectations with broad-based organic growth. Backlog near $50B driven by grid modernization, renewables, and data center segments. Board authorized new $1B share repurchase program. Stock rose 5% to ~$683 on June 11.

PWR.title: Quanta Services CFO Presents at Truist Securities Industrials Conference; Follow-Up at TD Cowen June 17
PWR.content: CFO Jayshree Desai presented at Truist Securities Industrials and Services Conference June 16, followed by TD Cowen US Corporate Access Day June 17, emphasizing PWR's AI/grid expansion positioning and record backlog.

PWR.title: Quanta Services Announces New $1 Billion Stock Repurchase Program and Quarterly Cash Dividend
PWR.content: Quanta Services announced a new $1 billion stock repurchase program (replacing the prior program) and declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.11 per share, ex-date July 1, 2026 (payable July 13). The buyback signals confidence in future cash flows amid a near-$50 billion backlog driven by AI data center and grid electrification projects.

PWR.title: Mizuho Raises Quanta Services Price Target to $645 from $593, Maintains Buy
PWR.content: Mizuho raised its Quanta Services price target to $645 from $593 ahead of Q2 2026 earnings on July 30. PWR's record Q1 backlog of $48.5B and raised 2026 revenue guidance of $34.7–35.2B support the higher target. AI data center power and grid modernization demand remain key drivers.

PWR.title: Quanta Services Nears Q2 Earnings (July 30) With Near-Record $50B Backlog; UBS Raises Target to $900
PWR.content: Quanta Services Q2 2026 results due July 30 (pre-market). Consensus projects Q2 EPS of $3.29 (+33% YoY) and revenue of $8.53B (+26% YoY). Recent analyst upgrades: UBS raised PT to $900 (Buy), TD Cowen raised to $775 (Buy), Oppenheimer upgraded to Outperform at $800 PT. Near-record backlog approaching $50B driven by AI data center electrification, grid modernization, and renewables buildout.

PWR.title: Quanta Services Q2 2026 Earnings Set for July 30; Analysts Project 32.7% EPS Growth on Surging Grid Demand
PWR.content: Quanta Services (PWR) will release Q2 2026 results before market open July 30. Analysts project EPS of $3.29 (+32.7% YoY) and revenue of $8.53B (+25.9% YoY). Company has beaten estimates four consecutive quarters. Full-year guidance raised to $34.7B-$35.2B revenue and adjusted EBITDA of $3.49B-$3.65B, with $500M-$700M investment to double transformer manufacturing capacity.

PWR.title: Quanta Services Q2 2026: Blowout Beat — EPS $4.24 vs $3.33 Est (+28.9% Surprise), Revenue $9.56B vs $8.70B Est
PWR.content: Quanta Services Q2 2026 adj EPS of $4.24 beat $3.33 consensus. Revenue $9.557B beat $8.699B estimate, up from $6.77B a year ago. Full-year revenue guidance raised to $34.7-35.2B. Driven by grid modernization, AI data center power buildout, and AEP ~$72B transmission program. Management cited $2.4 trillion addressable market through 2030.

EME.title: EMCOR Q1 2026: Record Revenue $4.63B (+20% YoY); Data Center Electrical Revenues +~50%; Raises Full-Year Guide to $18.5-19.25B
EME.content: EMCOR Q1 2026: revenue $4.63B (+19.7% YoY), EPS $6.84 (+30%), beat consensus EPS by 16.9% and revenue by 9.7%. Network & Communications (data center electrical) revenues surged ~50%. Raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $18.5-19.25B and adj EPS to $28.25-29.75.

EME.title: EMCOR Q1 2026: Revenue $4.63B +19.7% YoY, EPS $6.84 +30%; Backlog $15.62B
EME.content: EMCOR Q1 2026: Revenue $4.63B (+19.7% YoY), EPS $6.84 (+30%), backlog $15.62B. Data center mechanical/electrical construction driving strength across industrial and commercial segments.

EME.title: EMCOR Group +82% YTD 2026; Electrical and Mechanical Data Center Contracting Drives Infrastructure Supercycle
EME.content: EMCOR Group shares rose approximately 82% YTD in 2026, driven by strong AI data center electrical and mechanical EPC contracting demand. EMCOR focuses on electrical, mechanical and building services, with growing data center, manufacturing and specialty contracting. Quanta Services (PWR) similarly up ~82% YTD. Infrastructure supercycle driven by AI capex accelerating.

EME.title: EMCOR Raises FY2026 Revenue Guidance to $18.5–19.25B; Q1 EPS Up 30% YoY
EME.content: Raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance from $17.75–18.50B to $18.50–19.25B. Q1 2026: EPS $6.86 (vs. $5.27 prior year), revenue $4.63B (+20% YoY), net income $305.5M (+27% YoY).

EME.title: EMCOR Group Competing for Hyperscaler AI Data Center Projects; Data Center Construction Boom Drives Electrical & Mechanical Demand
EME.content: EMCOR Group (EME) is benefiting from the AI data center and semiconductor manufacturing construction boom, competing alongside Comfort Systems, Quanta Services, and others for high-margin hyperscaler electrical and mechanical facility projects across the U.S.

EME.title: EMCOR Raises FY2026 Revenue Guidance to $18.5B–$19.25B After Record Q1 $4.63B (+19.7% YoY)
EME.content: EMCOR raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $18.5-19.25B (from $17.75-18.5B) on record Q1 revenue $4.63B (+19.7% YoY), EPS $6.86. Remaining performance obligations $15.62B (+32.9% YoY). Growth driven by AI data center electrical and mechanical construction.

EME.title: EMCOR Declares $0.40 Quarterly Dividend and Raises FY2026 Revenue Guidance on AI Data Center Backlog
EME.content: EMCOR Group declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per share payable July 31, 2026, and raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $18.5–19.25 billion, citing record electrical construction backlog driven by AI data center, grid modernization, and semiconductor fab infrastructure projects.

EME.title: EMCOR Q1 2026 Electrical Revenue Hits Record $1.45B (+33% YoY); Network & Communications Revenue +50% on AI Data Center Hyperscaler Investment
EME.content: EMCOR's network and communications segment surged ~50% as hyperscalers and enterprises accelerated AI infrastructure buildout; remaining performance obligations hit record $15.62B; Q2 earnings expected late July.

EME.title: EMCOR Group (EME) Sets Revenue Records As AI Data Center Demand Builds Backlog
EME.content: EMCOR's Q1 2026 revenues hit a quarterly record of $4.63B (+19.7% YoY). Analysts highlight growing backlog driven by AI data center construction and industrial electrification. Q2 earnings due July 30; consensus EPS $7.33 on revenue $4.74B. Stock returned -10.4% over the past month despite strong fundamentals.

EME.title: How EMCOR Group (EME) Narrative Is Shifting With Upgraded Guidance And Analyst Optimism
EME.content: Multiple analysts including UBS, Stifel, DA Davidson and Baird have raised price targets on EME ahead of July 30 Q2 earnings. Analyst consensus: 81% Buy among 14 analysts, avg PT $863.68. Stock trading near $924.90. Commentary centers on upgraded guidance and sustained data center construction demand.

EME.title: EMCOR Group Q2 2026 Earnings Set for July 30; Consensus EPS Revised Up to $7.23 on Data Center Strength
EME.content: EMCOR Group (EME) will release Q2 2026 earnings before market open July 30, with a conference call at 10:30 a.m. EDT. Analyst consensus is $7.23 EPS (+7.6% YoY) and $4.71B revenue; estimate was revised up from $7.02 over the past 60 days. FY2026 EPS guidance remains $28.25-$29.75. Quarterly dividend of $0.40/share payable July 31.

EME.title: EMCOR Q2 2026: Record RPOs $17.14B (+44% YoY), EPS $9.06 Beats $7.23 Est (+25% Surprise); Stock Jumps 18%
EME.content: EMCOR Q2 2026 revenue $5.15B (+20% YoY) beat $4.73B est. Adj EPS $9.06 beat $7.23 consensus (+25.3% surprise). Remaining performance obligations hit a record $17.14B (+44% YoY). AI/data center construction drove results across all segments. FY2026 guidance raised to $32-33.25 adj EPS and $20-20.5B revenue. Stock rose 18.42%.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems Q1 2026: Revenue +56% to $2.9B; EPS Beats by 55%; Record GM 26.3%; Backlog $12.45B; Full-Year Guide $10.93B
FIX.content: Comfort Systems Q1 2026: EPS $10.51 beat estimates by 55%; revenue $2.9B beat by ~21%; same-store revenue +51% driven by data center HVAC construction demand; gross margin all-time high 26.3%. Backlog $12.45B; guided FY2026 revenue to $10.93B with mid-to-high 20% same-store growth.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems Q1 2026: Revenue $2.87B +57% YoY, EPS $10.51; Backlog $12.45B Record
FIX.content: FIX Q1 2026: Net income $370.4M ($10.51/share) vs $169.3M ($4.75) prior year; Revenue $2.87B vs $1.83B. Backlog $12.45B as of March 31. Data center HVAC/mechanical work driving exceptional growth.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems 2026: Technology/Data Center Now 56% of Revenue; Gross Margin 26.3%; FIX Stock +113% YTD
FIX.content: Comfort Systems Q1 2026: technology/data center projects reached 56% of quarterly revenue (highest ever). Gross margin expanded to 26.3% from 22% YoY; operating margin 17%. Expanding modular capacity to 4M sq ft by end of 2026. FIX stock +113.5% YTD — AI data center HVAC construction driving extraordinary growth. Largest backlog in company history.

FIX.title: Erste Group Initiates Comfort Systems USA at Buy; Cites Mid-to-High 20% Sales Growth Outlook and Record $8.1B Backlog
FIX.content: Erste Group initiated coverage with Buy rating, noting management guidance for mid-to-high 20% sales growth in 2026 driven by hyperscale data centers and semiconductor fab customers. Record backlog $8.1B (+37% same-store YoY).

FIX.title: Comfort Systems Q1 2026 Earnings More Than Doubled; Record Backlog; Shares Up 96% YTD on Data Center Boom
FIX.content: Comfort Systems (FIX) Q1 2026 earnings more than doubled year-over-year with record backlog levels, driven by AI data center, semiconductor manufacturing, and industrial construction demand. Shares up 96.2% YTD as backlog growth and estimate revisions continue upward.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems USA Backlog Nearly Doubles to $12B on AI Data Center and HVAC Demand
FIX.content: Comfort Systems USA's backlog reached a record ~$12B, doubling YoY, driven by hyperscaler data center and AI-related HVAC/mechanical projects. Management notes supply constraints, not demand, are the primary growth governor.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems USA Names Craig Sasser as COO and Briston Blair as Chief Strategy & Innovation Officer, Both Effective July 1, 2026
FIX.content: Comfort Systems USA named Craig Sasser (Regional VP, Atlantic Region) as COO effective July 1 with a $600,000 base salary, alongside Briston Blair's appointment as Chief Strategy & Innovation Officer, aimed at scaling AI data center HVAC infrastructure capabilities.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems USA Q2 2026 Earnings Coming Late July; Backlog Near $12B as AI Data Center HVAC and Modular Construction Demand Accelerates
FIX.content: Comfort Systems riding AI infrastructure wave; Q1 2026 CapEx jumped 564% to $147M to expand modular construction capabilities; backlog nearly doubled to $12B; Q2 earnings expected late July.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems USA Q2 2026 Earnings Preview — July 24, Street Expects $10.46 EPS
FIX.content: Consensus among 9 analysts: Q2 2026 EPS $10.46 (up ~60% from $6.53 YoY) on revenue $2.99B. FIX reports after market close July 23; conference call July 24. $12.45B backlog nearly doubled YoY. Same-store revenue growth guided to mid-to-high 20% for 2026. Stock up 94.2% YTD at ~$1,948.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems USA Announces Second Quarter 2026 Conference Call: July 24
FIX.content: Comfort Systems scheduled Q2 2026 earnings conference call for July 24 at 10:00 a.m. CT. Results released after close July 23. New COO Craig Sasser (effective July 1) and Chief Strategy & Innovation Officer Briston Blair will participate. Company highlighted $12.5B project backlog across MEP and data center services.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems USA (FIX) Drew Fresh Analyst Interest, Is The Stock Fully Priced?
FIX.content: Analysts revising targets ahead of July 23 earnings. FIX trading at 35.3x forward earnings. Bulls cite $12.5B backlog and doubling of MEP demand for data centers and industrial electrification. Bears question premium valuation. At least one target raised to $2,000 based on backlog visibility and execution track record.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems USA (FIX) to Report Q2 2026 Earnings on July 23; Analysts Expect EPS of $10.38 (+59% YoY)
FIX.content: Comfort Systems USA will release Q2 2026 earnings after market close on July 23, with a conference call on July 24 at 11:00 AM ET. Analysts expect EPS of $10.38 (up 59% YoY from $6.53) and revenue of $2.94B (up ~35% YoY). Q1 2026 results crushed estimates by 46% on EPS, driven by data centers dominating the backlog.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems (FIX) To Report Earnings Tomorrow: Analysts Watching Gross Margin for Data Center HVAC Demand Signal
FIX.content: Pre-earnings analysis ahead of FIX Q2 2026 results on July 23. Data centers continue to dominate Comfort Systems' pipeline and backlog, underpinning 59% expected EPS growth and 35% revenue growth. Key metric: gross margin — if it holds at or above 25%, it confirms structural margin expansion. Company has beaten consensus in each of the last four quarters.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems USA Reports Strong Q2 2026 Earnings: EPS $12.53 Beats by $2.11, Revenue +50.7% YoY
FIX.content: Comfort Systems posted Q2 2026 EPS of $12.53 (beat by $2.11) on revenue of $3.27B (+50.7% YoY vs. $2.99B estimate). Data center technology demand drove 43.8% same-store growth and remaining performance obligations hit $14.06B.

FIX.title: Comfort Systems USA Q2 2026 Earnings Crush Estimates: Revenue +50.7% YoY, Backlog +73% to $14.06B
FIX.content: FIX reported Q2 EPS of $12.53 (beat by $2.11) on revenue of $3.27B (+50.7% YoY, exceeding estimates by $280M), with operating margin expanding to 17.1% from 13.8% and backlog surging 73.2% YoY to $14.06B driven by data center and semiconductor demand.

FIX.title: UBS Raises Comfort Systems USA Price Target to $2,225 After Record Q2 Beat and $4.9B Orders
FIX.content: UBS raised FIX price target to $2,225 from $2,125 (Buy) following Q2 2026 results: revenue $3.27B (+50% YoY), EPS $12.53 beat by $2.11, orders $4.9B vs ~$3.7B expected, backlog hit $14.1B (+73% YoY). UBS lifted 2026E EPS to $49.10 and 2027E to $60.64. Dividend raised to $0.90/share.

FIX.title: William Blair Issues Buy Rating on Comfort Systems USA; Sees Street Estimates as Too Low
FIX.content: William Blair analyst Tim Mulrooney issued Buy on FIX post-Q2 earnings, saying the scale of outperformance—record $14.1B backlog, $1.1B operating cash flow, 50% revenue growth—should prompt meaningful upward revisions to 2026-2027 Street estimates.

FIX.title: UBS and KeyBanc Raise Comfort Systems USA Price Targets After Record Q2 2026 Earnings
FIX.content: Following Comfort Systems USA's Q2 2026 blowout (revenue $3.27B, +50.7% YoY; EPS $12.53, +92% YoY; first-ever $3B+ revenue quarter), UBS raised its price target to $2,225 and KeyBanc raised to $2,110. Record backlog of $14.1B (+73.2% YoY). Company raised quarterly dividend to $0.90/share.

MOD.title: Modine Manufacturing Announces $4 Billion AI Data Center Cooling Deal with Hyperscaler for 2027-2029
MOD.content: Modine Manufacturing disclosed a long-term AI data center cooling agreement expected to generate over $4B in sales between 2027-2029, including a $165M upfront payment for manufacturing capacity expansion. Deal is with an existing hyperscaler customer for Airedale cooling solutions. Stock up 10%.

MOD.title: Modine Manufacturing Q3 FY2026: Data Center Cooling Sales +78% YoY; Raises FY2026 Guide to 40-45% Climate Solutions Growth
MOD.content: Modine Q3 FY2026 (ended Dec 31, 2025): net sales +31% YoY to $805M; data center cooling +78% YoY. Four new chiller production lines commissioned with four more planned Q4. Raised FY2026 guidance to Climate Solutions growth 40-45% and total data center sales >70% growth. Q4 FY2026 (fiscal year end Mar 31) results due May 22, 2026.

MOD.title: Modine Q4 FY2026 Results Due May 26; Data Center Cooling Sales >70% Growth Expected for FY2026
MOD.content: Modine Manufacturing will host its Q4 FY2026 (ended March 31, 2026) earnings conference call May 27 at 9:00 AM CT; results released after market close May 26. Management previously raised FY2026 guidance projecting total sales +20-25%, Climate Solutions revenue +40-45%, and data center cooling sales growth in excess of 70%. Adjusted EBITDA target raised to $455-475M. Four new chiller production lines commissioned in Q3; four more planned.

MOD.title: Modine Manufacturing FQ4 FY2026 Earnings Expected Late May; Data Center Liquid Cooling Demand Intact
MOD.content: MOD FQ4 FY2026 earnings expected late May. FQ3 (Oct-Dec 25) NM -3.8% included impairment/restructuring charges. Data center thermal/liquid cooling business remains key growth driver as AI GPU clusters demand immersion cooling solutions.

MOD.title: Modine -7.5% on Nvidia Vera Rubin "Hot Water Cooling, No Chillers" Reveal; FQ4 Earnings Still Pending
MOD.content: Modine Manufacturing fell 7.5% on May 20 after Nvidia announced Vera Rubin GPU platforms maintain hot-water cooling loop architecture instead of chiller-based systems, implying reduced demand for large HVAC chiller equipment in AI data centers. Modine FQ4 (Jan-Mar 2026) earnings still pending, expected late May 2026.

MOD.title: Modine Q4 FY2026 Results Released Today May 26; Earnings Conference Call May 27 at 9AM CT
MOD.content: Modine Manufacturing Q4 FY2026 (fiscal year ended March 31, 2026) financial results released after market close May 26, 2026. Management (CEO Neil Brinker and CFO Michael Lucareli) to host earnings conference call May 27 at 9:00 AM CT. FY2026 guidance projected: total sales +20-25%, Climate Solutions revenue +40-45%, data center cooling sales >70% growth, adjusted EBITDA $455-475M. Q3 FY2026 showed data center cooling +78% YoY; four new chiller production lines commissioned.

MOD.title: Modine Q4 FY2026 Record: Net Sales $954.4M (+47%), Adj EPS $1.71 (+53%); $4B Hyperscale Chiller Deal; TurboChill 3+MW Unveiled
MOD.content: Modine Q4 FY2026 (ended Mar 31, 2026): net sales $954.4M (+47% YoY), adj EBITDA $146.1M (+40%), adj EPS $1.71 (+53%). FY2026 full year: net sales $3,181.1M (+23%), adj EBITDA $471.0M (+20%), adj EPS $5.02; GAAP EPS $2.26 impacted by $116.1M non-cash pension charge. FY2027 guidance: net sales +20-35%, EBITDA $650-680M. Signed $4 billion long-term chiller capacity agreement with a major hyperscale customer for 2027-2029 delivery; customer paid $165M upfront. Unveiled TurboChill 3+MW air-cooled chiller unit for AI data centers. Elevating Data Center Cooling to a standalone business division.

MOD.title: Modine Manufacturing Q4 FY2026 Record Results: Revenue +47% YoY, Data Center Sales +158%
MOD.content: Modine reported record Q4 FY2026 net sales of $954.4M (+47% YoY), adjusted EPS $1.71 (+53% YoY). Data center sales within Climate Solutions surged 158% in Q4 (to $246M) and 73% for full year (to $1.1B). FY2027 guidance: EPS growth >40%.

MOD.title: Modine Manufacturing Wins $4B+ AI Data Center Cooling Contract Through 2029; Records FY2026 Results
MOD.content: Announced long-term AI data center cooling agreement expected to generate $4B+ in sales from 2027–2029, including $165M upfront payment for capacity expansion. FY2026 record quarterly net sales $954.4M (+47% YoY). FY2027 guidance: +20–35% revenue growth.

MOD.title: Modine Manufacturing Thermal Solutions Positioned for AI Data Center Liquid Cooling Wave; Climate Solutions Growth Accelerating
MOD.content: Modine Manufacturing (MOD) is positioning its thermal management and climate solutions for AI data center liquid cooling demand. The company's data center segment benefits alongside competitors Vertiv and Eaton from surging hyperscaler cooling infrastructure build-out.

MOD.title: Roth Capital Raises Modine PT to $341 Following $4B Airedale Data Center Cooling Deal
MOD.content: Roth Capital raised Modine PT to $341 (Buy, 22% upside) following Modine's $4B long-term capacity agreement (2027-2029) with an undisclosed data center customer for Airedale cooling solutions, including $165M upfront for manufacturing expansion. FY2027 guidance: net sales growth 20-35%.

MOD.title: Modine Gains As Investors Revisit Data Center Growth Story Ahead Of Earnings
MOD.content: MOD moving higher as investors refocus on data center cooling thesis ahead of Q1 FY2027 earnings on July 29. Q4 FY2026 data center revenues exceeded $400M in a single quarter (+78% YoY). Company holds a $4B long-term data center cooling supply agreement. Analyst PT raised from $263 to $325.

MOD.title: Modine Manufacturing (MOD) Valuation Check After Data Center Pivot And Planned Performance Technologies Spin-Off
MOD.content: Modine spinning off Performance Technologies via merger with Gentherm (Q4 2026 target). Modine shareholders to receive ~21M Gentherm shares (~$790M equity) plus $210M cash. Post-spin, Modine becomes a pure-play data center and thermal cooling company. Q1 FY2027 results due July 29; analyst fair value revised to $265.57.

MOD.title: Why The Modine (MOD) Investment Story Is Shifting With Data Center Deals And New Guidance
MOD.content: Q4 FY2026: EPS $1.71 (beat $1.51 est), revenue $954.4M (beat $907M est), +47% YoY. FY2026 Climate Solutions organic growth +32%. Modine is shedding its auto-adjacent segment to focus entirely on AI data center cooling. MOD up 89% YTD. Q1 FY2027 earnings July 29 are the next catalyst.

MOD.title: Modine Manufacturing Splits Into Three Segments: Data Centers, Commercial HVAC, and Performance Technologies; Reaffirms Gentherm Spin-Off
MOD.content: Modine reorganized its Climate Solutions segment into two distinct units — Data Centers and Commercial HVAC — effective April 1, 2026, to be reported separately from fiscal Q1 2027. Reaffirmed plans to spin off Performance Technologies and combine with Gentherm via a Reverse Morris Trust transaction, expected to close by end of calendar 2026.

MOD.title: Modine Manufacturing Files 8-K on Segment Restructuring and Reporting Change
MOD.content: SEC 8-K filing disclosing Modine's reorganization of Climate Solutions into Data Centers and Commercial HVAC reporting units, effective April 1, 2026. Beginning fiscal Q1 2027, results will be reported across three segments: Data Centers, Commercial HVAC, and Performance Technologies.

MOD.title: Modine Manufacturing Releases Q1 Fiscal 2027 Earnings After Market Close
MOD.content: Modine Manufacturing reported Q1 fiscal 2027 results after market close on July 29, 2026. Pre-report consensus estimates were EPS of $1.38 and revenue of $895.51M, implying ~30% YoY bottom-line growth and ~31% top-line growth. Full fiscal 2027 guidance targets 20-35% total sales growth and 38-44% adjusted EBITDA growth.

MOD.title: Modine Q1 FY2027: EPS $1.53 Beats $1.38 Est, Revenue $874.1M (+28% YoY); Data Centers and Commercial HVAC Drive Growth
MOD.content: Modine Q1 FY2027 (ended June 2026): EPS $1.53 (beat $1.38 by $0.15), Revenue $874.1M (+28% YoY from $682.8M). Growth driven primarily by Data Centers and Commercial HVAC segments, partially offset by lower Performance Technologies sales. Modine's AI data center thermal management positioning drives organic growth.

MOD.title: Modine Manufacturing Q2 FY2026: Revenue +28% to $874M, EPS $1.53 Beats $1.34; Data Center and HVAC Segments Lead
MOD.content: Modine Q2 FY2026 net sales $874.1M (+28% YoY). Net earnings $74.3M (+44% YoY). Adj EPS $1.53 beat $1.34 consensus. Growth driven by Data Centers and Commercial HVAC segments. Full-year sales guidance raised.

TT.title: Trane Technologies Q1 2026: Revenue $4.97B Beat; Acquires Stellar Energy (Data Center Cooling) for $553M; Raises Full-Year Guide
TT.content: Trane Q1 2026: revenue $4.97B beat $4.81B estimate; adj EPS $2.63 topped $2.53; Americas Commercial HVAC bookings +~40%; record backlog $10.7B (+30%+ from year-end). Acquired data center cooling provider Stellar Energy for ~$553M. Raised FY2026 revenue growth guidance to ~9.5%, adj EPS $14.75-14.95.

TT.title: Trane Technologies Presents at Bank of America Industrials Conference; Morgan Stanley Raises PT to $565 on Data Center HVAC Demand
TT.content: Trane Technologies management presented at the Bank of America Industrials, Transportation & Airlines Key Leaders Conference (May 13). Morgan Stanley raised PT to $565 from $535. Multiple firms lifted targets May 1-4 (Evercore, Mizuho, Oppenheimer, KeyBanc). Trane Technologies acquired Stellar Energy for ~$553M to deepen data center cooling capabilities. Q1 EPS $2.63 beat; raised FY26 adj EPS to $14.75-14.95.

TT.title: Trane Technologies Q1 2026: Record Bookings $6.7B +27%; Data Center Backlog $10.7B; Acquires Liquidstack
TT.content: Trane Q1 2026: Total bookings record $6.7B (+27%), backlog $10.7B (+30% vs year-end 2025). Customer lead times stretched 12-18 months. Closed Liquidstack acquisition for two-phase liquid cooling market entry.

TT.title: Trane Technologies -5.3% on Nvidia Vera Rubin Cooling Architecture Announcement; Chiller Demand Narrative Challenged
TT.content: Trane Technologies fell 5.3% on May 20 after Nvidia CEO revealed Vera Rubin GPUs use direct hot-water cooling loops that bypass traditional chilled-water HVAC systems. Raises questions about long-term demand for large data center air chillers. Sector-wide HVAC selloff. TT's Q1 2026 bookings for data center HVAC had been strong prior to this announcement.

TT.title: Trane Technologies Names Donald Simmons as EVP and Chief Operating Officer Effective July 1
TT.content: Donald Simmons, currently Group President for the Americas, elevated to EVP and COO effective July 1, 2026 as the company accelerates its data center cooling push following Q1 2026 acquisitions of Stellar Energy Digital ($553M) and LiquidStack.

TT.title: Nvidia Liquid Cooling Data Center Push Raises Disruption Concerns for Traditional HVAC; TT and JCI Shares Dip
TT.content: Nvidia's advanced liquid cooling innovations for AI data centers raised investor concerns about potential disruption to traditional HVAC equipment suppliers like Trane Technologies (TT) and Johnson Controls (JCI). Both stocks saw mild pressure as analysts reassess long-term market share dynamics.

TT.title: Trane Technologies Declares $1.05/Share Dividend; Names Donny Simmons as New COO Effective July 1
TT.content: Trane declared $1.05/share quarterly dividend (payable June 30). Named Donny Simmons as COO effective July 1. Completed Stellar Energy Americas (data center cooling) and LiquidStack (liquid-to-chip cooling) acquisitions. FY2026 guidance: ~9.5% revenue growth, adjusted EPS $14.75-14.95 on $10.7B record backlog.

TT.title: Trane Technologies Q2 2026 Earnings Conference Call Scheduled for July 30; Data Center HVAC Demand Remains Primary Growth Driver
TT.content: Trane Technologies schedules Q2 2026 earnings call for July 30 at 10 AM ET; AI data center HVAC and precision cooling demand is primary near-term revenue driver alongside commercial building efficiency.

TT.title: Trane Technologies Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
TT.content: Trane Technologies will host Q2 2026 earnings conference call on July 30, 2026 at 10 a.m. ET. Q1 2026 EPS was $2.63 (beat $2.53 consensus). TT raised full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance to ~9.5%; GAAP EPS guidance $14.75-$14.95. Commercial HVAC demand driven by data center build-out is a primary growth driver.

TT.title: Trane Technologies Quarterly Earnings Preview: What You Need to Know
TT.content: TT to report Q2 2026 on July 30. Analysts expect EPS $4.27 (+10.1% YoY). TT has beaten EPS estimates in each of the last 4 quarters. Key themes: data center HVAC demand booming, LiquidStack immersion cooling acquisition positions TT for AI infrastructure buildout. Immersion cooling slashes water use and power overhead vs. traditional air cooling.

TT.title: Trane Technologies Reports Q2 2026 Earnings Beat Before Market Open; Investor Call at 10am ET
TT.content: Trane Technologies Q2 2026 results released before market open July 30 with an earnings beat. Investor conference call scheduled at 10am ET. Full details available at Trane Technologies investor relations website.

TT.title: Trane Technologies Q2 2026: Revenue $6.35B Beats, Bookings +39%, Record $12.1B Backlog; Full-Year Guidance Raised
TT.content: Trane Technologies Q2 2026 revenue $6.35B (+10.6% YoY) beat $6.20B estimate. Adj EPS $4.31 beat consensus; bookings surged 39% to $7.82B with commercial HVAC bookings +50%, driven by data center buildout. Record backlog of $12.1B. Full-year guidance raised to adj EPS $15.20-15.30 and revenue ~$23.8B.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Q2 FY2026: Orders +30%; Record Backlog $20B; Adj EPS +45% to $1.19; Raises FY2026 Guidance
JCI.content: JCI Q2 FY2026: sales +8% to $6.1B (organic +6%), adj EPS $1.19 (+45% YoY); orders +30% with record $20B backlog driven by data center and technology demand. Raised FY2026 guidance to ~6% organic sales growth and adj EPS ~$4.85.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls AI Factory Reference Design Guide 2.0: Air-Cooled Chillers for 1GW Hyperscale Data Centers
JCI.content: Johnson Controls released its second AI Factory Reference Design Guide covering air-cooled chiller architectures for data centers up to 1GW — targeting hyperscaler AI factories. Guide specifies 220MW cluster designs: 50MW returned to AI factory (energy recovery), 32% annual energy reduction, zero-water operation (saving 12M+ gallons/day), 30% COP improvement with 27% fewer chillers. JCI Q2 FY2026 orders +30%, backlog record $20B.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Q2 FY2026: Data Center BMS Orders Accelerate; HVAC Backlog Grows on AI Buildout
JCI.content: JCI Q2 FY2026 results continue to reflect strong data center Building Management System (BMS) and HVAC demand. Q1 FY2026 revenue $6.14B (+12% YoY), targeting data center AI thermal management as key growth vertical.

JCI.title: JCI -6.2% as Nvidia Vera Rubin "No Chillers Needed" Cooling Announcement Disrupts HVAC Thesis; Alloy Enterprises Acquisition Complete
JCI.content: Johnson Controls fell 6.2% on May 20 after Jensen Huang announced Vera Rubin data center GPUs use hot-water cooling loops without requiring conventional air-cooled chillers. JCI completed acquisition of Alloy Enterprises (advanced thermal management for data centers) on May 13. Sector-wide HVAC selloff: MOD -7.5%, JCI -6.2%, TT -5.3%.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Raises Long-Term Organic Growth Target to High Single Digits at Investor Day; UBS Raises PT to $180
JCI.content: At its Going to Gemba Day investor event, management raised long-term organic growth target to high single digits (from mid-single digits). UBS raised PT to $180 from $170 (Buy). Shares jumped ~6%.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Appoints Irene Esteves (Former Spirit AeroSystems CFO) to Board of Directors
JCI.content: Appointed Irene Esteves (former CFO of Spirit AeroSystems, 25+ years financial leadership) to the board, effective immediately.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Hosts "Going to Gemba Day" Investor Event; CEO Showcases AI-Driven Energy Efficiency Strategy
JCI.content: Johnson Controls held its "Going to Gemba Day" investor event on June 1, 2026, featuring site tours and discussions with CEO Joakim Weidemanis and CFO Marc Vandiepenbeeck on AI integration in building management, energy efficiency, and smart infrastructure for data centers.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Appoints Irene Esteves to Board; Confirms $0.40/Share Quarterly Dividend Payable July 10
JCI.content: Johnson Controls appointed veteran finance executive Irene Esteves to its board of directors, adding financial expertise. The company also confirmed a regular $0.40/share quarterly dividend payable July 10, 2026, continuing JCI's 138-year dividend history.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Ex-Dividend June 15; UBS Raises PT to $180 After Long-Term Growth Target Hiked to High-Single Digits
JCI.content: Johnson Controls traded ex-dividend June 15 ($0.40/share, payable July 10). Following June 1 investor day, JCI raised long-term organic growth target to high-single digits. UBS raised PT to $180 (Buy); shares rose 6% on June 2. FY2026 guidance: ~6% organic sales growth, adjusted EPS ~$4.85.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Schedules Q3 FY2026 Earnings Conference Call for July 29; Q2 FY2026 Beat EPS $1.19 vs $1.12 Estimate
JCI.content: Johnson Controls Q3 FY2026 earnings call on July 29 at 8:30 AM ET; last reported Q2 EPS $1.19 (beat $1.12 estimate by 6.25%); company serves AI data center HVAC and building automation markets.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Stock: Strong Growth, High Data Center Demand, Technical Concerns Loom
JCI.content: Analyst lowers JCI to 'Hold' citing near-term technical chart risks despite attractive PEG ratio and margin expansion trajectory. JCI holds a record $20B backlog with AI-enabled HVAC and smart building solutions. Q3 FY2026 earnings due July 29; consensus EPS $1.32 (+25.7% YoY). UBS separately holds Buy with $180 PT.

JCI.title: What to Expect From Johnson Controls' Next Quarterly Earnings Report
JCI.content: JCI Q3 FY2026 earnings call scheduled July 29 at 8:30 a.m. ET. EPS consensus $1.32 (+25.7% YoY). Company has beaten EPS estimates 4 consecutive quarters. Management raised long-term organic growth target to high single digits at a June 2026 investor event. Smart building and data center HVAC backlog driving results.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Announces Quarterly Dividend
JCI.content: Johnson Controls announced a regular quarterly cash dividend to shareholders ahead of its Q3 FY2026 earnings on July 29. The company continues returning capital while investing in smart building and data center HVAC infrastructure. JCI is positioned for double-digit earnings growth over the next three years per analyst models.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls to Announce Q3 FY2026 Earnings on July 29; Analysts Expect EPS $1.32, Revenue $6.46B
JCI.content: Johnson Controls will release Q3 FY2026 earnings (April–June quarter) before market open on July 29. Analysts expect EPS of $1.32 (up 25.7% from $1.05 YoY) and revenue of $6.46B. Prior Q2 FY2026 beat estimates with adjusted EPS of $1.19 vs. $1.11 expected, raised FY2026 guidance, reported 30% order growth, and reached a record $20 billion backlog driven by data center demand.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Beats Fiscal Q3 2026 Estimates; Raises Long-Term Organic Growth Target to High Single Digits
JCI.content: JCI reported fiscal Q3 2026 earnings before market open July 29, beating analyst consensus of $1.32 adjusted EPS and ~$6.43B revenue. The company raised its long-term organic growth target from mid-single digits to high single digits. Demand is driven by AI/data-center cooling (orders up ~30% organically) and a record $20B backlog.

JCI.title: Johnson Controls Q3 FY2026: Record $20B Backlog, Orders +30% Organic, Adj EPS $1.19 Beats; Guidance Raised
JCI.content: Johnson Controls fiscal Q3 FY2026 revenue $6.1B (+8% YoY, organic +6%). Adj EPS $1.19 beat $1.12 estimate (+45% YoY). Orders rose 30% organically; backlog hit a record $20B (+26% YoY) driven by data center demand. Adj EBIT margin expanded 310 bps to 15.5%. FY26 full-year guidance raised.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Opens First New Power Plant in Over a Decade at TH Wharton, Houston
NRG.content: NRG Energy officially opened its first new power plant in 10+ years — a 456MW natural gas peaker at TH Wharton Generating Station in northwest Harris County, TX. The $617M project received $216M Texas Energy Fund loan. Can power 100,000+ Texas homes during peak demand.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Q1 2026: Revenue $10.26B Post-LS Power Acquisition; EPS $1.49 Misses $2.78 Estimate on Texas Weather Costs
NRG.content: NRG Q1 2026: revenue $10.26B (from $8.59B) following January close of ~$13B LS Power acquisition (13GW gas generation). EPS $1.49 missed $2.78 consensus due to mild Texas weather and Winter Storm Fern supply costs. Reaffirmed 2026 guidance; announced $1B share buyback.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Signs Long-Term 295MW Power Deal for Two Texas AI Data Centers on Company-Owned Sites
NRG.content: NRG signed a long-term 295MW power supply agreement serving two data centers on company-owned Texas sites, part of its strategy to monetize the expanded post-LS Power generation fleet for AI data center demand growth.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Falls 8.8% After Q1 EPS Miss Despite Revenue Beat; LS Power Integration Adds Temporary Cost Pressure
NRG.content: NRG Energy stock fell 8.8% after Q1 2026 EPS of $1.49 missed $2.78 consensus, impacted by mild Texas weather and Winter Storm Fern costs following the $13B LS Power acquisition close. Revenue $10.26B beat $8.64B estimate; FY2026 EPS guidance $7.90-9.90 reaffirmed. Strategy: contracting at least 1GW of data center power deals; Texas 1GW residential VPP by 2035.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Q1 2026: Revenue $10.26B; Data Center PPA Strategy Expands as Power Demand Surges
NRG.content: NRG Q1 2026 revenue $10.26B. Company continues expanding long-term power purchase agreements with hyperscaler data center customers. Retail electricity + gas generation portfolio benefits from AI-driven industrial power demand.

NRG.title: NRG New CEO Robert Gaudette 'Bring Your Own Power' AI Strategy; 445MW Contracted; Fleet Doubles to 25GW After LS Power Acquisition
NRG.content: New CEO Robert Gaudette (took over end of April 2026) unveiled 'bring your own power' (BYOP) model and virtual power plant strategy for hyperscalers, growing contracted data center capacity to 445MW. LS Power acquisition (closed January 2026) doubled NRG's generation fleet to ~25GW (13GW quick-start gas + 6GW CPower demand-response via CPower). Stock +7.1% on May 20 on AI power-demand wave.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Closes ~$10B LS Power Acquisition, Nearly Doubling Generation Portfolio; New CEO Robert Gaudette Takes Over
NRG.content: NRG closed acquisition of 18 natural gas-fired power plants from LS Power for ~$10B, nearly doubling generation capacity. Robert Gaudette became CEO April 30. New CEO focused on 'bring your own power' AI strategy.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Announces 295 MW Long-Term Power Agreement for Texas AI Data Centers; Initial Power H2 2026
NRG.content: NRG Energy signed a 295 MW long-term power purchase agreement to supply two new data center sites in Texas. Initial power delivery is expected in H2 2026, with full operations by 2030. NRG is expanding its data center power franchise beyond traditional retail electricity.

NRG.title: NRG Management Highlights Multi-GW Data Center Pipeline as Upside to Reaffirmed 2026 EBITDA Guide
NRG.content: NRG management noted 25.8 GW generation fleet positions it to capture AI data center demand as pure upside to 2026 guidance ($5.325-5.825B adj. EBITDA). Q1 adj. EPS $1.49 (vs $2.68 prior year, weather-impacted). Infrastructure/interconnection are primary hurdles for new agreements.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Opens First New Power Plant in Over a Decade — 456 MW TH Wharton Natural Gas Station in Texas
NRG.content: NRG Energy opened its 456 MW TH Wharton natural gas generating station in northwest Harris County, Texas — its first new plant in more than 10 years, partly financed by a $216M Texas Energy Fund loan. The plant adds critical dispatchable capacity to the ERCOT grid amid surging AI data center power demand.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Schedules Q2 2026 Earnings for August 4; 415-MW Texas Gas Plant Near Completion
NRG.content: NRG Energy announced Q2 2026 earnings call for August 4, 2026; separately, the company is close to completing a new 415-MW natural gas plant in Texas backed by the Texas Energy Fund, adding dispatchable generation capacity to its portfolio as power demand surges from AI data centers and extreme weather events.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Surges After PJM Accelerates Data Center Reliability Auction; AI Power Demand Forcing Faster U.S. Grid Upgrades
NRG.content: NRG rallied alongside CEG and VST after PJM moved up its reliability auction; NRG has both retail and generation exposure; benefits from elevated power prices driven by AI data center electricity demand.

NRG.title: Scotiabank and Wells Fargo Raise NRG Energy Price Targets Ahead of Q2 Earnings
NRG.content: Multiple analysts raised NRG price targets in mid-July 2026: Scotiabank to $226 (from $223) and Wells Fargo to $209 (from $203); Siebert Williams Shank also added positive coverage. 13 of 16 analysts rate NRG 'Strong Buy.' Q2 2026 EPS consensus stands at $1.83 (+8.9% YoY), with earnings due August 4. Full-year 2026 guidance: adjusted EPS $7.90–$9.90, adjusted net income $1.69B–$2.12B.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Near Completion of 415-MW Texas Gas Plant Backed by Texas Energy Fund
NRG.content: NRG Energy is nearing completion of a 415-MW gas-fired power plant funded through the Texas Energy Fund. The project expands NRG's ~25 GW fleet, which grew significantly with the January 2026 close of the 13 GW LS Power acquisition. NRG also has a 5.4-GW gas development deal with GE Vernova and Kiewit targeting a 2026 next step.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Reports Better-Than-Expected Earnings Results
NRG.content: NRG Energy reported earnings results that beat analyst expectations, reinforcing bullish sentiment ahead of full Q2 2026 disclosure on August 4. The company operates roughly 25 GW of generation assets following the LS Power acquisition and has data center agreements targeting 445 MW of new load by 2032 at retail margins above $25/MWh.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend of $0.475 Per Share
NRG.content: NRG Energy declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.475 per share, payable August 17 to shareholders of record as of August 3. NRG's Q2 2026 earnings are separately scheduled for August 4; analysts expect EPS of $1.83, up approximately 8.9% year-over-year.

NRG.title: NRG Energy Opens 456 MW T.H. Wharton Natural Gas Plant in Houston — First New Plant in Over a Decade
NRG.content: NRG Energy opened its T.H. Wharton Generating Station, a 456 MW two-unit natural gas facility in Houston funded partly by a $216M Texas Energy Fund loan ($360M total capex). NRG's first new generating asset in over a decade, designed to sustain grid reliability during hurricane season and peak demand events.

NRG.title: NRG Energy LS Power Acquisition Share Lock-Up Expires July 30, Potential Overhang
NRG.content: Sellers who received NRG shares in the $6.4B LS Power asset acquisition (closed Jan 30, 2026) face a six-month lock-up expiring July 30, 2026. Q2 2026 earnings scheduled for August 4; consensus EPS $1.78 on $6.06B revenue.

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan Q1 2026: EPS +41% to $0.48; Acquires Monument Pipeline for $505M; Moody's Upgrades to Baa1
KMI.content: KMI Q1 2026: adj EPS +41% YoY to $0.48, revenue +13.8% to $4.83B. Announced and closed $505M acquisition of Monument Pipeline (225-mile Houston-area system) on May 1. Moody's upgraded to Baa1. Long take-or-pay contracts expand Texas intrastate gas network supporting data center generation.

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan Greenlights $7B in New Natural Gas Pipeline Projects for Data Center Power and LNG Export Demand
KMI.content: Kinder Morgan approved $7B in new pipeline projects: MSX (Mississippi Crossing), SSE4 (South System Expansion 4), and Trident Intrastate Pipeline ($1.8B, 219 miles, 2 Bcf/d from Katy to Port Arthur, TX). Projects add ~3.4+ Bcf/d capacity targeting data center power generation growth and LNG export terminals. Total project backlog $9.3B; dividend raised to $1.19/share (9th consecutive annual increase).

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan COO Art Holland Retiring Sept 4; Kenneth Grubb Named Successor
KMI.content: Kinder Morgan announced Chief Operating Officer Art Holland plans to retire effective September 4, 2026. Kenneth W. Grubb appointed as new COO. Company also scheduled Bernstein Strategic Decisions Conference presentation for May 27.

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan: US Natural Gas Demand to Reach 150 Bcf/d by 2031; 153 GW New Gas-Fired DC Power; $10.1B Project Backlog; All 3 Agencies Now BBB+
KMI.content: KMI management projects US natural gas demand to reach 150 Bcf/d by 2031, driven by LNG export ramp and ~153 GW of new gas-fired power generation tied to AI data centers. Project backlog reached $10.1B, bolstered by new data center infrastructure deals. After Moody's upgrade to Baa1 (completed April 2026), KMI is now rated equivalent to BBB+ at all three major credit rating agencies—a credit milestone that lowers funding costs.

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan Extends and Restates $3.5B Revolving Credit Facility to 2031
KMI.content: KMI extended and restated its $3.5B revolving credit facility to 2031 with increased swingline capacity, providing enhanced liquidity as its $10.1B project backlog requires continued capital deployment.

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan $10.1B Backlog Positioned for 153 GW New Gas Generation Surge Driven by Data Centers and LNG
KMI.content: Kinder Morgan's $10.1B project backlog positions it to benefit from an estimated 153 GW of new gas-fired power generation driven by AI data center power demand and rising LNG exports. KMI's extensive natural gas pipeline network benefits from both secular trends.

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan Monument Pipeline $505M Acquisition Expected to Close Q2 2026; $10.1B Project Backlog
KMI.content: Kinder Morgan's $505M Monument Pipeline acquisition (225-mile natural gas system, Houston area) expected to close Q2 2026 at under 8x EBITDA. KMI's $10.1B project backlog supports 41% YoY adjusted EPS growth.

KMI.title: FERC's Proposed Blanket Certificate Expansion Could Accelerate Kinder Morgan's $10.1B Natural Gas Project Backlog
KMI.content: FERC's proposed rulemaking to more than double project cost thresholds for blanket certificates could directly benefit Kinder Morgan, whose $10.1B project backlog is ~92% natural gas. The NOPR could accelerate KMI's Trident, SSE4, and Mississippi Crossing projects by bypassing case-specific FERC approval.

KMI.title: Kinder Morgan's $455M Gulf Coast Express Expansion Fully Ramping, Lifting Waha Hub Natural Gas Prices from Negative Levels
