TER.title: Teradyne and Tokyo Electron Launch Integrated KGD Test Solution for AI and Data Center Chiplets at SWTest 2026
TER.content: Teradyne and Tokyo Electron launched a commercially available integrated known-good-device (KGD) test cell solution at SWTest 2026 (June 8-10), combining Teradyne's UltraFLEXplus test platform with TEL's Prexa SDP singulated device prober for AI and data center device screening within 2.5D and 3D advanced packaging flows.

TER.title: Teradyne Shares Drop 13.6% to $369 in Broad Semiconductor Sector Selloff; Q2 2026 Earnings Scheduled July 29
TER.content: TER fell from $427.34 to $369.09 on July 5 in a semiconductor-sector selloff; Q1 2026 revenue +87% YoY with AI now comprising 70% of revenues; Q2 earnings scheduled July 29.

TER.title: Teradyne Hits All-Time High of $472.37 as Customer Micron Reports 1,400% Net Income Jump
TER.content: TER surged 10.47% to close at a record $471.96 (intraday high $472.37) after key customer Micron Technology reported Q3 FY2026 net income of $28.2B (+1,400% YoY) and revenue of $41.5B (+346% YoY), with Q4 revenue guidance of ~$50B. Micron's AI memory outperformance confirms robust demand for Teradyne's chip-testing equipment. Semiconductor test revenue exceeded $1B in a single quarter for the first time in Q1.

TER.title: Analysts Raise Teradyne Price Targets: UBS to $500, Cantor Fitzgerald to $550, BofA to $525
TER.content: Multiple analysts raised TER PTs ahead of Q2 2026 earnings (scheduled July 28): UBS raised to $500 from $440 (Buy); Cantor Fitzgerald raised to $550 from $400 (Overweight); BofA raised to $525 from $365 (Buy). 18-analyst consensus is Buy. TER Q1 2026 showed record $1.28B revenue (+87% YoY), with ~70% of revenue now tied to AI demand.

TER.title: Teradyne Q2 2026 Earnings Scheduled for July 28; Consensus Expects $2.04 EPS / $1.22B Revenue
TER.content: Teradyne will release Q2 2026 results on July 28 at 4:30 p.m. ET, with the earnings call on July 29 at 8:30 a.m. ET. Analyst consensus: $2.04 EPS and $1.2165B revenue. Q1 2026 beat consensus by $0.45/share ($2.56 actual vs. $2.11 estimate). Stock surged 12.1% in the July 19-22 window, significantly outperforming the tech sector.

TER.title: UBS Raises Teradyne Price Target to $500 from $440, Maintains Buy Rating on AI Testing Demand
TER.content: UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri raised price target on Teradyne to $500 from $440 (Buy maintained), citing AI-driven semiconductor testing demand — with 70% of Q1 2026 revenue tied to AI workloads and 87% from semiconductor testing overall. Stock rose approximately 5% on July 20. Q2 2026 earnings scheduled for July 28.

TER.title: Teradyne Q2 2026 Earnings Beat: EPS $2.56 vs $2.11 Estimate, Revenue $1.28B vs $1.20B Forecast
TER.content: Teradyne released Q2 2026 results after market close on July 28, beating consensus on both lines. EPS of $2.56 exceeded the $2.11 estimate by 21%; revenue of $1.28B beat the $1.20B forecast by ~7%. AI-related demand (~70% of revenue) drove outperformance across compute, networking, and memory test segments.

TER.title: Teradyne Stock at Record High Ahead of July 28 Q2 Report; Micron HBM Demand Key Swing Factor
TER.content: Teradyne shares closed at a record high before its July 28 Q2 2026 earnings. Analysts flagged AI memory test—particularly HBM ramps tied to Micron—as the swing variable for Q3 guidance. Q1 2026 saw semiconductor test segment revenue exceed $1B for the first time.

TER.title: Teradyne Reports Record Q2 2026 Results: Revenue $1.33B (+104% YoY), EPS $2.47 Beats by $0.36, Stock Jumps ~13%
TER.content: Teradyne reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.329B (second consecutive record quarter), up 104% YoY, with Semiconductor Test at $1.122B, Product Test at $107M, and Robotics at $100M. Non-GAAP EPS of $2.47 beat the $2.11 consensus by $0.36. Q3 2026 revenue guidance midpoint of $1.25B was 21% above analyst expectations. Stock surged ~12.6%.

TER.title: Teradyne Issues Q3 2026 Guidance Above Consensus, Highlighting AI Test Push and Tokyo Electron Partnership
TER.content: Teradyne set Q3 2026 EPS guidance of $1.85-$2.15, well above analyst estimates, and highlighted an AI test strategy and partnership with Tokyo Electron as key growth drivers. The strong Semiconductor Test segment ($1.122B) reflects surging demand for AI chip testing infrastructure.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Q1 2026: Revenue +22%; Now Assist ACV Target Raised to $1.5B; Stock Falls 14-17% on Iran War Deal Delay Disclosure
NOW.content: ServiceNow Q1 2026: subscription revenue $3.67B (+22% YoY); raised FY2026 subscription revenue guidance by $205M to $15.735-15.775B; Now Assist ACV target raised $1B to $1.5B. Stock fell 14-17% on disclosure of ~75bps headwind from delayed large on-premise deals in the Middle East due to the Iran war.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Knowledge 2026: Otto AI, Action Fabric, Project Arc (with NVIDIA); $30B Revenue Target by 2030 Set
NOW.content: ServiceNow unveiled at Knowledge 2026 (Las Vegas): Otto enterprise AI experience executing entire business processes; Action Fabric enabling governed actions from external AI systems; Project Arc (with NVIDIA) — autonomous desktop AI agent in early preview; Autonomous Workforce suite completing workflows without human intervention. Set long-term $30B annual subscription revenue target by 2030 (20% CAGR). Now Assist ACV $750M in Q1, targeting $1.5B by year-end.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Q1 2026: cRPO $12.64B +22.5% YoY; 16 Deals >$5M Net New ACV, +80% YoY
NOW.content: NOW Q1 2026 exceeded high end of guidance: cRPO $12.64B (+22.5% YoY). 16 transactions over $5M in net new ACV, +80% YoY. Now Assist (AI workflow) gaining enterprise traction. Upcoming: Q2 FY2026 earnings call.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Launches Autonomous CRM Competing Directly with Salesforce; BofA Reiterates Buy Rating
NOW.content: ServiceNow expanded into autonomous CRM with new customer experience features unveiled at Knowledge 2026 (May 5-7), directly targeting Salesforce's market. Stock jumped ~9% on the AI platform expansion. BofA reiterates Buy on NOW while cautious on CRM. ServiceNow Q1 FY2026 strong. Enterprise AI workflow automation TAM expansion from IT service management into CRM and sales.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Stock Rises to $107 as Snowflake/Salesforce Earnings Reverse Enterprise Software Selloff
NOW.content: ServiceNow (NOW) stock rose to $107.48 on May 28 as Salesforce ($11.1B Q1 revenue, record 34.8% non-GAAP operating margin) and Snowflake (+34% product revenue, AI accounts +49%) earnings reversed fears that AI was displacing enterprise SaaS platforms rather than expanding them.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Up 41% in May 2026; Now Assist Spending Over $1M Grew 130% YoY; FY2026 Revenue Guidance Raised to $15.7B (+21%)
NOW.content: ServiceNow surged 41% in May 2026, among the best-performing enterprise software stocks. Now Assist (AI) deals over $1M grew 130% YoY. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance raised to $15.7B (+21% YoY). ServiceNow surpassed $1B in cumulative transactions through AWS Marketplace. New Control Tower product oversees agentic AI deployments across enterprise clients.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Discloses Security Breach: Unauthenticated REST API Flaw Exposed Customer Instance Data
NOW.content: ServiceNow disclosed attackers exploited a REST API endpoint (patched June 5) to query customer instance tables without credentials. Compromised data may include employee records, IT assets, and incident reports. Stock fell 6.3%.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Launches Autonomous Workforce AI Specialists for IT, CRM, Security at Knowledge 2026
NOW.content: At Knowledge 2026, ServiceNow announced AI specialists for IT, CRM, employee services, security/risk. IT AI specialists available June 2026; security/risk specialists GA September 2026.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Surpasses $1B in AWS Marketplace Transactions, Deepens Platform Partnership
NOW.content: ServiceNow surpassed $1 billion in cumulative AWS Marketplace transactions and expanded its platform partnership with Amazon Web Services.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Lays Off Hundreds of Employees in AI-Driven Restructuring; Stock Down ~30% YTD
NOW.content: ServiceNow is laying off hundreds of employees as part of AI-focused restructuring, investing in AI skills while managing headcount. Stock down ~30% YTD despite strong AI product momentum.

NOW.title: ServiceNow and IBM Expand Strategic AI Collaboration to Unlock Enterprise Data at Scale
NOW.content: ServiceNow and IBM announced expanded strategic collaboration combining IBM's AI and automation capabilities with the ServiceNow AI Platform to remove barriers blocking enterprise AI deployment at scale.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Expands AI Integration with Digimarc Verification Capabilities for AI Governance
NOW.content: Digimarc will enhance provenance and verification tools within ServiceNow, enabling AI agents to cryptographically verify their outputs upon creation, targeting AI governance use cases.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Expands Agentic AI Ecosystem: Wipro Deployment, Digimarc Verification, Microsoft Governance, NVIDIA Desktop Agent
NOW.content: ServiceNow announced a wave of agentic AI partnerships: Wipro deploying ServiceNow workflows enterprise-wide; Digimarc integrating cryptographic verification into AI agents; deeper Microsoft AI governance integration; and Project Arc with NVIDIA — an autonomous desktop AI agent governed through ServiceNow AI Control Tower. Reinforces ServiceNow as the enterprise AI orchestration backbone.

NOW.title: Guggenheim Upgrades ServiceNow to Buy with $125 Price Target; Stock +5% as AI 'SaaSpocalypse' Fears Seen as Overdone
NOW.content: Guggenheim analyst John DiFucci upgraded ServiceNow to Buy from Neutral with a $125 price target (7.5x EV/NTM recurring revenue). Analyst says AI disruption fears have driven SaaS valuations to levels implying perpetual decline. Expects subscription revenue growth to stabilize in 2026 and reaccelerate in 2027. NOW stock rose 5%+ on the upgrade.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Q2 2026 Earnings Preview: Revenue Est $3.92B (+22% YoY), Reports After Close July 22
NOW.content: Q2财报7月22日盘后发布；Zacks共识营收$3.92B(+22% YoY)，EPS $0.86(+4.88% YoY)；Now Assist、AI Control Tower和Autonomous Workforce是主要增长驱动力；Evercore和Bernstein维持跑赢大市评级

NOW.title: ServiceNow Announces Q2 2026 Financial Results After Market Close
NOW.content: ServiceNow releasing Q2 2026 results after market close today. Consensus: $3.92B revenue (+22% YoY), EPS $0.86. NOW has beaten consensus in all four trailing quarters with avg 9.47% upside surprise. Conference call at 2 PM PDT. Key AI drivers: Now Assist, AI Control Tower, Autonomous Workforce platform.

NOW.title: Guggenheim Upgrades ServiceNow to Buy Ahead of Q2 2026 Earnings
NOW.content: Guggenheim upgraded NOW to Buy just before Q2 earnings, citing strong AI platform adoption trends and consistent beat track record. Street expects $3.92B in Q2 revenue.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Stock in the Spotlight: Earnings, Analyst Activity, Technical Picture
NOW.content: Earnings-day spotlight on ServiceNow: strong analyst consensus, AI-native platform momentum (Now Assist, AI Control Tower, Autonomous Workforce), positive technical setup ahead of Q2 2026 report after close.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Reports Q2 2026 Results: Revenue $3.99B Beats Estimates, AI ACV Crosses $1B
NOW.content: ServiceNow reported Q2 2026 revenue of $3.99B (vs. $3.93B consensus), subscription revenue of $3.877B (+24.5% YoY), EPS of $0.90 beating $0.85 estimate. AI ACV crossed $1 billion. cRPO grew 21% YoY to $13.20B; RPO ~$29B (+22% constant currency). 123 transactions over $1M in net new ACV (+~40% YoY). Now Assist customers generating >$1M ACV up 130%+ YoY. Full-year subscription revenue guidance raised to $15.770B (21% YoY growth).

NOW.title: ServiceNow Beats Estimates and Raises Outlook as AI Passes $1B in Bookings
NOW.content: ServiceNow's AI annual contract value crossed $1 billion in Q2 2026. CEO Bill McDermott raised the Now Assist pipeline commitment from $1B to $1.5B; multi-product AI deals grew nearly 70% YoY and shares jumped 4.6% after hours.

NOW.title: Analysts Raise ServiceNow Price Targets Following Strong Q2 AI-Driven Earnings Beat
NOW.content: Multiple analysts increased price targets on ServiceNow after Q2 beat; Jefferies raised target from $135 to $140 maintaining Buy, citing accelerating AI platform adoption with 123 deals over $1M net new ACV (+40% YoY) and best-in-class renewal rates of 98%.

NOW.title: ServiceNow Analysts Raise Price Targets After Q2 Beat; Evercore Hikes to $160
NOW.content: Following ServiceNow's Q2 2026 beat (revenue +24% to $3.987B, EPS beat, AI ACV exceeding $1B), Evercore ISI raised its PT to $160 (Outperform) and BMO Capital raised to $118 (Outperform). Full-year revenue guidance set at $15.735B-$15.775B. Stock had surged 6.9% on earnings day (July 22) before pulling back.

CRM.title: Salesforce FY2026 Results: $41.5B Revenue (+10%); Agentforce $800M ARR (+169%); FY2027 Revenue Guided $45.8-46.2B
CRM.content: Salesforce FY2026: revenue $41.5B (+10% YoY), RPO $72B (+14%). Agentforce ARR reached $800M (+169% YoY) with 29,000 deals closed (+50% QoQ). Combined Agentforce + Data 360 ARR $2.9B (+200%+ YoY). FY2027 revenue guided $45.8-46.2B (+10-11%). Q1 FY2027 earnings scheduled May 27, 2026. Next earnings date approaching.

CRM.title: Fortune: Salesforce Agentforce Converts 20 Trillion Tokens Into 2.4B Agentic Work Units — AI Turns Efficiency Into Revenue
CRM.content: Salesforce reports Agentforce has processed ~20 trillion tokens converting them into 2.4 billion agentic work units — measurable AI-to-business-output productivity gains. CEO Benioff positions Salesforce as leading AI-for-enterprise platform competing directly with Microsoft Copilot. Agentforce vs. Copilot competition intensifying as both target large enterprise AI deployment at scale; Salesforce differentiated by CRM data integration depth.

CRM.title: Salesforce Secures $72M U.S. Air Force Enterprise License Agreement; Q1 FY2027 Earnings on May 27
CRM.content: Salesforce secured a $72M enterprise license agreement with the U.S. Air Force, expanding government AI deployment. Q1 FY2027 results scheduled May 27 after market close. Agentforce ARR grew 330% YoY. Company executing $25B accelerated share repurchase — its largest buyback ever. CRM stock down 30% in 2026 as Citigroup cut PT to $188 (Neutral) on SaaS transition concerns.

CRM.title: Citigroup Cuts Salesforce Target to $188 Ahead of Q1 Earnings; Stock Down 30% YTD on SaaS Transition Concerns
CRM.content: Citigroup lowered its Salesforce price target to $188 (from $200) maintaining Neutral rating, citing concerns over SaaS-to-AI platform transition timing and competitive pressure from Microsoft Copilot. CRM down 30% YTD and 36% over past 12 months despite Agentforce ARR growing 330% YoY. $25B buyback program largest in company history; FY2027 earnings guide $45.8-46.2B. Q1 FY2027 results May 27.

CRM.title: Bank of America Downgrades Salesforce to Underperform with $160 Target Amid AI Monetization Concerns
CRM.content: BofA downgraded CRM to Underperform, $160 target, citing AI monetization concerns and customer growth questions. Salesforce Q1 FY2026: Revenue $9.8B (+8% YoY), guidance raised. Q2 FY2026 earnings due May 27.

CRM.title: Salesforce Q1 FY2027 Earnings May 27: Consensus EPS $3.12 (+20.9% YoY); BofA Cautious Amid ServiceNow CRM Competition
CRM.content: Salesforce reports Q1 FY2027 on May 27. Consensus: EPS $3.12 (+20.9% YoY). BofA reinstated coverage cautiously citing ServiceNow's autonomous CRM expansion as competitive threat. Key metric: Agentforce AI agent adoption and seat expansion. Stock at ~$175. Q2 FY2027 guide will be closely watched for AI monetization signals.

CRM.title: Salesforce Q1 FY2027 Earnings Beat: Revenue $11.1B (+13% YoY); Non-GAAP EPS $3.88 Beats $3.12 Est; Agentforce ARR Tops $1B with 3.8B AI Work Units
CRM.content: Salesforce Q1 FY2027 (ended April 2026): Revenue $11.1B (+13% YoY, includes $444M Informatica contribution); non-GAAP EPS $3.88 beat $3.12 consensus by 24%; GAAP EPS $2.42 (+52% YoY); GAAP OM 21.1%, non-GAAP 34.8%. Agentforce ARR exceeded $1B milestone with 3.8 billion Agentic Work Units delivered. Combined AI+data ARR $3.4B. CRPO $33.6B (+14% YoY).

CRM.title: Salesforce Agentforce Surpasses $1B Annual Recurring Revenue; Faces Intensified Competition from ServiceNow Autonomous CRM
CRM.content: Salesforce Agentforce AI agent platform crossed $1B ARR milestone. ServiceNow directly challenged Salesforce's core market by launching Autonomous CRM. Enterprise AI competition intensifying. Salesforce's Q1 FY2027 revenue $9.83B with 15.7% net margin. CRM stock market cap ~$250B.

CRM.title: Salesforce Declares $0.44/Share Quarterly Dividend; Ex-Date June 11, Payable July 2; Agentforce ARR Surpasses $1B; Q2 FY2027 Guidance $11.27-11.35B
CRM.content: Salesforce declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.44/share, ex-date June 11, 2026, payable July 2. Agentforce AI agent platform has surpassed $1B annual recurring revenue; largest deal signed with CVS Health. Q2 FY2027 guidance $11.27-11.35B (+8-9% YoY). CRM Q1 FY2027 actual: revenue $11.13B (+13%), non-GAAP EPS $3.88.

CRM.title: Salesforce Named Official Tournament Supporter of FIFA World Cup 2026; Agentforce Powers Fan Engagement
CRM.content: Salesforce announced partnership as Official Tournament Supporter of the FIFA World Cup 2026 (North America & Europe), deploying Agentforce AI agents for fan engagement, ticketing, and sponsorship management — a major enterprise AI showcase. Agentforce has surpassed B annual recurring revenue. Q1 FY2027 results (reported May 27): revenue 1.1B (+13% incl. Informatica), EPS .88 +50%.

CRM.title: Salesforce Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Contentful for Headless CMS Capabilities
CRM.content: Salesforce signed a deal to acquire Contentful GmbH, a content platform used by 4,800+ brands, to strengthen its Headless 360 offering. Transaction expected to close between July 1 and September 30, 2027.

CRM.title: Salesforce Q1 FY2027 Record Non-GAAP EPS $3.88 (+50% YoY); Acquires m3ter for Consumption-Based Pricing
CRM.content: Salesforce reported record Q1 FY2027 non-GAAP EPS $3.88 (+50% YoY). Simultaneously announced acquisition of m3ter, a consumption-based metering platform, to integrate into Agentforce Revenue Management.

CRM.title: Salesforce Announces Third Round of 2026 Layoffs; 86 California Employees Affected
CRM.content: Salesforce filed California WARN Act notices for 86 layoffs on June 10, marking its third workforce reduction since September 2025 as the company shifts headcount toward AI-focused roles amid Agentforce transition.

CRM.title: Salesforce Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Fin (Formerly Intercom) for ~$3.6B
CRM.content: Salesforce announced acquisition of Fin (formerly Intercom), an AI-powered customer support agent company, for approximately $3.6B to accelerate the Agentforce offering.

CRM.title: Salesforce Announces $1 Billion Investment in Italy to Accelerate Agentic AI Transformation
CRM.content: Salesforce announced $1B investment in Italy over 5 years to drive AI innovation and support agentic AI adoption among Italian enterprises and government customers.

CRM.title: Salesforce Launches Summer '26 Release; Agentforce ARR Hits $800M (+169% YoY), AI Revenue $2.9B
CRM.content: Salesforce Summer '26 release features multi-agent orchestration, Slack-first workflows, real-time data activation. Agentforce ARR $800M (+169% YoY), combined AI revenue surpassed $2.9B. Shift to usage-based AI pricing.

CRM.title: Salesforce Summer 2026 Release: Multi-Agent Orchestration in Agentforce Goes Generally Available Across All Enterprise Functions
CRM.content: Salesforce's Summer 2026 release became fully available, headlined by Multi-Agent Orchestration in Agentforce — enabling AI agents to collaborate as unified teams handling complex end-to-end workflows. The release also introduced Agentic Advisor for financial services and a new Agentic Sales Package for mid-market clients.

CRM.title: Salesforce Launches Agentforce Help Agent with Pay-Per-Resolution Pricing at $2 Per Successfully Resolved Case
CRM.content: Salesforce launched Agentforce Help Agent, an autonomous AI service agent deployable in minutes across all channels. The product introduces pay-per-resolution pricing at $2 per successfully resolved case, with no charge if human escalation is requested. Already handled 4.3 million inquiries on help.salesforce.com, resolving 70% autonomously. GA slated for July 2026.

CRM.title: Guggenheim Upgrades Salesforce to Buy with $228 Price Target After 41% YTD Decline; AI Integration Not as Disruptive as Feared
CRM.content: Guggenheim upgraded Salesforce (CRM) to Buy from Neutral with a $228 PT, citing the stock's 41% YTD decline creating an attractive entry point. Analyst argues that AI model commoditization and Agentforce ARR hitting 00M (+169% YoY) demonstrate Salesforce's AI integration is additive rather than cannibalistic. CRM stock rose ~4% on the upgrade.

CRM.title: Salesforce Commits $1 Billion to Switzerland for Agentic AI Transformation and 6,000 New Jobs
CRM.content: Salesforce announced a $1 billion investment commitment in Switzerland to accelerate Agentic AI transformation, including expanded Swiss data center capacity and creation of 6,000 new AI-focused jobs. The announcement comes alongside Guggenheim's Buy upgrade and reflects Salesforce's accelerating international Agentforce expansion strategy.

CRM.title: Salesforce Agentforce ARR Hits $1.2B (+205% YoY); Combined Agentforce + Data 360 ARR Reaches $3.4B; Stock Down 37% YTD Despite Explosive AI Growth
CRM.content: Salesforce Agentforce ARR reached $1.2B (+205% YoY); combined with Data 360, AI ARR totals $3.4B (+200%); despite strong fundamentals, CRM down 37% YTD; analysts see significant value gap vs. peers.

CRM.title: Morgan Stanley Downgrades Salesforce to Equal Weight, Slashes Price Target 35% to $185 on Slow Agentforce Adoption
CRM.content: Morgan Stanley analyst Adam Wood downgraded Salesforce (CRM) from Overweight to Equal Weight on July 21, cutting price target from $287 to $185 (−35%). Firm cited Agentforce AI adoption not yet translating into cRPO acceleration, plus continued drag from legacy Commerce and Tableau products. CRM fell ~3.9% to $170.06. This is the third major downgrade in July. Agentforce still represents only ~7% of CRM revenue.

CRM.title: Morgan Stanley Downgrades Salesforce to Equal-Weight, Cuts Price Target 35% to $185
CRM.content: Morgan Stanley downgraded Salesforce from Overweight to Equal-Weight and cut its price target 35% from $287 to $185, citing insufficient evidence of organic growth recovery and continued drag from legacy products Commerce and Tableau. CRM shares fell 3.6% in premarket trading.

CRM.title: VA Awards Salesforce $1.6 Billion Agentic AI Contract for Veteran Care Modernization via Missionforce
CRM.content: The U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs awarded Salesforce a $1.6B three-year Agentic Enterprise License Agreement to deploy AI agents via Missionforce for veteran care coordination, benefits verification, triage automation, and 24/7 contact center services; shares rose approximately 1.5% on the announcement.

CRM.title: VA Awards Salesforce $1.6 Billion Agentic Enterprise License Agreement to Deploy AI Agents Across Veteran Healthcare and Benefits
CRM.content: The U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs awarded Salesforce a $1.6B three-year Agentic Enterprise License Agreement (AELA) to deploy Agentforce AI agents across VA healthcare and benefits services. Largest disclosed U.S. government AI agent deal to date. CRM stock gained 8.05% on July 27.

CRM.title: Salesforce Wins $1.6B VA Agentforce Contract; Stock Surges 8.05%
CRM.content: The VA awarded Salesforce a $1.6B 3-year Agentic Enterprise License Agreement to deploy Agentforce, Slack, MuleSoft, Tableau, and Data 360 across 170 medical centers serving 17M+ veterans. The deal targets cutting appointment scheduling from 28 days to minutes. CRM surged 8.05% on July 27 as investors treated it as major validation of Agentforce enterprise demand.

CRM.title: Salesforce Extends Post-VA Contract Rally With 4.51% Gain on July 28
CRM.content: CRM gained 4.51% on July 28, extending its 2-day rally to ~12.5% since the $1.6B VA contract announcement. Stock broke above its 20-day and 50-day moving averages. Analysts view the deal as reshaping Salesforce's government-cloud narrative.

CRM.title: Salesforce Wins $1.6B, 3-Year Agentforce Deal with U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs; Stock +4%
CRM.content: Salesforce secured a $1.6B, 3-year Agentic Enterprise License Agreement with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs to deploy Agentforce agentic AI alongside Slack, MuleSoft, Data 360, and Tableau. Drives CRM shares up ~4%. Agentforce ARR reached approximately $800M-$1.2B (+169-205% YoY) with 29,000 deals closed.
